*Ryne Gonzales,Ethan Liesdyanto,Rex Worley,Michael Frederick,Jaewon Kim,Eman Hammad*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出并实证评估了一种面向多节点ROS 2机器人车队的零信任分层网络安全框架，整合TPM 2.0硬件信任根、ELK Stack与Kismet的SIEM遥测监控，以及基于帧间延迟（IPD）时间水印的非密码学检测机制。在Wi-Fi移动测试平台上针对OSI Layer 2-5的多层攻击进行验证，结果表明体积过滤可隔离暴力拒绝服务洪泛，而对嵌入IPD水印的统计峰度（K）追踪能以零负载开销、完全检测精度暴露隐蔽的中间人命令注入攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主无人驾驶车辆在现代战术任务和公共安全行动（如搜救、灾难响应）中至关重要，但其依赖开放无线链路和标准ROS 2中间件，暴露了广泛的网络物理攻击面。系统一旦被攻破，可能扰乱实时控制回路，在高风险环境中导致任务失败或资产损失，亟需有效的安全防护框架。

Method: 提出一个分层、上下文感知的零信任网络安全框架，包含三大组件：1) 主动硬件信任根（TPM 2.0）；2) 带内与带外SIEM遥测监控（ELK Stack与Kismet）；3) 非密码学帧间延迟（IPD）时间水印机制。系统在实时ROS 2移动测试平台上进行实证评估，覆盖OSI Layer 2-5的多层攻击。

Result: 实验结果表明：基于流量的过滤方法能够有效隔离暴力拒绝服务（DoS）洪泛攻击；而通过统计追踪嵌入IPD水印的样本峰度（K），能够以完全检测精度暴露隐蔽的中间人命令注入攻击，且无需增加任何有效载荷开销。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，结合硬件信任根、SIEM遥测与IPD时序水印的统一分层框架，能够有效防御针对ROS 2机器人车队的多层网络攻击，其中基于统计峰度分析的IPD水印方法在检测隐蔽注入攻击方面表现尤为突出，且不产生额外负载开销，为该类系统的实战化安全部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Autonomous unmanned vehicles are vital to tactical missions, mission-critical public-safety operations like search and rescue and disaster response. However, their reliance on open wireless links and standard Robot Operating System (ROS 2) middleware exposes a broad cyber-physical attack surface. A compromise of these systems can disrupt real-time control loops, leading to mission failure or asset loss in high-stakes environments. This paper presents and empirically evaluates a layered, context-aware cybersecurity framework enforcing Zero-Trust principles for a multi-node robotic fleet over Wi-Fi. The framework integrates an active hardware root of trust (TPM 2.0), centralized in-band and out-of-band SIEM telemetry monitoring (ELK Stack and Kismet), and a non-cryptographic Inter-Packet Delay (IPD) timing watermark. Evaluated on a live ROS 2 mobile testbed under multi-layer exploits (OSI Layers 2-5), results demonstrate that while volume-based filters isolate brute denial-of-service floods, tracking the statistical sample kurtosis (K) of the embedded IPD watermark exposes stealthy Man-in-the-Middle command injections with complete detection accuracy without payload overheads.

</details>


### [239] [The consequences of high SMR operating costs in electricity markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08929)
*Pradyumna Rao,Daniel T. Kaffine,Bri-Mathias Hodge*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究了小型模块化反应堆（SMRs）在美国电力市场中的经济可行性，发现其运行和边际成本比投资成本对经济可行性更为关键。结果表明，SMRs在制造商广告成本基准下不经济，需要超出历史常态的价格和补贴才能吸引私人投资。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 美国电力市场对稳定发电（firm generation）的需求日益增长，核工业提出了小型模块化反应堆（SMRs）作为解决方案。然而，由于缺乏运营实例，这些概念在快速演变的电网中表现如何尚不清楚。现有文献受传统核电站成本大幅超支影响，主要关注SMRs实现私人投资可行性所需达到的投资成本，忽视了运行和边际成本的重要性。

Method: 采用灵活运营模型调度SMRs，考虑容量市场和批发能源市场两个主要电力市场的收入，分别在有和无政策支持的情景下进行分析。使用制造商广告的投资和运营成本，并根据制造商提供的设计参数计算燃料成本。

Result: SMRs不经济的主要原因是投资成本降低被增加的边际成本所抵消。当前SMRs的盈利能力与先进估计的AP1000传统核反应堆相当；若投资成本按核项目平均速率上涨，则与Vogtle 3和4相似。需要有超出历史常态的价格和补贴环境才能吸引私人投资。

Conclusion: 在未来的电力市场中，降低边际成本可能比降低投资成本带来更大的收益。政策制定者和行业应重视SMRs的运行和边际成本优化，而非仅关注投资成本削减。

Abstract: As US power markets contend with growing demand for firm generation, the nuclear industry has offered Small Modular Reactors (SMRs). However, how these concepts would fare in a rapidly evolving power grid is unclear, given the paucity of operational examples. Current literature, informed by substantial cost escalations for traditional nuclear plants, focuses on the investment costs SMRs need to achieve for private investment feasibility. However, this work finds that the operating and marginal costs of SMRs are more critical to economic feasibility in market environments. This work dispatches SMRs using a flexible operations model, considering revenue from two main electric markets, capacity and wholesale energy markets, with and without policy support. Manufacturer advertised costs for investment and operating costs are used, with fuel costs calculated from manufacturer provided design parameters. Results indicate that SMRs are uneconomical primarily because investment cost reductions are offset by increased marginal costs. As such, an environment of prices and subsidies beyond historic norms are necessary to attract private investment at manufacturer advertised cost benchmarks. Current SMRs are as profitable as advanced estimates of the AP1000 traditional nuclear reactor, and if investment costs escalate at the average rate for nuclear projects, they are similar to Vogtle 3 & 4. In projected future power markets, reductions in marginal cost may be more beneficial than those in investment costs.

</details>


### [240] [AgentHomeID - Agent-based modelling of building stock transformation: A multi-scale framework for policy assessment and infrastructure planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05763)
*Helen Ganal,Sarah Becker,Sascha Holzhauer,Thilo Glißmann,Friedrich Krebs,Martin Braun,Philipp Härtel*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了AgentHomeID，一个基于主体建模的建筑部门脱碳模型，在单栋建筑和业主层面显式表征业主行为、技术经济约束和监管框架，并在国家、区域和城市街区三个尺度上进行应用验证，揭示业主异质性和地方结构对转型路径的关键影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑部门脱碳对实现气候目标至关重要，但现有模型很少能捕捉系统级转型动态与异质个体投资决策之间的相互作用。传统自上而下模型无法反映不同业主类型的行为差异和空间异质性，导致政策评估和基础设施规划出现偏差。

Method: 构建AgentHomeID代理模型，显式区分自住业主、私人房东和机构业主三类主体，利用实证决策者研究估计的支付意愿（WTP）参数，可在代表性建筑原型和基于GIS的真实建筑数据上运行。模型分别在德国国家尺度（至2045年情景分析）、区域配电规划尺度（NUTS-3级热泵部署模拟）和城市街区尺度（变电站级负荷异质性）三个层面应用。

Result: 国家尺度上，移除强制性可再生供暖要求会显著提高终端能源需求；补贴分配和投资活动在业主类型和收入分位数间差异悬殊，最低收入群体持续投资不足。区域尺度上，热泵采用在空间上集中分布，与自顶向下聚合预测在规模和空间分布上均不同。街区尺度上，综合系统峰值（热泵、电动车、光伏叠加）与单一技术峰值不重合。

Conclusion: 三个尺度上的应用均表明，业主异质性和地方结构实质性塑造转型路径，应在用于政策评估和基础设施规划的模型中显式加以表征，而非仅依赖聚合模型。

Abstract: Decarbonising the building sector is central to meeting climate targets, yet existing models rarely capture the interaction between system-level transformation dynamics and heterogeneous individual investment decisions. This work presents AgentHomeID, an agent-based model of building stock evolution in which owner behaviour, techno-economic constraints, and regulatory frameworks are represented explicitly at the level of individual buildings and their owners. The model differentiates owner-occupiers, private landlords, and institutional owners, using willingness-to-pay (WTP) parameters estimated from empirical decision-maker studies, and operates on both representative building archetypes and real building data derived from geographic information systems (GIS). We demonstrate this versatility across three applications. At national scale, scenario analysis for Germany to 2045 shows that removing binding renewable heating requirements substantially raises final energy demand even where envelope refurbishment is unchanged, and that subsidy allocation and investment activity diverge sharply across owner types and income quartiles, with the lowest quartiles persistently underinvesting. At regional scale, bottom-up simulation for a German distribution grid planning region yields spatially concentrated heat pump uptake at NUTS-3 level that differs from aggregated top-down projections in both magnitude and spatial distribution. At urban block level, the same simulations resolve substation-level load heterogeneity and show that integrated system peaks driven by heat pumps, electric vehicles, and photovoltaics do not coincide with individual technology peaks. Across all three scales, owner heterogeneity and local structure materially shape transition pathways, indicating that they should be represented explicitly in models used for policy assessment and infrastructure planning.

</details>


### [241] [Bidirectional Wireless Communication for Weakly Coupled Implantable Brain-Computer Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05786)
*Shreyas Sen,Baibhab Chatterjee,Gourab Barik,Anirudh Roy*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文综述了植入式脑机接口（BCI）中双向无线链路的进展，涵盖感应、中场、射频、超声、磁电、光学、超宽带和电准静态等多种模态，并以临床相关的深度、尺寸和数据速率三个维度为基准进行对比分析。文章指出，在约10 mW通信预算和1°C组织升温限制下，窄带高Q链路适用于功率传输和低速数据，但无法满足千至百万通道接口所需的10 Mbps至数十Gbps上行速率，因此需要sub-10 pJ/b甚至sub-1 pJ/b的宽带技术（如UWB和脑信道通信BCC）。最后提出了跨电磁学、电路、封装、安全和监管的协同设计路线图，指向安全、网络化、百万通道的脑接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 植入式BCI从实验室原型走向临床慢性系统面临根本性瓶颈：深层（毫米至厘米）、大规模（千至百万电极）、严格的加热和尺寸限制使得几乎所有临床相关植入体都工作在弱耦合区（耦合系数10^-3到10^-1）。在这一区域，无线信道成为决定功率传输效率、通信带宽和每比特能量的限制因素，因此需要系统性地了解各无线模态的能力边界并指明发展方向。

Method: 本文采用综述与定量分析相结合的方法：对八种无线模态（感应、中场、射频、超声、磁电、光学、UWB、电准静态）进行双向无线链路进展的系统梳理，并沿临床轴（深度、尺寸、数据速率）进行基准对比；在此基础上以约10 mW通信预算（对应1°C升温上限）为约束进行能量效率核算，评估各模态在能效（pJ/b）和数据速率上的可达性，最后提出定量分析框架和跨领域协同设计路线图。

Result: 研究发现：在10 mW预算下，窄带高Q链路（如感应和中场）适合功率传输及低速数据，但其1-10 nJ/b的能效无法支撑千至百万通道接口要求的>10 Mbps至数十Gbps的上行速率，即使采用激进的植入端压缩也无法达成。相比之下，宽带技术（UWB和BCC）因具备sub-10 pJ/b乃至sub-1 pJ/b的潜力而被认为是满足大规模高数据率需求的关键方向。

Conclusion: 实现百万通道脑接口需要从窄带高Q链路转向超低能耗（sub-1 pJ/b）的宽带无线链路，并通过电磁学、电路、封装、安全和监管的跨学科协同设计（co-design），构建安全、网络化的深层大规模脑机接口系统。文章提供的定量框架和路线图为此提供了系统化的分析工具和发展指引。

Abstract: Implantable brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) promise transformative societal impact, from restoring lost motor, sensory, and speech function in patients with paralysis, stroke, sclerosis, and sensory deficits to serving as a high-bandwidth conduit between human cognition and machine intelligence. Realizing these visions requires moving from laboratory prototypes to chronic clinical systems that support thousands to millions of electrodes, several millimeters to centimeters deep beneath the brain surface, under strict heating and size limits. Almost every clinically relevant implant therefore operates in a weakly coupled regime, with coupling coefficients of $10^{-3}$ to $10^{-1}$ across centimetres of lossy tissue. In this regime, the wireless channel sets the limits of power-transfer efficiency, communication bandwidth, and energy per bit. We review the recent progress of bidirectional wireless links across inductive, mid-field, RF, ultrasonic, magnetoelectric, optical, UWB, and electro-quasistatic modalities, and benchmark them against the clinical axes of depth, size, and data rate. Within an approximately 10 mW communication budget set by the approximately $1^\circ$C tissue-heating ceiling, narrowband high-Q links are well suited for power transfer and low-speed data, but at 1-10 nJ/b cannot reach the greater than 10 Mbps to tens of Gbps uplinks that thousand- to million-channel interfaces demand, even with aggressive on-implant compression. This calls for sub-10 pJ/b and ultimately sub-1 pJ/b wireless links, where wideband techniques, such as ultra-wideband (UWB) and brain-channel communication (BCC), are suitable. We close with a quantitative framework for analyzing such wireless links and a co-design roadmap across electromagnetics, circuits, packaging, security, and regulation, toward secure, networked, million-channel brain interfaces.

</details>


### [242] [Multimodal Large Language Model-guided Constrained Optimization for RAN Intelligent Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06122)
*Hyeonho Noh*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出MLLM-coRIC，一种基于多模态大语言模型引导的约束优化框架，用于Open RAN中的联合资源与功率分配。该框架利用自然语言操作需求和射频网络上下文作为多模态输入，在Non-RT RIC端由MLLM进行长时间尺度推理设计数值控制损失，在Near-RT RIC端通过损失条件混合执行器快速生成无线动作，无需重新设计算法或重训练策略即可适应不同优化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于AI的RAN控制器通常针对预定义操作场景和优化任务设计，当网络条件或运营商需求在部署后发生变化时，其适应性受限，无法灵活应对动态变化的需求。

Method: 提出分层Open RAN框架MLLM-coRIC：(1) 在Non-RT RIC层，MLLM基于运营商自然语言需求、预测的网络演化和测量优化结果进行长时段推理，设计数值控制损失，并通过闭环过程迭代细化约束惩罚权重；(2) 在Near-RT RIC层，损失条件混合执行器将合成准则转化为快速无线动作，结合学习的分段约束资源分配与基于模型的干扰感知功率控制；(3) 融合CARLA城市移动性模拟器和Sionna RT光线追踪无线传播模拟器构建多小区验证环境。

Result: 通过整合CARLA与Sionna RT的多小区评估环境对所提框架进行了验证，能够处理不同优化问题而无需重新设计任务特定算法或重训练控制策略。

Conclusion: MLLM-coRIC通过多模态输入和层次化架构实现了需求自适应的RAN智能控制，使单一部署框架能够灵活应对运营商需求与网络条件的变化。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based radio access network (RAN) controllers are commonly designed for predefined operating scenarios and optimization tasks, limiting their adaptability when network conditions and operator requirements change after deployment. This paper proposes multimodal large language model (MLLM)-guided constrained optimization for RAN intelligent control (MLLM-coRIC), a requirement-adaptive hierarchical Open RAN (O-RAN) framework for joint resource and power allocation. MLLM-coRIC jointly exploits the operator's natural-language specification and radio-frequency (RF)-derived network context as multimodal inputs, enabling a single deployed framework to address different optimization problems without redesigning task-specific algorithms or retraining control policies. At the Non-Real-Time RAN Intelligent Controller (Non-RT RIC), the MLLM performs holistic, longer-timescale reasoning over the operator requirement, predicted network evolution, and measured optimization outcomes to design the numerical control loss. The relative constraint penalties are iteratively refined through a closed-loop process, allowing the optimization criterion to reflect both the intended network behavior and the expected operating context. At the Near-Real-Time RIC (Near-RT RIC), a loss-conditioned hybrid executor translates the synthesized criterion into fast radio actions by combining learned ramp-constrained resource allocation with model-based interference-aware power control. A multi-cell evaluation environment integrating the CARLA urban mobility simulator and the Sionna RT ray-tracing-based wireless propagation simulator is implemented for validation.

</details>


### [243] [Fixed-Time Integral Reinforcement Learning for Saturated Nonlinear Multi-Agent Systems Under FDI Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06163)
*Tien Dat Vu,Minh Doan*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究了受未知动力学、外部扰动和致动器通道上虚假数据注入攻击影响的非线性多智能体系统的领导者-跟随者编队控制问题。该问题被建模为零和微分博弈，并通过积分Bellman-Isaacs方法求解。通过引入非二次控制代价函数处理输入饱和约束，并提出了代价函数构建方法和评论家学习律，保证了系统的实用固定时间稳定性。仿真验证了该方法在外部扰动、FDI攻击和输入约束下的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性多智能体系统在存在未知动力学、外部扰动和假数据注入攻击时，编队控制面临巨大挑战。现有固定时间强化学习公式存在局限性，且输入饱和约束、安全性等问题尚未被充分考虑，需要一种既能对抗攻击又能满足实际约束的鲁棒控制方案。

Method: (1) 将编队控制问题建模为零和微分博弈，采用积分Bellman-Isaacs方法求解；(2) 引入非二次控制代价函数以处理输入饱和约束，得到有界控制律；(3) 提出代价函数构造方法并设计评论家学习律，实现实用固定时间稳定性；(4) 通过严格的数学证明保证评论家权重估计误差和编队跟踪误差收敛到有界残差集。

Result: 严格证明了评论家权重估计误差和领导者参考的编队跟踪误差在实用固定时间内收敛到有界残差集；仿真结果验证了所提方法在外部扰动、FDI攻击和输入约束条件下具有良好的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文所提出的基于积分Bellman-Isaacs方法、结合固定时间评论家学习与非二次代价函数的控制方案，能够在未知动力学、外部扰动、FDI攻击及输入饱和等多重不利条件下实现多智能体系统的稳定编队控制，克服了现有固定时间强化学习方法的局限性，具有良好的理论保证和实际应用价值。

Abstract: The leader-follower formation control problem is investigated for nonlinear multi-agent systems with unknown dynamics, external disturbances, and false data injection (FDI) attacks on actuator channels. The problem is formulated as a zero-sum differential game and solved using the Integral Bellman-Isaacs approach. To address input saturation constraints, a non-quadratic control cost function is incorporated into the optimization problem, leading to a bounded control law. Furthermore, this paper proposes a cost function construction method and develops a critic learning law, which together guarantee the practical fixed-time stability of the system while overcoming the limitations of existing fixed-time reinforcement learning formulations. Finally, the practical fixed-time convergence of both the critic weight estimation error and the leader-referenced formation tracking error to bounded residual sets is rigorously proven. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method under external disturbances, FDI attacks, and input constraints.

</details>


### [244] [Non-parametric Formal Synthesis of Unknown Stochastic Systems: Asymptotic Convergence Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06206)
*Zhi Zhang,Sadegh Soudjani*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究一类基于非参数估计的数据驱动形式验证方法，能够在未知模型的情况下，仅通过观测样本对离散时间随机动力系统进行时序逻辑规范的形式验证，并提供概率性保证。作者先考虑马尔可夫决策过程(MDP)形式的有限抽象，利用Bernstein不等式和统计性质推导转移概率估计的渐近收敛保证，然后提出估计随机系统Lipschitz常数渐近上界的理论结果，最后证明转移概率和LC的收敛率均为O(n^{-1/(3+d)})，并整合这些结果保证形式验证和政策综合的渐近可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在安全关键系统中，系统模型往往未知或过于复杂，传统的基于模型的形式验证方法难以适用。因此需要能够仅从观测数据中学习系统表征并进行形式验证的数据驱动方法，同时提供严格的理论保证。

Method: 1) 用MDP作为系统的有限抽象表示；2) 利用Bernstein不等式和非参数估计器的统计性质，推导抽象MDP转移概率与其估计之间的渐近收敛保证；3) 提出估计随机系统Lipschitz常数渐近上界的理论方法以确定有限抽象的大小；4) 在适当假设下证明转移概率和LC的估计收敛率为O(n^{-1/(3+d)})；5) 整合结果以根据数据集规模保证原始系统与其有限抽象之间形式验证和政策综合的渐近一致性。

Result: 在适当假设下，转移概率和LC估计的渐近收敛率均为O(n^{-1/(3+d)})，其中d为系统维度，n为数据规模。通过整合理论结果，可以基于数据集大小保证形式验证与政策综合的渐近可靠性。多个案例研究验证了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种仅需观测样本、无需模型知识即可对离散时间随机动力系统进行形式验证的数据驱动方法，具有严格的理论收敛保证和概率性满意度保证，并通过多个案例验证了实际有效性。该方法在安全关键领域的数据驱动验证中展现出了广阔的应用前景。

Abstract: Data-driven techniques have shown promising potential for checking behavior of complex systems operating in safety-critical domains against safety and other temporal requirements. This paper studies a class of data-driven techniques that are based on learning a representation of the system from data using non-parametric estimation. The proposed approach is able to formally verify discrete-time stochastic dynamical systems against temporal logic specifications only using observation samples and without the knowledge of the model, and provides a probabilistic guarantee on the satisfaction of the specification. We first consider finite abstract representations of the system in the form of Markov decision processes (MDPs) and derive asymptotic convergence guarantees between the transition probabilities of the abstract MDP and their estimation using Bernstein's inequality and statistical properties of non-parametric estimators. We then propose theoretical results for estimating the asymptotic upper bound of the \emph{Lipschitz constant} (LC) of the stochastic system, which can determine the size of the finite abstract MDP for a given precision error. Under appropriate assumptions, our results prove that the asymptotic convergence rate of the estimations is $O(n^{-1/(3+d)})$ for both the transition probabilities and the LC, where $\mathsf d$ is the dimension of the system and $n$ is the data scale. By integrating these results, we can guarantee the asymptotic closeness in formal verification and policy synthesis performed on the original system and its finite abstraction based on the size of the dataset. Multiple case studies are presented to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

</details>


### [245] [Rethinking Safety for Generalist Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06326)
*Rohan Sinha,Anushri Dixit,Ran Tian,Anirudha Majumdar,Andrea Bajcsy*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出"具身AI安全"（embodied AI safety）的新范式，认为通用机器人的安全性不能仅局限于传统机器人学中的碰撞和力学安全，而必须扩展到情境感知、用户意图、难以建模的物理后果等更广泛的危险类别，并提出了新兴风险的分类体系和全栈研究议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用机器人有望改变社会，但其多功能性带来了远超传统碰撞/力学安全范畴的风险。安全考量必须包含情境（如断电只有在计划维护时才安全）、用户意图（清洁厨房隐含不能混用漂白剂和氨水等危险清洁剂的期望）、难以建模的物理后果（如烹饪时烧焦食物）等维度。现有安全框架无法应对这些新挑战。

Method: 本文并非提出具体算法，而是提出概念框架：1）论证"具身AI安全"的新时代需求，将机器人生命周期中考虑的危险范围拓宽；2）强调"比特的安全"（软件/AI层面）与"原子的安全"（物理层面）不可分离；3）提出新兴风险的分类体系（taxonomy）；4）提出全栈（full-stack）研究议程以指导通用机器人的安全部署。

Result: 本文提出了一种新的安全范式——具身AI安全——并建立了新兴风险的分类体系，同时勾勒出覆盖全栈的研究议程，用于指导通用机器人的安全部署。该框架超越了传统机器人安全关注的碰撞和力学范畴，整合了情境、意图和物理后果等多维风险。

Conclusion: 通用机器人的安全需要进入"具身AI安全"的新时代，必须将数字层面的安全与物理层面的安全统一考量，并系统性地拓宽风险定义与研究范围，方能实现对这类系统的安全部署与信任。

Abstract: Generalist robots promise to transform our society: the same system that prepares a meal or folds laundry might also repair a car, inspect infrastructure, or care for a loved one. Yet this versatility introduces risks far beyond the collision- and force-based safety notions that have long dominated robotics. Notions of safety must now consider context (e.g., turning off a building's electricity is only safe during scheduled maintenance), user intent (e.g., asking the robot to ``clean the kitchen'' includes unspoken expectations that the robot should not mix dangerous but powerful cleaning agents like bleach and ammonia), hard-to-model physical consequences (e.g., burning food during meal preparation), and more. We argue the need for a new era of robot safety---embodied AI safety---that broadens the hazards considered across the robot's lifecycle while recognizing that the safety of bits cannot be separated from the safety of atoms. We present a taxonomy of emerging risks and a full-stack research agenda to guide the safe deployment of generalist robots.

</details>


### [246] [A Theory of Information Architecture for Networked Decisions: Freshness, Locality, and Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06351)
*Scott Moeller,Bhaskar Krishnamachari*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究了网络化系统中信息范围与信息新鲜度之间的权衡：更广的视角支持更好的协调但信息到达更晚。作者分析了团队代理在重复决策中关于信息架构的设计，证明在指数相关的环境下，本地新鲜信息与完整延迟信息的比较可简化为阈值，并推导出最优邻域半径由空间相关、决策相关和时间传播长度共同决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络化系统中存在一个基本矛盾：决策需要的信息范围越广，收集和传播这些信息所需时间越长，导致信息到达时已经过时。这一范围-新鲜度权衡对于多智能体协调系统的设计至关重要，但此前缺乏系统的理论研究。

Method: 作者建立了一个团队决策框架，其中多个智能体重复选择行动以最小化共享的二次代价，环境独立演化。信息架构指定每个智能体观察什么、从何处观察以及延迟多久。通过比较（1）新鲜局部观察与完整但延迟的全局视图，以及（2）时间对齐但较旧的更广邻域快照的时间对齐中间架构来刻画该权衡。

Result: 在环境各分量以共同指数速率去相关的条件下，新鲜局部信息与延迟全局信息之间的比较简化为一个关于延迟与相干时间之比的闭式阈值。对于中间架构，最优邻域半径出现在增加范围的边际价值等于丢失新鲜度的边际成本之处。在典型空间模型中，此半径由空间相关长度、决策相关长度和时间传播长度设定。且整个架构的性能由最优决策的可预测性而非原始状态的可预测性决定。

Conclusion: 系统架构的性能本质上取决于最优决策的可预测性（而非原始状态），这为设计权衡提供了统一视角。最优信息架构需要在信息范围带来的协调收益与信息陈旧带来的决策损失之间取得平衡，并通过解析阈值和特征长度给出了设计指导。

Abstract: Networked systems face a tradeoff between the scope of the information behind a decision and its freshness: a broader view of the system supports better coordination, but assembling and communicating it takes time, so it arrives older. We study this tradeoff for a team of agents that repeatedly choose actions to minimize a shared quadratic cost driven by an environment that evolves on its own, unaffected by the agents' actions. An information architecture specifies what each agent observes, from where, and with what delay; we measure an architecture by the cost it loses relative to a decision made with complete, current information. We first compare fresh local observations with a complete but delayed global view. When every component of the environment decorrelates at a common exponential rate, this comparison reduces to a closed-form threshold on the ratio of delay to coherence time. We then study intermediate architectures in which each agent acts on a time-aligned, and therefore older, snapshot of a wider neighborhood. The optimal neighborhood radius occurs where the marginal value of added scope equals the marginal cost of lost freshness. In a canonical spatial model, this radius is set by the spatial-correlation, decision-relevance, and temporal-propagation lengths. Throughout, architecture performance is governed by the predictability of the optimal decision rather than of the raw state.

</details>


### [247] [Dynamic System Emulation: Fixed Wing Dynamics on a Multicopter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06520)
*Abdelhakim Amer,Andriy Sarabakha*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种控制框架，使配备双轴云台的多旋翼飞行器能够模拟固定翼飞机的飞行动力学，为飞行员训练和自主控制研究提供一个操作简单且不受固定翼空气动力学约束（如最小空速和非完整约束）的平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定翼飞行器存在空气动力学约束（如最小空速和非完整约束），导致其训练和仿真平台操作复杂、成本高昂。需要一种能够模拟固定翼飞行动力学但操作更简单的替代平台。

Method: 使用动态反馈线性化推导两种平台（多旋翼+双轴云台与固定翼）之间的状态-输入映射，建立控制框架实现飞行动力学的模拟仿真。

Result: 在代表性固定翼机动动作上进行了评估，结果表明在标称条件下具有高保真的仿真效果。

Conclusion: 虽然评估在仿真环境中进行，但该方法为硬件部署铺平了实际道路，可应用于飞行员训练、自主研究及控制器基准测试。

Abstract: This work presents a control framework that enables a multicopter equipped with a two-axis gimbal to emulate the flight dynamics of a fixed-wing aircraft. The goal is to provide an operationally simple platform for training and simulation that avoids the aerodynamic constraints of fixed-wing vehicles, such as minimum airspeed and nonholonomic constraints. A state-input mapping between the two platforms is derived using dynamic feedback linearization. The framework is evaluated on representative fixed-wing manoeuvres. Results show high-fidelity emulation under nominal conditions. While evaluations are conducted in simulation, the approach establishes a practical path toward hardware deployment for pilot training, autonomy research, and controller benchmarking.

</details>


### [248] [Assessing Fixed-Batch Reporting for Deadline-constrained Inference in Intermittently Powered IoT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06585)
*Onel L. A. López*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对能量收集型物联网设备在"立即传输"与"批量积累后传输"之间的权衡问题，建立了一个统一的分析框架。该框架在重复、有截止期限的推理周期场景下，通过CRPS贝叶斯风险缩减来精确表达长期及时价值，并构建精确的马尔可夫奖励模型，综合考虑间歇性收集、有限存储、能量结转、不可靠传输、重传和截止期限等因素，证明了长期状态的良定义性并推导出批量大小比较与定时基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 能量收集型IoT设备面临一个基本权衡：每次观察立即传输可使边缘端更快获得信息，但消耗更多传输能量；而批量积累则节省报告次数但延迟信息并保留更多状态。现有研究缺乏一个统一框架来严格比较不同批量策略在长期、有截止期限的推理周期中的表现，特别是在考虑间歇性收集、能量限制和传输不可靠性等现实约束时。

Method: 作者构建了一个统一分析框架：1) 所有配置处理相同的有序观察并产生相同的最终后验，实现受控比较；2) 利用连续等级概率评分(CRPS)下的贝叶斯风险缩减，将长期及时价值精确表达为统计价值加权和与期望决策加权报告可用性的乘积，从而分离观察的推断价值与决策时点的可用性；3) 构建精确的马尔可夫奖励模型，联合建模间歇性收集、有限存储、能量结转、不可靠传输、重传和截止期限；4) 推导精确批量大小比较和定时基准，并将能量收集定律效应分解为周期内贡献与结转贡献。

Result: 作者证明了长期运行状态良定义的数学性质，并推导出精确的批量大小比较结果。通过可直接计算的高斯和高斯混合信念特化案例，发现最佳批量大小会随先验分布、决策时间剖面、链路可靠性、能量收集统计和积累成本的变化而改变，表明不存在一个普遍最优的固定批量配置。

Conclusion: 该框架为能量收集IoT设备的传输批量决策提供了严格的理论基础，揭示了批量选择与多种系统因素之间的复杂依赖关系，证明了最佳批量大小对系统参数高度敏感，为实际系统设计提供了指导性见解。

Abstract: Energy-harvesting Internet of Things (IoT) devices must decide whether to transmit each observation immediately or accumulate several observations before reporting to the edge. Early reports make information from initial observations available sooner at the edge but require more transmission actions, whereas larger batches save reports while delaying that information and retaining more state. We develop a unified analytical framework to compare this fixed-batching choice in scenarios with repeated, deadline-constrained inference cycles. Every configuration processes the same ordered observations and yields the same final posterior if all reports arrive, enabling a controlled comparison of the persistent state, actions, and energy costs induced by batching. Using reductions in Bayesian risk under the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS), we express long-run timely value exactly as a statistical-value-weighted sum of expected decision-weighted report availabilities. This separates the inferential value of observations from their availability at application-relevant decision times. We construct exact Markov-reward models accounting jointly for intermittent harvesting, finite storage, energy carry-over, unreliable delivery, retransmissions, and deadlines. We prove that the long-run regime is well defined and derive exact batch-size comparisons, timing benchmarks, and a decomposition of harvesting-law effects into within-cycle and carry-over contributions. Directly evaluable Gaussian and Gaussian-mixture belief specializations show that the preferred batch size can change with the prior, the decision-time profile, link reliability, harvested-energy statistics, and accumulation cost.

</details>


### [249] [A Control Philosophy for Multiplexed Power Converters in Active Distribution Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06621)
*Matthew Deakin,Mahmood Jamali,Nail Tosun,Shafiq Odhano*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于状态机的控制理念，用于管理可重构多路复用电力电子设备（M-PEDs）中互斥的选择器和电流控制信号，通过离线切换（Off-Load）和热插拔（Hot-Swap）两种控制方法实现该设备的有效运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: M-PEDs能为主动配电网提供更灵活有效的运行方式，缓解热约束和电压越限问题，但目前缺乏针对此类设备的运行控制方法，且其相对传统PEDs更为复杂，亟需提出相应的控制策略。

Method: 提出一种基于状态机的控制理念来管理M-PEDs中互斥的选择器信号和电流控制信号；基于该理念设计了两种控制方法：Off-Load（适用于无时间关键网络约束的系统）和Hot-Swap（适用于需最小化暂态影响的场景）。

Result: 通过背靠背电压源换流器拓扑的仿真，展示了状态机的演化过程，验证了所提出的控制理念能够有效管理M-PED运行的额外复杂性。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于状态机的控制理念使得M-PED的运行成为可能，同时有效管理了这种有前景的换流器拓扑所带来的额外复杂性。

Abstract: Reconfigurable, multiplexed power electronic devices (M-PEDs) can provide more effective, flexible operation for applications in active distribution networks, enabling the mitigation of thermal constraints and voltage violations. To-date, operational approaches of these M-PEDs have not been described, a significant issue as a result of their relative complexity as compared to conventional PEDs. This work proposes a state machine-based control philosophy that can be used to manage the mutually exclusive selector- and current-control signals for M-PEDs. Two control approaches are described using this philosophy: an Off-Load approach, suitable for systems without time-critical network constraints; and a Hot-Swap approach, implemented when the impact of transients must be minimized. Simulations illustrate the evolution of the state machine for a back-to-back voltage source converter topology. It is concluded that the proposed state machine-based control philosophy enables M-PED operation whilst managing the additional complexity of this promising converter topology.

</details>


### [250] [TD-STGT: A Spatio-Temporal Graph Transformer for Mobile Traffic Demand Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06636)
*Mohamad Alkadamani,Halim Yanikomeroglu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出TD-STGT（交通需求时空图Transformer），一种用于细粒度移动流量需求预测的图神经网络框架，结合众包移动测量和日间人口数据构建人口规模化的需求代理，在五个加拿大都市区域上实现最佳预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向5G和未来6G网络的长期规划（无线电升级、站点加密、回传扩展和频谱激活）需要细粒度的移动流量需求预测，但现有方法难以准确预测精细地理网格上的流量需求变化。

Method: 提出Traffic Demand Spatio-Temporal Graph Transformer (TD-STGT)框架，是一个图神经网络预测模型。利用众包移动测量和日间人口信息构建人口规模化的需求代理（population-scaled demand proxy），以预测跨精细地理网格的无线移动流量需求变化。

Result: 在加拿大五个都市区域的实验中，TD-STGT在网格级需求变化预测中取得最佳性能，ΔR²达到0.462，相对于最强基线将ΔRMSE降低了5.7%。

Conclusion: TD-STGT为识别需求压力增长区域和优先安排未来移动网络容量升级提供了实用工具。

Abstract: Fine-grained mobile traffic demand forecasting is essential for long-term planning of 5G and future 6G networks, including radio upgrades, site densification, backhaul expansion, and spectrum activation. This paper proposes the Traffic Demand Spatio-Temporal Graph Transformer (TD-STGT), a graph neural forecasting framework for predicting changes in wireless mobile traffic demand across fine geographic grids. The framework uses a population-scaled demand proxy developed from crowdsourced mobile measurements and daytime population information. Experiments across five Canadian metropolitan regions show that TD-STGT achieves the best performance in forecasting grid-level demand changes, reaching a $ΔR^2$ of 0.462 and reducing $Δ$RMSE by 5.7\% relative to the strongest baseline. The proposed model provides a practical tool for identifying areas with increasing demand pressure and prioritizing future mobile-network capacity upgrades.

</details>


### [251] [User-specified Kelvin-hour budgets within model predictive control for energy-efficient buildings: Simulation and field demonstration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06698)
*Jicheng Shi,Colin N. Jones*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种开尔文小时(Kh)预算MPC方法，允许用户在运行前指定温度边界违规严重程度的运行平均预算，并在运行中根据已实现的预算盈余或超支动态更新温度边界。该方法在BOPTEST模拟和实际住宅部署中均验证了其有效性，能在显著降低能耗的同时严格控制温度边界违规在用户设定的预算范围内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统软约束MPC通过调节松弛权重来平衡能耗与温度违规，但用户无法在运行前规定违规严重程度的预算。这导致实际应用中对温度边界违规的控制缺乏可预测性和用户可控性。

Method: 提出Kh-budget MPC框架：用户预设温度边界违规的运行平均预算（以Kh/步为单位），控制器在运行中实时监测已实现的Kh预算盈余或超支情况，并据此动态调整温度边界以实现预算的逐步反馈和满足。

Result: 在单区案例中，预设预算0.005 Kh/step时比默认控制器节能31.9%、Kh违规降低36.2%。在耦合双区案例中实现18.9%-20.5%节能和9.4%-64.3%的区域级Kh违规降低。在实际住宅部署中，运行平均Kh违规保持在或低于预设预算。

Conclusion: Kh-budget MPC提供了一种用户可预设、运行可反馈的温度违规预算控制机制，在不同场景（单区、双区、实际部署）中均能有效控制违规程度同时实现显著节能，是一种实用的建筑能源管理方案。

Abstract: For energy-efficient building control, model predictive control (MPC) has been widely proposed to reduce energy use while maintaining prescribed indoor temperature bounds. In practice, MPC implementations may still produce temperature-bound violations because of model mismatch, weather-forecast errors, and softened constraints introduced to preserve feasibility. Existing soft- constrained MPC usually handles this trade-off through slack-weight tuning, so users cannot prescribe a violation-severity budget before operation. This paper develops a Kelvin-hour (Kh)-budget MPC that allows users to specify a running-average budget for temperature-bound violation severity. During operation, the controller uses the realized Kh budget surplus or overspend to update the temperature bounds, providing step-by-step budget feedback. We evaluate the method in two high-fidelity BOPTEST simulation cases and in an occupied residential deployment. In the first one-zone case, prescribed budgets produce clear running-average Kh violation responses across predictors and disturbance settings. At a prescribed budget of 0.005 Kh/step, the controller reduces energy use by 31.9% and Kh violation by 36.2% relative to the built-in default controller. In the second coupled two-zone case, separate zone budgets produce zone-level responses, with 18.9%-20.5% energy reduction and 9.4%-64.3% zone-level Kh violation reduction. In the occupied residential deployment, the running-average Kh violations remain close to or below their prescribed budgets under real sensing, actuation, weather, and occupancy conditions.

</details>


### [252] [Local Energy Function-Based Power System Transient Stability Analysis with Grid Forming and Grid Following Inverters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06714)
*Yingyi Tang,Junbo Zhao,Baosen Zhang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对混合GFL-GFM逆变器系统的暂态稳定分析问题，提出了一种基于局部能量函数的解析评估方法，通过考虑系统耦合阻尼效应来量化暂态稳定裕度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着基于逆变器的资源（IBRs）广泛部署，GFL和GFM逆变器将长期共存，但混合系统的暂态稳定性仍是一个关键且研究不足的挑战。现有方法往往忽略或对逆变器耦合阻尼效应做出苛刻假设，难以准确评估系统暂态稳定。

Method: 首先推导混合GFL-GFM逆变器系统的暂态稳定分析模型以揭示动态交互机理；然后提出一个局部能量函数，通过对系统能量耗散性质成立区域进行局部界定，妥善处理GFL和GFM逆变器的耦合阻尼效应；基于该能量函数推导临界能量和稳定性指标用于快速定量评估。

Result: 在修改的IEEE 14节点系统中对混合GFL和GFM逆变器进行了验证，数值仿真结果表明所提方法有效且保守性较小；同时揭示了GFM逆变器阻尼不足对系统暂态稳定的不利影响。

Conclusion: 所提出的局部能量函数方法能够充分考虑GFL和GFM逆变器的综合阻尼效应，为混合逆变器系统提供快速、定量的暂态稳定评估工具，且具有良好的精确性。

Abstract: The widespread deployment of inverter-based resources (IBRs) is reshaping power system dynamics by their control strategies. Grid-following (GFL) and grid-forming (GFM) inverters are expected to co-exist from now on. However, ensuring the transient stability of such systems remains a critical and underexplored challenge. In this paper, a comprehensive transient stability analysis of the mixed-GFM-GFL inverter system is conducted using a newly derived local energy function. The transient stability analysis model of the system is first derived to reveal the dynamic interactions between GFL and GFM inverters during transient responses. A local energy function is then proposed for analytical transient stability assessment. Instead of ignoring or making harsh assumptions on inverters' coupled damping effect, the proposed local energy function carefully addresses its impact on system transient stability by locally bounding the region where the system's energy dissipation property holds. Such a property fully considers the combined damping effect of GFL and GFM inverters. The derived critical energy and stability index provide a fast and quantitative transient stability assessment. Furthermore, the adverse impact of insufficient damping of GFM inverters on system transient stability is thoroughly investigated. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated on the modified IEEE 14-bus system with mixed GFL and GFM inverters, and the numerical simulation results further demonstrate the small conservativeness of the proposed method.

</details>


### [253] [Moment Matching for Descriptor Systems: A Möbius Mapping Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06716)
*David Militaru,Denisa Jungheatu,Andrei Sperilă,Tudor C. Ionescu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对一类由正则或不正则传递函数描述的单输入单输出系统，提出了适用于连续时间和离散时间情形的矩匹配降阶方法。该技术比现有文献中的方法更灵活可靠，并且能够在降阶模型的极点和零点上施加约束，这一特性此前仅适用于连续时间状态空间系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的矩匹配降阶方法在灵活性和可靠性方面存在不足，且对降阶模型极点和零点施加约束的特性此前仅适用于连续时间状态空间系统，缺乏对传递函数描述系统及离散时间情形的支持。

Method: 针对正则或不正则传递函数描述的单输入单输出系统，提出了适用于连续时间和离散时间两种情境的矩匹配降阶程序，能够在降阶过程中对模型的极点和零点施加位置约束。

Result: 所提出的方法比现有文献中的其他程序更灵活可靠，并通过一个来自文献的实际数值示例验证了基于约束的降阶特性。

Conclusion: 该方法扩展了约束型矩匹配降阶的适用范围，使其从连续时间状态空间系统推广到传递函数描述系统，并同时覆盖连续时间和离散时间两种情境。

Abstract: For a class of single-input single-output systems described by proper or improper transfer functions, we propose moment-matching procedures applicable in both continuous- and discrete-time contexts. The resulting technique is not only more flexible and reliable than other procedures which are currently available in literature, but it also enables the placement of constraints on the reduced-order model's poles and zeros. This constraint-based feature, hitherto available only for continuous-time state-space systems, is illustrated via a numerical example based on a practical problem from literature.

</details>


### [254] [Reliability Value of Long-Duration Energy Storage against Extreme Events in High-Renewable Grids: A Full-Year AC-OPF Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06864)
*Jeongdong Kim,Jonggeol Na,Sungho Shin*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多时段交流最优潮流（AC-OPF）模型，用于评估长时储能（LDES）在高比例可再生能源电网中的可靠性价值。通过在200节点伊利诺伊合成输电网络上进行全年8760小时负荷削减最小化计算及N-1安全约束分析，发现LDES相比短时储能能更有效减少年负荷削减，并在线路故障期间维持电网可行运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长时储能（LDES）研究多依赖分区或线性化直流网络模型，未能充分分析全年大规模可再生能源、负荷及突发故障场景下的电网运行可行性，无法准确评估LDES在极端天气事件（Dunkelflaute）中的可靠性价值。

Method: 提出多时段交流最优潮流（AC-OPF）模型，完整刻画非线性网络物理特性；基于高斯copula模型（拟合2010-2025年历史风能和节点负荷数据）采样全年8760小时场景，进行年负荷削减最小化；并将模型扩展为多日安全约束AC-OPF以考虑N-1线路故障。

Result: 在200节点伊利诺伊合成网络上，50MW的BESS与LDES混合储能平均减少年负荷削减83.0%，而同等功率的短时BESS仅为68.5%。在N-1故障下，基线网络无可行解，而配备LDES的网络在所有情况下保持可行，故障期间仅需比无故障基线多5.5%发电量。

Conclusion: LDES在极端低可再生能源事件和线路故障期间具有显著的可靠性价值，可作为备用电源降低年负荷削减并保障系统安全运行，从而节约额外发电和输电容量投资成本。

Abstract: Long-duration energy storage (LDES) can mitigate prolonged renewable--load imbalances during Dunkelflaute events, but existing studies rely on zonal or linearized DC network models and inadequately analyze the operational feasibility of the grid across a wide range of full-year renewable, load, and contingency scenarios. To address this gap, this paper introduces a multi-period alternating-current optimal power flow (AC-OPF) formulation that captures the full nonlinear network physics and assesses the reliability value of LDES in high-renewable grids. To evaluate scarcity events spanning multiple days to weeks, full-year operation is modeled as an 8,760-h load-shedding minimization over scenarios sampled from a Gaussian copula model, fitted to 2010--2025 historical wind and bus-level load data, that represents both typical variability and tail events. On a synthetic 200-bus Illinois transmission network, a hybrid fleet of battery energy storage (BESS) and LDES with 50 MW total power reduces annual load shedding by 83.0% on average relative to the base network, versus 68.5% for short-duration BESS alone at equal power. To further account for unexpected line outages throughout the year, the formulation is extended to a multi-day security-constrained AC-OPF. Under N-1contingencies, no feasible operating solution is obtained for the base network, whereas the LDES-equipped network remains feasible in all considered cases, thereby saving the cost of additional generation and transmission capacity. During the contingency period, LDES acts as a backup power supply, requiring only 5.5% more generation on average than the no-contingency base case.

</details>


### [255] [A Data-Driven Koopman-Behavioral Distance for Nonlinear Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06875)
*Sarang Sutavani,Umesh Vaidya*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于非线性随机系统的Koopman行为距离度量方法，通过共同的可观测字典提升状态测量值，并利用Grassmannian距离比较主导提升行为子空间，无需显式识别Koopman算子，实现了坐标不变性和参数判别能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接从轨迹数据比较非线性动态系统仍然具有挑战性，因为有限时域轨迹表示通常依赖于坐标选择。现有的行为子空间方法主要针对线性系统，缺乏对非线性系统的通用距离度量。

Method: 利用共同的可观测字典将状态测量值提升到更高维空间，提取主导的提升行为子空间，然后通过Grassmannian距离比较这些子空间，从而避免显式的Koopman算子识别。该方法基于多rollout轨迹数据进行。

Result: 建立了坐标不变性，证明了在精确提升闭包条件下与最近提出的线性行为距离的联系，并验证了对近似闭包的鲁棒性。数值实验展示了坐标不变性和参数判别能力。

Conclusion: Koopman行为距离为非线性随机系统提供了一种有效的比较框架，克服了坐标依赖问题，无需系统识别即可进行系统间距离度量。

Abstract: Comparing nonlinear dynamical systems directly from trajectory data remains challenging because finite-horizon trajectory representations are generally coordinate dependent. Motivated by recent behavioral subspace approaches for linear systems, this paper introduces a Koopman-behavioral distance for nonlinear stochastic systems using multi-rollout trajectory data. State measurements are lifted through a common observable dictionary, and dominant lifted behavioral subspaces are compared using Grassmannian distances without explicit Koopman operator identification. We establish coordinate invariance, connection with recently proposed linear behavioral distances under exact lifted closure, and robustness to approximate closure. Numerical examples demonstrate coordinate invariance and parameter discrimination.

</details>


### [256] [Spectral Koopman-Hopf Formula for Reachability with Adversary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06878)
*Sarang Sutavani,Umesh Vaidya*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于谱Koopman-Hopf框架的非线性对抗系统可达性分析方法，通过将非线性漂移动力学提升到Koopman特征函数坐标中，将原本依赖于状态的Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs (HJI)方程转化为谱坐标中近似不依赖状态的优化问题，并利用最小二乘谱投影来近似变换后的控制与扰动方向，推导值函数和后向可达集的上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性对抗系统的后向可达集分析通常需要求解高维且依赖状态的HJI方程，这在计算上极其困难甚至不可行。作者希望通过Koopman算子理论将非线性动力学线性化地提升到谱坐标中，从而规避直接求解HJI方程的复杂性，实现对抗性可达性分析的高效近似。

Method: 1) 将非线性漂移动力学提升到Koopman特征函数坐标中；2) 将依赖状态的HJI方程转化为谱坐标中近似不依赖状态的优化问题；3) 使用最小二乘谱投影近似变换后的控制与扰动方向；4) 利用变换后Hamiltonian的上下界推导值函数和后向可达集的界；5) 采用基于路径积分的Galerkin框架计算Koopman特征函数，避免对特征函数PDE进行空间离散化。

Result: 数值实验表明，所提出的方法能够对非线性对抗系统的后向可达集进行可计算的近似，展示了该框架在实践中的可行性和有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作为非线性对抗系统的可达性分析提供了一种新的谱方法路径，通过Koopman-Hopf框架将难题转化为谱坐标中的可处理优化问题，在保证理论界的同时实现了计算可行性。

Abstract: This paper develops a spectral Koopman-Hopf framework for adversarial reachability analysis of nonlinear systems. By lifting the nonlinear drift dynamics into Koopman eigenfunction coordinates, the proposed approach transforms the original state-dependent Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs (HJI) equation into an approximate state-independent optimization problem in spectral coordinates. The transformed control and disturbance directions are approximated using least-squares spectral projections, and upper and lower bounds on the transformed Hamiltonian are used to derive corresponding bounds on the value function and backward reachable sets. Koopman eigenfunctions are computed using a path-integral-based Galerkin framework that avoids spatial discretization of the associated eigenfunction PDEs. Numerical examples demonstrate tractable approximation of backward reachable sets for nonlinear adversarial systems.

</details>


### [257] [Toward Autonomous GNSS Networking: Low-Complexity Onboard Routing and Topology-Routing Co-Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07056)
*Huan Yan,Rongqin Yang,Kanglian Zhao,Jinjun Zheng*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向GNSS星间链路网络时隙结构的路由与拓扑控制联合框架。利用每颗卫星在单个时隙内最多与一个调度对端通信的特性，该方法沿时隙序列反向传播未来投递信息，直接决定数据应存储还是转发，避免了大规模端到端路径搜索，并使得拓扑生成与路由计算可并行进行。在24小时、30颗卫星的北斗场景中，所提路由方法在性能上与Contact Graph Routing相当，而路由计算时间降低约1500倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）自主运行高度依赖星间链路，但星上路由面临两大挑战：一是GNSS星座拓扑频繁变化，二是星上计算资源有限，难以承担繁重的路由计算。现有方法在拓扑规划与路由计算之间存在割裂，缺乏能够同时兼顾两者的自主网络方案。

Method: 提出一种面向GNSS星间网络时隙结构的"路由-拓扑协同构建"框架。核心思想是：利用卫星在单个时隙内最多与一个被调度对端通信的特性，将未来投递信息沿时隙序列反向传播，借此直接判断每颗卫星当前应存储数据还是转发数据，从而规避大规模端到端路径搜索；同时将同样的投递信息引入拓扑构建环节，使链路调度能够直接反映端到端通信性能，实现拓扑生成与路由计算的并行推进。

Result: 在24小时、30颗卫星的北斗仿真场景下，所提路由方法达到与Contact Graph Routing相当的路由性能，但路由计算时间减少约1500倍。协同构建的拓扑进一步改善了全对全通信以及两种主站相关业务方向的性能，同时保持了较强的星间测距能力。

Conclusion: 该研究填补了自主拓扑规划与自主路由计算之间的关键空白，为未来GNSS更完整的星上自主组网提供了支撑，验证了拓扑与路由协同构建在提升实时性、降低计算开销方面的有效性。

Abstract: Inter-satellite links constitute a critical enabler for the autonomous operation of global navigation satellite systems (GNSSs).Nevertheless, onboard routing still poses substantial challenges, stemming from the frequent topology variations of GNSS constellations and the constraint of limited onboard computational resources for routing calculation. This paper develops a routing and topology-control framework tailored to the time-slotted structure of GNSS inter-satellite networks. By exploiting the fact that each satellite communicates with at most one scheduled peer in a slot, the proposed routing method propagates future delivery information backward over the slot sequence and directly determines whether data should be stored or forwarded. This structure avoids massive end-to-end path searches and enables topology generation and routing computation to proceed concurrently. The same delivery information is further introduced into topology construction so that link scheduling can directly account for end-to-end communication performance. A master-satellite autonomous orbit-determination scenario is used to demonstrate this topology--routing co-construction mechanism. In a 24-h, 30-satellite BeiDou scenario, the proposed routing method achieves routing performance comparable to Contact Graph Routing while reducing routing computation time by approximately 1500 times. The co-constructed topology further improves all-to-all communication and both master-related traffic directions while preserving strong inter-satellite ranging performance. These results fill a critical gap between autonomous topology planning and autonomous routing computation, supporting more complete onboard autonomous networking for future GNSSs.

</details>


### [258] [Observer-Based Robust Control for an Aerial Manipulator System under Unknown External Disturbances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07114)
*Mayank Pandey,Sneha Gajbhiye*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对无人机-机械臂（QRM）复合系统，提出了一种基于连续非线性扰动观测器的反馈控制方法。通过将系统动力学解耦为平移（锁定）子系统和姿态（形状空间）子系统，并采用扰动观测器消除跨系统耦合效应，实现了各子系统的独立控制，仿真验证了其实用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四旋翼本身具有不稳定性，飞行中机械臂（RM）的运动会产生扰动与机械耦合，可能危及整个QRM系统的稳定性。此外，第一个子系统中的恒定有界扰动会表现为第二个子系统中时变、状态相关的扰动，这构成了控制上的关键挑战。

Method: 以整体质心速度和系统姿态为约束建立动力学模型，将系统分解为锁定（整体平移）子系统和形状空间（驱动/整体旋转）子系统两个解耦子系统；在此基础上提出基于连续非线性扰动观测器的反馈控制律，用以独立控制各子系统并系统性消除交叉耦合效应。

Result: 通过多个模拟实际运行工况的仿真实验验证了所提出控制器的有效性，证实了其在现实场景中的可应用性。

Conclusion: 该控制方案能有效管理扰动与耦合效应，实现QRM系统的稳定控制与独立子系统操控，具有实际工程应用前景。

Abstract: This paper addresses the mathematical modeling and control of an aerial manipulator system comprising a quadrotor as the uncrewed aerial vehicle and a robotic arm as the manipulator. The dynamic model is established by identifying the overall center-of-mass velocity and the system's orientation as constraints, yielding a simplified, two-decoupled subsystems: a locked (overall translation) subsystem and a shape-space (actuation or overall rotation) subsystem, both subjected to external disturbances. Since the system is mechanically coupled, a critical challenge arises where constant bounded disturbances in the first subsystem manifest as time-varying, state-dependent disturbances in the second subsystem. Given that the quadrotor is inherently unstable, the movement of the robotic manipulator (RM) during flight can further jeopardize the stability of the entire QRM system if these disturbances and coupling effects are not effectively managed. To address this, we present a continuous nonlinear disturbance observer-based feedback control law, which enables the independent control of each subsystem while systematically eliminating cross-coupling effects. The efficacy of the proposed controller is validated through multiple simulations emulating practical operating conditions, thereby substantiating its real-world applicability and highlighting the core contributions of this work.

</details>


### [259] [A Continuous-Time Generalization of the LPV Fundamental Lemma](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07241)
*Philipp Schmitz,Chris Verhoek*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对连续时间线性参数变化（LPV）系统，将离散时间系统的LPV基本引理推广到一类连续时间LPV系统，实现了可直接从数据设计连续时间LPV控制器的数据驱动表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接数据驱动的控制器设计在工业界和学术界都极具吸引力，但现有研究主要集中于离散时间线性时不变系统。向连续时间非线性系统迈进的步骤高度非平凡，因此需要一个中间路线。

Method: 通过LPV系统作为非线性系统的代理框架，将离散时间系统的LPV基本引理推广到一类连续时间LPV系统，从而获得可用于设计连续时间LPV控制器的数据驱动表示。

Result: 成功实现了对一类连续时间LPV系统的数据驱动表示，使得这些表示可直接用于连续时间LPV控制器的设计。

Conclusion: 该工作为从数据直接设计连续时间LPV控制器搭建了理论桥梁，是从数据驱动控制向连续时间非线性系统拓展的重要中间步骤。

Abstract: Controller design for physical systems directly from data is of tremendous interest in both the industry and academia. However, the research on direct data-driven control has thus far mainly focused on discrete-time linear time-invariant systems. To make the highly non-trivial step to continuous-time nonlinear systems, this paper explores an intermediate route through the framework of linear parameter-varying (LPV) systems. LPV systems can be used as a convenient surrogate for nonlinear systems to achieve systematic analysis and controller design. In this work, we generalize the LPV Fundamental Lemma for discrete-time systems towards a class of continuous-time LPV systems, achieving data-driven representations that can be used to design continuous-time LPV controllers.

</details>


### [260] [Timescale-aware surrogate-assisted multi-objective optimization of battery cell design for energy density, fast charging, and degradation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07302)
*Qingbo Zhu,Changfu Zou,Yicun Huang,Chunqiu Xia,Torsten Wik*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 提出了一种时间尺度感知的代理辅助框架，用于电池电芯的多目标优化，联合优化能量密度、快充能力和循环退化三个指标，通过目标特定代理模型、Sobol分析和跨目标秩联合策略实现高效的Pareto优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电池电芯设计需要在能量密度、快充性能和退化之间取得平衡，但这些指标在不同时间尺度上演化，且联合优化成本高昂，缺乏系统的多目标优化框架。

Method: 1) 基于物理仿真生成1501种电芯设计、1427个质控样本，涵盖12个制造相关参数；2) 为目标特定代理模型支持全阶Sobol分析；3) 采用跨目标秩联合策略保留对至少一个目标有影响的变量；4) 进行进化Pareto优化；5) 用原始物理模型重新评估优化候选方案。

Result: 优化设计在三项指标上均优于参考电芯，其中最佳设计可减少SOH损失99.31%、提高体积能量密度12.49%、缩短充电时间28.73%，且各指标最优解来自不同设计。

Conclusion: 该框架使跨不同电化学时间尺度的Pareto探索在计算上可行，实现了电池电芯设计的系统性多目标优化。

Abstract: Battery cell design must balance energy density, fast charging, and degradation, yet these metrics evolve over different time scales and are costly to optimize jointly. We develop a timescale-aware surrogate-assisted framework that evaluates beginning-of-life volumetric energy density and 10--80% charging time together with state-of-health (SOH) loss over 200 cycles. Physics-based simulations of 1501 cell designs generate 1427 quality-controlled samples across 12 manufacturing-relevant parameters. Objective-specific surrogates support total-order Sobol analysis, which reveals distinct parameter rankings across the three metrics. A cross-objective rank-union strategy then retains variables influential to at least one objective before evolutionary Pareto optimization. Re-evaluation of the optimized candidates using the original physics-based models confirms designs that outperform the reference cell in all three metrics. Among these jointly improving candidates, the objective-wise best solutions, attained by different designs, can reduce SOH loss by 99.31%, increase volumetric energy density by 12.49%, and shorten charging time by 28.73%. The framework makes Pareto exploration across disparate electrochemical timescales computationally tractable, thereby enabling systematic multi-objective optimization of battery cell design.

</details>


### [261] [Decentralised Plug-and-Play Stability Conditions for AC Grids-Part I](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07315)
*Liam Hallinan,Ioannis Lestas*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于频域条件的两部分去中心化小信号稳定性评估框架，通过在局部子系统上施加频域条件（许多具有图形化解释）来共同保证整个电网的稳定性，适用于高比例可再生能源接入的逆变器主导电网。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着可再生能源在交流电网中的渗透率不断提高，传统依赖集中式、全系统模型的小信号稳定性评估方法不再适用。需要一种不依赖系统级集中模型的去中心化稳定性评估框架，以支持plug-and-play功能。

Method: 该框架在局部子系统上施加频域条件，这些条件共同隐含整个电网的稳定性。框架具备多项灵活性：调节条件的额外自由度、跨频率范围混合条件的能力、对耦合母线与连接线路及负载的扩展子系统施加条件、以及处理不稳定子系统的方法。采用阻抗、导纳和功率流模型在频域中容纳详细的异构设备和线路模型。Part I关注稳定的阻抗和导纳表示，Part II将结果扩展到不稳定子系统。

Result: 该框架推广了众多此前报道的结果，并在修改后的9母线案例研究中得到验证，展示了该方法在降低保守性和显著性方面的优势。

Conclusion: 该去中心化频域稳定性框架适合作为电网规范的基础，可在逆变器主导电网中实现plug-and-play功能，并能够容纳实际电网模型中普遍存在的不稳定子系统。

Abstract: The rise of renewable generation in AC power systems calls for small-signal stability assessment methods that do not rely on centralised, system-wide models. In this two-part paper, we present a decentralised stability framework based on frequency-domain conditions imposed on local subsystems (many admitting equivalent graphical interpretations) which collectively imply the stability of the entire grid. The framework generalises many previously reported results, with added flexibility and plug-and-play compatibility provided by the additional degrees of freedom of the imposed conditions, the ability to mix conditions across frequency ranges, conditions on extended subsystems that couple buses to their connecting lines and loads, and a method to incorporate unstable subsystems. Detailed, heterogeneous device and line models are accommodated in the frequency domain using impedance, admittance, and power-flow models, making the framework suitable as a foundation for grid codes that enable plug-and-play functionality in inverter-dominated grids. Part I focuses on stable impedance and admittance representations and Part II extends the results to unstable subsystems, which are shown to be fundamentally present in many grid models. The results of Part I are validated on a modified 9-bus case study, demonstrating the reduced conservatism and significance of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [262] [Decentralised Plug-and-Play Stability Conditions for AC Grids-Part II: Unstable Subsystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07331)
*Liam Hallinan,Ioannis Lestas*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文是系列论文的第二部分，将基于频域二次约束的分散式小信号稳定性认证框架从稳定子系统扩展到包含不稳定子系统的更广电网网络。通过定义混合表示（低频为PQ模型、高频为IV模型），推导出即插即用兼容的稳定性条件，并在Kundur双区域系统上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多实际电网场景中，即使聚合系统稳定且表现良好，也可能包含不稳定子系统。这些子系统必须通过闭环网络互联来稳定，这使得分散式稳定性分析变得复杂，需要扩展原有框架以处理此类情况。

Method: 定义一种稳定的混合表示，在低频类似于功率(PQ)模型、在高频类似于阻抗(IV)模型，从而可将第一部分的稳定性框架应用于此表示。进一步分析低频下返回比的奈奎斯特特征轨迹沿经典P-δ/Q-V分离解耦为无界和有界分支，并为每个分支提供充分稳定性条件。

Result: 在Kundur双区域系统上验证了所提方法，成功认证了系统稳定性，并提供了覆盖电磁交互频率范围的分散式、即插即用兼容电网规范。

Conclusion: 所提出的混合表示和分支稳定性条件能够处理包含不稳定子系统的电网，实现分散式即插即用稳定性认证，弥补了第一部分框架的局限性。

Abstract: Part I of this paper presented a decentralised framework for certifying small-signal stability in AC grids using frequency-domain quadratic constraints on individual grid subsystems. Part II extends the framework to a broader class of networks that contain unstable subsystems. In particular, we show that such unstable subsystems arise in many common scenarios, even when the aggregate system is stable and well behaved. Such subsystems must be stabilised by the closed-loop network interconnection, which complicates decentralised stability analysis. A stable hybrid representation resembling the power (PQ) model at low frequencies and the impedance (IV) model at high frequencies is then defined, to which the stability framework of Part I can be applied, allowing plug-and-play compatible conditions to be formulated. Furthermore, we show that at low frequencies, the characteristic loci in the Nyquist plot of the return ratio in this hybrid representation decouple into unbounded and bounded branches along the classical $P$-$δ$ / $Q$-$V$ separation, and give sufficient conditions on each branch for ensuring system stability. The results are validated on the Kundur two-area system, where stability is certified, with a decentralised, plug-and-play compatible grid code covering the frequency ranges in which electromagnetic interactions arise.

</details>


### [263] [Stochastic Model Predictive Control under AC Power-Flow Constraints Using Generative Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07433)
*Jie Zhu,Yinliang Xu,Guan Wang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种端到端生成式框架（CSNG），用于高效求解具有非线性交流潮流约束的多周期多场景随机模型预测控制（SMPC）问题。通过条件随机神经生成器生成多个候选调度轨迹并从中选择可行且经济的解，配合可行性感知的自监督分布塑形方案和约束感知的可微分架构，在IEEE 14/118节点系统中实现了100%可行性、低于2%的最优性差距，并具备适合日内调度的计算效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统确定性神经代理依赖单次预测，难以保证同时满足所有场景和时间段的非线性约束，导致可行调度轨迹难以获得。需要一种能够生成多个候选解并在其中选择可行解的方法来克服这一限制。

Method: 1) 提出条件随机神经生成器（CSNG），为每个不确定性实例生成多个候选调度轨迹，通过候选选择恢复可行且经济的解；2) 引入可行性感知的自监督分布塑形方案，提升约束满足率、候选多样性和经济性，避免候选坍缩，且无需昂贵的SMPC标签；3) 设计约束感知的可微分架构：投影机制精确执行箱式约束和爬坡约束，同时保留活动边界附近的梯度信息；采用可微等式补全代理实现高效交流潮流重构。

Result: 在IEEE 14节点和118节点系统上的案例研究显示：100%可行性、最优性差距低于2%，计算效率适合日内调度场景。

Conclusion: 该生成式框架有效解决了多场景多周期SMPC问题中单次预测难以保证可行性的难题，通过多候选生成与选择机制实现了可行性与经济性的平衡，且无需昂贵的SMPC求解标签，代码已开源。

Abstract: This paper proposes an end-to-end generative framework for efficiently solving multi-period and multi-scenario stochastic model predictive control (SMPC) problems under nonlinear AC power-flow constraints. Conventional deterministic neural surrogates rely on a single-shot prediction, which makes reliable feasibility difficult to achieve because one dispatch trajectory must simultaneously satisfy nonlinear constraints across all scenarios and time periods. To address this limitation, a conditional stochastic neural generator (CSNG) is developed to produce multiple candidate dispatch trajectories for each uncertainty instance, enabling the recovery of a feasible and economical solution through candidate selection. A feasibility-aware self-supervised distribution-shaping scheme is further introduced to promote constraint satisfaction, candidate diversity, and operating economy without requiring computationally expensive SMPC solution labels, while mitigating candidate collapse in generative ACOPF learning. To support efficient end-to-end training, a constraint-aware differentiable architecture is introduced. It employs a projection mechanism to exactly enforce box and ramping constraints while preserving informative gradients near active bounds, together with a differentiable equality-completion surrogate for efficient AC power-flow reconstruction. Case studies on the IEEE 14- and 118-bus systems demonstrate $100\%$ feasibility, optimality gaps below $2\%$, and computational efficiency suitable for intraday dispatch. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/JieZhu6/Generative_SMPC.

</details>


### [264] [Noninvasive Anisotropic Identification of Magnetic Properties in Toroidal Shaped Magnetic Steel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07476)
*Xusen Qin,Reza Zeinali,Mitrofan Curt*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无模型逆方法，用于从边界测量数据中识别软磁材料的非线性各向异性磁本构特性（B-H关系）。通过谐波近似独立重建内部磁场B和磁场强度H，避开预设参数化B-H映射函数的限制，再沿选定采集线进行空间平均恢复主方向的B-H特性。数值实验表明，无扰动数据下重建精度高，10%高斯噪声下总体平均误差低于5%，为非线性各向异性磁本构特性的非侵入式识别提供了简单高效的计算框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的非线性各向异性磁本构特性识别方法通常依赖预定义的参数化B-H映射函数，这限制了其适用性和灵活性。需要一种无需预设函数形式的无模型方法，直接从边界测量数据中恢复材料内部的磁特性。

Method: 采用谐波近似（harmonic approximation）从边界测量数据中独立重建内部磁通密度B和磁场强度H，避免了预设参数化B-H映射函数的局限性。随后将重建的场沿选定的采集线进行空间平均，以恢复主方向的B-H特性曲线。

Result: 数值实验显示：对于无扰动数据具有高重建精度；对边界测量的高斯扰动具有良好的鲁棒性，在10%噪声水平下总体平均误差保持在5%以下。

Conclusion: 在谐波场假设下，基于场的重建方法为非线性各向异性磁本构特性的非侵入式识别提供了一种简单且计算高效的框架。

Abstract: This research proposes a model-free inverse approach for identifying the nonlinear anisotropic single-valued magnetic constitutive characteristics of soft magnetic materials from boundary measurements. Using the harmonic approximation, the internal magnetic flux density B and magnetic field strength H are independently reconstructed from the measured boundary data, thus avoiding the limitation of using a predefined parametric B--H mapping function. Subsequently, the reconstructed fields are spatially averaged along selected collection lines to recover the B--H characteristics of the principal directions. Numerical results demonstrate high reconstruction accuracy for unperturbed data and good robustness against Gaussian perturbations of the boundary measurements, with the overall mean error remaining below 5% for a 10% noise level. These results indicate that under the harmonic-field assumptions, the field-based reconstruction provides a simple and computationally efficient framework for non-invasive identification of nonlinear anisotropic magnetic constitutive characteristics.

</details>


### [265] [Decentralized Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Predictive Shielding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07618)
*Yacine El Yamani,Hanna Krasowski,Elena Vanneaux*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种分散式框架，将预测性安全盾与基于模型的有限时域Q学习相结合，使多智能体系统在部署时能够安全适应状态偏移，并引入无通信协议解决对称场景中的活锁问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人系统中，部署状态与训练数据存在偏移会导致策略性能下降和安全性受损。现有安全盾方法通常是反应式的（在接近未见障碍物时性能下降）和集中式的（可扩展性差），无法有效解决这些问题。

Method: 提出分散式框架，结合预测性屏蔽（predictive shielding）与基于模型的有限时域Q学习（model-based finite horizon Q-learning），使智能体在部署期间安全适应预训练策略；同时引入无通信的冲突解决协议以缓解对称场景中的活锁（livelock）现象。

Result: 该框架能够在状态偏移下保持策略安全性与性能表现，并在对称场景中有效避免活锁，且具备分散式架构带来的良好可扩展性。

Conclusion: 通过预测性而非反应式地处理部署状态偏移，并结合分散式设计与无通信冲突消解机制，该框架为多智能体系统的安全在线自适应提供了一种兼具安全性和可扩展性的解决方案。

Abstract: Environments are increasingly populated by multiple robots performing independent tasks with limited prior knowledge of each other. Deploying such multi-agent systems presents significant challenges. Specifically, shifts in deployment states compared to training data can lead to poor policy performance and compromised safety. While safety shields exist to mitigate these risks, they are typically reactive, which degrades performance near unseen obstacles,and centralized, limiting their scalability. To address this, we propose a decentralized framework that integrates predictive shielding with model-based finite horizon Q-learning. This approach allows agents to safely adapt their pre-trained policies during deployment. Furthermore, to mitigate livelocks in symmetric scenarios, we introduce a communication- free protocol for conflict resolution

</details>


### [266] [Data-driven estimation of design heating loads for HVAC equipment sizing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07619)
*Alex H. Lee,Elias N. Pergantis,Kevin J. Kircher*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文开发了两种基于数据的供暖设计负荷估算方法（一种利用智能恒温器数据，另一种利用电费账单），用于改善供暖设备选型过大的问题。在74栋美国单户住宅（覆盖5个气候区）的测试中，两种方法均表现出良好的拟合度且彼此一致。研究发现现有供暖设备平均比方法估算值大2.75-2.96倍，行业标准Manual J估算也偏大约2.26-2.35倍，表明设备选型普遍存在过度设计现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过大的供暖和制冷设备会增加前期成本、能源消耗、污染物排放，并对电力基础设施造成压力。需要更精确的设计负荷估算方法来改进设备选型，避免过度设计带来的资源浪费。

Method: 开发了两种数据驱动的供暖负荷估算方法：一种基于智能恒温器时间序列数据，另一种基于月度电费账单。在74栋位于美国5个气候区的独栋住宅上进行测试，数据集包含智能恒温器数据、月度账单、天气数据和行业标准Manual J设计负荷计算。

Result: 两种方法均有良好的拟合统计量且相互之间具有较好一致性。74栋住宅的平均结果显示：现有供暖设备比恒温器法估算值大2.75倍（1.34-6.52），比账单法估算值大2.96倍（1.36-7.76）；Manual J估算比恒温器法大2.26倍（0.87-5.21），比账单法大2.35倍（1.02-5.28）。

Conclusion: 研究证实了住宅供暖设备普遍存在选型过大的问题，并展示了利用智能化表计数据进行负荷估算的可行性与潜力。作者探讨了将这些数据驱动方法规模化实施的展望，以及将其纳入行业标准的可能性。

Abstract: Oversized heating and cooling equipment can unnecessarily increase up-front costs, energy costs, pollutant emissions, and strain on electrical infrastructure. This paper develops two data-driven methods for estimating heating loads at design conditions to improve equipment sizing. One method uses smart thermostat data; the other uses utility bills. We test the methods on a dataset that we gathered from 74 detached single-family houses in five United States climate zones. The dataset includes smart thermostat time-series data, monthly utility bills, weather data, existing equipment specifications, and Manual J design load calculations (the United States industry standard) purchased from practitioners. The two methods have strong goodness-of-fit statistics individually and show fair agreement with each other. On average over the 74 houses, existing heating equipment is 2.75 (2.5th to 97.5th empirical percentile: 1.34-6.52) times larger than the thermostat-method estimate and 2.96 (1.36-7.76 times larger than the bill-method estimate. As implemented by practitioners, the Manual J estimate is 2.26 (0.87-5.21) times larger on average than the thermostat-method estimate and 2.35 (1.02-5.28) times larger than the bill-method estimate. We discuss prospects for implementing the data-driven methods at scale and for incorporating data-driven sizing into industry standards.

</details>


### [267] [A unified power-grid representation for reuse across network structures and computational tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07650)
*Yanhao Huang,Changqing Liu,Zichang Wang,Qianhong Wu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一电网表示方法，将物理电网描述与下游计算分离。通过自监督编码器将电网表示为可变数量但维度固定的节点、支路和全局向量。预训练仅使用至多270母线系统，冻结编码器可零适配迁移到70,000母线电网（规模扩大250倍以上），并支持电力潮流计算、无功调整、运行工况生成和暂态稳定评估四种下游任务，均取得良好性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据驱动的电力系统模型通常针对特定电网和计算任务开发，当网络结构或分析目标变化时性能会显著下降甚至失效。缺乏能够跨不同电网结构和异构计算任务统一复用的表示方法。

Method: 提出统一的电网表示框架：将物理电网描述与下游计算解耦。采用自监督编码器将每个电网编码为可变数量的固定维度节点向量、支路向量和全局向量，置于通用潜在描述空间中。编码器仅在至多270母线的系统上预训练，然后冻结用于下游任务。

Result: 冻结编码器零适配迁移至70,000母线电网时保持0.7919母线对应精度；电力潮流计算在未知大电网中相角均方误差0.108°，电压幅值误差3.8×10^-6 p.u.；无功调整在70,000母线电网达到75% PSASP验证修正率；运行工况生成在400-1000母线电网有82.2%请求获得至少一个可行状态；暂态稳定评估精度与全编码器适配相差仅0.8个百分点。

Conclusion: 统一的电网表示可以一次学习，无需修改即可复用于结构迥异的电力系统和异构计算任务，验证了分离电网描述与计算范式在大规模跨域泛化中的可行性和有效性。

Abstract: Data-driven power-system models are typically developed for specific grids and computational tasks, but their performance can deteriorate markedly or even fail when network structures or analytical objectives change. This paper develops a unified grid representation that separates physical-grid description from downstream computation. A self-supervised encoder represents each grid as a variable number of fixed-dimensional node, branch and global vectors under a common latent description. Although pretrained only on systems with at most 270 buses, the frozen encoder transfers without adaptation to a 70,000-bus network, more than 250 times larger in bus count, while preserving 0.7919 bus-correspondence accuracy. The same representation supports four independently trained downstream tasks: power-flow calculation, reactive-power adjustment, operating-condition generation and transient-stability assessment. On the previously unseen 70,000-bus grid, power-flow calculation achieves mean errors of 0.108$^{\circ}$ in phase angle and 3.8$\times$10\textsuperscript{-6} p.u. in voltage magnitude. Reactive-power adjustment achieved a 75\% PSASP-verified correction rate on the previously unseen 70,000-bus grid, while operating-condition generation delivered at least one PSASP-verified feasible state for 82.2\% of requests on previously unseen 400--1,000-bus grid families. For transient-stability assessment, the frozen encoder achieves accuracy within 0.8 percentage points of full encoder adaptation under matched training conditions. These results demonstrate that a unified power-grid representation can be learned once and reused unchanged across structurally different power systems and heterogeneous computational tasks.

</details>


### [268] [Online Constrained Control of Storage Systems via Simplex Disturbance-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07690)
*Kamiar Asgari,Michael J. Neely*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究带有对抗性非负资源到达和状态依赖行动约束的标量存储系统的在线控制问题。作者提出了一种Simplex Disturbance-Action Control (SDAC)策略，其参数在单纯形上取值，天然保证可行性。通过熵在线镜像下降更新参数，获得了O(√(T log(H+1)))的遗憾界，并通过极小极大下界证明了对T的依赖是最优的。此外引入无限记忆SDAC策略，可实现对固定分数策略的几何精度逼近，在H=Θ(log T)时遗憾界达到O(√(T log log T))。该框架适用于能量收集电池等存储受限资源系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典在线学习通常假设行动可行性与成本无关，但在存储系统中行动可行性依赖于时变的状态（如电池容量、资源可用性），且行动选择发生在资源到达和成本揭示之前，这带来了可行性约束与在线学习之间的耦合挑战。

Method: 提出SDAC策略族，参数化在单纯形上（H个非负参数之和至多1），任何固定的SDAC策略天然可行。利用熵在线镜像下降更新参数，同时确保沿时变轨迹保持可行性。进一步引入无限记忆SDAC策略以覆盖所有可行的固定分数策略，SDAC对这些策略的逼近误差随H呈几何衰减。

Result: 相对于最佳固定SDAC策略的遗憾界为O(√(T log(H+1)))，并证明了匹配的极小极大下界（对T的依赖紧致）。选择H=Θ(log T)时，相对于无限记忆SDAC策略的遗憾界达到O(√(T log log T))。

Conclusion: 该框架为带状态依赖约束的在线存储控制问题提供了严格的理论保障，验证了对到达和成本具有对抗性的设定下遗憾界的紧致性，并将结果推广到能量收集电池等实际系统。

Abstract: We study online control of a scalar storage system with nonnegative adversarial resource arrivals and state-dependent action constraints. The adversarial, time-varying cost depends on both state and action. At each time, the controller selects a feasible action before the current resource arrival and cost are revealed. To handle the coupling between feasibility and online learning, we introduce Simplex Disturbance-Action Control (SDAC), whose policies have $H$ nonnegative parameters summing to at most one. Every fixed SDAC policy is feasible by construction. Our online SDAC controller updates these parameters using entropic online mirror descent while preserving feasibility along the time-varying trajectory. We prove a regret bound of $O\!\left(\sqrt{T\log(H+1)}\right)$ relative to the best fixed SDAC policy and a minimax lower bound showing that the dependence on $T$ is tight. We also introduce infinite-memory SDAC policies, which include every feasible fixed-fraction policy. SDAC policies approximate this class with an error that decreases geometrically with $H$. For a suitable choice $H=Θ(\log T)$, the resulting regret against infinite-memory SDAC policies is $O\!\left(\sqrt{T\log\log T}\right)$. The framework applies to energy-harvesting batteries and other storage-constrained resource systems.

</details>


### [269] [Distributed Droop-Free Control of Grid-Forming Inverters with Dynamic Line and Load Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07777)
*Hiya Akhil Gada,Marija Ilic*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向电网形成（GFM）逆变器的瞬态感知、无下垂分布式主/次级控制框架，该框架将网络线路和负载的动态模型纳入控制设计，通过基于投影算子的梯度下降分布式控制更新，在强/弱电网条件下实现比例有功/无功功率共享及频率、电压调节，并在弱电网中显著改善了瞬态性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无下垂分布式控制方法通常依赖准稳态（QSS）网络模型，忽略了快速电磁瞬态，并假设有功/无功功率分别与频率/电压解耦。这种简化不能准确反映瞬态行为和有功-无功功率耦合特性，尤其在弱电网条件下可能导致瞬态性能不佳。

Method: 本文提出瞬态感知的无下垂分布式控制框架：(1) 将网络线路和负载动态模型纳入控制设计，以精确表征瞬态行为及功率耦合；(2) 从优化公式推导梯度基分布式控制更新；(3) 通过投影算子强制满足电压幅值约束；(4) 集成主/次级控制实现功率共享、频率与电压调节。

Result: 在四逆变器微电网的实时仿真中，对所提方法在强/弱电网条件下进行了负载变化的验证。结果表明，该方法改善了瞬态性能（尤其在弱电网中），同时保持与现有基于QSS的无下垂方法相同的稳态工作条件。

Conclusion: 所提出的瞬态感知无下垂控制方法在保持与准稳态方法相同稳态性能的前提下，通过更精确的网络动态建模和优化驱动的分布式控制策略，显著提升了交流微电网（尤其是弱电网）中的瞬态响应性能。

Abstract: Droop-free distributed control has emerged as a promising alternative to conventional linear droop control for coordinating inverter-based resources in AC microgrids. However, existing droop-free methods typically rely on quasi-steady state network models that neglect fast electromagnetic transients and assume a decoupled dependence of active and reactive power on frequency and voltage, respectively. In this paper, we propose a transient-aware droop-free distributed primary/secondary control framework for grid-forming (GFM) inverters. The control objective is to achieve proportional active and reactive power sharing, frequency regulation, and voltage regulation within prescribed bounds. The proposed approach incorporates dynamic models of network lines and loads into the control design, enabling accurate representation of transient behavior while capturing the coupled nature of power flow interactions. A gradient-based distributed control update is derived from an optimization formulation, in which voltage magnitude constraints are enforced through a projection operator. To validate the performance of the proposed control, real-time simulation studies are conducted on a four-inverter microgrid under load changes in both strong and weak grid conditions. The results demonstrate that the proposed method improves transient performance, particularly in weak grids, while preserving the same steady state operating conditions as existing QSS-based droop-free approaches.

</details>


### [270] [Sound Compilation of Weighted Event Signal Temporal Logic to Timeless Geometric Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07900)
*Avinash Malik*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无时间尺度的几何控制范式，并引入新的规范语言weSTL+（加权事件基信号时序逻辑），通过两遍编译器将时序逻辑公式转换为C^1可微的时间不变的几何替代约束，从而完全消除显式的运行时时钟监控，使CPS控制器在异步时序异常（时钟跳变、抖动、网络延迟）下仍能保证安全性和活性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从标准时序逻辑综合出的CPS控制器依赖刚性全局时钟，在面对异步时序异常（如时钟跳变、抖动和网络延迟）时表现脆弱，缺乏鲁棒性。

Method: 提出一种新颖的无时间语义的几何控制范式，并设计weSTL+规范语言（融合Event-STL的事件触发特性与weighted-STL的加权用户偏好）。通过两遍编译器将weSTL+公式转换为C^1可微分的时间不变几何替代约束，利用有限时间水平集反演将时序窗口直接映射到与物理时间无关的几何边界，从而消除显式的运行时时钟监控。

Result: 在自主机器人案例研究中，所提出的几何架构在严重的宏观时序不连续条件下能保证安全性和活性的执行，而传统的时间索引控制器在此场景下失效。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了通过将时序逻辑从时间域转化为几何域，可以构建对异步时序异常具有固有权变性的CPS控制器，为实用自主系统的规范与控制提供了新思路。

Abstract: Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) controllers synthesized from standard
  temporal logics rely on rigid global clocks, rendering them vulnerable
  to asynchronous timing anomalies like clock snaps, jitter, and network
  delays. To overcome these vulnerabilities, we introduce a
  fundamentally timeless geometric control paradigm alongside a novel
  specification language: Weighted Event-Based Signal Temporal Logic
  (weSTL+). This new weSTL+ logic combines the event triggered nature of
  Event-STL with weighted user preferences of weighted-STL making it
  suitable for specification of practical autonomous CPS. Using a
  two-pass compiler, our framework translates weSTL+ formulae directly
  into C^1-differentiable time-invariant geometric surrogate
  constraints via finite-time level-set inversion. By mapping temporal
  windows directly into physical time independent geometric boundaries,
  this approach entirely eliminates explicit runtime clock monitoring.
  Our autonomous robotics case study demonstrates that the proposed
  geometric architecture guarantees enforcement of safety and liveness
  under severe macroscopic timing discontinuities, succeeding where
  traditional time-indexed controllers fail.

</details>


### [271] [Trajectory Optimization via Schrödinger Bridge Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07914)
*Mattia Mosso,Yang Liu,Heng Yang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了有限时域轨迹优化与Schrödinger桥采样之间的关系。作者将KL正则化的轨迹优化视为推断问题，通过采样Gibbs-Boltzmann分布求解，并提出伴随Schrödinger桥采样器(ASBS)来处理带硬约束的轨迹优化任务。论文分析了rollout和double-shooting两种参数化方式，建立了可行域为光滑嵌入流形的正则性条件，并提出黎曼ASBS方法在流形上采样。实验证明该方法在接触丰富的运动和操作任务中有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的轨迹优化方法难以有效处理具有硬等式约束（如路径约束和终端约束）的问题，因为这些约束将可行决策变量限制在零测度的流形上。作者希望通过将轨迹优化与Schrödinger桥采样（一种无仿真的扩散采样方法）相结合，实现在约束流形上进行高效采样，从而解决高维、接触丰富的轨迹优化问题。

Method: 作者提出了一种结合轨迹优化与Schrödinger桥采样的框架：(a) 分析两种互补参数化方式——rollout参数化（消去动力学约束）和double-shooting参数化（状态和控制联合采样，动力学作为流形的一部分）；(b) 建立光滑嵌入流形的正则性条件；(c) 在紧致和路径连通假设下，通过黎曼ASBS（Riemannian ASBS）从内在Gibbs测度中采样，利用指数松弛变量处理严格不等式约束。

Result: 实验包括接触丰富的运动控制和操作任务，验证了rollout参数化和double-shooting参数化两种机制的有效性。结果表明该方法能够成功地在流形约束下进行采样并求解轨迹优化问题。

Conclusion: 本文建立了有限时域轨迹优化与Schrödinger桥采样之间的严格理论联系，为在约束流形上进行基于采样的轨迹优化提供了新方法。通过黎曼ASBS方法，可以在处理硬约束的同时保持采样效率，为复杂的机器人控制问题提供了新的求解途径。

Abstract: We take a new look at the relation between finite-horizon trajectory optimization and Schrödinger bridge sampling. Viewed as inference, KL-regularized trajectory optimization is solved by sampling from a Gibbs--Boltzmann distribution whose energy is the trajectory cost, and the adjoint Schrödinger bridge sampler (ASBS) is a simulation-free diffusion sampler designed for exactly such unnormalized targets. Hard equality path and terminal constraints, by contrast, confine the admissible decision variables to a measure-zero feasibility manifold, on which the target must be redefined intrinsically. In particular: $(a)$ we analyze two complementary parametrizations; a rollout parametrization, in which the dynamics are eliminated and only the remaining constraints shape the manifold, and a double-shooting parametrization, in which states and controls are sampled jointly and the dynamics themselves become part of the manifold; $(b)$ we establish regularity conditions under which both admissible sets are smooth embedded manifolds; $(c)$ under compactness and path-connectedness assumptions, we sample from the resulting intrinsic Gibbs measures via Riemannian ASBS, treating strict inequalities through exponential slack variables. Experiments, including contact-rich locomotion and manipulation, demonstrate the effectiveness of both regimes.

</details>


### [272] [Koopman-Based Model Predictive Control for Simultaneous State of Charge and Temperature Balancing of Lithium-Ion Cells](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08008)
*Jihoon Moon*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Koopman算子的框架，用于串联锂电池组的荷电状态（SoC）和温度同步均衡控制。该方法利用扩展动态模式分解（EDMD）识别电池特定的Koopman预测器，构建保留电池异质性和热扰动效应的邻域误差动态；采用Tikhonov正则化前馈控制器实现鲁棒补偿，并通过受约束的Koopman模型预测控制（KMPC）经由凸二次规划调节残余误差。三电池仿真验证表明，KMPC在均衡性能上与非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）相当，相比未控制情况可将SoC和温度差异的RMSE分别降低66-81%和57-76%，同时将单次优化计算时间从NMPC的0.0259秒降至0.0028秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电池组中电池间的电学与热学差异会导致SoC和温度分布不均匀，影响电池组性能和寿命。现有方法在精度与计算效率之间难以兼顾，需要一种既能处理非线性电池动态、保留电池异质性，又能实现快速在线控制的均衡方法。

Method: 1) 利用扩展动态模式分解识别各电池专属的Koopman预测器，将非线性电池动态提升到线性空间中。2) 将Koopman预测器组装为邻域电池误差动态模型，保留电池异质性和热扰动影响。3) 采用Tikhonov正则化前馈控制器实现数值鲁棒的补偿，避免电流过度放大。4) 设计受约束的Koopman模型预测控制（KMPC），利用凸二次规划调节残余误差实现SoC与温度同步均衡。

Result: 三电池仿真在连续两个UDDS驾驶循环下验证：KMPC均衡性能与NMPC相当；相比未控制情况，邻域电池SoC差异和核心温度差异的RMSE分别降低66-81%和57-76%；每步优化计算时间由NMPC的0.0259秒降至KMPC的0.0028秒，计算效率提升约9倍。

Conclusion: Koopman算子框架能够在保持与NMPC相媲美均衡精度的同时，显著降低实时计算负担，为锂电池组SoC与温度协同均衡提供了一种高效可行的控制方案。

Abstract: Cell-to-cell electrical and thermal variations produce nonuniform state of charge (SoC) and temperature distributions in lithium-ion battery packs. This paper proposes a Koopman-operator-based framework for simultaneous SoC and temperature balancing of series-connected cells. Cell-specific Koopman predictors identified using extended dynamic mode decomposition are assembled into neighboring-cell error dynamics that retain heterogeneity and thermal-disturbance effects. A Tikhonov-regularized feedforward controller provides numerically robust compensation without excessive current amplification, while constrained Koopman-based model predictive control (KMPC) regulates the residual errors through a convex quadratic program. Three-cell simulations validate the controller under two consecutive Urban Dynamometer Driving Schedule cycles. KMPC achieves balancing performance comparable to nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC). Relative to the uncontrolled case, KMPC reduces the RMSEs of the neighboring-cell SoC and core temperature differences by 66-81% and 57-76%, respectively, while reducing the computation time per optimization from 0.0259s for NMPC to 0.0028s for KMPC.

</details>


### [273] [Stabilizing Traffic Flow Via Autonomous Vehicles: A Less Conservative Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08218)
*MirSaleh Bahavarnia,Ahmad F. Taha*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究在控制约束下使用最少数量自动驾驶车辆(AV)稳定交通流的问题。不同于多数研究假设人类驾驶车辆(HV)同质，本文考虑异构参数场景以反映真实驾驶行为差异。通过直接确保无增长特征模态而非使用H∞充分条件来保证弦稳定性，降低了保守性，并通过非线性优化系统性地求解最少AV数量及最优控制参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献使用基于H∞的充分条件来保证交通流弦稳定性，但这往往产生保守的AV渗透率下界。为了减少这种保守性并得到更不保守的下界，需要直接施加无增长特征模态的条件。同时考虑异构HV参数设置以反映真实世界驾驶行为的差异，并研究稳定化/性能退化与所需AV数量之间的权衡。

Method: 1) 直接施加无增长特征模态条件来保证交通流弦稳定性，替代传统H∞充分条件；2) 通过非线性优化系统性地寻找所需最少AV数量并求解最优控制参数；3) 通过数值仿真评估保守性降低效果。

Result: 相比文献中基于同质HV基线和H∞条件的算法，本文算法将AV渗透率降低17.14%同时保证弦稳定性。数值仿真还显示AV渗透率可降低61.54%，但代价是位置偏差增加27.66%，且真实稳定半径(RSR)退化92.47%。揭示了稳定化/性能与AV数量之间的权衡关系。

Conclusion: 本文提出的方法能有效降低AV渗透率的保守下界，且揭示了稳定化性能与AV使用数量之间存在权衡，这有助于工程师/运营者在实际交通控制中做出更好的决策。

Abstract: This paper explores stabilizing traffic flow using a minimum number of autonomous vehicles (AVs) under control constraints. In contrast to most studies, we consider a heterogeneous parameter setup scenario for human-driven vehicles (HVs) to reflect real-world differences in driving behavior. While current literature uses an H-Infinity based sufficient condition to ensure the string stability of traffic flow, this often yields a conservative lower bound on the AV penetration rate to stabilize traffic flow. To reduce such conservativeness and obtain a less conservative lower bound, we ensure the string stability of traffic flow by directly imposing the possession of no growing eigenmodes. We also systematically find a minimum number of required AVs and solve for the optimal control parameters via nonlinear optimization. We finally assess the intended conservativeness reduction via numerical simulations. Quantitatively, applying our algorithm to the homogeneous HV baseline in the literature (the result built upon an H-Infinity based sufficient condition) reduces (improves) the AV penetration rate by 17.14% while ensuring the string stability of traffic flow. We observe a trade-off between the stabilization/performance degradation and the number of utilized identical AVs.
