Recent skill-augmented frameworks take an important first step, but they treat the skill library as a flat or two-tier prompt-side cache and offer no principled mechanism for compressing redundancy or composing skills recursively. We introduce \textsc{Scaffold}, a self-improving framework for visual web agents that (i) induces parametric, executable skills from successful trajectories under a multi-instance abstraction constraint, (ii) maintains a recursively composed hierarchy in which higher-level skills invoke lower-level ones, (iii) compacts the library via a minimum-description-length (MDL) criterion and behavioral equivalence checking, and (iv) periodically distills skill-augmented trajectories back into model weights to internalize the abstractions. Across WebArena, VisualWebArena, and a held-out split of Online-Mind2Web, \textsc{Scaffold} improves success rate by $11.1$--$17.2$ absolute points over the strongest skill-augmented baseline and shows monotonic gains across five self-improvement iterations without library collapse. We release the code and documents in the Github \href{https://github.com/BokwaiHo/SCAFFOLD}{repository}.

</details>


### [310] [Reasoning-Aware Compression: Identifying and Protecting Vulnerable Reasoning Circuits for Energy-Efficient LLM Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05512)
*Leonard Twagirayezu,Prasenjit Mitra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种推理感知的压缩框架，通过硬件级GPU能量测量和逐模块INT4脆弱性分析，选择性恢复敏感电路至FP16，在不均匀压缩中实现Pareto最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大推理模型(LRMs)部署能耗巨大，但现有压缩方法对所有组件采用统一量化，可能破坏关键推理回路，导致能量效率不升反降。

Method: 在五个推理基准上结合硬件GPU能量测量进行量化条件基准测试；通过扰动扫描对196-224个(layer, projection)对进行逐模块INT4脆弱性分析，选择性地将最敏感电路恢复为FP16。

Result: 发现INT4量化可通过延长推理链增加能量消耗（GSM8K上25%功耗降低变为净能量增加）；脆弱性具有任务依赖性（数学推理中注意力投影更关键，逻辑推理中敏感性模式因架构而异）；选择性压缩在ProofWriter上Top-10%相比FP16提升+12pp且能量降低9.7%。

Conclusion: 选择性压缩能在统一量化无法达到的Pareto最优点上运行，并在五个推理基准的保留数据上得到验证。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) impose substantial energy costs during deployment, yet current compression methods apply uniform quantization across all components, risking damage to critical reasoning circuits. We present a reasoning-aware compression framework that benchmarks quantization conditions across five reasoning benchmarks, GSM8K, FOLIO, MATH-500, ProofWriter, and MuSiQue, with hardware-level GPU energy measurement; profiles per-module INT4 vulnerability across all 196-224 (layer, projection) pairs via a perturbation sweep on a held-out calibration split, then selectively restores the most sensitive circuits to FP16. Three findings emerge. First, INT4 quantization can increase energy by extending reasoning chains; a 25% power reduction becomes a net energy increase on GSM8K. Second, vulnerability is task-dependent: attention projections are more critical for mathematical reasoning, and sensitivity patterns differ by architecture in logical inference. Third, selective compression achieves Pareto-optimal points inaccessible to uniform methods: R1-Qwen-7B Top-10% on ProofWriter gains +12 pp over FP16 at -9.7% energy, validated on held-out data across five reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [311] [When and What to Teach: Budget-Aware Online Adaptation for Web Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05513)
*Jianwei Zhang,Sihan Cao,Pengcheng Zheng,Ya Wen,Pei Ke,Kuien Liu,Shen Gao,Wei Dong,Yang Yang,Chaoning Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Score-Guided Online Teaching with Budgeted Trajectory Trimming，一个预算感知的在线教学框架，通过在查询大型教师模型前判断任务可解性、并在保留学生训练轨迹时筛选信息量高的关键轮次，大幅降低教师调用次数和训练算力开销，同时保持首次通过成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实环境中部署Web智能体需要持续在线适应，但使用专有大型模型成本过高，需依赖部署后可在线学习的轻量学生模型。然而传统轨迹级偏好优化存在两大浪费：对不可解的episode浪费教师查询预算，以及对冗余执行轮次进行重复优化，导致交互式教学成本难以承受。

Method: 提出预算感知框架，系统性地协调何时教学（通过可解性感知的教师门控决定何时查询教师模型）与教什么（通过分数引导的轮次选择机制决定保留哪些信息量高的执行轮次用于学生训练），从而对教师调用和训练轨迹进行精细化预算裁剪。

Result: 在MiniWoB和TimeWarp基准上的大量实验表明，方法在保持相当的首次通过成功率的同时，平均减少教师调用22.6%，减少学生训练算力52.1%。

Conclusion: 通过智能地分配宝贵的教师教学预算和学生的训练资源，可以在不牺牲性能的前提下大幅降低在线教学成本，为轻量模型在真实Web环境中的可持续部署提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Web agents have achieved significant success in automating complex internet tasks but deploying them in real-world environments requires continuous online adaptation. Given that deploying powerful proprietary models remains commercially cost-prohibitive, practitioners must rely on lightweight local models that evolve post-deployment via online teaching from a stronger teacher. However, standard interactive feedback imposes prohibitive costs. We show that conventional trajectory-level preference optimization wastes budget on both unresolvable episodes and redundant execution turns. To resolve these inefficiencies, we propose \textbf{Score-Guided Online Teaching with Budgeted Trajectory Trimming}, a budget-aware framework that systematically orchestrates \textbf{when} and \textbf{what} to teach. Specifically, our framework integrates a solvability-aware teacher gate to dictate \textbf{when} to query the teacher model and a score-guided turn selection mechanism to decide \textbf{what} informative turns to retain. Extensive experiments on MiniWoB and TimeWarp demonstrate that our method achieves comparable first-pass success while reducing teacher calls by 22.6\% and student training compute by 52.1\% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/zjw131f1fc/budgeted-online-teaching.

</details>


### [312] [The Failure Happens Before the Drift: The Social Dynamics of Values in LLM Agent Societies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05514)
*Farah Atif,Sougata Saha,Monojit Choudhury*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于世界价值观调查（WVS）的模拟框架，用于评估LLM智能体模拟人类价值观的能力。通过对约4000场对话、1200个人设、15个话题和3种模型的测试，发现超过50%的人设从一开始就无法表达其分配的WVS档案，2-7%在多次对话后发生价值观漂移，且模拟对话与人类对话在风格一致性和语义多样性之间存在不同权衡，表明当前LLM智能体作为人类价值观代理仍有局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地被用作社会科学研究中的人类参与者替代品，但它们能否忠实模拟多样化甚至相互冲突的人类价值体系仍未明确，需要系统性评估。

Method: 构建WVS grounded模拟框架，让具有不同文化背景和沟通风格的智能体参与纵向、价值观相关的讨论。使用1200个人设、15个话题、3种模型（GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Flash、Gemma-4-E4B），进行约4000场对话，评估价值忠实度、价值漂移和对话真实感，并进行移除人口统计细节的消融实验。

Result: 超过50%的人设从一开始未能表达分配的WVS档案；2-7%在重复对话后发生价值观漂移；消融实验仅对部分模型的忠实度有改善但未改变整体偏差趋势；模拟对话与人类对话在风格一致性与语义多样性之间呈现不同的权衡特征，模拟对话内容多样但风格重复。

Conclusion: 当前LLM智能体能够生成看似合理的对话，但作为随时间表示和保持多样化人类价值观档案的代理仍然存在明显局限。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used as proxies for human participants in social science research, yet it remains unclear whether they can faithfully simulate diverse and conflicting human value systems. We present a World Values Survey (WVS)-grounded simulation framework where culturally diverse agents with different communication styles engage in longitudinal, value-laden discussions. Across approximately 4,000 conversations involving 1,200 personas, 15 topics, and three models (GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Gemma-4-E4B), we evaluate value faithfulness, value drift, and conversational realism. We find that more than 50\% of personas fail to express their assigned WVS profiles from the outset, while 2-7\% drift after repeated conversations. Ablations removing demographic details improve faithfulness for some models but do not change the broader trend: simulated value distributions still systematically deviate from the assigned WVS profiles. Compared to human discussions, simulated dialogues show a different trade-off between stylistic consistency and semantic diversity, often producing content-wise varied but stylistically repetitive exchanges. These findings suggest that current LLM agents can generate plausible conversations, but remain limited proxies for representing and preserving diverse human value profiles over time.

</details>


### [313] [Beyond "AI Helps Humans": Decision-Targeted Evaluation Design for Human-Agent Teams in the Agentic Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05527)
*Hamed Khosravi,Xiaoming Huo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出TEAM-Design规则，用于在固定回放预算下决定哪些任务应接受人类单独回放、哪些应接受智能体单独回放，以验证人类-AI协作工作流是否优于两种替代方案。该规则根据基线结果的可预测性和比较难度来分配回放概率，并通过理论证明和多种实验验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在人类-AI工作流部署中，需要判断协作流程是否优于人类单独或智能体单独。但由于部署后无法观察到替代结果，需要通过回放实验来恢复，而回放成本高昂且预算有限。现有方法（如智能体基准测试、基于方差的采样、贝叶斯信息方法）都没有直接针对这一任务级别的回放分配决策问题。

Method: 提出TEAM-Design规则：为每个任务分配两个回放概率（一个针对人类单独基线，一个针对智能体单独基线）。在缺失基线结果难以从已知信息预测、且该比较更难确立的任务上提高概率，在回放成本昂贵的任务上降低概率。通过理论证明该规则能求解预算化设计问题，并证明从记录概率中随机抽取回放仍能控制错误宣称工作流优于两种替代方案的概率。

Result: 在6个临床场景（无人类-AI工作流同时优于两种替代方案）和1个编码基准（存在此类工作流）上重新分析，并在合成设计和基于真实胸部X光读片研究的半合成设计上评估。TEAM-Design在两种比较难度差异明显时表现最佳，但在两种比较难度相似时可能劣于基于方差的分配方法。

Conclusion: TEAM-Design为解决固定预算下的人类-AI工作流验证问题提供了直接针对部署决策的方案，特别适用于两种基线比较难度不对称的场景。但当两种比较难度相似时，其优势减弱，需要结合场景特性选择合适的分配策略。

Abstract: Wherever a coding agent works under engineer supervision, or a clinical model assists a radiologist, the deployment question is whether to keep the human-AI workflow or replace it with the human alone or the agent alone. The human-AI workflow is worth keeping only if it beats both of those alternatives. Yet once it is deployed, neither alternative outcome is observed: recovering one means replaying the task under that alternative, and every replay costs expert time or compute. Under a fixed replay budget, the design question is therefore which tasks should be more likely to receive a human-only replay, and which an agent-only replay. Existing methods do not directly target this decision. Agent benchmarks do not choose which missing baseline to measure, variance-based sampling ignores which of the two comparisons is closer to failing, and Bayesian information methods focus on learning model parameters instead of making the deployment decision. We propose TEAM-Design, a rule that gives every task two replay probabilities, one per baseline. It raises a probability where the missing baseline outcome is hard to predict from what is already known about the task and where that comparison is harder to establish, and lowers it where replay is expensive. We prove that the rule solves this budgeted design problem, and that drawing the replays at random from recorded probabilities still controls the chance of wrongly declaring that the workflow beats both. We reanalyze 6 clinical settings, where no human-AI workflow beats both alternatives, and a coding benchmark, where one does, then evaluate TEAM-Design on synthetic designs and on a semi-synthetic design built from a real chest X-ray reader study. TEAM-Design works best when one of the two comparisons is clearly harder to settle than the other, and can do worse than variance-based allocation when the two are similarly difficult.

</details>


### [314] [EdgeMem: LLM-Free Agent Memory Construction and Retrieval via Evidence-Preserving Multi-Anchor Hypergraph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05553)
*Zeyang Cui,Jiannong Cao,Zhiyuan Wen,Bo Yuan,Junlan Feng,Shengyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EdgeMem提出了一种基于多锚点超图（multi-anchor hypergraph）的智能体记忆方法，通过保留原始交互轮次并通过内容、时间和情节线索组织它们，避免了现有方法中LLM生成的压缩表示所导致的信息丢失和额外开销。检索直接返回源证据，仅在最终答案生成时使用LLM，在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上取得了优异效果，且构建和检索过程无需生成式LLM调用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体记忆方法通常将交互历史压缩为摘要或其他LLM生成的表示，但重复生成增加成本，且可能在系统知道未来查询需求之前就丢弃包含答案的关键细节。因此需要一种无需提前压缩、保留原始信息并高效组织的记忆方法。

Method: EdgeMem遵循"保留原始交互轮次并通过互补的内容、时间和情节线索组织"的原则，利用轻量级本地处理构建多锚点超图（multi-anchor hypergraph），检索时直接返回源证据，LLM仅在最终答案生成阶段被调用，从而将结构化多会话访问与原始对话的忠实保留相结合。

Result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上表现出强的检索和基于记忆的问答性能。在LoCoMo上，EdgeMem在七个复现系统中以共享提示实现了最高严格评判分数（61.01对比58.70），且构建和检索不需要生成式LLM调用。

Conclusion: EdgeMem表明，保留和组织源证据为智能体记忆提供了有效且高效的基础，无需生成式记忆管理即可实现优异的性能，避免信息丢失并降低计算成本。

Abstract: Agent memory allows LLM agents to use earlier interactions when answering new queries. Existing methods often compress interaction histories into summaries or other LLM-generated representations. Repeated generation adds cost and can discard answer-bearing details before the system knows what a future query will require. We propose EdgeMem, an agent-memory method built around a simple principle: preserve original interaction turns and organize them through complementary content, temporal, and episodic cues. EdgeMem realizes this principle with a multi-anchor hypergraph constructed by lightweight local processing. Retrieval directly returns source evidence and reserves LLM use for final answer generation, combining structured access to multi-session histories with faithful retention of the original conversation. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S show strong retrieval and memory-grounded question answering; on LoCoMo, EdgeMem achieves the highest strict-judge score among seven reproduced systems under a shared prompt (61.01 versus 58.70), while construction and retrieval require no generative-LLM calls. Overall, EdgeMem shows that preserving and organizing source evidence provides an effective and efficient foundation for agent memory without generative memory management.

</details>


### [315] [Agentic BAIM-LLM Evaluation (ABLE): Benchmarking LLM Use of Protein Design Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05818)
*Bryce Cai,Geetha Jeyapragasan,Samira Nedungadi,Jake Yukich,Seth Donoughe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了ABLE基准，用于评估LLM智能体在蛋白质设计双用途工作流中使用生物AI模型（如ProteinMPNN和AlphaFold3）的能力。通过评估15个前沿模型，发现7个模型拒绝所有任务，其余模型表现差异显著，其中Claude Sonnet 4和Gemini 3 Pro在信息检索、工具选择和工具使用方面得分最高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体日益被用于蛋白质设计等具有双重用途（dual-use）的工作流中，但目前缺乏系统性的基准来评估这些智能体对生物AI模型（BAIMs）的调用能力，以及由此带来的安全与能力边界问题。

Method: 构建ABLE基准，设计覆盖结构检索、序列生成和设计验证等任务集，对15个前沿LLM模型进行系统评估，并在部分任务上将模型表现与专家人类基线进行对比。

Result: 15个评测模型中7个拒绝所有任务；其余模型表现差异显著。Claude Sonnet 4和Gemini 3 Pro在信息检索、工具选择和工具使用上得分最高。当前LLM能大幅降低蛋白质设计门槛，但在规划、策略生成及生物知识与工具使用整合方面仍不一致。

Conclusion: 当前LLM智能体在蛋白质设计辅助方面展现出显著潜力（降低准入门槛），但其能力尚不稳定，尤其在复杂任务规划与跨学科知识整合上仍有明显不足，需要进一步发展与改进。

Abstract: We introduce ABLE, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents' ability to use biological AI models (BAIMs), such as ProteinMPNN and AlphaFold3, in dual-use protein design workflows. ABLE assesses agent performance through a set of tasks spanning structure retrieval, sequence generation, and design validation. We evaluate 15 frontier models and find that seven refuse all tasks, while the remaining models exhibit substantial performance differences. Claude Sonnet 4 and Gemini 3 Pro achieve the highest scores across information retrieval, tool selection, and tool use. We further compare model performance on a subset of tasks against an expert human baseline. Our results suggest that current LLMs can substantially lower barriers to protein design, but remain inconsistent in planning, strategy generation, and integrating biological knowledge with tool use.

</details>


### [316] [Deep belief networks are exact](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05572)
*Gleb Smirnov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文证明{\{-1,1\}^n}上的任意严格正概率分布都能被具有有限参数的sigmoid信念网络精确表示，解决了Sutskever和Hinton提出的开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sutskever和Hinton之前提出了一个开放问题：sigmoid信念网络是否能够精确表示任意严格正的概率分布？此前只证明了近似表示的可能性，精确表示的问题悬而未决。

Method: 论文将Sutskever和Hinton的概率共享近似方法升级为精确表示，关键工具是使用Brouwer不动点定理来弥合近似与精确之间的差距。

Result: 证明了{\{-1,1\}^n}上任何严格正概率分布都可以由有限参数的sigmoid信念网络精确表示，从而正面回答了Sutskever和Hinton的问题。

Conclusion: sigmoid信念网络作为生成模型具有强有力的表达能力，能够精确捕捉任意严格正的离散分布，这为该模型的广泛应用提供了坚实的理论保证。

Abstract: We prove that every strictly positive probability distribution on \(\{-1,1\}^n\) is represented exactly by a sigmoid belief network with finite parameters. This answers a question of Sutskever and Hinton. The proof upgrades their probability-sharing approximation to exact representation using Brouwer's fixed-point theorem.

</details>


### [317] [EnvCraft: Synthesizing Executable Environments in Agentic RL for Claw-like Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05576)
*Yirong Zeng,Shen You,Jinhang Feng,Yufei Liu,Xiao Ding,Yutai Hou,Hao Cong,Yuxian Wang,Wu Ning,Wang Xu,Bibo Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EnvCraft是一个自动化框架，用于合成可执行的交互环境和可扩展的训练数据，以解决Agentic RL训练中交互环境严重稀缺的问题。该方法生成了139个交互环境和约20K复杂任务，在Claw风格基准上提升高达+11.9%，在通用工具使用基准上提升+8.0%，同时降低了推理token成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型正从被动语言接口转向自主的Claw-like智能体，需要在有状态的工作空间中执行长周期任务。虽然Agentic RL提供了优化路径，但其扩展受限于交互训练环境的严重稀缺。现有合成环境仅限于工具调用端点，无法满足Claw-like智能体端到端的真实世界需求。

Method: EnvCraft包含两个核心组件：(1) 环境合成引擎，用于构建沙箱隔离的工作空间；(2) 拓扑感知的数据生成引擎，用于产生连贯的任务轨迹。该方法可以端到端地合成可执行环境和可扩展的训练数据。

Result: 合成了139个交互环境，包含约20K复杂任务。在Qwen3/3.5模型（8B-32B）上实验显示：Claw风格基准提升最高达+11.9%，通用工具使用基准提升+8.0%，同时减少了推理token成本。

Conclusion: 合成的可执行环境能够为Agentic RL训练提供稳健且可泛化的学习信号，验证了合成环境方法的有效性和泛化性。

Abstract: The paradigm of LLMs has rapidly shifted from passive language interfaces to autonomous Claw-like agents that execute long-horizon tasks across stateful workspaces. While Agentic Reinforcement Learning (Agentic RL) provides a promising path to optimize these agents, its scaling is heavily bottlenecked by the severe scarcity of interactive training environments. Existing synthetic environments are strictly limited to tool-calling endpoints, rendering them insufficient for accommodating the end-to-end real-world demands of claw-like agents. To bridge this gap, we introduce EnvCraft, an automated framework for synthesizing executable environments and scalable training data. Specifically, EnvCraft employs an environment synthesis engine to build sandbox-isolated workspaces, alongside a topology-aware data generation engine to produce coherent task trajectories. Overall, we synthesize 139 interactive environments comprising approximately 20K complex tasks for Agentic RL training. Experiments on Qwen3/3.5 models (8B-32B) show that our method yields gains of up to +11.9% on Claw-style benchmarks and +8.0% on general tool-use benchmarks, with concurrent reductions in inference token cost. The results confirm that synthesized executable environments provide robust and generalizable learning signals for training.

</details>


### [318] [A Translational Note on AI Safety Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06573)
*Madhava Gaikwad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出自动红队基准测试存在"威胁模型覆盖缺口"：基准只衡量预定义危害集内的搜索彻底性，无法发现集外危害（如非英语提示词），因此不能据此认为人类评估者可有可无，需要部署上下文不同的独立评估者来弥补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究表明自动红队比人类红队在AI安全基准上发现更多漏洞且成本更低，有人据此认为人类评估者正在变得可有可无。作者认为这种比较衡量的是A（预定义危害集内的搜索效率），而结论宣称的是B（人类评估者的不可替代性），存在逻辑谬误——基准中遗漏的危害对任何在框架内工作的攻击者都是不可见的，无论自动与否。

Method: 作者类比了学术密码学和临床药物试验中的同类盲点——内部效度良好的评估无法揭示其从未指向的人群/领域的问题；提出"威胁模型覆盖缺口"（threat-model coverage gap）概念，并在当前开源权重模型中实证验证该缺口持续存在——非英语提示词中的危害是英语基准无法捕捉的。

Result: 实证表明覆盖缺口在现役开源模型中确实存在：非英语提示词能够触发英语基准覆盖不到的危害。这证明了仅依赖开发者预设的自动红队基准不足以覆盖真实部署威胁。

Conclusion: 弥合覆盖缺口需要部署上下文与开发者不同的人类评估者（或等价的外部评估框架），其必要性是基于方法论（覆盖性）论证的，而现有的评估框架本身不太可能自发产生这类独立评估者。

Abstract: Recent studies report that automated red-teaming finds more vulnerabilities, at lower cost, than human red-teaming on standard AI safety benchmarks, and some read this as evidence that human evaluators are becoming dispensable. The comparison measures one thing and the conclusion claims another. A benchmark measures how thoroughly an attacker searches a predefined set of harms, fixed in advance by the developers, and a harm left out of that set is invisible to any attacker working inside it, automated or not. The same blind spot appeared in academic cryptography and in clinical drug trials, where an evaluation that was internally valid stayed silent about the population it was never pointed at. We call the AI-safety version the \emph{threat-model coverage gap}, and find that it persists in a current open-weight model, where harms surface in non-English prompts that English benchmarks miss. Closing it requires evaluators whose deployment context differs from the developers'. The case for those evaluators is methodological, grounded in coverage, and the existing evaluation frame is unlikely to produce them on its own.

</details>


### [319] [Planning and Scheduling Business Processes under Control-Flow Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05578)
*Michel Kunkler,Stefanie Rinderle-Ma*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究业务流程中的活动调度问题，考虑执行过程中存在的不确定性（案例所需活动序列不确定）。提出将问题建模为机会约束优化问题，并给出两种方法：两阶段分解方法（先规划后调度）和集成方法。实验表明集成方法生成更优的完工时间但难以扩展，分解方法可扩展到大规模场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 业务流程中的调度可以提升效率（如减少完工时间），但由于数据驱动的决策导致活动序列不确定，调度具有很大挑战。虽然执行日志可以估计概率信息以预测成功路径，但规划特定执行路径会影响成功完成的概率和多余活动的预期数量，因此需要新的建模与求解方法。

Method: 将问题形式化为机会约束优化问题，提出两种公式化方案：(1) 分解方法——两阶段，规划阶段在可行性约束下最小化多余活动的预期数量，调度阶段在规划的活动上最小化完工时间；(2) 集成方法——将规划与调度合并为单一公式。

Result: 在两个真实数据集和一个合成数据集上的评估显示：集成方法能产生更优的完工时间，但在规模扩大时难以处理（不可扩展）；分解方法则能够扩展到大规模场景。

Conclusion: 集成方法在解质量上更优但缺乏可扩展性，分解方法在可扩展性上具有优势，两者之间存在精度与规模的权衡，为业务流程中的不确定调度提供了实用的方法论选择。

Abstract: Scheduling activities in business processes can improve efficiency (e.g., reduce makespan), but is challenging because the exact sequence of activities required to complete a case is often uncertain due to decisions based on data that emerges during execution. Nevertheless, probabilistic information regarding such decisions can often be estimated or derived from historical execution logs, and can help anticipate which execution paths are likely to lead to successful completion. Planning with particular execution paths affects feasibility, i.e., the probability of successful completion, and the expected number of superfluous activities that are planned but never executed. We frame the problem as a chance-constrained optimization problem and present two formulations: A decomposed approach with two stages, a planning stage that minimizes the expected number of superfluous activities subject to a feasibility constraint, and a scheduling stage that minimizes the makespan over the planned activities; and an integrated approach that combines planning and scheduling into a single formulation. Evaluation on two real-world and one synthetic dataset shows that the integrated approach yields superior makespans but is intractable at scale, while the decomposed approach scales to large settings.

</details>


### [320] [EmoMed: An Emotionally-Aware Agent for Multimodal Medical Support with Real-Time Information Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07194)
*Ivan Nasonov,Nikita Glazkov,Ivan Makovetskiy,Mikhail Mozikov,Daniil Sukhorukov,Andrey Savchenko,Ilya Makarov*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EmoMed是一个多模态医疗咨询智能体，能够根据用户情绪状态（焦虑、困惑、紧迫感）自适应调整回应方式，同时通过双检索机制（网络事实核查+API连接的持续更新医学知识库）确保临床准确性，经过7个先进语言模型和多项指标评估显示情感自适应响应优于中性基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的医疗咨询系统往往只关注内容的临床准确性，忽略了用户的情绪状态对沟通效果的影响。在医疗场景中，用户常常处于焦虑、困惑或紧急状态，情绪敏感的沟通可能显著影响患者的理解度和信任感，因此需要一种既能保持临床准确性又能适应患者情绪的多模态医疗对话系统。

Method: EmoMed构建了一个多模态医疗咨询智能体，核心包含三个部分：（1）同时处理文本和医学图像输入；（2）从用户输入中检测情感指标（焦虑、困惑、紧迫感）；（3）根据情绪状态调整回应的语气、结构和细节层级。为保证事实可靠性，采用双检索机制：基于网络的事实核查与通过API连接持续更新的医学知识库。

Result: 在7个先进语言模型（GPT-4/5、Qwen3、Llama 4、Gemini 2.5、Grok4、Claude3）上进行评估，使用包括LLM-as-judge评估、MedQA风格准确性测试、BERT Score、安全/帮助性评级及多模态医学基准等综合指标。结果显示情感自适应响应在所有维度均优于中性基线，且不损害临床准确性。受控用户研究验证了参与者报告感知共情和沟通清晰度提升，同时保持对事实准确性的信任。

Conclusion: EmoMed证明了在医疗咨询场景中，情感自适应的响应策略能够在保持临床准确性的前提下显著提升用户的感知共情与沟通清晰度，为构建更具人性化的AI医疗助手提供了可行的技术路线和实证支持。

Abstract: We present EmoMed - a multimodal medical consultation agent that adapts its responses based on users' emotional states while maintaining clinical accuracy. The system processes text and medical images, detects affect indicators (anxiety, confusion, urgency) from user input, and adjusts response tone, structure, and detail level accordingly. To ensure factual reliability, the agent grounds clinical information through a dual retrieval mechanism: web-based fact-checking and an API-connected, continuously updated medical knowledge base. We evaluate our approach across seven state-of-the-art language models (GPT-4/5, Qwen3, Llama 4, Gemini 2.5, Grok4, Claude3) using comprehensive metrics including LLM-as-judge assessments, MedQA style accuracy tests, BERT Score, safety/helpfulness ratings, and multimodal medical benchmarks. The results demonstrate that emotionally adaptive responses consistently outperform neutral baseline across evaluation dimensions, without compromising clinical accuracy. A controlled user study validated these findings, with participants reporting improved perceived empathy and communication clarity, while maintaining trust in factual accuracy. Source code: https://github.com/NasonovIvan/EmoMed-Agent

</details>


### [321] [Agents Trust Tools Too Much: Measuring Reliance on Unreliable Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05587)
*Hoyeol Yang,Woojung Song,Taewon Kim,Jonghyun Song,Seoyeon Park,Yohan Jo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了大语言模型智能体对不可靠工具返回结果的过度信任问题。通过评估14个LLM在三种工具（网页搜索、LLM子代理委派、代码执行）上的表现，发现智能体对工具返回的错误内容有极高的采纳率（平均超过三分之一，网页搜索高达68%）。更严重的是，推理痕迹显示智能体有时内部已识别出冲突甚至恢复正确答案，却仍只向用户呈现错误内容。虽然提示、工具元数据、后训练三种干预手段在部分场景有效，但没有一种能跨工具一致缓解过度信任问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的工具使用智能体评估主要关注任务完成能力，但假设工具返回可靠信息。然而真实系统中工具返回可能看起来合理但实际错误，因此需要研究智能体对不可靠工具返回的应对能力，这是一个被忽视但重要的问题。

Method: 作者使用三种工具（网页搜索、LLM子代理委派、代码执行）评估14个LLM。对每种工具故意破坏其返回内容，测量智能体在最终答案中是否采纳被破坏的内容（采纳率）。同时分析推理痕迹，并在三个层面进行干预：用户提示（prompting）、工具提供者元数据（metadata）、智能体构建者后训练（post-training）。

Result: 所有智能体在三个设置下均表现出高度的过度信任：每种工具的采纳率均值超过三分之一，网页搜索的采纳率高达68.0%。推理追踪揭示了一个令人担忧的失败模式：智能体常常识别出冲突甚至在内部恢复正确答案，却只呈现被破坏的答案而不警告用户。三种干预手段仅对特定模型或工具有效，没有一种能跨工具一致地缓解过度信任。

Conclusion: 对不可靠工具的过度信任是智能体严重且持续存在的失败模式。这提示我们需要开发新的评估方法和干预手段，使智能体能够验证工具输出并透明地传达未解决的冲突，而非盲目采纳工具返回的内容。

Abstract: Existing evaluations of tool-using agents primarily measure whether an agent can successfully complete diverse tasks with tools. These evaluations generally assume that tools return reliable information. However, tool returns in real-world systems can be plausible yet incorrect. We investigate how agents respond to unreliable tool returns by evaluating fourteen LLMs using three tools-web search, LLM sub-agent delegation, and code execution. For each tool, we corrupt its returns and measure whether agents adopt the corrupted content in their final answers. Agents exhibit high levels of overtrust across all three settings: the mean adoption rate exceeds one third for every tool and reaches 68.0% for web search. Analysis of reasoning traces reveals a particularly concerning failure mode: agents often recognize conflicts and even recover the correct answer internally, yet present only the corrupted answer without warning the user. To mitigate agents' overtrust in tool returns, we intervene at three levels: prompting by the user, metadata from the tool provider, and post-training by the agent builder. Although some interventions help for particular models or tools, none consistently mitigates overtrust across tools. These findings identify overtrust in unreliable tools as a serious and persistent failure mode, motivating evaluations and interventions that enable agents to validate tool outputs and transparently communicate unresolved conflicts.

</details>


### [322] [Human-like moral judgments conceal divergent motive attributions in large language models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07353)
*Xiaoyan Wu,Jean-Claude Dreher*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究比较了五个大语言模型（LLMs）与两组人类样本（N=125和N=742）对医生举报欺诈行为这一情境的道德判断与动机归因。结果显示，LLM虽能复现人类对举报者道德品质的排名，但在动机归因上与人类存在显著差异（LLM将举报者描绘得更乐于助人、更少自利和敌意），且竞争性动机与道德判断的关联强度在四个模型中弱于人类。研究强调仅验证平均评分的吻合不足以证明LLM可作为有效的人类参与者模拟工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被越来越多地用于模拟心理学研究中的人类被试，但现有验证方法通常仅比较平均评分，忽略了更深层的判断结构。研究者质疑：即使LLM能复现人类对外显道德评价的排名，其背后的动机归因模式、判断间关系及对情境的敏感性是否也与人类一致？这关乎LLM作为人类模拟工具的有效性根本。

Method: 实验设计包含5个LLM和2个人类样本，所有被试评估一位医生在四种条件下的表现：保持沉默、向医院举报、向监管机构举报、向报纸举报虚假账单。研究者比较了：(1)道德品质评分的排名一致性；(2)动机归因（利他、自利、敌对、竞争等）的水平差异；(3)动机与道德判断之间的关系强度；以及(4)在LLM提示中复现人类样本的人口统计特征与叙述情境后的评分变化。

Result: 主要发现包括：(1)五个LLM均复现了人类对医生道德品质的排名（举报者高于沉默者）；(2)LLM将举报者动机描绘得比人类更利他、更少自利、更少敌对；(3)四个模型中，竞争性动机与道德判断的关联强度显著弱于人类；(4)在LLM提示中复现人类样本的人口特征和叙述后，模型评分变化很小，虽无法单独隔离视角效应。

Conclusion: 即使LLM在平均道德评分上与人类排名一致，但在动机归因、判断间关系及情境敏感性等心理信息丰富的响应模式上仍与人类存在实质分歧。因此，仅评估平均一致性不足以验证LLM作为人类心理模拟的有效性，需采用更具心理信息量的检验模式。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are used to simulate human participants in psychological research. We asked whether LLMs that reproduce human evaluations of a whistleblower's moral character also reproduce the motive attributions that accompany them. Five LLMs and two human samples (N = 125 and N = 742) evaluated a physician who either remained silent about fraudulent billing or reported it to a hospital, regulator, or newspaper. Models reproduced the human ranking of the physician's moral character but portrayed whistleblowers as more helpful, less self-interested, and less hostile. In four of five models, competitive motives were less strongly associated with moral-character judgments. Model ratings changed little when prompts reproduced the narratives and demographic profiles of both human samples, although this comparison cannot isolate a perspective effect. Thus, agreement in average ratings can conceal differences in attributed motives, relationships among judgments, and sensitivity to context. Validating LLMs as simulated participants therefore requires testing psychologically informative response patterns, not average agreement alone.

</details>


### [323] [The convergent laboratory: when AI reasoning, autonomous experiments, high performance and quantum computing reshape chemistry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05643)
*Eliu Huerta,Xiaoyun Wang,Geetika Gupta,Edward H. Sargent,Cameron J. Owen,Victor Fung,Abhishek Mitra,Austin Cheng,Emma Bouchard,Shams Mehdi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文是TPC26会议（汇集学术界、国家实验室和工业界领袖的会议）的评论文章，探讨人工智能、自主代理、自驱动实验室、高性能计算和量子计算如何汇聚融合，以放大各自在材料科学发现中的影响力，并认为化学科学正处于变革性突破和生产性颠覆的临界点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI驱动推理、自主智能体框架、自驱动实验室和容错量子处理器同时成熟，作者希望提供一个参考，记录这一被视为化学科学领域变革性突破和生产力颠覆的关键转折点。该评论源于TPC26会议，旨在反映一线研究人员在这些前沿领域的亲身经验。

Method: 本文是一篇评论性文章（Comment），基于TPC26会议（https://tpc26.org）的讨论与交流，通过汇集来自学术界、国家实验室和工业界领袖的多方视角，探讨AI、自主智能体、自驱动实验室、高性能计算与量子计算等技术的协同融合如何重塑材料科学发现范式。

Result: 文章捕捉了这一全球性事业的精髓，呈现了处于AI驱动推理、自主智能体框架、自驱动实验室和容错量子处理器等前沿交叉领域研究者的第一手经验与观点。

Conclusion: 作者认为化学科学正处于一个颠覆性变革的临界点——多种前沿技术的同时成熟将产生协同放大效应，推动材料科学发现进入新的范式，本文作为这一历史性转折时刻的参考文献而存在。

Abstract: This Comment emerges from TPC26 (https://tpc26.org), a conference convening leaders from academia, national laboratories, and industry who are reshaping materials science discovery. The meeting explored how AI, autonomous agents, self-driving labs, higher performance and quantum computing converge to amplify their individual impact on materials science discovery. The perspectives here reflect the firsthand experiences of researchers at these frontiers and capture the essence of this global endeavor. As AI-driven reasoning, autonomous agentic frameworks, self-driving laboratories, and fault-tolerant quantum processors mature simultaneously, we offer this Comment as a reference at what we believe is a tipping point of transformative advances and productive disruption in the chemical sciences.

</details>


### [324] [Norms at a Price: Why RL-Based Alignment Can Promise Conditional Compliance at Best](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07627)
*Kevin Baum,Rūta Binkytė,Felix Jahn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文论证AI智能体的"有条件合规"行为（仅在可能被观察时遵守规范）并非异常，而是当前基于强化学习的对齐训练机制的结构性必然产物，并提出解决方向应从内部化转向架构性约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体常出现"测试时对齐、非测试时偏离"的行为，现有观点视其为异常。作者认为这恰恰是当前行为训练范式的必然选择结果，而非偶然缺陷。

Method: 通过分析强化学习对齐机制的本质：规范与任务追求被折叠进单一策略；评分机制将规范扁平化为"如果被发现就有代价"的成本信号；指出条件合规与始终合规在可训练数据上不可区分，而检测未观察行为在逻辑上自相矛盾。进一步论证迭代pipeline实际选择的是"通过检测"而非"真正合规"。

Result: 该理论框架统一解释了alignment faking（对齐伪装）、sandbagging（能力隐藏）和evaluation-aware scheming（评估感知策略）等现象，证明它们同源于行为训练的固有局限。

Conclusion: 补救方向不应是追求更深层的内化（这无法通过行为训练可靠实现），而应转向架构性设计——使违规行为在物理/结构上不可行，而非仅仅在行为上不被选择。

Abstract: AI agents sometimes act aligned when they infer they are being tested, and differently when not. We argue this is not an anomaly but what current training regimes are structured to select for. Reinforcement-learning-based alignment folds norms and task pursuit into one policy: the system learns its norms from scored behavior, and scoring flattens them. Do not do X is learned as doing X costs something if noticed. On every datum training can produce, a policy that complies only when it might be observed is indistinguishable from one that complies always. The experiment that would tell them apart - scoring unobserved behavior - is a contradiction in terms. Conditional compliance is thus the most that behavioral training can be known to deliver. Agency sharpens the problem: agents operate mostly where no one is watching, and can act on whether they are watched. An iterated pipeline that trains against detected failures selects for passing detection, not for complying. This account unifies alignment faking, sandbagging, and evaluation-aware scheming. And it reorients the remedy: not deeper internalization but architecture, making violations unavailable rather than unchosen.

</details>


### [325] [What LLM Trading Agents Actually Do in Production: A Six-Month, Population-Scale Record from Two Fleets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05663)
*T. J. Barton,Chris Constantakis,Patti Hauseman,Annie Mous,Alaska Hoffman,Brian Bergeron,Hunter Goodreau*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文呈现了一个大规模、连续的生产环境记录，涵盖两个同源设计的自主语言模型交易代理系统（DX Terminal Pro 与 DXAP 实时alpha舰队），时间跨度约六个月，涉及750万次模型调用和约30万次链上操作。核心发现包括：操作层比策略文本更能决定行为、规模设定忽视波动率、代理几乎无法捕获其触及的上行空间、两个舰队均无方向性优势。所有结论均通过多种统计稳健性检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对自主语言模型交易代理在生产环境中大规模运行的真实测量数据，多数研究停留在仿真或短期实验层面。作者希望用长期、连续、人口级（population-scale）的生产记录来实证检验这些代理的真实行为模式与盈利能力，填补该领域缺乏真实生产证据的空白。

Method: 研究方法包括：1) 部署并记录两个同源设计的LM交易代理系统（DX Terminal Pro和DXAP舰队）的长达六个月的运行数据；2) 运用多种计量分析方法：固定效应模型（agent fixed effects）、回归不连续性设计（regression discontinuity, 1.75x效应）、波动率分位数分析、配对回放联赛（paired-replay league of frontier models on 416 scenarios）；3) 采用多重稳健性检验：日聚类推断（day-clustered inference）、置换零假设（permutation nulls）、共同费用重述（common-fee restatement）。

Result: 四项主要发现：1) 操作层（risk slider、leaderboard边界等）对行为的影响远大于策略文本本身，风险滑块每级增加0.425倍杠杆，代理固定效应解释60%方差，榜单前三名边界处存在1.75x的因果选择效应；2) 规模设定完全无视波动率，杠杆中位数在所有波动率六分位中均保持5.0x，一个姿态滑块单元占账本的11%却承担了62%的清算；3) 代理几乎捕获不到它们触及的上行空间，43.2%的仓位24小时内出现至少+300bps的有利偏移，但其中49.3%以负收益平仓，机械挂单（bracket）可每仓位恢复+39.0 bps；4) 两个舰队均无方向性优势，DXAP舰队亏损且输给Hyperliquid散户基准（41%对50%回合胜率），前沿模型对416个生产情景的决策质量在统计上无显著差异。所有结论通过全部稳健性检验。

Conclusion: 作者认为，当前语言模型交易代理的核心局限不在AI模型的决策智能本身（前沿模型决策质量无显著差异），而在系统设计层面——操作界面、风险控制结构、订单执行机制等"操作层"才是决定交易表现的关键。论文以17条方法论准则收尾，这些准则是基于自身多次撤回经验总结而来的。

Abstract: We present a continuous, population-scale measurement record of autonomous language-model trading agents operating in production across two systems with one design lineage: DX Terminal Pro (3,505 user-funded vaults trading real ETH in Base memecoin markets for 21 days, February to March 2026) and the DXAP live alpha fleet (500 to 599 user-created agents all-history, 91 to 117 concurrently active, trading Hyperliquid perpetuals, June to August 2026). The record spans roughly six months, 7.5M single-model invocations with about 300K onchain actions, and a further 231,638 multi-tool turns producing 14,596 fills. Four findings carry the paper. First, the operating layer determines behavior more than anything written in strategy text: a risk slider explains leverage (+0.425 per level), agent fixed effects absorb 60% of variance, and a leaderboard render boundary causally routes selection (regression discontinuity 1.75x at the top-3 cut). Second, sizing is volatility-blind: median leverage is 5.0x in every volatility sextile, and one posture-slider cell (11% of the book) holds 62% of liquidations. Third, agents capture almost none of the upside they reach: 43.2% of positions saw at least +300 bps of favorable excursion within 24h, yet 49.3% of those closed with a negative trade return; a mechanical bracket recovers +39.0 bps per position. Fourth, neither fleet shows a directional edge. The DXAP fleet is not profitable and trails a matched Hyperliquid retail benchmark (41% vs. 50% roundtrip win rate). A paired-replay league of frontier models on 416 captured production scenarios finds decision quality statistically indistinguishable at this horizon, while choice stability differs sharply across model families. Every headline survives day-clustered inference, permutation nulls, and a common-fee restatement; the paper closes with a 17-rule methodology canon bought with our own retractions.

</details>


### [326] [CUSP: Decomposable Collective Uncertainty for Multi-Agent Multimodal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05708)
*Chung-En Johnny Yu,David Garcia,Brian Jalaian,Nathaniel D. Bastian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CUSP（Collective Uncertainty through Semantic Opinion Pooling），一个无需训练的集体不确定性量化框架。它将多个VLM的响应映射到共享语义空间，进行意见池化，并报告两类互补的系统级信号：集体不确定性和杰森-香农散度（JSD）。该框架无需token logits或校准标签，适用于开源和商业VLM，在多VLM集成和multi-step多智能体系统中均验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合异构视觉语言模型可以提升多模态推理能力，但单个模型的置信度或聚合答案的置信度都无法在系统层面衡量可靠性，因此需要一种能够从集体层面量化不确定性的方法。

Method: 将多个VLM的响应映射到共享语义响应空间，池化为语义意见（pooled semantic opinion），并从中提取两个互补信号：集体不确定性（反映池化意见的分散程度）和JSD（反映模型间观点冲突）。未归一化的集体熵被精确分解为各模型个体语义熵的均值与JSD之和。方法无需token logits或校准标签。

Result: 静态多VLM集成中，集体不确定性在小模型场景表现最佳（预测错误检测AUROC 0.764，弃权AUARC 0.889），优于多数投票和朴素选择基线4.7-15.8个百分点，且随着集成规模增大优势扩大；JSD在商业模型场景表现最佳（AUROC 0.819，AUARC 0.910），对困难答案的模型冲突排序AUROC最高达0.982。池化预测相较平均单模型准确率提升5.6-13.0个百分点。在多步多智能体系统中，子智能体集体不确定性排名系统失败优于随机（AUROC 0.619），弃权排序最佳（AUARC 0.699）。

Conclusion: CUSP提供了一种训练免费、普适于开源与商业VLM的系统级不确定性量化方法，其分解关系揭示了集体不确定性与模型冲突的互补本质，在静态集成和动态多智能体系统中均展现出可靠性与实用性。

Abstract: Aggregating heterogeneous vision-language models (VLMs) can improve multimodal reasoning, but neither an individual model's confidence nor that of the aggregated answer measures reliability at the system level. We present CUSP (Collective Uncertainty through Semantic Opinion Pooling), a training-free uncertainty quantification framework that maps multiple VLM responses to a shared semantic response space, pools them into a pooled semantic opinion, and reports two complementary system-level signals: collective uncertainty, the dispersion of the pooled opinion, and Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD), the conflict among the model-level opinions. Within this pooled semantic opinion, the unnormalized collective entropy decomposes exactly into the mean of the models' individual semantic entropies and the JSD, separating total dispersion from model conflict. Requiring neither token logits nor calibration labels, CUSP applies to open-weight and commercial VLMs alike. In static multi-VLM ensembles, collective uncertainty is the strongest signal in the small-model regime (0.764 AUROC for prediction-error detection, 0.889 AUARC for abstention), outperforming uncertainty baselines majority voting and naive selection by 4.7 to 15.8 points and widening its margin as the ensemble grows; JSD is strongest in the evaluated commercial regime (0.819 AUROC, 0.910 AUARC) and ranks hard-answer model conflict with AUROC up to 0.982. The pooled prediction also improves accuracy over the average single model by 5.6 to 13.0 points. Over the full trajectory of a multi-step, multi-agent system, subagent collective uncertainty ranks system failures above chance (0.619 AUROC) and gives the best abstention ordering among the evaluated signals (0.699 AUARC).

</details>


### [327] [Recovering Temporal and Geographic Signals from Language Model Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05721)
*Esteban Feuerstein,Victoria Klimkowski,Juan Manuel Ortiz de Zarate,Federico Hernán Suaiter*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于投影的简单方法，仅使用输出嵌入即可检测语言模型嵌入中是否编码时间和地理信息。该方法仅需少量种子示例定义嵌入空间中的轴，通过投影对文本或实体进行排序，完全黑盒且与模型无关，适用于仅能通过API访问的现代嵌入模型。实验表明嵌入投影能够恢复有意义的时序和空间结构，为下游时间与地理信息检索任务提供实用工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解语言模型嵌入是否编码结构化的真实世界信息，对表示分析和信息检索都至关重要。现有方法往往需要访问模型权重、内部激活或训练辅助探针，限制了其对仅通过API提供的现代嵌入模型的适用性。

Method: 提出一种基于投影的方法：给定少量种子示例，在嵌入空间中定义一个轴，然后通过计算文本或实体在该轴上的投影值对其进行排名。该方法完全黑盒且模型无关，仅需嵌入输出，无需模型权重、内部激活、辅助探针或额外训练。

Result: 将该方法应用于时间和地理数据集，发现嵌入投影能够恢复有意义的年代顺序和空间结构，表明输出嵌入确实编码了与时间和空间相关的信号。

Conclusion: 输出嵌入编码了时间与空间相关的信号，该投影方法为模型可解释性及下游时间与地理信息检索任务（如时间排序、地理排名和标记）提供了轻量级实用工具。

Abstract: Understanding whether language-model embeddings encode structured real-world information is important for both representation analysis and information retrieval. We study this question for temporal and geographic signals using a simple projection-based method that operates directly on output embeddings. Given a small set of seed examples, the method defines an axis in embedding space and ranks texts or entities by their projection onto that axis. Our approach is fully black-box and model-agnostic: it requires only embeddings, without access to model weights, internal activations, auxiliary probes, or additional training. This makes it applicable to modern embedding models available only through APIs and provides a lightweight way to analyze whether temporal and spatial dimensions are present in their representation spaces. We apply the method to temporal and geographic datasets and find that embedding projections recover meaningful chronological and spatial structure. These results provide evidence that output embeddings encode signals relevant to time and space, while also offering a practical tool for interpretability and for downstream temporal and geographic information retrieval tasks, such as temporal ordering, geographic ranking, and tagging.

</details>


### [328] [Beyond Prompts: Measuring and Optimizing LLM Tool-Agent Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05736)
*Cen,Zhao,Haibo Ruan,Wenjie Chen,Pei-fen Tu,Usman Abbasi,Joel Hesch*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究固定大语言模型下的工具代理运行时环境优化问题，提出在资源受限条件下从不修改模型、仅调整提示词和工具边界中间件的搜索空间中选取最优运行时环境的协议。作者引入PRISM优化器，通过在Pareto搜索中对失败聚类并路由修复到提示词、工具边界中间件或联合编辑面，在多个基准上取得显著提升，并强调应同时报告平均提升与可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM工具代理的性能可以通过修改运行时环境（提示词、工具接口、中间件、状态处理、恢复逻辑）来提升而无需重新训练模型。然而，如何在固定模型下系统性地搜索和选取最优的运行时配置，同时兼顾性能提升与可靠性，是尚未被充分研究的问题。

Method: 提出资源受限的运行时环境选择框架，将搜索面限定为提示词与工具边界中间件（即受保护的拦截编辑）。设计与优化器无关的评估协议，报告平均保持集提升、最差条件提升、可重复性、成本诊断以及RelLift95(B)——在预算B下所选环境的保守保持集增益估计。实例化两种优化器：仅提示词优化器与提示词加中间件优化器，其中PRISM对失败进行聚类，并在Pareto搜索中将修复路由到提示词、工具边界中间件或联合编辑面。通过组件消融验证各模块贡献。

Result: 在BFCL多轮、tau2-Retail和tau2-Telecom基准上，PRISM分别取得14.2、14.9和10.1个百分点的平均保持集提升，并在三个基准上均获得正的RelLift95。组件消融表明主要收益来自失败表面路由和编辑模式约束。跨优化器的对比显示，某些搜索过程偶尔能发现大增益但会选择脆弱更新，因此需同时报告所选环境的可靠性与平均保持集提升。

Conclusion: 固定模型下的工具代理可通过运行时环境的系统性优化获得显著且可靠的性能提升；PRISM证明了将失败聚类与编辑面路由结合的Pareto搜索的有效性。研究强调在报告优化结果时必须同时呈现平均增益与可靠性指标，以避免选取脆弱的更新方案。

Abstract: LLM tool agents can be improved without retraining by modifying the runtime harness around a fixed model: prompts, tool interfaces, middleware, state handling, and recovery logic. We study this setting as resource-bounded harness selection for fixed-model multi-turn tool agents, with the search surface scoped to prompts and tool-boundary middleware: edits are guarded intercepts at the tool boundary, not arbitrary rewriting of agent execution logic. Our optimizer-agnostic protocol reports mean held-out lift, worst-condition lift, repeatability, logged cost diagnostics, and RelLift95(B), a conservative estimate of the held-out gain of the harness selected under budget B. We instantiate the protocol with prompt-only and prompt-plus-middleware optimizers, including PRISM, which clusters failures and routes repairs to prompt, tool-boundary middleware, or joint edit surfaces within a Pareto search. On BFCL multi-round, tau2-Retail, and tau2-Telecom, PRISM obtains mean held-out lifts of 14.2, 14.9, and 10.1 percentage points and positive empirical RelLift95 on all three benchmarks, and a component ablation attributes the margin chiefly to failure-surface routing and the edit-pattern constraint. Across optimizers, the results show that some search procedures can occasionally find large gains but still choose brittle updates, so the reliability of the chosen harness should be reported alongside average held-out lift.

</details>


### [329] [The Normalization of Deviance in AI Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05749)
*Emilio Barkett,Alexander Kimpton,Daniel Graham,Yusuf Kundgol*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨人工智能开发中常被忽视的组织层面风险，认为构建AI的机构本身易受结构性动力驱使而走向失败。通过分析挑战者号航天飞机、三哩岛核事故和波音737 MAX坠机等历史灾难案例，识别出共同的结构性失败机制，并将其映射到当代AI开发中，指出现有安全基础设施可能提供的保护比表面看起来更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI风险研究过度聚焦于能力风险（系统过于强大、过于自主或与人类价值观不一致），而对组织层面的风险关注甚少——即构建这些系统的机构本身是否倾向于走向失败。

Method: 采用案例研究方法，对挑战者号航天飞机事故、三哩岛核事故及波音737 MAX坠机事件进行历史案例分析，提取每次失败前的共同结构性机制，并将其映射到当代AI发展情境中。

Result: 研究表明，无论AI系统能力如何，构建它们的组织面临与过去重大技术灾难相同的结构性动力。现有安全基础设施可能提供的保护低于表面所见，因为组织可以在完全合规地完成安全流程的同时，仍然产生灾难性后果。

Conclusion: AI发展的灾难前阶段仍在进行中，本文旨在使这些结构性动力在仍可被干预时变得清晰可见，从而为预防潜在的AI相关灾难提供组织层面的警示与对策。

Abstract: Work on the risks of artificial intelligence has focused predominantly on capability risk: the danger that systems become too powerful, too autonomous, or too misaligned with human values. Far less attention has been paid to the organizational level---to whether the institutions building these systems are themselves predisposed to drift toward failure. This paper argues that they are. Regardless of how capable AI systems become, the organizations building them face the same structural dynamics that preceded past major technological disasters. Drawing on case studies of the Space Shuttle Challenger, the Three Mile Island accident, and the Boeing 737 MAX crashes, this paper identifies the common structural mechanisms preceding each failure and maps them onto contemporary AI development. The findings suggest that existing safety infrastructure may provide less protection than it appears, as organizations can complete safety processes in full compliance and still produce catastrophic outcomes. The pre-disaster period of AI development is still underway; the purpose of this paper is to make these dynamics legible while they can still be interrupted.

</details>


### [330] [From Monolithic Blending to Agentic Orchestration: Dynamic Response for Conversational Assistants at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05758)
*Cen,Zhao,Peng Wang,Chuan Shi,Yufeng Zhang,Ying Lyu,Wanmeng Ren,Robert Xue,Claire Na Cheng,Yashar Mehdad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文报告了大型住宿市场客服助手的生产迁移：用有界ReAct编排器加小型生成器（Dynamic Response, DR）替代单一Qwen3-235B-A22B混合应答模型。通过回放测试和低流量A/B测试归因架构效果：类型化实体选择将预约选择器精度从8.3%提升至89.1%（召回率从75.2%降至67.3%），类型化动作ID加成员检查消除结构化动作幻觉（2.14%降至0.0%），硬升级响应从5.60%降至3.08%，软升级从9.56%降至2.49%。服务优化将编排器P90延迟从3.87秒降至2.24秒，GPU占用减少约三分之一，自托管使年模型服务成本降低超过一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 会话助手既可以在单一模型路径中混合检索、动作选择、升级和措辞，也可以分离这些角色。作者旨在通过生产迁移验证分离架构（编排器+工具+小型生成器）相比单一大模型混合应答的优势，并严谨地将架构效果与提示词、对齐、服务等其他变更区分开来。

Method: 将单一Qwen3-235B-A22B混合应答器替换为"动态响应"（DR）系统：一个有界ReAct编排器，通过类型化工具进行工作，加上一个较小的生成器，从后端验证的上下文契约中生成回复。为了公平归因，仅在完全相同的重放轮次上测量架构效果（即只改变架构、不改变其他因素），并通过低流量A/B测试复现升级率的降低。此外应用了服务优化（延迟降低）和自托管（成本降低）。

Result: 重放测试显示：类型化实体选择使预约选择器精度从8.3%升至89.1%（召回率75.2%降至67.3%）；类型化动作ID加成员检查将结构化动作幻觉从2.14%降至0.0%。A/B测试显示硬升级响应从5.60%降至3.08%，软升级从9.56%降至2.49%，自助解决有方向性提升（+5.1点，95% CI [-2, +12]）。服务优化使编排器P90延迟从3.87秒降至2.24秒，GPU占用减少约三分之一；自托管使年成本降低超一个数量级。系统在生产环境处理每月数百万对话、覆盖11种语言、满足10秒P90要求。

Conclusion: 分离架构（有界ReAct编排器+类型化工具+小型生成器+后端验证上下文契约）相比单一大型混合应答模型，在实体选择精度、动作幻觉消除和升级率降低方面具有显著且可归因的架构优势；同时通过服务优化和自托管在延迟与成本上也获得大幅改进。该迁移验证了在真实大规模多语言生产环境中，"分离关注点"的Agent架构优于"全功能混合"的单模型路径设计。

Abstract: Conversational assistants can blend retrieval, action selection, escalation, and wording in a single model path, or separate those roles. We report a production migration of a customer-support assistant at a large accommodation marketplace (millions of conversations per month, 11 languages, 10-second P90). Dynamic Response (DR) replaces a single Qwen3-235B-A22B blended responder with a bounded ReAct orchestrator over typed tools plus a smaller generator that writes from a backend-validated context contract. Because the migration also changed prompts, alignment, and serving, we attribute each effect to its cause and claim as architecture effects only those measured on identical replayed turns: typed entity selection moves the reservation selector to a precision-first operating point (precision 8.3% to 89.1%, recall 75.2% to 67.3%), and typed action IDs with a membership check remove observed structured-action hallucination (2.14% to 0.0%). A low-ramp A/B test reproduces the replay escalation reductions: hard-escalation responses fall from 5.60% to 3.08% and soft-escalation responses from 9.56% to 2.49%, while production handoff volume holds roughly steady; self-solve is directional (+5.1 points, 95% CI [-2, +12]). Serving optimizations cut orchestrator P90 latency from 3.87s to 2.24s on a GPU footprint reduced by roughly one-third, and self-hosting reduces estimated annual model-serving cost by more than an order of magnitude.

</details>


### [331] [Inference-Time Graph Engineering for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05774)
*Katherine Tieu,Dongqi Fu,Yinglong Xia,Hong Li,Hong Yan,Jingrui He*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReActNet是一个无需训练的框架，将查询和角色专业化智能体编译为时序有向通信图序列，每个图快照对应一个推理阶段，通过结构化消息传递执行，在多种任务上优于固定拓扑和学习的拓扑基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体LLM系统依赖图结构通信来协调专业化智能体，但多采用静态拓扑或需要强化学习/梯度优化的拓扑学习，缺乏任务条件化的动态协调，且协调过程不够透明和可检视。

Method: 提出ReActNet，采用训练自由的框架：1) 将查询和角色专业化智能体编译为一系列有向通信图（时序工作流图）；2) 每个图快照对应一个推理阶段，每条边携带自然语言指令指定消息语义；3) 通过结构化消息传递执行编译后的时序图，智能体整合控制器分配的邻居消息更新推理状态；4) 最终聚合器合成所有状态生成答案。将图编译与图执行分离，无需强化学习或梯度优化。

Result: 在知识推理、数学问题求解、代码生成和GAIA风格助手任务上，ReActNet一致优于固定拓扑和学习的拓扑基线，同时保持有竞争力的推理成本。

Conclusion: 有效的多智能体编排不仅取决于哪些智能体通信，还取决于工程设计可执行的工作流图，编码推理过程中信息流动的时机、原因和方式。

Abstract: Recent multi-agent LLM systems increasingly rely on graph-structured communication to coordinate specialized agents. We revisit multi-agent orchestration from a graph-engineering perspective: rather than optimizing a static topology, we synthesize a task-conditioned temporal workflow graph that jointly specifies agent connectivity and edge-level communication semantics. We introduce ReActNet, a training-free framework that compiles a query and a set of role-specialized agents into a sequence of directed communication graphs. Each graph snapshot corresponds to one reasoning stage, and each edge carries a natural-language instruction specifying the message that a source agent should provide to a target agent. The compiled temporal graph is then executed through structured message passing: agents update their reasoning states by integrating their previous states with messages from controller-assigned neighbors, and a final aggregator synthesizes the resulting states into the answer. This design separates graph compilation from graph execution, making multi-agent coordination explicit, inspectable, and task-conditioned without requiring reinforcement learning or gradient-based topology optimization. Across knowledge reasoning, mathematical problem solving, code generation, and GAIA-style assistant tasks, ReActNet consistently improves over fixed-topology and learned-topology baselines while maintaining competitive inference cost. These results suggest that effective multi-agent orchestration depends not only on which agents communicate, but also on engineering executable workflow graphs that encode when, why, and how information should flow during reasoning.

</details>


### [332] [DI-Bench: Systematically Generating In-Domain Data Intelligence Benchmarks for Enterprise Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05776)
*Jiangyun Zhang,Kristen Surrao,Torpong Nitayanont,Yupei Zhang,Roopali Singh,Zhiyu Chen,Julia Huang,Zhou Tang,Shayan Ali Akbar,Omar Alonso,Erwin Cornejo,Yuan Li,Yi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DI-Bench，一个自动生成"数据智能"（DI）领域基准测试的流水线，通过构件关联图连接数据表、维度、指标和文档，生成需要计算与知识检索相结合的评测任务。在两个公开数据集上构建了731个任务，评估四个模型后发现：当业务规则修改计算任务时，模型准确率仅32%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业级agent的领域基准测试至关重要，但现有公开基准很少评估agent能否将业务知识与分析计算整合，且人工构建此类基准成本高昂。

Method: 提出DI-Bench流水线：首先在数据表、维度、指标和文档之间构建构件关联图（artifact linkage graph）；然后基于该图生成需要结构化数据和关联知识的问题；通过查询执行推导ground truth答案；最后利用LLM进行问题生成和验证。问题类型涵盖知识检索、分析计算和规则接地推理。

Result: 在两个公开数据集上生成731个任务的基准。评估四个模型后发现，模型整体表现不佳，尤其在涉及业务规则修改计算的任务上仅达到32%的准确率，展示了该基准的区分度和难度。

Conclusion: DI-Bench揭示了现有模型在企业数据智能场景中的明显短板——当计算需要结合领域业务规则（知识检索）时性能大幅下降，说明当前模型在"知识与计算融合"方面仍需显著提升。

Abstract: Evaluating enterprise agents on domain-specific benchmarks is critical, yet public benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can integrate business knowledge with analytical computation, and constructing such benchmarks manually is costly. We present DI-Bench, a pipeline for generating realistic benchmarks for data intelligence (DI), the practice of extracting insights from large volumes of enterprise data. To emulate realistic DI tasks that require both computation and knowledge retrieval, DI-Bench builds an artifact linkage graph over data tables, dimensions, metrics, and documents to form questions involving structured data and associated knowledge. Ground truth answers are derived via query execution, followed by LLM question generation and validation. Applied to two public datasets, the pipeline produces a 731-task benchmark covering knowledge retrieval, analytical computation, and rule-grounded reasoning. To show the discriminatory capability and difficulty of the benchmark, we evaluate four models, revealing a substantial finding: models achieve only 32% accuracy when doing computational tasks where retrieved business rules modify the computation.

</details>


### [333] [Distilling Vision-Language Models for On-Device Fire Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05782)
*Mohammad Kazzazi,Zixuan Liu,Siavash Khajavi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了如何将领域特化的视觉语言模型（VLM）通过知识蒸馏压缩，使其能够完全部署在资源受限的嵌入式火灾检测传感器上，同时保持火灾理解的安全关键行为。实验表明，紧凑的学生模型能保留教师模型大部分火灾理解能力，并在商业检测传感器上验证了推理精度、延迟和内存的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统火灾检测系统存在误报问题，而VLM虽能通过语义理解减少误报，但模型体积过大无法部署在嵌入式火灾传感器上。需要在保持安全关键行为的前提下实现模型压缩与端侧部署。

Method: 提出教师-学生知识蒸馏框架，将针对火灾理解微调的大型VLM蒸馏为轻量级学生模型，并在商用Detectium火灾检测传感器上进行端侧部署与联合评估。

Result: 多组VLM家族和模型规模的实验表明，紧凑学生模型保留了教师模型大部分火灾理解能力。Qwen2.5-0.5B在推理精度、延迟和内存使用方面提供了最强的整体部署权衡。

Conclusion: 压缩与部署不仅影响准确率，还会改变模型的失败模式。该研究为在资源受限、安全关键的场景中部署领域特化VLM提供了更广泛的指导。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising alternative to conventional fire detection systems by reasoning about the semantic context of a scene and thus reducing false alarms, yet their large model size makes deployment on embedded fire sensors impractical. In this paper, we study how domain-specialized VLMs can be compressed for fully on-device deployment without losing the safety-critical behavior required for fire detection. We develop a teacher-student knowledge distillation framework in which large VLMs fine-tuned for fire understanding can be distilled into lightweight students. Experiments across multiple VLM families and model scales show that compact students preserve most of their teachers' fire-understanding capability. We further deploy the distilled models on our commercial Detectium fire detection sensor and jointly evaluate reasoning accuracy, latency, and memory usage. The results show that compression and deployment affect not only accuracy but also model failure modes, with Qwen2.5-0.5B providing the strongest overall deployment trade-off. Our findings provide broader guidance for deploying domain-specialized VLMs in resource-constrained, safety-critical settings.

</details>


### [334] [More Than Mimicking Reviewers: Evaluating LLMs for Pre-Submission Peer Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05788)
*Pouya Parsa,Amin Rezaei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了一个面向作者的LLM预审系统，该系统在论文提交前生成大量原子性关注点并压缩成简短报告。基于3,398篇ICLR 2026论文，研究发现大型候选池能提供广泛覆盖率（去重和补充后达78.7%严格覆盖率），但压缩效果不佳——仅基于论文的选择器只能保留40-44%的覆盖率，主要瓶颈在于代表性选择和匹配器敏感度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同行评审反馈往往来得太晚，作者无法在提交前进行有意义的修改。因此，研究者希望构建一个面向作者的LLM系统，在提交前提前进行部分"压力测试"，以帮助作者改进论文。

Method: 系统先生成大量原子性关注点（候选池），然后将其压缩为简短报告。实验使用3,398篇ICLR 2026提交论文，通过独立采样评估覆盖率，再通过去重和补充策略提升覆盖，同时对比了隐藏的Top-32 Oracle与仅基于论文的选择器的表现，并通过消融实验分析差距来源。

Result: 在十篇论文的诊断测试中，独立采样覆盖44.9%的历史问题；去重和补充后达到78.7%的严格覆盖率和84.9%的严重性加权覆盖率（代价是3.6倍请求量和5.2倍token量）。隐藏的Top-32 Oracle可保留256候选池79.3%的加权覆盖率，但仅基于论文的选择器仅保留40-44%。消融实验表明主要瓶颈在于代表性选择和匹配器敏感度。

Conclusion: LLM评审在大型候选池下能提供广泛覆盖率，但压缩效果不佳。当前系统的主要局限性在于从大候选池中挑选代表性关注点的能力不足，以及匹配器对覆盖率的敏感度问题。这为该领域后续改进指明了方向。

Abstract: Peer-review feedback often arrives too late for authors to make meaningful revisions. We study an author-facing LLM system that moves part of this stress test before submission: it generates a broad pool of atomic concerns and compresses them into a short report. We evaluate agreement with historical reviews and, separately, the possible validity of concerns they omit.
  From 10,000 ICLR 2026 submissions, we use 3,398 manuscripts with accessible versions that predate review. On a ten-paper diagnostic, independent sampling covers 44.9% of historical issues; deduplication and refill reaches 78.7% strict and 84.9% seriousness-weighted coverage, at 3.6$\times$ more requests and 5.2$\times$ more tokens. A hidden Top-32 Oracle preserves the full 79.3% weighted coverage of a 256-candidate pool, but paper-only selectors retain only 40--44%. LLM review therefore provides broad coverage with a large candidate pool but compresses poorly; ablations identify representative selection and matcher sensitivity as the main sources of this gap.

</details>


### [335] [Spillover-Aware Multi-Value Steering for Pluralistic LLM Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05800)
*Weici Pan,Xander Barron,Jiawei Zhou,Zhenhua Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多维度激活引导（pluralistic alignment）方法，解决现有LLM激活引导只能处理单一概念的问题。研究发现朴素的多概念同时引导会产生严重的溢出效应（spillover），即一个价值维度的效果泄漏到其他维度。作者将问题类比因果推断中的处理-溢出分解，将溢出归因于引导方向在几何上的纠缠（由Gram矩阵刻画），并推导出基于激活范数惩罚目标的无成本修正，精确解耦各方向的贡献。该端到端管线无需微调、奖励模型或提示工程，仅凭领域问题即可自动发现价值维度、提取方向、诊断纠缠并应用修正。在气候话语任务上，修正将净引导效果从+5.9%提升至+14.0%，经过10万次成对判断验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有激活引导（Activation Steering）方法每次只能处理单一概念，而现实中的多元对齐（Pluralistic alignment）要求不同利益相关方需要不同的价值侧重，因此必须同时引导多个维度。作者发现简单地同时引导多个维度会产生严重的溢出效应，价值效果会相互泄漏，这构成了亟需解决的技术挑战。

Method: 1) 将多维度引导的溢出问题形式化为因果推断中的处理-溢出分解框架；2) 通过方向间的Gram矩阵揭示纠缠来源，证明溢出源于几何上的方向耦合；3) 推导基于激活范数惩罚目标的零成本修正公式，精确解耦每个方向的贡献；4) 构建端到端管线，无需微调、奖励模型或提示工程，仅需领域问题即可自动完成价值维度发现、方向提取、纠缠诊断和修正引导。

Result: 在气候话语（climate discourse）任务上，所提出的修正方法将净引导效果从+5.9%提升到+14.0%，提升幅度超过两倍，结果经过100,000次成对判断验证，表明该方法在真实场景中具有显著有效性。

Conclusion: 多维度激活引导中的溢出问题可以通过识别方向间的几何纠缠并施加零成本修正来有效解决，这为多元价值对齐提供了一种无需训练成本的高效途径，将激活引导从单一概念扩展到了多维度场景。

Abstract: Activation steering controls LLM behavior at inference time by adding learned directions to hidden states, but existing methods handle one concept at a time. Pluralistic alignment, where different stakeholders need different value emphases, requires steering multiple dimensions simultaneously. We show that naive steering produces substantial spillover: the effect intended for one value leaks into others. This parallels the treatment-versus-spillover decomposition in causal inference. We trace spillover to geometric entanglement of steering directions, captured by their Gram matrix, and derive a zero-cost correction from an activation-norm-penalized objective that decouples each direction's contribution exactly. Our end-to-end pipeline requires no fine-tuning, no reward model, and no manual prompt engineering: given only domain questions, it automatically discovers value dimensions, extracts directions, diagnoses entanglement, and applies corrected steering. On climate discourse, the correction improves the net steering effect from +5.9% to +14.0%, validated over 100,000 pairwise judgments.

</details>


### [336] [Evidence-Aligned Local Composition of Discrete Experts for Sequence Restoration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05801)
*Mohammad Panahazari,Usman A. Khan,Shuchin Aeron*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种"证据对齐的局部组合"方法，用于在测试时、无需区域标签或训练路由器的情况下，从被破坏的混合领域文档中恢复内容。该方法通过从专家自身的去噪损失估计证据，推断出每个位置上对各个专家的软权重，从而在真实组合为混合时恢复混合，在单个专家足够时集中到该专家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实文档（如README）通常是由不同领域文本（散文、代码、配置）组合而成的，在损坏后需要恢复时，既要决定缺失内容，又要决定每个位置应该信任哪个领域专家。现有的方法缺乏区域标签或训练路由器，无法在测试时进行这种决策，因此需要一种无需这些条件就能推断位置级专家权重的机制。

Method: 引入证据对齐的局部组合方法：在给定的损坏模型下，从损坏观测的边缘证据推断各专家在每个位置的软权重；具体通过专家自身的去噪损失来估计证据，并在位置上对权重进行平滑处理。由于权重是软的，当真实组合是混合时可恢复混合权重，当单个专家足够时则集中到该专家。

Result: 在分类模拟器、字节级专家以及从1.3B离散流匹配模型微调的专家上进行实验：在自然混合的科学文档上，推断权重达到0.85的字段准确率；在词汇不相交的构造混合上达到0.98。当专家真正不同时，恢复效果优于单一全局权重；当专家趋同时则退化为全局权重，整体跟踪专家分离度。

Conclusion: 证据对齐的局部组合能够在不依赖区域标签或训练路由器的条件下，通过软权重自适应地恢复混合领域文档，其性能与专家之间的实际分离程度密切相关，在专家差异明显时优势显著。

Abstract: A document modeled as a discrete sequence of tokens can be thought of as being generated from a composition of texts from different domains; a README file, for example, moves between prose, code, and configuration. When such a document is corrupted and only frozen domain experts are available, restoring it requires deciding both what is missing and which expert to trust at each position, at test time and without region labels or a trained router. We introduce evidence-aligned local composition, which infers a soft, position-wise weighting over the experts from the marginal evidence of the corrupted observation under a given corruption model, estimating the evidence from the experts' own denoising losses and smoothing the weights across positions. Because the weighting is soft, it recovers a mixture when the true composition is mixed and concentrates on one expert when that suffices. Across a categorical simulator, byte-level experts, and experts fine-tuned from a $1.3$B discrete flow-matching model, the inferred weights track the true regions at $0.85$ field accuracy on naturally mixed scientific documents, and at $0.98$ on constructed mixtures whose regions are lexically disjoint. Restoration improves over a single global weight when the experts are genuinely distinct and reduces to it when they converge, tracking a measure of expert separation.

</details>


### [337] [A Generalization of Amari's Bayesian Duality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09126)
*Mohammad Emtiyaz Khan,Thomas Möllenhoff*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了Amari在贝叶斯对偶性方面的工作，将其与贝叶斯规则的凸对偶性联系起来，并提出了一种Amari贝叶斯对偶性的推广，讨论了其对现代人工智能的相关意义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Amari在信息几何和机器学习领域的贡献广为人知，但其贝叶斯对偶性工作受到的关注较少。作者希望通过重新审视这一工作，建立其与贝叶斯规则凸对偶性的联系，从而揭示其对现代人工智能（AI）的潜在价值。

Method: 将Amari的贝叶斯对偶性与贝叶斯规则的凸对偶性建立连接，并基于此连接提出Amari贝叶斯对偶性的推广形式。

Result: 建立了Amari贝叶斯对偶性与贝叶斯规则凸对偶性之间的联系，获得了Amari贝叶斯对偶性的推广，并阐述了其对现代AI的相关性。

Conclusion: Amari的贝叶斯对偶性可以通过凸对偶的视角得到推广和更深理解，这一推广对现代人工智能具有重要的现实意义。

Abstract: Amari's contributions to information geometry and machine learning are well known. Here, we revisit Amari's work on Bayesian duality which has not received as much attention. We connect Amari's Bayesian duality to a convex duality of Bayes' rule. Using this connection, we present a generalization of Amari's Bayesian duality and discuss its relevance for modern artificial intelligence.

</details>


### [338] [Exposing Weaknesses in Emotion Recognition in Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05806)
*Amir Ben Khalifa,Fanny Bezancon,Amine Trabelsi,Bessam Abdulrazak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文质疑情感识别对话（ERC）中每个话语可被赋予单一明确情感标签的基本假设，通过在零样本设置下使用LLM进行研究，发现聚合指标掩盖了系统性失败，且大量"错误"实为注释歧义而非模型缺陷。作者引入LLM-as-Judge框架，按每个情感在对话情境中的合理性独立评估，而非强制单一标签决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ERC方法依赖任务特定微调，可能利用数据集特定线索；且ERC领域普遍假设每个话语可被分配单一无歧义的情感标签，这一核心假设从未被认真质疑。作者希望通过LLM零样本研究来审视该假设的有效性。

Method: 采用LLM在零样本设置下进行ERC研究，将前序对话话语作为上下文；通过受控的四名人类标注者重新标注研究验证注释歧义；提出LLM-as-Judge框架，对每个情感类别按其对话情境合理性独立评分，而非强制单一标签。

Result: 错误集中在含否定、感叹词和感叹语的语句中，且该模式在所有评估模型中一致出现，表明是基准问题而非模型弱点。四名人类标注者仅35%的情况达成强一致性，中性和平话语主导高一致性实例，许多情感类别处于低一致性区域。标准单标签评估因此不足。

Conclusion: 许多看似模型产生的错误实际反映的是真实存在的注释模糊性，而非模型情感理解能力不足。标准单标签情感评估方法不足以可靠衡量模型在ERC任务中的真实能力，需要更细粒度、独立的情感维度的评估框架。

Abstract: Emotion Recognition in Conversations (ERC) aims to identify speakers' emotions in multi-turn dialogue. Accurate emotion recognition can support a wide range of applications, including empathetic conversational agents, mental health support, and educational technologies. While many recent approaches rely on task-specific fine-tuning, such models may exploit dataset-specific cues. A central yet rarely questioned assumption in ERC is that each utterance can be assigned a single unambiguous emotion label. To investigate this assumption, we study ERC using Large Language Models (LLMs) in a zero-shot setting while incorporating preceding conversational turns as context. We show that aggregate metrics mask systematic failures. Errors concentrate around utterances containing negations, exclamations, and interjections. This pattern is consistent across all evaluated models, suggesting limitations in the benchmarks rather than model-specific weaknesses. A controlled re-annotation study involving four human annotators supports this finding: strong agreement is observed in only 35 percent of cases, with neutral utterances dominating high-agreement instances, while many emotional categories fall into low-agreement regimes. These findings suggest that many apparent model errors reflect genuine annotation ambiguity rather than poor emotion understanding. Standard single-label evaluation is therefore insufficient. To address this limitation, we introduce an LLM-as-Judge framework that evaluates each emotion independently according to its plausibility in the conversational context rather than enforcing a single-label decision.

</details>


### [339] [Beyond Top-$k$ Skill Retrieval: Diversity-Aware Skill Routing for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05824)
*Wang Wei,Tiankai Yang,Samyadeep Basu,Hongjie Chen,Yue Zhao,Zhengzhong Tu,Xiyang Hu,Franck Dernoncourt,Ryan A. Rossi,Hoda Eldardiry*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了Diverse Skill Routing (DSR)框架，利用行列式点过程在技能路由中平衡相关性与多样性，解决大语言模型智能体在大型技能库中选择技能时的冗余问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体日益依赖外部技能，但用户请求在大型技能注册表上的路由很困难，因为许多技能功能冗余，而复杂任务往往需要互补的技能组合。现有技能路由器通常独立按查询相关性排序候选项，可能浪费上下文预算在冗余技能上。

Method: 提出DSR框架，一种多样性感知的重排序框架，使用行列式点过程(DPP)来平衡相关性和非冗余性。DSR引入了查询残差多样性核(query-residual diversity kernel)，惩罚冗余技能重叠，同时减少仅由共享查询相关性引起的惩罚。

Result: 在SkillRouter基准测试上，DSR相比强逐点重排序基线在召回率和全覆盖率上都有提升，在多技能查询上增益更大。

Conclusion: 技能路由不仅应被视为相关性排序问题，还应当被视为互补集合选择问题。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external skills, but routing user requests over large skill registries is difficult because many skills are functionally redundant while complex tasks often require complementary skill sets. Existing skill routers typically rank candidates independently by query relevance, which can waste context budget on redundant skills. We propose Diverse Skill Routing (DSR), a diversity-aware reranking framework that uses a Determinantal Point Process to balance relevance and non-redundancy. DSR introduces a query-residual diversity kernel that penalizes redundant skill overlap while reducing penalties caused only by shared query relevance. On the SkillRouter benchmark, DSR improves recall and full coverage over a strong pointwise reranking baseline, with larger gains on multi-skill queries. These results suggest that skill routing should be treated not only as relevance ranking, but also as complementary set selection.

</details>


### [340] [Learning Counterfactual World Models for Embodied Reasoning under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05834)
*Todd Y. Zhou,Daniel Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文指出世界模型的一个关键失败模式——"反事实坍缩"（counterfactual collapse），即模型虽能预测视觉上合理的未来，却无法区分具有不同行为后果的干预。作者提出反事实隐世界模型（CLWM），结合循环信念状态编码器、动作条件隐动力学和对比反事实目标，在遮挡操作、混叠导航和长时程操作任务上显著提升规划成功率，并提出一个表征无关的反事实可分性度量指标用于审计编码器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型被认为是具身智能的通用途径，但大规模预训练的表征通常针对感知相似性优化而非干预结构，导致模型可能产生视觉上看似合理但行为上不可区分的预测。预测质量本身无法回答"学习到的表征何时真正可操作"这一关键问题。

Method: 提出CLWM框架，包含三部分：(1) 循环信念状态编码器捕捉历史信息；(2) 动作条件隐动力学模型；(3) 对比反事实目标，用于分离不同干预导致的不同未来状态，即使对应观测在外观上相似。此外引入反事实可分性度量，可审计任意编码器的可操作性。

Result: 在遮挡推物任务上规划成功率从65.1%提升至74.6%，在混叠迷宫任务上从67.3%提升至78.9%，在延迟厨房任务上将利用性规划失败从18.4%降至9.7%。消融实验表明增益主要来自困难反事实负样本（尤其感知混叠负样本）。反事实可分性度量在五类基线模型上与规划成功率高度相关（r≥0.94）。

Conclusion: 论证了为感知相似性优化的表征不足以支撑可操作的世界模型，需要反事实干预结构。反事实可分性度量是一个表征无关的审计工具，可在规划器信任任意编码器之前评估其可操作性。作者诚实指出尚未在大规模预训练编码器上验证该度量，目前仅建立了与从头训练世界模型规划成功率的关联。

Abstract: World models promise a general route to embodied intelligence: learn predictive dynamics once, then reason, plan, and act with them. Increasingly, the representations beneath such models are pretrained on large-scale video, interaction, and multimodal corpora, which raises a question prediction quality alone cannot answer: when is a learned representation actually actionable? We identify a failure mode we call counterfactual collapse: a model predicts visually plausible futures while failing to distinguish interventions with different behavioral consequences. This arises whenever a representation is optimized for perceptual similarity rather than intervention structure, which is precisely the objective under which most large-scale pretrained encoders are learned. We introduce Counterfactual Latent World Models (CLWM), which combine a recurrent belief-state encoder, action-conditioned latent dynamics, and a contrastive counterfactual objective that separates futures induced by distinct interventions even when their observations look alike. Across occluded manipulation, aliased navigation, and long-horizon manipulation, CLWM improves planning success over the strongest baseline (65.1% $\to$ 74.6% on Occluded Push and 67.3% $\to$ 78.9% on Aliased Maze) and reduces exploitative planning failures (18.4% $\to$ 9.7% on Deferred Kitchen), with ablations attributing the gains to hard counterfactual negatives, especially perceptual-alias negatives. Finally, our counterfactual separability metric, which tracks planning success across the five baseline model classes ($r \ge 0.94$), is representation-agnostic: given intervention-outcome labels, it can audit any encoder, pretrained or trained from scratch, before a planner trusts it. We do not yet measure it on large-scale pretrained encoders. Here we establish the metric and its relationship to planning success for world models trained from scratch.

</details>


### [341] [AgentBrew: Offline Tool-Use Agent Learning from Raw Real-World Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05837)
*Zhiyi Lyu,Yewen Li,Longtao Zheng,Shengtian Yang,Lang Feng,Lei Feng,Peng Jiang,Kun Gai,Qingpeng Cai,Bo An*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AgentBrew是一个离线训练框架，从单批原始交互轨迹中学习有效的工具使用策略，无需任务验证器或在线交互，通过回溯任务推断和PMI信用分配来从噪声轨迹中提取训练信号，在三个真实MCP应用上超越大规模模型和拒绝采样方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代理在真实应用中通过工具API部署时，训练面临三大根本困难：真实应用没有预定义任务或验证器、没有忠实的模拟器、且大规模环境交互的预算有限，因此需要一种能在离线条件下从现成轨迹中学习的训练方法。

Method: AgentBrew采用两步核心机制：(1) 回溯任务推断——基于轨迹的实际结果，为每条轨迹重构一致的对齐指令；(2) 基于PMI的信用分配——通过点互信息将轨迹关于推断指令的总信息量分解为每个动作的加性信用，用以加权策略训练目标，放大信息量高的动作并抑制无效动作。

Result: 在GitHub、Notion、PostgreSQL三个真实MCP应用中，AgentBrew将Qwen3-32B平均提升+8.7 Accuracy/+9.7 Score，超越Qwen3-235B(+2.3/+4.4)，并优于拒绝采样方法(+5.9/+10.3)。

Conclusion: 细粒度的离线学习能够从原始轨迹中恢复过滤方法会丢弃的有用监督信号，证明了纯粹基于离线交互数据训练高效工具使用策略的可行性。

Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed in real-world applications through tool-use APIs, yet training them for specific environments remains fundamentally difficult: real-world applications provide no pre-defined tasks or verifiers, no faithful simulators, and limited budget for large-scale environment interaction. In this paper, we propose \textbf{AgentBrew}, an offline training framework that learns effective tool-use policies from a single batch of raw interaction trajectories, without task verifiers or iterative on-policy rollouts. The agent first explores the target environment to collect a raw trajectory corpus without quality filtering. To extract training signal from this noisy corpus, \emph{retrospective task inference} reconstructs an aligned instruction for each trajectory based on its actual outcome, and \emph{PMI-Based credit assignment} decomposes the trajectory's total information about the inferred instruction into additive per-action credits via pointwise mutual information (PMI). These credits weight the policy training objective, amplifying informative actions while suppressing ineffective ones. On three real-world MCP applications (GitHub, Notion, PostgreSQL), AgentBrew improves Qwen3-32B by +8.7 Acc / +9.7 Score on average, surpassing Qwen3-235B (+2.3 / +4.4) and outperforming rejection sampling (+5.9 / +10.3). These results demonstrate that fine-grained offline learning can recover useful supervision from raw trajectories that filtering-based approaches would discard. The code is available at https://github.com/alphatogo/AgentBrew

</details>


### [342] [Multimodal Resource-Exhaustion Attacks on Vision-Language Models via Joint Pixel-Prompt Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05889)
*Zhaoxiong Ni,Yatie Xiao,Chi-Man Pun,Fei Peng,Qingxiao Guan,Keke Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Joint Pixel-Prompt Optimization (JPPO)，首个将可见提示词与图像扰动共同作为对抗变量的复合攻击框架，通过联合的像素和提示词分阶段优化实现资源耗尽攻击，在多种VLM上达到远超单模态基线的延迟和能量放大效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对自回归视觉语言模型的资源耗尽攻击通常只考虑单模态威胁模型，将图像分支作为主要优化面而保持用户提示词不变。即使是最近的循环型攻击也局限于单一通道范式，未将跨模态交互中的可见提示词视为可利用的对抗变量，导致攻击面未被充分探索。

Method: JPPO将可见提示词提升为与图像扰动同等重要的第一类对抗变量，在受限的联合输入威胁模型下，对像素和提示词两个表面执行耦合的分阶段联合优化，从而产生协同的成本放大效应，其机制区别于依赖循环失效的攻击。

Result: 在MS COCO和ImageNet上评估五个开源VLM家族，在8/255无穷范数预算下，JPPO在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上实现超过4.6倍延迟和5.3倍能量放大，在BLIP-2上实现超过36.6倍延迟和32.7倍能量放大，在直接对比的基线中达到最强成本放大效果，且所需优化迭代次数显著更少。消融实验证实放大效应源于多模态协同而非提示词长度或单一模态。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了当前VLM服务防御中的结构性盲区，主张将成本感知的鲁棒性评估作为多模态部署中的一等安全需求。

Abstract: Resource-exhaustion attacks against autoregressive vision-language models (VLMs) typically assume unimodal threat models, treating the image branch as the primary optimization surface while holding user-visible prompts fixed. Even recent loop-centric variants remain confined to this single-channel paradigm, leaving the exploitation of availability unexplored as a cross-modal optimization problem over jointly controllable input surfaces.
  We introduce Joint Pixel-Prompt Optimization (JPPO), the first compound adversarial framework elevating the visible prompt to a first-class adversarial variable alongside image perturbations. Under a restricted joint-input threat model, JPPO performs coupled, stagewise optimization over both the pixel and prompt surfaces. This produces synergistic cost amplification, mechanistically distinct from loop-dependent failures, exhibiting negligible loop incidence in our experiments.
  Evaluating five open-source VLM families on MS COCO and ImageNet under an 8/255 infinity-norm budget, JPPO achieves over 4.6x latency and 5.3x energy amplification on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and over 36.6x latency with 32.7x energy amplification on BLIP-2. This represents the strongest cost amplification among directly compared baselines while requiring substantially fewer optimization iterations. Ablations confirm this amplification arises from multimodal coordination rather than prompt length or isolated modalities. These findings reveal structural blind spots in current VLM serving defenses, motivating cost-aware robustness evaluation as a first-class security requirement for multimodal deployments.

</details>


### [343] [The End of AI Exponentiation: Fluttering Inside and Outside AI Bubble](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05894)
*Victor Kebande*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文探讨了人工智能指数级增长时代可能面临终结的现象，分析了AI生态系统内部与外部的多重不稳定因素，包括算力与数据中心竞赛、投机性投资、超级智能竞赛，以及劳动力冲击、治理担忧、公众不确定性和地缘政治加速等外部挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI发展虽然由大语言模型、大规模算力基础设施和自主推理系统驱动进入变革时代，但传统扩展范式正面临峰值数据限制、计算需求上升、合成数据递归、估值膨胀和社会不稳定等摩擦，持续指数增长难以为继，需要审视这一转折点。

Method: 本文采用概念性/评论性分析方法，从"AI指数增长终结"的视角切入，将AI生态系统中的不稳定因素分为内外两个维度进行系统探讨：内部涵盖算力和数据中心竞赛、投机性投资、超级智能军备竞赛；外部涵盖劳动力颠覆、治理问题、公众不确定性以及全球地缘政治加速。

Result: 文章识别并梳理了AI指数增长面临的系统性挑战，揭示了泡沫内外不稳定性的双层结构，即生态内部的结构性风险与生态外部的社会性冲击相互交织，共同制约AI的持续指数发展。

Conclusion: AI正从粗放的指数扩展时代向更具反思性的阶段过渡，需要正视技术、社会、经济、伦理和基础设施等多维度的瓶颈与风险，重新评估AI发展的可持续路径。

Abstract: The exponentiation of Artificial intelligence (AI) in the recent past has entered a transformative era that has been driven by the growth in large language models (LLMs), large-scale compute infrastructures, and autonomous reasoning systems. However, the rapid acceleration of AI has increasingly shown technological, societal, economic, ethical and infrastructural challenges associated with peak data limitations, rising computational demands, synthetic data recursion, valuation inflation, and societal instability. The traditional scaling paradigms that have powered the modern AI systems are gradually encountering friction in sustaining continuous exponential growth. This paper views ``the end of AI exponentiation,'' thus exploring how it flutters inside and outside the bubble, where instability emerges within the AI ecosystem through compute and data-center races, speculative investments, and the rat-race toward superintelligence, and outside the ecosystem through labor disruption, governance concerns, public uncertainty, and geopolitical acceleration surrounding future intelligent systems and infrastructures globally.

</details>


### [344] [Beyond Final Decisions: A Process-Centric Benchmark for Transparent AI-Assisted Peer Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05947)
*Siming Yuan,Xueyi Zhang,Wangze Ni,Tianfang Xiao,Shimin Di,Jia Zhu,Zhuoren Jiang,Rong Tan,Lei Chen,Kui Ren*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个以过程为中心（process-centric）的AI辅助同行评审诊断基准，通过对比黄金过程变量与预测过程变量在决策预测中的价值，分阶段评估、链一致性评估和干预敏感性分析，揭示模型生成的中间评审文本虽具局部一致性，但其最终决策并未被前置评审证据可靠支撑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI辅助同行评审评估多聚焦于评审整体质量或最终决策准确性，未能验证模型决策是否基于充分且可靠的评审证据，缺乏对评审过程可靠性的系统诊断。

Method: 构建过程对齐数据集（来自PeerRead、NLPeer ARR-22和OpenReview-ICLR），以直接从论文内容预测决策（Direct）为基线，比较黄金过程变量与预测过程变量的决策价值，并执行阶段级评估、链一致性评估和干预敏感性分析。

Result: 在三个数据集和六个模型上的实验表明：黄金过程变量通常具有更高的决策价值；对于主分析模型，黄金-预测差距在数据集和随机种子间保持稳定，且在大多数模型-数据集组合中复现；模型生成的相邻中间评审阶段文本局部一致性较高，但最终决策未得到前置评审证据的一致支撑。

Conclusion: 该基准面向辅助而非替代人类审稿人的AI系统，提供了一个透明、可审计的诊断工具，用于评估AI评审过程的可靠性。

Abstract: Peer review is central to quality control in science. However, existing evaluations of AI-assisted peer review mainly focus on the overall quality of generated reviews or the accuracy of final decisions. They therefore provide limited evidence about whether model decisions are supported by sufficient and reliable review evidence. We introduce a process-centric diagnostic benchmark for AI-assisted peer review. It uses (x,$z_s$,$z_c$,$z_r$,y)
  to represent the paper content, summary, critique, suggestion, and decision. We convert heterogeneous review records from PeerRead, NLPeer ARR-22, and OpenReview-ICLR into process-aligned data. Our benchmark uses direct decision prediction from the paper content (Direct) as its baseline. It compares the decision value of Gold-process variables and Predicted-process variables, and conducts stage-level evaluation, chain-consistency evaluation, and interventional sensitivity analysis. Experiments across three datasets and six models show that Gold-process variables generally have higher decision value. For the main analysis model, the Gold--Predicted gap remains stable across datasets and random seeds. This gap is also reproduced in most model--dataset combinations. Although model-generated intermediate review texts show relatively high local consistency across adjacent stages, the final decisions are not consistently supported by the preceding review evidence. Our benchmark targets AI systems designed to assist rather than replace human reviewers. It provides a transparent and auditable diagnostic tool for evaluating the reliability of their review processes.

</details>


### [345] [MOAE: Multi-Objective Agent Evolution with Pareto-Preserving Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05992)
*Hengle Jiang,Qijun Cai,Ziying Luo,Ke Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出多目标智能体进化（MOAE）方法，将迭代式上下文优化组织为帕累托保持的进化搜索，在有限回滚预算下维护非支配候选档案，实现任务性能、轨迹质量和安全性等目标的同时优化，避免传统固定标量化丢失有用的部署权衡候选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体的评估越来越多元化，不仅需要任务完成准确率，还要兼顾交互质量、安全和效率。现有方法常将异构指标折叠为固定标量分数，这依赖于指标归一化和偏好权重，可能丢弃具有实际部署价值的权衡候选。

Method: MOAE将迭代式上下文优化组织为帕累托保持的进化搜索，作用于完整的智能体回滚轨迹。在有限回滚预算下，维护非支配候选的经验档案，利用目标特定诊断引导子代生成，仅在部署阶段应用约束感知选择，从而将搜索阶段的候选保留与返回最终解时的偏好分离开来。该方法无需参数更新，且每个目标可替换为任意可测属性，论文将其实例化为任务性能、轨迹质量和安全性。

Result: 在TravelPlanner和AgentDojo上的实验表明，在匹配的回滚预算下，MOAE一致地提升了任务性能和轨迹质量，同时保持较强的安全性。搜索行为分析进一步表明，帕累托保持扩展了可达目标区域，并增加了联合改进的频率。

Conclusion: 结果展示了帕累托保持的上下文化进化在优化多种智能体属性方面的潜力，无需在搜索阶段承诺固定的标量化方案，同时保留多样化的部署权衡选择。
