Abstract: Automated alpha factor discovery searches symbolic trading signals from price-volume panels and order-book data under a fixed evaluation budget. Existing single- and multi-agent program-search systems can overfit predictive proxies that fail after execution costs and repeatedly explore redundant factor families, limiting execution robustness and behavioral diversity. We introduce GoAnt, a quality-diversity multi-agent search framework that combines non-communicating Explorer, Exploiter and Connector workers with a shared adaptive Mental Map and a compact Queen dispatcher. The Mental Map organizes candidates by leakage-free execution profiles and retains one elite per niche, while the Queen reallocates the evaluation budget from explicit search-state summaries. We also define a map-independent effective-yield protocol that counts high-quality, mutually nonredundant factors directly from each method's evaluation records, giving archive-based and map-free systems the same ruler. On real A-share microstructure data spanning 2023--2026, GoAnt reaches quality-weighted yields of 41.8 and 47.6 in price-volume and order-book settings, improving the strongest baseline by 57% and 97% under matched budgets. Its locked populations retain 0.64 and 0.67 of in-sample quality out of sample, compared with 0.61 and 0.63 for a static map.

</details>


### [476] [Application of curiosity driven exploration methods for hardware interference identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08729)
*Ludovic Matar,Clement Moulin-Frier,Pierre-Yves Oudeyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了将多核安全关键系统中的干扰分析建模为复杂系统行为空间探索问题，并采用人工智能中的好奇心驱动探索算法，在模拟器环境中系统高效地覆盖可能的干扰行为。相比传统伪随机程序生成方法，该方法能在有限实验预算内实现更广泛、更均匀的行为覆盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从单核向多核架构的转变在安全关键嵌入式系统中引入了因共享硬件资源竞争导致的核间干扰挑战，这种干扰影响执行时间并使严格时序要求的验证复杂化。现有干扰分析方法（无论是手动还是基于模型的）都难以捕捉微架构组件间复杂交互所产生的全部行为范围，因此需要更系统化的探索方法。

Method: 将多核干扰分析形式化为对复杂系统行为空间的探索问题，采用人工智能中的好奇心驱动探索算法（curiosity-driven exploration algorithms），在基于模拟器的环境中系统性地覆盖可能的干扰行为空间，以弥补传统伪随机程序生成方法在行为覆盖上的不足。

Result: 实验表明，与传统的伪随机程序生成方法相比，所提出的好奇心驱动探索方法在有限的实验预算内实现了更广泛且更均匀的行为覆盖。

Conclusion: 好奇心驱动的人工智能探索算法为多核干扰分析提供了一种新颖且有效的思路，能够更高效全面地覆盖干扰行为空间，有望辅助航空航天等安全关键领域中干扰源识别与验证工作。

Abstract: The transition from single-core to multi-core architectures in safety-critical embedded systems introduces significant challenges due to inter-core interference caused by contention for shared hardware resources. Such interference affects execution times and complicates the verification of strict temporal requirements, particularly in domains such as avionics where standards require comprehensive identification of interference sources. Existing interference analysis approaches, whether manual or model-based, struggle to capture the full range of behaviors arising from the complex interactions among micro-architectural components. In this paper, we frame multi-core interference analysis as the exploration of a complex system behavior space. We propose the use of curiosity-driven exploration algorithms from artificial intelligence to systematically and efficiently cover the space of possible interference behaviors. Using a simulator-based environment, we show that the proposed approach achieves broader and more uniform behavioral coverage within a limited experimental budget compared to traditional pseudo-random program generation methods.

</details>


### [477] [When Can One Obtain Certificates of Optimality Using Positivstellensaetze?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08736)
*Nayoon Kim,Allen Gehret,Shenyuan Ma,Jakub Marecek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究学习问题中非多项式目标函数与约束条件的正性证书与最优性证书。作者将Fischer的构造性严格与非严格Positivstellensätze的证明核心公理化，并在有序域上的抽象函数代数中证明了相应定理，通过分离客观/约束函数与辅助原语的不同角色，覆盖连续与可定义函数代数等多种实例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Positivstellensätze主要针对多项式问题，而实际学习问题中目标函数和约束条件往往并非多项式。作者希望将这些经典代数几何与实代数结果推广到更广泛（非多项式）的函数类上，从而为更一般的学习优化问题提供正性与最优性证书的理论基础。

Method: 作者从Fischer的严格与非严格Positivstellensätze中提炼出核心公理框架，在有序域上的抽象函数代数中重新构建定理证明。该框架的关键在于分离两种角色：目标与约束函数可由宽泛的连续或可定义运算构建，而用于构造证书的辅助原语则需要满足明确的标量与闭包公理。随后在连续函数代数与可定义函数代数上给出具体实例。

Result: 该框架成功扩展到包括不封闭于平方根的有序域在内的场景，给出了下界证书与全局最优性证书，并分析了展开项长度与共享计算图复杂度两方面的代价。

Conclusion: 通过将Positivstellensätze抽象公理化，本文为一般（非多项式）学习问题的正性与最优性证明提供了统一的、可构造的理论工具，极大扩展了这类证书方法的应用范围。

Abstract: We study certificates of positivity and optimality for learning problems whose objectives and constraints need not be polynomial. We isolate an axiomatic core of Fischer's constructive strict and weak Positivstellensätze and prove the resulting theorems for abstract function algebras over ordered fields. The framework separates two roles that can otherwise be conflated: objective and constraint functions may be built from broad classes of continuous or definable operations, while the auxiliary primitives used to construct a certificate satisfy explicit scalar and closure axioms. We give instances over continuous and definable function algebras, including ordered fields not closed under square roots, derive lower-bound and global-optimality certificates, and analyze both expanded term length and shared computation-graph complexity.

</details>


### [478] [It's All in the Way You Say It: The Role of Information Representation in LLM-Based Glycemic-Event Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08772)
*Andrea Apicella,Pasquale Arpaia,Matteo Orefice,Andrea Pollastro,Roberto Prevete*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了基于提示的通用大型语言模型(LLMs)在1型糖尿病患者餐后高/低血糖预测中的表现，使用OhioT1DM数据集，评估多种开源LLM在零样本和少样本推理下的效果。结果显示任务依赖性明显：传统监督模型在高血糖预测中表现最佳，而基于提示的LLM配置在低血糖预测中显著提升性能。生理信息的文本表示方式对效果影响显著，但增加上下文信息并非系统性获益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLMs正被越来越多地应用于生理时间序列预测，但其有效性可能不仅取决于模型本身，还取决于生理信息在推理时的表示和呈现方式。现有研究缺乏对提示设计、信息表示方式以及信息量对LLM血糖预测效果影响的系统性评估。

Method: 使用OhioT1DM数据集，评估多种开源权重LLM在零样本和少样本推理下的血糖预测。预测窗口涵盖30/60/90分钟。系统性变化两类因素：1)生理信息的文本表示方式；2)暴露给模型的信息量（从仅血糖观测到衍生描述符及胰岛素、膳食、碳水化合物、体力活动等上下文变量）。与患者特异性监督模型及Gluco-LLM（专用于血糖预测的语言模型架构）进行性能对比。

Result: 1) 传统监督模型在高血糖预测中表现最强；2) 最佳的基于提示的LLM配置在所有预测窗口下均改善了低血糖预测；3) 提示推理的有效性强烈受生理信息表示方式影响；4) 提供额外的上下文信息并未带来系统性改进。

Conclusion: 生理信息的表示方式是基于提示的LLM方法在血糖事件预测中的核心设计因素。该发现为未来面向LLM的生理时间序列预测研究提供了重要指导，强调信息表征设计比单纯增加信息量更为关键。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being investigated for physiological time-series prediction, yet their effectiveness may depend not only on the model itself, but also on how physiological information is represented and presented at inference time. This study investigates prompt-based general-purpose LLMs for postprandial hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia prediction in individuals with type 1 diabetes. Using the OhioT1DM dataset, we evaluate multiple open-weight LLMs under zero-shot and few-shot inference across prediction horizons of 30, 60, and 90 minutes. The analysis varies both the textual representation of the available physiological information and the amount of information exposed to the model, ranging from glucose observations alone to derived descriptors and additional contextual variables related to insulin, meals, carbohydrates, and physical activity. Performance is compared with conventional patient-specific supervised models and with Gluco-LLM, a language-model-based architecture explicitly adapted to glucose time-series forecasting. Results show a marked task-dependent behavior. Conventional supervised models achieve the strongest performance for hyperglycemia prediction, whereas the best observed prompt-based LLM configurations improve performance for hypoglycemia across all investigated horizons. The effectiveness of prompt-based inference is also strongly influenced by how physiological information is represented, while providing additional contextual information does not lead to a systematic improvement. Overall, these findings highlight physiological information representation as a central design factor in prompt-based LLM approaches to glycemic-event prediction.

</details>


### [479] [Closing the Consistency Gap: Self-Evolving Agents That Learn to Stay on Course](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08832)
*Evelyn Duesterwald,Benjamin Elder,Lilian Ngweta,Shashanka Ubaru,Malgorzata Zimon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出了"一致性差距"（consistency gap）概念：LLM驱动的智能体在平均表现上准确，但在生产环境中可靠性不足。例如，ReAct智能体在AppWorld基准上单次通过率平均为77%，但同一任务运行五次全部成功的概率仅为53%，存在24个百分点的差距。作者提出一个自进化智能体框架，通过识别轨迹中不稳定的低一致性步骤，将其转化为情境记忆来缩小这一差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管已观察到LLM智能体"平均准确但生产不可靠"的现象，但该问题在很大程度上未被解决。作者认为弥合一致性差距是可信AI智能体部署的先决条件。

Method: 提出自进化智能体框架，核心包含两个组件：（1）一致性分析器（Consistency Analyzer）——精确定位轨迹中在多次执行间可能翻转的位置和原因；（2）指南生成器（Guideline Generator）——将诊断转化为有针对性的指南，存入记忆并在未来类似任务执行时注入。

Result: 在AppWorld基准上使用ReAct/GPT-4.1，该框架将"五次运行全部成功"的任务比例提升了16个百分点（同任务评估），并在类似任务的泛化场景中提升了13个百分点。

Conclusion: 通过识别和记忆不稳定步骤，自进化框架能有效缩小一致性差距，提升智能体在重复执行和相似任务上的可靠性，为可信AI智能体部署奠定基础。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-powered agents can be accurate on average yet unreliable in production, a discrepancy that has been observed but remains largely unaddressed. When given the same task five times, a ReAct agent on the AppWorld benchmark using GPT-4.1 succeeds in all five runs only 53% of the time, even though its per-run pass rate averages 77%. We call this 24-point shortfall the consistency gap, and we argue that addressing it is a precondition for trustworthy AI agent deployment. We present a self-evolving agent framework that reduces this gap by identifying unstable, low-consistency steps in agent trajectories and converting them into episodic memory the agent can draw on in future runs. At its core is a Consistency Analyzer that pinpoints where and why a trajectory is likely to flip across executions, and a Guideline Generator that converts the diagnosis into targeted guidelines, committed to memory and injected into future agent executions on similar tasks. On AppWorld with ReAct/GPT-4.1, our framework raises the fraction of tasks that succeed in all five runs by +16 points on same-task evaluation and +13 points on similar-task generalization.

</details>


### [480] [API Benchmark Scores Do Not Reliably Transfer to Chatbot Interfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08861)
*Jennifer Wang,Joachim Baumann,Daniel E. Ho,Sanmi Koyejo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文审计了ChatGPT、Claude和Gemini共7个系统、9个基准测试，发现API接口与网页界面之间存在系统性性能差异：API评估在准确率上平均高出3.4个百分点，在测试-重测一致性上高出2.1个百分点。对ChatGPT而言，API与界面间的差异甚至超过GPT 5.3与5.4之间的代际差异。即使用户调整系统提示、采样参数等API控制项，也无法可靠消除这一差距，揭示了"上下文有效性差距"（context-validity gap）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基准测试分数是模型发布中的核心衡量指标，影响着购买决策、公众信任和政策制定。然而，这些分数隐含一个关键假设：通过API测量的模型性能能忠实反映实际部署系统的行为。作者质疑这一假设，因为API访问和界面访问可能存在系统性差异，而现有研究未充分关注这一"接口差距"。

Method: 作者对ChatGPT、Claude和Gemini三个主流模型家族的7个系统进行了系统性审计，覆盖9个基准测试，包含通用能力、社会偏见和谄媚（sycophancy）三个维度。对比了API访问与界面访问下的模型性能，在准确率和测试-重测一致性两个指标上进行量化分析，并通过控制系统提示、采样参数和推理设置来检验能否消除该差距。

Result: （1）API评估在准确率上平均比界面评估高3.4个百分点，测试-重测一致性高2.1个百分点。（2）对ChatGPT而言，API与界面之间的性能差异超过了GPT 5.3到GPT 5.4的单一代际差异。（3）调整API暴露的控制参数（系统提示、采样参数、推理设置）在某些情况下能改变行为，但无法可靠地消除性能差距。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了"上下文有效性差距"：通过API获得的测量结果不一定能推广到对应的实际部署界面。这使将API评估作为部署系统代理的做法变得复杂化，对模型基准测试的解释和模型发布的可信度提出了重要警示。研究建议业界需要重新审视基准评估的有效性问题，并考虑对不同访问界面进行分层评估。

Abstract: Benchmark scores are a central currency in model releases: they inform purchasing decisions, shape public trust, and influence policy. Yet, a key assumption underlying benchmark scores is that the model performance measured through APIs faithfully reflects the behavior of deployed systems.
  We challenge this assumption by auditing ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini across seven systems and nine benchmarks spanning general capability, social bias, and sycophancy. We find systematic API--interface differences in both accuracy and consistency. On average, API evaluations score 3.4 percentage points higher in accuracy and 2.1 percentage points higher in test--retest agreement than corresponding interface evaluations. For ChatGPT, the performance difference between API and interface access exceeds the API-only difference between GPT 5.3 and GPT 5.4. Put differently, switching access surfaces can degrade performance as much as downgrading a full model generation.
  We further test whether exposed API controls can reproduce interface behavior by varying system prompts, sampling parameters, and reasoning settings. These controls shift behavior in some cases but do not reliably eliminate the gap. Our findings document a context-validity gap: measurements obtained through APIs do not necessarily generalize to corresponding deployed interfaces, complicating the use of API evaluations as proxies for deployed systems.

</details>


### [481] [SkillAdam: Stable and Efficient Skill Evolution for Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08944)
*Gaoyuan Li,Meihao Fan,Yizhe Liu,Shaolei Zhang,Ju Fan,Siyi Wang,Jiaheng Hou,Xudong Weng,Honghan Tian,Zang Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SkillAdam是一个受Adam优化器启发的框架，用于自动进化语言模型智能体的技能文档。它通过优化记忆（类比一阶矩）稳定更新方向，通过波动驱动的编辑预算（类比二阶矩）自适应控制更新幅度，在七个基准上取得SOTA性能，且迭代次数和成本更低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体技能能为冻结的语言模型提供领域知识和程序性指导，但获取高质量技能成本高昂且难以规模化。专家编写需要大量人力，现有技能自进化方法虽然自动化了迭代循环，但启发式更新策略往往导致不稳定的优化和低迭代效率。作者识别出两个核心挑战：方向稳定性（有效修正需要累积而非被局部反馈覆盖）和更新自适应性（每次修订范围需反映近期案例级改进的一致性）。

Method: SkillAdam灵感来自Adam优化器，针对离散且不可微的技能文档进行优化。框架包含两个关键组件：(1) 优化记忆作为Adam一阶矩的功能类比，记录已识别问题和先前解决方案尝试的结果，以稳定更新方向；(2) 波动驱动的编辑预算作为Adam二阶矩的功能类比，跟踪近期案例级改进的历史加权变化，自适应控制更新幅度（编辑范围）。

Result: 在覆盖短时程和长时程任务的七个基准上，SkillAdam取得了最先进的性能，优化动态更加稳定。相比此前的方法，它在显著更少的优化迭代和更低的成本下获得了更强的技能。代码库已公开。

Conclusion: SkillAdam证明了将Adam优化器的核心思想（一阶矩和二阶矩）功能性地映射到离散技能文档优化上是有效的，解决了技能自进化中方向稳定性和更新自适应性的问题，为高效获取高质量智能体技能提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Agent skills provide a lightweight way to equip frozen language-model agents with domain knowledge and procedural guidance, yet obtaining high-quality skills remains costly and difficult to scale. Expert-written skills require substantial human effort. Recent skill self-evolution methods automate an iterative loop that uses execution feedback to revise skills, but their heuristic update strategies often yield unstable optimization and low iteration efficiency. We identify two challenges in realizing stable and efficient skill self-evolution. Direction Stability requires effective corrections to accumulate rather than be overwritten by iteration-local feedback. Update Adaptivity requires the scope of each revision to reflect the consistency of recent case-level improvements. We introduce SkillAdam, an Adam-inspired framework for optimizing discrete and non-differentiable skill documents. As a functional analogue of Adam's first moment, an optimization memory records identified problems and the outcomes of prior solution attempts to stabilize the update direction. As a functional analogue of Adam's second moment, a volatility-driven edit budget tracks the history-weighted variation of recent case-level improvements and adaptively controls the update magnitude. Across seven benchmarks that span short- and long-horizon tasks, SkillAdam achieves state-of-the-art performance with more stable optimization dynamics. It also obtains stronger skills with substantially fewer optimization iterations and lower cost than prior methods. Code repository: https://github.com/ruc-datalab/SkillAdam

</details>


### [482] [PlannerForge: LLM Agents for Scenario-Based Testing of Motion Planners in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08965)
*Yuan Gao,Sebastian Müller,Mattia Piccinini,Marc Kaufeld,Yuchen Zhang,Finn Rasmus Schäfer,Qunying Song,Johannes Betz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PlannerForge是一个基于LLM-agent的统一框架，覆盖自动驾驶系统（ADS）场景测试的全流程，从场景生成到ADS评估，并新增ADS增强和ADS基准测试两个阶段。实验表明其在多项任务上表现优异，开源模型在多数任务上与商业API相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ADS场景测试是一个碎片化的模块化流程，各阶段（场景生成、检索、修改、执行、结果分析）由独立工具完成且缺乏交互。虽然LLM agent已在感知、规划、控制等ADS子系统中展现潜力，但尚无统一LLM-agent框架覆盖整个场景测试流水线。

Method: PlannerForge是一个LLM-agent框架，扩展了从场景生成到ADS评估的所有场景测试阶段，并新增两个LLM增强阶段：ADS增强和ADS基准测试。研究使用10种现成LLM，在5种提示条件下评估所有任务（生成、选择、修改、模块路由、规划器测试和增强）。

Result: 最佳任务得分范围为0.88-1.00；开源20-35B后端在大多数任务上与商业API相当。端到端模块链保留了83%（商业）/78%（开源）的种子查询。在自然语言生成上优于Scenario Factory 2.0（193 vs 144个可执行/200），实现了92-96%的城市/道路/车辆属性。在排序第1的选择上优于BM25（92.0% vs 67.5%），在物理有效编辑上优于From-Words-to-Collisions（≥94% vs 31%）。在N=400时，成本调优将规划器成功率从50.4%提升至70.2%，碰撞率从19.0%降至8.4%，无需领域特定微调。

Conclusion: PlannerForge证明了统一LLM-agent框架可以有效覆盖ADS完整场景测试流程，且开源模型（如Qwen3.6:35B）在五个任务中的三个可与商业API匹敌，展示了成本效益高的可替代方案。

Abstract: Ensuring the safety of autonomous driving is a critical challenge. Scenario-based testing is a systematic process used to validate Autonomous Driving Systems (ADSs), but it remains a fragmented modular pipeline in which scenario generation, retrieval, modification, ADS execution, and results analysis are performed by separate tools with little interaction. Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise across ADS sub-systems such as perception, planning, and control. However, no prior work covers the whole scenario-based testing pipeline for ADSs with a unified LLM-agent framework. We present PlannerForge, an LLM-agent framework that extends all scenario-based testing stages (from Scenario Generation to ADS Assessment) and adds two further LLM-enhanced stages: ADS Enhancement and ADS Benchmarking. We evaluate PlannerForge with 10 off-the-shelf LLMs across all tasks (Generation, Selection, Modification, Module Routing, Planner Testing, and Enhancement) under 5 prompt conditions. Best-per-task scores range from 0.88 to 1.00, and open-source 20-35B backends match commercial APIs on most tasks. Open-source models such as Qwen3.6:35B match commercial APIs on three of the five tasks. Chaining the modules end-to-end retains 83% / 78% of seed queries (commercial / open). It outperforms Scenario Factory 2.0 (Finkeldei et al., 2025) on natural-language generation (193 vs. 144 executable of 200) and realises 92-96% of requested city, road and vehicle attributes. It outperforms BM25 (Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009) at rank 1 selection (92.0% vs. 67.5%) and From-Words-to-Collisions (Gao et al., 2025) on physically valid edits (>=94% vs. 31%). At N=400, cost-tuning lifts planner success from 50.4% to 70.2% and cuts collisions from 19.0% to 8.4%, without domain-specific fine-tuning.

</details>


### [483] [Good Pretraining, Bad SFT: Checkpoint Quality Across the Training Stack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08966)
*Sohir Maskey,Philipp Scholl,Jonas Knupp,Pit Neitemeier,Sascha Wirges*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现，在30B混合专家（MoE）训练流程中，常用的检查点选择标准（如预训练损失或基准分数）可能失效，即最高分的检查点并不一定是最佳后续训练起点。研究者提出"解密度"（solution density）这一新指标——即检查点在局部权重扰动下保留下游性能的能力——能更好地预测哪些检查点在完整的下游训练栈后表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的检查点选择假设"得分最高的检查点=最佳训练起点"在完整训练流程中可能不成立，而这一假设在大型模型中普遍被默认采用。作者希望找出一种更可靠的指标来选择检查点。

Method: 在完整的30B MoE训练流水线中，比较不同检查点在经过下游训练后的表现，并引入"解密度"（solution density）这一概念，即检查点在局部权重扰动下维持下游性能的程度，用来衡量检查点作为后续训练起点的质量。

Result: 实验表明，预训练损失或基准分数最高的检查点在经历完整下游训练栈后并不一定表现最优；相反，具有更高解密度的检查点在后续训练后表现更好。

Conclusion: 检查点选择不应仅依赖预训练损失或基准分数，"解密度"可以作为更有效的检查点筛选指标，帮助在实际大规模训练中选择更适合作为后续训练起点（如对齐、微调）的检查点。

Abstract: Language-model checkpoints are commonly selected by pretraining loss or benchmark scores, assuming that the highest-scoring checkpoint will remain the best starting point for subsequent training. We show that this assumption can fail in a full 30B mixture-of-experts training pipeline. The checkpoints that perform better after the full downstream training stack also have higher solution density, i.e., retain downstream performance under local weight perturbations.

</details>


### [484] [Deposon: An Auditable, Conservation-Guaranteed, Game-Theoretically Tested Scattering Layer over LLM Reasoning Paths](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09001)
*Qihao Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Deposon散射层，为多步LLM推理提供可机器复检的账本机制，通过对概念分解图节点绑定两参数状态并进行三通道散射（透射、反射、不可逆耗散，满足T+R+A=1），实现路径能量审计（最大偏差2.2E-16）。作者诚实报告三层证据：合成陷阱基准上路径过滤增益闭合（统一达100%）；真实基准上与朴素关键词规则过滤无差异（GSM8K 0.87 vs 0.85，p=0.5），因此将主张收窄为"差分价值仅在机器可验证性"；融合为阴性结果，任何增益必须非线性。反向动力学建模为势博弈并量化了实证协调比（ECR），但三个动力学等价命题均被预注册杀死协议证伪，势博弈主张降级为近似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步LLM推理缺乏可机器复核的账本：被丢弃的推理路径不留下可审计的记录，这阻碍了推理过程的可信验证与审计。

Method: 提出Deposon散射层：将LLM生成的概念分解图中每个节点绑定到两参数Deposon状态；路径经历三通道散射（透射、反射、不可逆耗散），满足归一化条件T+R+A=1。同时将反向动力学建模为图上的势博弈，引入实证协调比（ECR）量化，并正式化三个动力学等价命题（P1a/P1b/T-P1c），采用预注册杀死协议与融合（凸组合）实验。

Result: 1) 合成陷阱基准：路径过滤增益闭合，统一达到100%，而诱饵捕获基线仅7%/10%；2) 真实基准：与朴素六关键词规则过滤无显著差异（GSM8K 0.87≥0.85，McNemar p=0.5；StrategyQA 0.899=0.899），故主张收窄为"差分价值仅在机器可验证性"；3) 融合为阴性结果：与语义先验的凸组合从不改善（物理0.484→0.452），lambda=2的表观增益为反场伪影，任何融合增益必须是非线性的；4) 动力学层面：三个命题在预注册杀死协议下被证伪，势博弈主张降级为近似（循环图中位残差0.669），仅一致性层级证据存活。

Conclusion: Deposon的主要价值不在于推理质量的提升（在真实基准上无增益），而在于提供机器可验证的审计账本；作者通过诚实的阴性结果报告（包括证伪自身命题、降级声称），确立了严谨的科学方法论示范。动力学层面的势博弈解释不成立，仅"可审计标量的单调性与近梯度性"等一致性证据得到支持。

Abstract: Multi-step LLM reasoning lacks a machine-recheckable ledger: discarded reasoning paths leave no auditable record. We propose the Deposon scattering layer, which binds each node of an LLM-generated concept-decomposition graph to a two-parameter Deposon state; paths undergo three-channel scattering -- transmission, reflection, irreversible dissipation -- obeying T+R+A=1 for arbitrary parameters, with a maximum per-path energy-audit deviation of 2.2E-16 (machine epsilon). We report all three evidence tiers honestly. On synthetic trap benchmarks the path-filtering gain is closed (pre-registered): unified reaches 100% versus a decoy-capture baseline at 7%/10%. On real benchmarks the layer is indistinguishable from a trivial six-keyword rule filter (GSM8K 0.87 >= 0.85, McNemar p=0.5; StrategyQA 0.899 = 0.899); no difference is detected here, so we sharpen the claim to "the differential value lies solely in machine verifiability." Fusion yields a second negative result: convex combinations with a semantic prior never improve (physics 0.484 -> 0.452), and the apparent lambda=2 gain is an anti-field artifact; any fusion gain must be nonlinear. Modeling the reverse dynamics as a potential game on the graph, we evidence an auditable scalar's monotonicity and near-gradientness and quantify the empirical coordination ratio (ECR). The three formalized dynamical-equivalence propositions (P1a/P1b/T-P1c) are falsified under the pre-registered kill protocol, and the potential-game claim is downgraded to approximate (cyclic-graph median residual 0.669): only consistency-level evidence survives at the dynamical level. Code: github.com/zeroandcat/Deposon.

</details>


### [485] [Answer-Distribution Trajectories: A Stochastic-Dynamics View of LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09030)
*Mar Gonzàlez I Català,Haitz Sáez de Ocáriz Borde,Davide Murari,Carola-Bibiane Schönlieb,Pietro Liò,George Montañez*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"答案分布轨迹"（answer-distribution trajectories）这一表示方法，通过追踪模型在推理过程中对答案的完整预测分布演化，来超越传统的端到端准确率和熵轮廓分析，揭示语言模型推理的动态机制。在16个开源模型和4个推理基准上的实验表明，即使端点答案和熵轮廓相同，推理轨迹也可能展现截然不同的动力学特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 链式推理虽然为输入与最终答案之间提供了结构化计算，但现有评估通常只关注端点准确率，忽略了到达该答案的路径。熵轮廓方法虽然能追踪推理过程中的不确定性演化，却无法揭示哪些相互竞争的假设导致了这种不确定性。因此需要一种更细粒度的表示来理解推理的动态过程。

Method: 引入受随机动力学启发的"答案分布轨迹"表示，追踪模型在推理展开过程中的完整预测分布。相比端点摘要和熵摘要，这是一种严格更精细的表示，能够刻画推理轨迹的探索、修正、运动和承诺等动力学特征，并区分推理成功与失败的不同动力学机制。

Result: 在16个开源权重语言模型和4个推理基准上，发现端点相同且熵轮廓相似的轨迹可能展现出显著不同的推理动力学。推理动力学在不同模型和任务内部及之间均存在显著差异，不同目标偏好不同的动力学轮廓。训练和推理选择会系统性地重塑这些动力学轮廓。

Conclusion: 答案分布轨迹为分析和评估LLM推理动力学提供了丰富的框架，能够揭示推理过程中隐藏的动态机制，为理解推理成功与失败提供了更深层的视角。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought reasoning provides a structured computation between a model's input and final answer. Yet it is often evaluated through endpoint accuracy, which ignores the path taken to reach that answer. An emerging line of work addresses this limitation using entropy profiles, which track how uncertainty evolves over the reasoning process but do not reveal which competing hypotheses account for that uncertainty. We introduce answer-distribution trajectories, a stochastic-dynamics-inspired representation that tracks the model's full predictive distribution over answers as reasoning unfolds. As a strictly finer representation than endpoint and entropy summaries, answer-distribution trajectories enable us to characterize a trace through a dynamical reasoning profile spanning exploration, revision, motion, and commitment, and to distinguish different dynamical mechanisms of reasoning success and failure. Across sixteen open-weight language models and four reasoning benchmarks, we show that traces with the same endpoint and similar entropy profiles can exhibit substantially different reasoning dynamics. We further find substantial variation in these dynamics both within and across models and tasks, with different objectives favoring different dynamical profiles. Additionally, we show that training and inference choices systematically reshape these profiles. Our results suggest that answer-distribution trajectories provide a rich framework for analysing and evaluating the dynamics of LLM reasoning.

</details>


### [486] [Everything in Moderation: Per-Domain Coverage Optima and Alignment-Resistant Domain Gaps in Multi-Domain Mid-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09081)
*Yunpeng Xu,Kun Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了大语言模型"中训练"（pre-training与alignment之间）阶段，各领域数据配比应如何设计。在受控逻辑推理场景（Qwen3-8B-Base及4B复现，五个KOR-Bench领域）中训练了30种配比分配，得出三大发现：每个领域存在10%-40%的内部覆盖最优区间；该差距无法被后续等预算的alignment（SFT）穿越弥补；零覆盖会导致准确率崩塌（但与通用漂移混杂）。探索性θ*分配取得最大全流程增益但统计显著性边际。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中训练阶段各领域的数据配比通常由数据可得性决定而非原理化设计，作者想弄清这一决策的价值，以及后续alignment能否撤销中训练时期数据配比造成的影响。

Method: 在Qwen3-8B-Base（另以4B复现）上，针对五个语义上规则不相交的KOR-Bench领域，在五域单纯形上训练30种配比分配（含24个sweep配置和6个留出配置），每种配比做5个种子。使用校准置换检验验证二次内部最优性，并通过固定预算的SFT对齐、等预算均匀对照及置换零假设检验来评估对齐对中训练差距的弥补能力。

Result: 三点发现：1) 每个领域都有内部覆盖率最优值，所有五域的10%-40%中等区间最佳，二次内部性置换检验P≈0.010；8B在9.9%-35.1%区间达到峰值。2) 该差距在固定预算对齐后依然存在：补偿性SFT提升116/120个单元（平均+4.32%），但仅在0/240（5%阈值）和30/240（10%比例）对中架起了桥梁，而置换零假设预期会架起13.8±3.3和77.9±8.5对。3) 零覆盖率会崩塌中训练准确率，但混杂着通用漂移。θ*分配获得最大的全流程增益（+4.36% vs +0.80%/+0.64%）但Welch检验边际显著。

Conclusion: 中训练阶段的数据配比决策具有实质性且不可逆的影响——alignment无法系统性撤销中训练时期因数据配比造成的领域性能差距。该发现支持需要对中训练数据组合进行原理化设计的观点，而不仅仅是依赖数据可得性。

Abstract: Mid-training, the stage between pre-training and alignment, is where a model's per-domain data composition is typically set by data availability rather than principled design. We ask what that decision buys, and whether a later alignment pass can undo it. In a controlled logical-reasoning setting (Qwen3-8B-Base, with a 4B replication; five semantically rule-disjoint KOR-Bench domains) we train 30 allocations spanning the five-domain simplex, 24 sweep configurations plus six withheld from the fit, at five seeds each. Three findings emerge. First, every domain has an interior coverage optimum: the moderate band ($10\%$-$40\%$) is best for all five domains, and a calibrated permutation test for quadratic interiority gives $P\approx0.010$; the fitted mid-training-only curves, with 8B peaks between $9.9\%$ and $35.1\%$, reproduce for curve shape but not peak location. Second, the gaps survive a fixed-budget alignment pass: compensatory SFT raises 116/120 cells (mean $+4.32\%$) yet bridges $0/240$ pairs at a $5\%$ threshold and $30/240$ at a $10\%$ ratio, an equal-budget uniform control behaves almost identically, and a permutation null would bridge $13.8\pm3.3$ and $77.9\pm8.5$ pairs ($P<0.001$). Third, zero coverage collapses mid-training-only accuracy, though a FineWeb-Edu-only control shows the collapse is commingled with generic drift. An exploratory $θ^*$ allocation attains the largest full-pipeline gain ($+4.36\%$ vs. $+0.80\%$/$+0.64\%$\,pp) but is marginal under Welch test.

</details>


### [487] [The Surprising Effectiveness of Approximate Value Iteration in Self-Play](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09094)
*Raphael Boige,Amine Boumaza,Bruno Scherrer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究在中等规模博弈（如四子棋、Hex(7x7)等）中，简单的近似值迭代（AVI）方法是否能与基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的AlphaZero方法竞争。结果表明，AVI能学习到比AlphaZero更准确的价值函数，其一步前瞻贪心策略在训练和推理成本大幅降低的情况下仍与MCTS策略具有竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MCTS方法虽然在博弈程序中取得了重大成功，但其计算开销巨大。作者希望探究在非平凡、中等规模游戏中，是否存在更简单的方法能够达到竞争力水平，挑战MCTS方法主导的现状。

Method: 训练一个最小化的自对弈近似值迭代（AVI）实现，使用地面真值oracle进行精确评估，并与AlphaZero在Connect Four、Hex(7x7)和合成游戏上进行对比实验。

Result: AVI学习到的价值函数比AlphaZero更准确，其一步前瞻贪心策略与MCTS策略竞争力相当，但训练和推理成本显著更低。在Othello和Go(9x9)上的初步实验表明AVI在更大游戏上也能稳定训练并学习有效价值函数。

Conclusion: MCTS方法的成功可能掩盖了更简单方法的潜力。随着现代深度学习工具的进步，简单的AVI方法已变得日益实用，值得重新评估此类方法的竞争力。

Abstract: Combining search with function approximation has driven major advances in game-playing programs, making self-play algorithms more competitive than ever. Still, the computational overhead of the most popular methods, based on Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), can be substantial. In this work, we investigate whether simpler methods remain competitive in non-trivial, moderately sized games such as Connect Four, Hex(7x7) and synthetic games. We train a minimal self-play implementation of Approximate Value Iteration (AVI) and use ground-truth oracles for exact evaluation. Contrary to expectations, our results demonstrate the surprising effectiveness of AVI: it learns more accurate value functions than those learned by AlphaZero, while its one-step-lookahead greedy policies remain competitive with MCTS-based policies at substantially lower training and inference costs. Preliminary experiments on Othello and Go(9x9) show that AVI trains stably on larger games and learns effective value functions. These findings suggest that the success of MCTS-based methods may have eclipsed simpler approaches that have become increasingly practical with modern deep-learning tools.

</details>


### [488] [SAEScientist-Bench: Can AI Agents Conduct Autonomous SAE Interpretability Research?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09113)
*Yuqiao Tan,Shizhu He,Jun Zhao,Kang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SAEScientist-Bench基准，用于评估AI智能体能否像科学家一样使用稀疏自编码器（SAEs）进行自主机制可解释性发现。在Gemma-2-9B-IT模型的13.1万+特征字典上进行20个任务和10种智能体配置的评估，前沿智能体展现出真实发现能力但在因果生成引导方面与专家基线差距明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）研究虽然已自动化了模型训练流程，但可靠的自主开发还缺少事后监控与审计能力来理解模型所学内容并确保安全对齐。机制可解释性工具是弥合这一差距的关键，因此需要衡量AI智能体能否自主使用SAEs进行机制发现。

Method: 提出SAEScientist-Bench基准。给定目标概念后，智能体设计对比探针，在Gemma-2-9B-IT的Gemma Scope字典（13.1万+特征）中导航以发现最优特征。评估指标基于Neuronpedia上的专家参考特征，涵盖激活排名、对比文本的概念选择性以及因果引导三个维度。在10种智能体配置和20个任务上系统评测。

Result: 前沿智能体展现了真实的发现能力并在不同评估维度上各有领先，但整体仍远落后于专家基线。在将目标概念与对比控制分开方面接近专家水平，但在因果生成引导上明显滞后。进一步分析表明智能体虽能设计对比来排除虚假候选，但常常误解实验结果。

Conclusion: 实验模型理解可作为闭环自主AI研发的可度量能力。该基准建立了评估智能体自主机制发现能力的新标准，揭示了当前智能体在实验解释上的显著短板，为未来改进指明方向。

Abstract: While research on recursive self-improvement (RSI) has predominantly automated model training pipelines, reliable autonomous development demands a missing pillar: post-hoc monitoring and auditing to understand what models learn and ensure safe alignment. Mechanistic interpretability tools are essential to bridge this gap, among which Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) serve as a cornerstone by isolating interpretable features for model inspection and steering. In this paper, we introduce SAEScientist-Bench to evaluate whether AI agents can act as scientists utilizing SAE tools for autonomous mechanistic discovery. Given a target concept, an agent designs contrastive probes and navigates a Gemma Scope dictionary of 131K+ features in Gemma-2-9B-IT to discover the optimal feature, evaluated against curated expert reference features anchored on Neuronpedia across activation rank, concept selectivity on contrastive texts, and causal steering. Across 10 agent configurations and 20 tasks, frontier agents demonstrate genuine discovery capabilities and lead different evaluation dimensions, but remain well behind the expert baseline, approaching expert levels on separating target concepts from contrastive controls while lagging substantially in causal generation steering. Further analysis reveals that although agents can design contrasts to rule out spurious candidates, they frequently misinterpret experimental measurements. These results establish experimental model understanding as a measurable capability for closed-loop autonomous AI R&D. Our code is available at https://github.com/Trae1ounG/SAEScientist.

</details>


### [489] [MeClear: Cooperative Game-Theoretic Attribution and Risk-Aware Memory Clearance for Long-Horizon LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09115)
*Boyu Yang,Jiazheng Sun,Zilong Lu,Zhi Qiu,Xin Peng,Jun Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MeClear，一个任务条件化的记忆清理框架，通过合作归因识别具有负面下游效用的记忆并将其从智能体执行中抑制，解决长时程LLM智能体外部记忆中冲突或误导性证据的问题。MeClear结合Leave One Out筛选与采样合作Shapley归因来分配交互证据间的效用，采用查询范围的嵌套过滤最小清理策略，在不永久修改记忆库的前提下验证任务恢复。实验表明其在十组长对话记忆池中达到85.9%的目标召回率和82.3%的任务恢复率，较LOO基线提升25.5个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统检索机制优化语义兼容性而非下游效用，经常将过时、误导或冲突的证据引入活动上下文，导致长时程LLM智能体性能下降。现有单一移除评估方法（如LOO）无法解决冗余冲突掩盖问题，需要更精细的效用归因机制。

Method: MeClear框架包含两个核心组件：（1）将LOO筛选与采样合作Shapley归因相结合，在相互作用的证据间分配效用，解决单个移除评估失效的冗余冲突掩盖问题；（2）基于归因排名，在嵌套过滤上执行查询范围的极小清理策略，验证清理后上下文的任务恢复，同时不永久改动持久记忆库。

Result: 在十个长对话记忆池上，MeClear达到85.9%的目标召回率和82.3%的整体任务恢复率，较LOO基线提升25.5个百分点。

Conclusion: 任务条件化的记忆清理相比单纯语义检索更能有效提升下游智能体效能，合作效用归因是处理交互证据间复杂关系的关键。

Abstract: Long horizon Large Language Model (LLM) agents rely on external memory systems to preserve user preferences and task knowledge across extended interactions. Conventional retrieval mechanisms optimize semantic compatibility rather than downstream utility, frequently introducing outdated, misleading, or conflicting evidence into the active context. We present MeClear, a task conditioned memory clearance framework that identifies memories featuring negative downstream utility through cooperative attribution and selectively suppresses them from agent execution. MeClear combines Leave One Out screening with sampled cooperative Shapley attribution to distribute utility across interacting evidence, effectively resolving redundant conflict masking where single removal evaluations fail. Utilizing attribution rankings, MeClear executes a query scoped minimal clearance strategy over a nested filtration, verifying task recovery on the cleared context without permanently altering the persistent memory bank. Comprehensive experimental evaluations across ten long dialogue memory pools demonstrate that MeClear achieves a target recall of 85.9% and an overall task recovery rate of 82.3%, representing a 25.5 percentage point improvement over Leave One Out (LOO) baselines.

</details>


### [490] [ExecCritic: Learn to Test, Test to Improve for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09133)
*Leitian Tao,Baolin Peng,Haorui Wang,Hang Wang,Hao Cheng,Wenlin Yao,Qianhui Wu,Tao Ge,Sharon Li,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ExecCritic提出了一种测试-验证-修订的脚手架与角色专用强化学习训练方法，将测试生成与源码修复分离，使编码代理能利用可靠的执行反馈修复代码仓库问题。在SWE-bench Verified上，组合两个经过后训练的Qwen代理达到72.6%的解决率，比无测试基线提升11.4个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 执行反馈能引导编码代理进行正确的仓库修复，但前提是测试必须准确捕获issue所要求的行为。代理生成的测试可能编码不完整或错误的行为目标；当同一轨迹同时编写补丁和测试时，两者的错误可能相互一致，造成虚假的置信度，误导修复过程。

Method: 提出ExecCritic框架，包含：(1) 测试-验证-修订脚手架，将测试构造与源码修复分离——Test代理独立生成仓库原生测试，fail-closed harness对测试进行限定和冻结，Repair代理基于执行反馈修订源码但不改动测试；(2) 角色专用强化学习配方——在Learn to Test阶段训练Test代理生成行为有效、能区分正确与错误补丁的测试；在Test to Improve阶段训练Repair代理同时学习直接任务求解与基于反馈的修订。两者均以Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B为骨干并分离训练。

Result: 在SWE-bench Verified上，测试质量决定反馈是否有帮助：固定基础Repair代理时，基础Test代理的测试将解决率从无测试基线61.2%降至57.3%，而GPT-5.6-sol生成的测试将其提升至65.3%。角色专用后训练将Qwen Test代理的Base-to-Gold成功率从22.2%提升至62.2%；组合两个后训练的Qwen代理达到72.6%，相比原始无测试基线提升11.4个百分点，且评估时无需更强模型或Oracle反馈。

Conclusion: 将测试生成与补丁修复分离，并对两个角色分别进行强化学习后训练，可以显著提升编码代理的仓库修复性能。代码已公开于GitHub。

Abstract: Execution feedback can guide coding agents toward correct repository repairs, but only when the tests capture the behavior requested by the issue. Agent-generated tests can encode incomplete or incorrect behavioral targets; when the same trajectory writes both the patch and the test, their errors can agree and create false confidence. We introduce ExecCritic, combining a test--verify--revise scaffold with a role-specific reinforcement learning recipe for training agents within it. The scaffold separates test construction from source-code repair: a Test agent independently generates repository-native tests, a fail-closed harness qualifies and freezes them, and a Repair agent revises source code from their execution feedback without changing the tests. Both roles use Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B as the backbone and are trained separately. In Learn to Test, the Test agent learns to produce behaviorally valid tests that distinguish correct from incorrect patches. In Test to Improve, the Repair agent learns both direct task resolution and feedback-guided revision. On SWE-bench Verified, test quality determines whether feedback helps: holding the base Repair agent fixed, tests from the base Test agent reduce resolved rate from a no-test baseline of 61.2% to 57.3%, whereas tests from GPT-5.6-sol raise it to 65.3%. Role-specific post-training raises the Qwen Test agent's Base-to-Gold success from 22.2% to 62.2%; composing the two post-trained Qwen agents reaches 72.6%, an 11.4-point gain over the original no-test baseline without stronger-model or Oracle feedback at evaluation time. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/execcritic.

</details>


### [491] [Co-Evolving Harnesses and Models: On-Policy Correction Helps Weaker Models Catch Up Where Imitation Fails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09134)
*Zhou Yu,Bin Bi,Shiva Kumar Pentyala,Shubham Mehrotra,Sougata Chaudhuri,Shilpa Bhagavath,Zeyuan Chen,Ran Xu,Phil Mui,James Zhu,Sitaram Asur*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了智能体harness演化与轻量级微调如何协同工作。发现用较弱模型演化harness后，直接对弱模型在专家完整轨迹上进行模仿学习会适得其反，导致7个任务全部性能退化4-30个点，原因在于破坏了模型与harness的契合度。作者提出了一种基于on-policy专家修正的流水线，由元级MLE智能体自动化，仅重写弱模型自身rollout中的失败回合，从而保留模型的规划风格并同时获得harness演化和模型适应的收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: harness（系统提示词、工具集、执行钩子、上下文管理脚手架）是决定智能体任务成功的关键因素。自动化harness演化可以让较小的模型在领域任务上以远低于前沿模型的成本表现良好。但由于harness和模型权重共同塑造行为，需要理解harness演化与轻量级微调应如何组合，以找到经济高效的协同演化方案。

Method: 先在7个企业智能体任务上使用较弱模型演化harness，然后尝试在演化后的harness下对弱模型进行基于专家完整轨迹的模仿训练（发现会损害性能）。为解决问题，开发了on-policy专家修正流水线：由元级MLE智能体自动化定位弱模型自身rollout中失败的回合，请专家仅重写该回合，从而保留模型的规划风格并保持模型与harness的契合度。

Result: 在演化harness下直接训练弱模型模仿专家的完整轨迹，在全部7个任务上性能均出现4-30个点的回归（在Qwen3-Coder和Gemma 4上均如此），而相同的流程在未演化的harness下是有帮助的。模仿虽能转移知识并增加脚手架使用，但扰乱了模型-harness契合度。on-policy专家修正方法则能同时融合harness演化和模型适应的收益。

Conclusion: 识别并解决了harness更新与权重更新之间的冲突源，提出了一套保持兼容性的经济协同演化配方，适用于特定领域的企业任务，证明模型-harness契合度是智能体系统优化中不可忽视的核心因素。

Abstract: Agent harnesses (the system prompt, tool set, execution hooks, and context-management scaffolding around a model) are a critical determinant of agentic task success. Automated harness evolution can enable smaller models to perform well on domain-specific tasks at a fraction of frontier-model cost. Since both the harness and model weights shape behavior, we ask how harness evolution and lightweight fine-tuning should be combined. Across seven enterprise agent tasks, we first evolve a harness with the weaker model, then find that a stronger expert often uses it more effectively, suggesting expert supervision could close the remaining gap. However, training the weaker model on the expert's complete trajectories under the evolved harness backfires: performance regresses on all seven tasks by 4 to 30 points across Qwen3-Coder and Gemma 4, even though the same procedure helps under the unevolved harness. Our analysis shows that imitation transfers knowledge and increases scaffold usage, but disrupts model-harness fit: the weaker model adopts the expert's planning strategy without the competence to execute it and no longer matches the harness evolved around its native planning style. We therefore develop an on-policy expert-correction pipeline, automated by a meta-level MLE agent, that localizes the failing turn in the weaker model's own rollout and asks the expert to rewrite only that turn. This preserves the model's planning style and combines the gains of harness evolution and model adaptation. Our results identify and resolve a source of contention between harness and weight updates, yielding a compatibility-preserving recipe for economical co-evolution on domain-specific enterprise tasks.

</details>


### [492] [A Data-Driven Framework for Identifying and Prioritizing RPA Opportunities in Healthcare Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09137)
*Maria Alejandra Gomez,Juan Manuel Castillo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个四模块数据驱动框架，用于在美国医院中系统化选择、排序和配置RPA（机器人流程自动化）项目。该框架涵盖流程分类、优先级评估（AHP）、自动化分层工具选择（Python bot/n8n/UiPath）及投资回报预测。通过综合模拟验证显示框架有效且稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医院中30-50%的RPA项目表现不佳，原因是流程选择非正式、缺乏可重复的方法来编目候选流程、排序、匹配自动化层级并预测财务回报。需要统一这些决策的数据驱动框架来解决行政负担问题。

Method: 提出四模块框架：(1) 流程分类法——涵盖5个价值流的20个常见医院流程；(2) 优先级模块——基于AHP矩阵推导自动化适用性指数并含一致性检查；(3) 工具分层选择模块——推荐满足流程复杂度、集成和合规要求的最低成本技术；(4) 投资回报模块——量化人力节省、错误成本规避、回收期和净现值。并用两个蒙特卡洛模拟、权重扰动测试及预算约束组合优化进行验证。

Result: 20个流程中12个超过优先级阈值；排序对±20%权重扰动稳健（Spearman相关0.83，前5集合保持97.7%，2000次蒙特卡洛试验）；自动化风险指数标记4个合格流程为关键风险；预算约束优化显示从$400K到$1.03M的边际NPV递减；第二个蒙特卡洛分析显示组合NPV第5百分位仍保持正值。

Conclusion: 该框架是文献的概念性综合而非基于医院原始数据的校准工具。作者讨论了HIPAA治理并提出了实证验证的研究议程，附有补充的Python实现。

Abstract: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is widely used to reduce administrative burden in United States hospitals, yet an estimated 30-50% of RPA initiatives underperform because processes are selected informally, without a repeatable method to catalogue candidates, prioritize them, match each to an automation tier -- a Python bot, an open-source orchestrator such as n8n, or an enterprise platform such as UiPath -- and forecast financial return before committing resources. We propose a four-module, data-driven framework unifying these decisions: a Process Taxonomy of twenty recurring hospital processes across five value streams; a Prioritization module deriving an Automation Suitability Index from an Analytic Hierarchy Process matrix with an explicit consistency check; a Tool-Tier Selection module recommending the least-cost technology sufficient for a process complexity, integration, and compliance profile; and a Return-on-Investment module quantifying labor savings, error-cost avoidance, payback, and net present value. Applied to a synthetic portfolio spanning all twenty processes, plus a reference data-flow architecture linking it to hospital EHR/payer/ERP systems: 12 of 20 clear the prioritization threshold; the ranking is robust to +/-20% weight perturbation (Spearman correlation 0.83, top-5 set preserved 97.7%, 2,000 Monte Carlo trials); an Automation Risk Index flags four qualifying processes as Critical risk; a budget-constrained portfolio optimization shows diminishing marginal NPV as spend scales from $400K to $1.03M; and a second Monte Carlo analysis shows portfolio NPV stays positive at its 5th percentile. The framework is a conceptual synthesis of the literature rather than an instrument calibrated on primary hospital data; we discuss HIPAA governance and a research agenda for empirical validation. A supplementary Python implementation accompanies the paper.

</details>


### [493] [Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09153)
*Yuxing Lu,Yicheng Chen,Shanchan Wu,Sercan Ö. Arık*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出程序图(Procedural Graph)框架，将智能体的程序性知识组织为(procedure, relation, procedure)三元组结构，在每个决策步骤通过领域定位和引导模型为LLM提供情境性指导，并通过自进化机制不断优化图结构，提升LLM在长时程工具调用任务中的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型作为智能体部署时，多数通过无约束生成从累积历史中选择动作，隐含了程序性知识（做什么、以什么顺序、在什么条件下做）。随着轨迹变长，智能体会失去目标、工具调用失序、重复无效动作。现有方法缺乏显式的程序性知识组织机制。

Method: 1) 构建程序图：将程序性知识组织为(procedure, relation, procedure)三元组；2) 在每个决策步骤定位智能体的活动节点，由引导模型将周围子图转化为逐步情境性引导，偏置求解器的下一步动作但不强制决定；3) 自进化机制：LLM精炼器对比失败轨迹与成功轨迹，编辑图的拓扑和属性，仅提交能保持或改善验证性能的编辑，拒绝的编辑被保留以抑制重复；4) 从最小骨架出发迭代构建图。

Result: 在多个数据集、任务类型和LLM上，程序图相比基于记忆的基线带来一致的性能提升；自进化进一步改善性能而无需人工工程；构建的图能达到或超过手工设计的图，且能够修复有缺陷的专家先验图。

Conclusion: 程序图提供了一种显式组织程序性知识的结构化方法，通过图引导和自进化机制有效缓解了LLM智能体在长时程规划中的目标丢失、工具调用失序和动作重复问题，展现了无需人工干预的持续自我改进能力。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that plan over long horizons and act through external tools. Most agents select actions through unconstrained generation over an accumulating history, leaving implicit the procedural knowledge of what to do, in what order, and under which conditions. As trajectories lengthen, agents can lose track of their objectives, invoke tools out of order, and repeat unproductive actions. We introduce the Procedural Graph: just as a knowledge graph organizes factual knowledge into (entity, relation, entity) triplets for what-is questions, a Procedural Graph organizes procedural knowledge into (procedure, relation, procedure) triplets for what-to-do questions. At each decision step, the framework localizes the agent's active node, and a guidance model translates the surrounding subgraph into step-level situational guidance that biases the solver's next action without dictating it. The graph is self-evolving: an LLM refiner contrasts failed trajectories with successful ones and edits the graph's topology and attributes, committing edits that preserve or improve held-out validation performance while retaining rejected ones to discourage repetition. Starting from a minimal skeleton, the loop builds graphs that match or surpass hand-designed ones. It can also repair a flawed expert prior. Across multiple datasets, task types, and LLMs, the Procedural Graph delivers consistent gains over memory-based baselines, and self-evolution further improves performance without manual engineering.

</details>


<div id='q-fin.MF'></div>

### [494] [Optimization of capital injections and absolutely continuous dividend payments in a diffusion model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05440)
*Hélène Guérin,Dante Mata,Jean-François Renaud,Alexandre Roch*

Main category: q-fin.MF

TL;DR: 本文研究了一般扩散过程盈余模型下分红与资本注入的联合优化问题，刻画了最优策略的Lokka-Zervos型二分性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在更一般的扩散盈余过程（相比经典Cramér-Lundberg或风险模型）下，联合优化分红与资本注入，并处理分红率受限于盈余凹函数、注入为非减过程的复杂约束。

Method: 先分析辅助保释问题（注入需保持盈余非负），在漂移凹性假设下证明值函数为凹函数且为HJB方程的经典解；再刻画最优策略为折射-反射策略，并通过辅助值函数在原点的比较来判定最优注入决策，最终建立Lokka-Zervos型二分性。

Result: 证明了一般扩散模型下联合优化问题的最优策略呈现Lokka-Zervos型二分性：要么是无注入的分红折射策略（发生破产），要么是折射-反射分红注入策略；最优注入决策仅通过比较原点处的辅助值函数即可判定。

Conclusion: 本文将该类分红-注入优化问题的Lokka-Zervos二分性推广至一般扩散过程框架，提供了简约的最优策略判定准则。

Abstract: We investigate a joint optimization problem of dividend payments and capital injections for a surplus process driven by a general diffusion. Dividend payments are assumed to be absolutely continuous in time, with the dividend rate bounded by a nonnegative concave function of the current surplus; while capital injections are modelled by a general nondecreasing process. We first analyze an auxiliary bail-out problem in which capital injections are required to keep the surplus nonnegative at all times. Under a concavity assumption on the drift, we prove that the associated value function is concave and is a classical solution of the corresponding Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation. We further characterize an optimal policy as a refraction-reflection strategy: the surplus is reflected at zero by capital injections, while dividends are paid at the maximal admissible rate whenever the surplus exceeds an optimal threshold. Our main contribution establishes that the general optimization problem exhibits a Lokka-Zervos type dichotomy. More precisely, an optimal policy is either a dividend refraction strategy without injections, in which ruin occurs, or a refraction-reflection dividend-injection strategy. This optimal injection decision is characterized through a simple comparison of the auxiliary value functions at the origin.

</details>


### [495] [Variance-Optimal Hedging in the Rough Hawkes--Heston Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08541)
*Yingli Wang,Xiaoyu Wang*

Main category: q-fin.MF

TL;DR: 本文在粗糙Hawkes-Heston模型中研究方差最优股票对冲及近似策略的收敛性，通过仿射条件变换与Galtchouk-Kunita-Watanabe投影获得欧式看涨期权的半显式对冲和最小二次误差表示，并通过核正则化与加权截断证明近似策略收敛到原方差最优值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 粗糙Hawkes-Heston模型能刻画波动率的粗糙性和跳跃特征，但其奇异记忆（singular memory）与共同标记跳跃（common marked jumps）使得方差最优对冲难以显式构造和数值实现，需要发展可计算且收敛的近似策略框架。

Method: 基于模型的仿射条件变换和仿射Volterra跳跃框架获得期权对冲的半显式形式；利用Galtchouk-Kunita-Watanabe投影给出最小二次误差表示；通过替换对冲所用核为正则化核（保持股价、方差驱动器和信息流固定），利用Riccati-Volterra稳定性与加权截断证明近似持有量在交易范数下收敛；对看涨期权联合选取核正则化参数与Fourier截断参数获得多项收敛保证。

Result: 获得了看涨期权的半显式对冲策略与最小二次误差表示；构建了基于交易前历史的近似持有量，并证明在紧凑Fourier区间上的交易范数下收敛；对看涨期权验证了初始资本与策略收敛、连续时间收益的时均方收敛以及终端均方误差收敛到方差最优值；数值实验采用移位分数核在共同原始市场路径上验证了构造的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文建立了粗糙Hawkes-Heston模型中方差最优对冲的近似可计算框架，填补了奇异记忆跳跃过程下对冲策略收敛性理论的空白，为实际应用提供了理论保证和数值验证。

Abstract: We study variance-optimal stock hedging and the convergence of approximate strategies in the rough Hawkes--Heston model. Starting from the model's affine conditional transform and the affine Volterra jump framework, we obtain semi-explicit hedges for European calls and a representation of the minimum quadratic error through the Galtchouk--Kunita--Watanabe projection. Our main approximation result keeps the original stock, variance driver, and information flow fixed while regularizing the kernel used to evaluate the hedge. To handle singular memory and common marked jumps, we construct the approximate holdings from histories available before trading and preserve the conditional transform's random modulus envelope. Riccati--Volterra stability and weighted truncation then yield convergence in the original stock's trading norm on compact Fourier intervals. For calls, a joint choice of kernel regularization and Fourier cutoff gives convergence of the initial capitals and strategies, uniform-in-time square-mean convergence of continuous-time gains, and convergence of the terminal mean-square error to the variance-optimal value. A numerical experiment with shifted fractional kernels illustrates the construction on common original-market paths.

</details>


### [496] [Numeraire Invariance of Entropy-Projected Martingale Measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08605)
*Jan Vecer*

Main category: q-fin.MF

TL;DR: 本文研究熵投影（entropy projection）在计价单位（numeraire）变换下的行为差异。前向相对熵投影（最小化D_KL(P‖Q)）与计价单位变换可交换，而最小熵鞅测度（MEMM，最小化D_KL(Q‖P)）不具备该性质。作者通过三项式反例证明MEMM在不同计价单位下独立重算结果可能不一致，并给出经济后果：两种熵方向分别对应指数效用和对数效用的对偶目标；似然兼容性等价于两种计价单位下定价泛函相等。此外还证明了有限状态下的类级刻画定理和平滑凸f-散度在均匀不变性下必为对数的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在金融数学中，等价鞅测度的选择依赖于计价单位（numeraire），而不同计价单位下的测度选择应保持一致性（似然兼容）。作者旨在揭示两种常见的熵投影方向（前向D_KL(P‖Q)与MEMM的D_KL(Q‖P)）在计价单位变换下的本质差异，探讨其经济含义与定价后果。

Method: 理论分析结合反例构造。作者：(1) 证明前向相对熵投影与计价单位变换（通过终端似然比L）可交换，因其目标函数仅差常数-E_P log L；(2) 构造三项式模型反例说明MEMM不满足似然兼容性；(3) 将两种熵方向与经典凸对偶目标（对数效用与指数效用）建立精确对应；(4) 证明定价功能对每个可积或有权益在不同计价单位下的一致性等价于似然兼容性；(5) 推导有限状态下的类级刻画定理，证明均匀不变性迫使光滑凸f-散度退化为对数形式；(6) 在有限状态市场中证明前向投影的存在性及其与对数最优终端财富的联系。

Result: 前向熵投影（D_KL(P‖Q)）与计价单位变换可交换且保持似然兼容，在其度量下每个可积或有权益在不同计价单位下定价一致；而MEMM（D_KL(Q‖P)）不具此性质，三项式反例显示其在不同计价单位下的结果不对应，并对不可复制的数字型权益给出不同价格。有限状态下，前向投影存在（在通常严格正的可行点条件下），dP/dQ*为可达的log最优终端财富，最小前向熵等于最大期望对数增长。

Conclusion: 前向熵方向是计价单位不变的选择准则，能保证跨计价单位的定价一致性并联系到log效用最大化框架；而MEMM方向虽然具有某些优良性质，但不具备计价单位兼容性。这为金融市场中测度选择的合理性提供了新的判据：若要求选择准则不依赖于计价单位（numeraire-invariant），则应采用前向熵投影而非MEMM。

Abstract: Let \(P\) be a fixed physical law and let \(Q\) be an equivalent martingale measure selected from the martingale-measure set associated with a chosen numeraire. A change of numeraire maps \(Q\) to \(T_LQ\), where \(d(T_LQ)=L\,dQ\) and \(L\) is the terminal likelihood ratio. The forward relative-entropy projection minimizing \(D_{\mathrm{KL}}(P\Vert Q)\) commutes with this transform because its objective changes only by the constant \(-E_P\log L\). The minimal entropy martingale measure (MEMM) orientation \(D_{\mathrm{KL}}(Q\Vert P)\) does not have this property, and a trinomial counterexample shows that independently recomputed MEMMs need not be likelihood compatible. We make two economic consequences explicit. First, the two entropy orientations are precisely the \(Q\)-dependent terms in the classical convex-dual objectives for logarithmic and exponential utility, respectively. Second, likelihood compatibility is equivalent to equality of the pricing functionals obtained in the two numeraires. Hence the forward selectors value every integrable claim consistently across numeraires, whereas the two MEMMs in the counterexample assign different prices to a nonreplicable digital claim. We also prove a finite-state class-level characterization: uniform invariance over the elementary one-period likelihood-ratio families forces a smooth convex \(f\)-divergence to be logarithmic, up to scaling and affine equivalence. Finally, in finite-state markets, the forward projection exists under the usual strictly positive feasible-point condition; its density \(dP/dQ^*\) is attainable log-optimal terminal wealth, and the minimum forward entropy equals maximal expected log growth.

</details>


### [497] [The Delta of a Variance Swap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08959)
*Sébastien Bossu,Sebastian Gaitan-Escarpeta*

Main category: q-fin.MF

TL;DR: 本文定义了方差互换delta（方差价格对标的资产价格的敏感性），利用Carr-Madan展开公式分析隐含波动率微笑曲线依赖标的价格时的敏感性。研究发现，当微笑曲线是（对数）货币性的纯函数时，方差互换总delta为零，这与"市场下跌时方差上升"的实证观察相矛盾。作者提出一种简单的微笑曲线修正方案来解决这一问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 方差互换是重要的波动率衍生品，其价格对标的资产价格的敏感性（即delta）对于对冲至关重要。然而，在标准的微笑曲线假设下，方差互换的总delta为零，这与实际市场中"方差与标的价格负相关"的实证现象不符，因此需要理论上的修正来更好地刻画和定价这一敏感性。

Method: 作者首先利用Carr-Madan展开公式对方差互换价格关于标的价格的敏感性进行分析，考察隐含波动率微笑曲线对标的价格的依赖关系。通过数学推导，证明当微笑曲线仅作为（对数）货币性的纯函数时，方差互换总delta严格为零。随后，作者提出对微笑曲线进行简单修改的方案，使方差互换delta能够反映市场下跌时方差上升的实证特征。

Result: 证明了对数货币性纯函数类的微笑曲线会导致方差互换总delta为零，这与实证观察（市场下行时方差上升）相矛盾。提出的简单微笑修正方案能够恢复方差与市场下跌之间的负相关关系，从而修正delta为零这一不合理的结果。

Conclusion: 纯货币性函数的微笑曲线假设在方差互换delta分析中存在缺陷，需要通过修改微笑结构来纳入标的价格与波动率之间的实际关联，从而更准确地捕捉方差互换的delta风险。

Abstract: We define the variance swap delta as the sensitivity of the price of variance to a change in underlying price. We use Carr-Madan spanning formulas to analyze this sensitivity when the implied volatility smile curve may depend on the underlying price. We show that the variance swap total delta is zero for the class of smile curves that are pure functions of (log) moneyness, which goes against the empirical observation that variance is up when the market is down. We propose a simple modification of the smile to correct this issue.

</details>
