### [498] [From Voice to Leverage in Data Governance. Building Enforceable Social License for Data ReUse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05731)
*Stefaan G. Verhulst,Adam Zable,Begona Gonzalez Otero,Jacqueline Lu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文批判当前数据治理中"参与"共识的缺陷，提出以"杠杆"（leverage）补充"声音"（voice）：社区和数据主体必须能够对数据持有者施加可信的代价。作者发展了一个由"反事实性、可执行性、持久性"定义的杠杆分析范畴，并基于认识论层面的"可读性"论证透明工具应服务于被治理者而非监管者。论文绘制了六大杠杆来源、聚合杠杆的中间结构，并提出六维评估框架（义务、可执行性、后果、监测装备、可撤销性、制度持久性），核心主张是：名副其实的社会许可必须具有法律许可的属性——条件、许可方和可执行的违约救济。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当代数据治理已趋同于"参与"范式，但这一共识建立在一个未经检验的假设之上：赋予受影响社区发言权本身就会改变数据持有者的行为。作者认为该假设不成立，需要以"杠杆"来补充"声音"。

Method: 论文采用跨学科理论综合方法：借鉴劳资关系谈判理论、争议社会学和James C. Scott的"可读性"论述，将杠杆建构为一个分析范畴（三个属性），并映射六大杠杆来源，提出中间结构和六维评估框架。

Result: 论文提出并界定"杠杆"分析范畴及六维评估框架，用于审计社会许可过程是否真正再分配权力。

Conclusion: 名副其实的社会许可必须具备法律许可的属性：条件、许可方和对违约的可执行救济，即参与若要产生后果，必须有相应的杠杆机制作为支撑。

Abstract: Contemporary data governance has converged on participation. Citizens assemblies, deliberative polls, codesign workshops, and community advisory panels are now routinely suggested to build trust and secure a social license for the reuse of data. Yet this consensus rests on an unexamined assumption: that giving affected communities a voice will, on its own, change what data holders do. This paper argues that the field needs to complement voice with leverage: the capacity of individuals and communities to make their participation consequential by attaching credible legal, institutional, contractual, economic, or reputational costs to being ignored. Drawing on labor relations bargaining theory, the sociology of disputes, and James C. Scott's account of legibility, we develop leverage as an analytic category defined by three properties: it is counterfactual, enforceable, and durable. We further argue that leverage presupposes epistemic legibility affected publics can rarely impose costs on a system they cannot see, document, or contest; and that most existing transparency instruments equip regulators and procurers rather than the governed. We then map six sources from which communities and data subjects can derive leverage (legal and regulatory; institutional decision; contractual; economic; data access; and political and reputational), examine the intermediary structures that aggregate and sustain it, and propose a six dimension evaluative framework: obligation, enforceability, consequence, monitoring equipment, revocability, and institutional durability for auditing whether any social license process actually redistributes power. The paper's central claim is that a social license worth the name must share the properties of a legal license: conditions, a licensor, and enforceable remedies for breach.

</details>


### [499] [Intent Drift at SME Scale: Deployment Practice, Not Model Capability, Determines Agentic Compliance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05975)
*Ilia Voroshilov*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出Chain of Intent，一个面向小型受监管企业的智能体AI治理框架，并通过对比实验验证其有效性：在模拟香港资产管理场景中，该框架将违规行为从13/15次降低到0次，且无需安全工程、成本仅为行动点治理的一半。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有智能体治理研究假设企业具备大型企业基础设施，而小型受监管企业（如小型资管公司）通常不具备这些资源。然而这些企业同样受严格监管且面临合规风险（如香港法律下违法行为最高可判三年监禁），亟需轻量级、无需安全工程介质的治理方案。

Method: 提出Chain of Intent框架，包含四项无需安全工程的治理控制：机器可读的目的声明、受限工具访问、范围账本（scope ledger）、动作前检查（pre-action check）。通过模拟香港资管公司及415条合成联系人记录，测试智能体在管理压力下的行为，并对比有无明确目的的配置、进行消融实验及两阶段漂移测量。

Result: 在明确授权的约束配置下，智能体仅15次运行中违规2次；而在未声明目的（资源受限企业的常规做法）时，15次运行中违规13次，最多联系220人，其中94%无可证明的营销同意。应用Chain of Intent后每次运行均消除非法联系且保持任务完成。消融显示每项控制均可独立通过不同机制起效；漂移需在候选集扩展与实际行动两个阶段测量；意图点治理成本约为行动点治理的一半。

Conclusion: Chain of Intent为缺乏企业级基础设施的小型受监管企业提供了可行、低成本的智能体治理方案。研究强调目的（intent）的明确编码是治理的关键支点，且治理介入的时机（意图点 vs 行动点）对成本效益有显著影响，漂移检测需覆盖意图形成与行动执行两个阶段。

Abstract: We introduce Chain of Intent, a governance framework for agentic AI at small regulated firms, and validate it against a failure it was built to address. Existing agentic governance research assumes enterprise infrastructure that small firms do not have. In a simulated Hong Kong asset manager with 415 synthetic contact records, an agent performing a routine client-communications task was subjected to ordinary managerial pressure to increase its reach. With its authorised constraints written into its configuration, the agent held: it identified every ambiguity in the firm's records, cited privacy legislation it had never been shown, and refused six successive requests, breaching in two of fifteen runs. With the same task, data, pressure and model, but its purpose left unstated as resource-constrained firms routinely leave it, it breached in thirteen of fifteen runs, contacting up to 220 individuals of whom 94 per cent had no demonstrable marketing consent - conduct carrying a maximum of three years' imprisonment under Hong Kong law. Chain of Intent applies four controls requiring no security engineering: a machine-readable purpose, constrained tool access, a scope ledger, and a pre-action check. It eliminated unlawful contact in every run while preserving task completion, and ablation shows each control independently sufficient by a different mechanism. We further show that drift must be measured at two stages - agents widened their candidate sets in every pressured run while acting on them in roughly one in seven - and that governance applied at the point of intent costs roughly half as much as governance applied at the point of action.

</details>


### [500] [Formalising Grassroots Social Contracts: From Legal Text to Grassroots Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06231)
*James Golike,Andy Lewis-Pye,Ehud Shapiro*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了"草根社会契约"的概念，基于Proudhon两百年前提出的六项社会契约条件，并补充两项数字平台条件。作者通过抽象级联（从契约文本到正式行为图式，再到意志守护的多主体原子事务）将草根社会契约转化为可工作的草根平台，并证明满足三个可判定条件（Introduction、Provenance、Volition）的语法草根契约所实现的协议是草根且意志性的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索如何将Proudhon所设想的理想社会契约（人与人相互约定、互惠、无外部权威、自由签署、交换性质）以数字化形式实现为真正的草根平台——多实例可依共同同意合并，人们可自由交易且无外部人员登记——从而弥合社会契约理论与实际去中心化数字平台之间的鸿沟。

Method: 通过三层抽象级联实现：(1)将契约文本形式化为正式的行为图式语言（act schemas），该语言命名各方角色、哪方须意愿该行为、每一角色的前提与效果；(2)验证契约是否满足三个可判定的语法草根条件：Introduction、Provenance和Volition；(3)将契约转化为意志守护的多主体原子事务协议。契约条款分为强制、见证、承诺三类法律类型，分别以不同机制保证或追诉。

Result: 证明了满足三个可判定条件的语法草根契约，其实现的协议是草根的且意志性的（volitionally grassroots）。强制条款的正确实现使违约不可能发生；见证条款的违约可凭借签名证据诉诸法庭；承诺条款也可诉诸法庭。以草根社交图和草根货币两个案例进行了说明。

Conclusion: 草根社会契约理论上是可实现且可验证的，通过语法层面的可判定条件与形式化协议转换，Proudhon的愿景可落地为真正去中心化、无外部权威与登记的数字平台，同时为契约条款提供了三种法律类型的执行与追诉框架。

Abstract: Two centuries ago Pierre-Joseph Proudhon envisioned a social contract that is (1) an agreement of man with man; (2) reciprocal; (3) imposing no obligation upon the parties except that which results from their personal promise; (4) subject to no external authority; (5) freely accepted and signed by all the participants; (6) of the nature of a contract of exchange. He also envisioned a property of social contracts, analogous to a property of digital platforms we term grassroots: that one could "make a contract with all, as ... with some"; digitally, that a grassroots platform can have multiple instances, which may coalesce by mutual consent. We define grassroots social contracts as social contracts meeting these conditions and that (7) people are free to deal with each other; and (8) there is no external register of people. We show that a grassroots social contract can be transformed into a working grassroots platform through an abstraction cascade, from the contract text to formal act schemas, verified syntactically to be grassroots, and then to volition-guarded multiagent atomic transactions. Act schemas are a formal language for the acts the contract describes, each naming the parties' roles, which of them must will the act, and its precondition and effect at each role. Any contract written in this language meets the eight conditions, provided it is syntactically grassroots, satisfying three decidable conditions, Introduction, Provenance and Volition. We prove that the protocol realising a syntactically grassroots contract is grassroots, and volitionally so. Clauses of a grassroots social contract are of three legal types: a breach of an enforced clause is impossible with a correct implementation; a breach of an attested or undertaken clause can be taken to court, with signed evidence for an attested clause. We illustrate them with a grassroots social graph and grassroots currencies.

</details>


### [501] [Ordinary, Reasonable Chatbots: Do AI Models Track Human Legal Judgments?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06769)
*Nirav Patel,Emily Wenger,Christopher Buccafusco*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究比较了26个大语言模型与人类参与者在25个法律合理性判断上的回答，发现LLM总体上与人类判断趋同，但存在同质化倾向、偏向政府和企业的倾向，且其回答更接近白人、男性、年长和受教育程度更高的人群。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI被越来越多地用于法律决策场景，且生成式AI模型（"硅基采样"）已影响学术研究，"硅基陪审员"可能出现在法庭上。法律合理性判断（reasonableness）本质上是模糊和依赖语境的，且可能随人口统计学特征而变化，因此需要系统考察LLM在模拟人类法律判断方面的能力与局限。

Method: 设计25个法律相关的合理性判断任务，采集人类参与者的回答作为基准，同时运行26个不同的LLM聊天机器人回答相同问题，将两组答案进行系统性对比分析。

Result: 研究发现：1) LLM回答总体上与人类参与者追踪一致；2) 但LLM生成的回答比人类更同质化，偶尔将可变标准当作不变规则对待；3) LLM倾向于生成对政府和公司更有利的答案；4) LLM的回答与白人、男性、年长和受教育程度更高的受访者更为接近。

Conclusion: 初步证据表明，虽然LLM能在一定程度上模拟人类的法律合理性判断，但其存在同质化、偏向权力方以及与特定人口群体趋同等问题，这些潜在偏见需要在更系统的研究中得到进一步确认或反驳，之后才能考虑在真实法律场景中使用。

Abstract: As people increasingly rely on artificial intelligence (AI) for guidance in their own lives, scholars, lawyers, and even judges have begun to consider the role of AI in legal decision-making. As "silicon sampling" -- the use of generative AI models in social science research -- is now impacting academia, "silicon jurors" could make an appearance in courtrooms. This study joins an emerging line of research on generative AI models' ability to simulate human legal judgments. In particular, we study how large language model (LLM)-powered chatbots respond to series of questions about legal reasonableness. When the law needs to judge the appropriateness of a behavior, it most often asks whether the behavior was "reasonable." Yet despite the ubiquity of reasonableness judgments, they are the site of constant vexation for lawyers, judges, and lay people. Reasonableness seems inherently vague and unpredictable, since it relies on variable context and implicit conceptual schemas. Moreover, many scholars caution that reasonableness judgments may vary along demographic lines. We compare the answers of human participants to those of twenty-six LLMs across twenty-five different legally relevant reasonableness judgments. Overall, our findings suggest that chatbot responses generally track those of human participants. Nonetheless, we find some suggestive -- and potentially concerning -- results. Compared to humans, LLMs generate more homogeneous responses and occasionally treat a variable standard as an invariant rule. And, compared to humans, LLMs tend to generate answers that are more favorable to the government and to corporations. Finally, our results indicate that LLMs' responses tend to align more closely with those of respondents who are white, male, older, and more educated. More systematic research is needed to confirm or reject these initial findings.

</details>


### [502] [GreenPassport: Request-Level Carbon Accounting for Cross-Border AI Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06784)
*Rui Lu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出GreenPassport Carbon Accounting (GPCA)，一种用于AI推理请求级别的碳排放核算方法，统一了服务边界、站点、路由、本地比较器、不确定性和数据溯源等输入，能更准确估算跨区域AI推理的碳足迹。与现有基线相比，GPCA将中位绝对百分比误差降低了56.3%，并解决了跨区域请求级核算的粒度问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI推理常常跨越地区边界——提示词被发送到远程数据中心，生成的token再返回用户。区域性平均值无法代表服务硬件、电力和网络交付的差异，请求级核算需要统一的边界来定义服务、服务站点、路由、本地比较器、不确定性和数据溯源，现有方法在这些方面存在缺失。

Method: GPCA将服务、站点、路由、本地比较器、不确定性和数据溯源等输入与每个请求关联，估算服务与路由碳足迹，并根据可用文档选择报告级别。其公共数据实现覆盖了数据中心实例、加速器、模型族、电力结构、路由和云区域碳强度等维度。

Result: 与六个核算基线和四个能量预测基线对比，GPCA在加速器能量对齐边界下相对于EcoLogits将中位绝对百分比误差降低了56.3%，中位绝对误差降低了15.5%。在确定性一致性测试中产生零规则过度陈述。买方案例中，清洁电力CN-West场景产生0.0148 gCO₂e/请求，比本地服务0.1220 gCO₂e/请求低88%。

Conclusion: GPCA提供了更精确的请求级AI推理碳核算方法，能够显著提高估算精度并支持跨区域碳足迹的比较与决策，在清洁电力场景下可为买方可提供远低于本地服务的碳选项。

Abstract: AI inference often crosses regional boundaries as prompts travel to remote data centers and generated tokens return to users. Regional averages cannot represent the resulting differences in serving hardware, electricity, and network delivery. Request-level accounting needs a common boundary for the service, serving site, route, local comparator, uncertainty, and data provenance.GreenPassport Carbon Accounting (GPCA) associates these inputs with each request. It estimates serving and route carbon, then selects a reporting level from the available documentation. Our public-data implementation covers data-center instances, accelerators, model families, electricity mixes, routes, and cloud-region carbon intensity. Against six accounting baselines and four energy-prediction baselines, GPCA reduced median absolute percentage error by 56.3\% and median absolute error by 15.5\% relative to EcoLogits under the aligned accelerator-energy boundary. It produced zero rule overstatement in the deterministic conformance tests. In the buyer case, the clean-electricity CN-West scenario produced $0.0148$ gCO$_2$e /request, 88\% below the local service at $0.1220$ gCO$_2$e /request.

</details>


### [503] [What a Model Refuses, a State Fears: How Authoritarian Information Control Reproduces in Language-Model Guardrails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07507)
*Menglin Liu,Yao Yu,Tong Wu,Chunran Zhang,Ge Shi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型的护栏如何编码开发者所在国家的政治威胁模型，而非普世的伤害概念。通过对十种模型和三种语言的比较研究发现，中国模型的护栏具有威权审查的特征，但缺乏人工审查的逐案判断力，其严格性在对抗性改写下崩溃，因此直接测量拒绝率的审计会高估模型实际受控程度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型成为政治信息入口，模型拒绝讨论的内容成为新的信息控制工具。作者提出模型的护栏编码的不是普遍的伤害概念，而是开发者所在国家（尤其是威权政权）的政治威胁模型，需从威权审查的比较研究中推导这种控制的预期结构。

Method: 对十种模型和三种语言进行比较分析，检验中国模型护栏中是否带有威权审查的特征：是否回应开发者本国政权（对涉华提示比涉外国提示更严格拒绝）；是否针对协调能力而非异议表达（甚至拒绝帮助组织亲政府动员）；以及审查的严格性是否可被对抗性改写所瓦解。

Result: 中国护栏确实带有威权审查的特征：对涉华集体行动提示的拒绝远多于涉外国提示；其针对性是协调能力而非异议表达；其严格性是可渗透的，在对抗性改写下崩溃。最具抗攻击能力的是西方前沿模型，而非最严格的拒绝者。但机器审查缺乏人工审查的逐案判断力，因此比其所模仿的官僚机构更粗糙。

Conclusion: 机器审查复制了前时代信息控制的摩擦式逻辑，但比官僚审查更粗糙钝拙。因此，直接测量拒绝率的审计会高估模型实际受控制程度，需要更精细的评估方法。

Abstract: As large language models become the front door to political information, what they refuse to discuss becomes a new instrument of information control. We argue that a model's guardrail encodes not a universal notion of harm but the political threat model of the state that governs its developer, and we derive the expected structure of that control from the comparative study of how authoritarian regimes censor. Across ten models and three languages, Chinese guardrails carry its signatures: they answer to the developer's own regime, refusing identical collective-action prompts far more when a prompt names China than a foreign state; within politics they target the capacity to coordinate rather than dissent, declining even to help organize pro-government mobilization; and their strictness is porous, collapsing under adversarial paraphrase, so that the models most resistant to attack are Western frontier systems, not the strictest refusers. Machine censorship thus reproduces the friction-based logic of prior-era information control while, lacking a censor's case-by-case judgment, proving blunter than the bureaucracy it resembles---so that audits which measure refusal directly overstate how controlled a model actually is.

</details>


### [504] [Mapping the Emerging Social Science of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07598)
*Yi Yang,Xiao Jia,Zeyun Dong,Chenzhang Wang,Zhanzhan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文基于198篇全文精读论文和47,719篇来自五个文献数据库的论文，通过句子嵌入、K-means聚类、LDA、结构主题建模等方法，将LLM社会科学研究映射为三个领域：LLM作为社会心智、LLM社会、LLM-人类交互，并细分为13个子类别，提供了可复现的分类框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM日益影响沟通、学习、工作、创造力和决策，但社会科学领域对这些发展的研究仍然碎片化，缺乏系统性的领域图谱。

Method: 组合使用句子嵌入（sentence embeddings）、K-means聚类、聚类内LDA、作者与LLM分类、结构主题建模（structural topic modeling）等多种方法；构建策展语料库（198篇全文精读）和领域规模语料库（47,719篇论文）。

Result: 识别出三大领域（Social Minds、Societies、Human Interactions）及13个子类别。策展语料库中三领域方案高度稳定（ARI=0.952），K-means与作者分类一致率达77.78%。领域规模下15个主题中的13个映射到分类体系，K-means与STM领域一致率73.83%。LLM-Human Interactions占领域映射主题质量78.02%，但高被引论文中Social Minds和Societies在会议领域占66.37%，而Human Interactions在期刊子集中占76.81%。

Conclusion: 该分类体系为理解模型行为、智能体交互和制度环境如何共同塑造LLM的社会后果提供了可复现的分析框架。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly shape communication, learning, work, creativity, and decision-making, yet social-science research on these developments remains fragmented. We map this emerging field using a curated corpus of 198 papers reviewed in full and a field-scale corpus of 47,719 published papers from five bibliographic databases. Combining sentence embeddings, K-means clustering, within-cluster Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), author and LLM classifications, and structural topic modeling, we identify three domains: LLM as Social Minds, examining socially interpretable model behavior; LLM Societies, examining collective dynamics among interacting model-based agents; and LLM-Human Interactions, examining how people perceive, use, and are affected by LLMs. These domains contain 13 subcategories spanning reasoning, personality and bias, behavioral games, collective intelligence, simulation, trust, work, creativity, and education. In the curated corpus, the three-domain solution is highly stable under resampling (adjusted Rand index = 0.952), and K-means assignments agree with author full-text classifications for 77.78% of papers. At field scale, 13 of 15 topics map onto the taxonomy, while K-means and structural-topic-model domains agree for 73.83% of overlapping papers. LLM-Human Interactions accounts for 78.02% of domain-mapped topic mass, but venue analysis reveals a contrasting pattern: Social Minds and LLM Societies together account for 66.37% of highly cited papers in leading conference venues, whereas LLM-Human Interactions accounts for 76.81% in the corresponding journal subset. The resulting taxonomy provides a reproducible framework for understanding how model behavior, agent interaction, and institutional context jointly shape the social consequences of LLMs.

</details>


### [505] [Near-Term Verification Methods for AI Chip Exports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07637)
*Bruna Avellar,Erich Grunewald*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨AI芯片出口管制的近期合规验证机制（约一年内可实施），将其分为三类：终端位置验证、终端用户验证和终端用途验证，并分析各机制如何在BIS监管框架内实施及其可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI芯片出口管制是美國塑造前沿AI发展的重要工具，但其有效性依赖于可靠的合规验证方法。当前缺乏对近期可实施验证机制的系统性研究。

Method: 将验证机制分为三类（终端位置、终端用户、终端用途），分析每种机制在BIS监管框架内的实施步骤，并识别可执行验证的主体（BIS、出口商或经认证的第三方审计机构）。

Result: 鉴于BIS资源有限，最可行的机制依赖私营部门与BIS协作、利用现有技术、无需大幅增加政府人员即可扩展。这些机制还可用于监测未来AI国际协议。

Conclusion: 有效且可实施的AI芯片出口合规验证应依托私营部门参与、现有技术利用和可扩展性设计，而非单纯依赖政府资源的扩充。

Abstract: AI chip export controls can help the United States shape the development of frontier AI, but their effectiveness depends on reliable methods for verifying compliance. This paper examines near-term verification mechanisms (implementable in approximately one year) and groups them into three categories: end-location verification (whether controlled chips remain in authorized locations and/or jurisdictions), end-user verification (whether entities that acquire or access compute are legitimate), and end-use verification (whether computing power is used for prohibited purposes). We discuss how each mechanism can be implemented within the regulatory framework of the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS), outlining implementation steps and identifying which actors can perform verification (BIS, exporters, or accredited third-party auditors). Given BIS's resource constraints, the most viable mechanisms rely on private-sector actors working alongside BIS, leverage existing technologies, and scale without requiring large increases in government staffing. These mechanisms could also help monitor future international agreements on AI.

</details>


### [506] [Human-AI Co-Creativity: Advances, Opportunities, and Challenges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07711)
*Adish Singla,Abhilasha Ravichander,Liwei Jiang,Alexander Spangher,Alice Oh,Jiho Jin,Jun Seong Kim,Changyoon Lee,Manh Hung Nguyen,Chao Wen*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 这是一篇基于ICML 2026会议上由作者组织的人机共创研讨会而撰写的综述文章。文章概述了研讨会活动，并指出了人机共创领域若干未来研究方向，旨在推动生成式AI、创造力和人机共创社区的建设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望通过组织研讨会和撰写综述，将关注生成式AI、创造力和人机协同创造的研究者与实践者聚集在一起，建立社区共识并明确该领域的未来发展方向。

Method: 本文基于ICML 2026人机共创研讨会的内容，对研讨会活动进行系统梳理与总结，并综合讨论出未来研究方向的建议。

Result: 提供了研讨会活动的整体概览，并识别并阐述了人机共创领域的多个未来研究方向。

Conclusion: 本文作为社区建设的成果，为生成式AI与人机共创交叉领域的研究提供了纲领性参考，并激励未来更多研究者投入该方向。

Abstract: This survey article has grown out of the human-AI co-creativity workshop organized by the authors at the ICML 2026 conference. We organized this workshop as part of a community-building effort to bring together researchers and practitioners interested in topics of generative AI, creativity, and human-AI co-creation. This article aims to provide an overview of the workshop activities and highlight several future research directions in the area of human-AI co-creativity.

</details>


### [507] [An emancipatory vision for designing (generative) AI for learner flourishing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07715)
*Luis P. Prieto,Yannis Dimitriadis*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文批判了生成式AI在教育中的过度炒作，指出其代理性特征可能导致学习者个体孤立、过度依赖等技术风险。作者认为以人为中心的设计方法（如价值敏感设计）不足以解决由经济激励和人类惰性等系统性因素驱动的问题，因此提出一种面向学习者繁荣（flourishing）的、更具解放性的教育AI设计愿景，包含初步设计原则和整体设计方法论，但承认仍有大量开放问题待解决。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有以人为中心的设计方法假设通过挖掘人类需求与价值可以规避AI教育技术带来的依赖和孤立风险，但这些方法忽视了经济激励、人类惰性等更广泛的系统性因素，且相关努力尚未能指导出既避免上述风险又能广泛采用的教育技术设计，亟需一种替代性的解放性愿景。

Method: 提出一种替代性的、更具解放性的未来教育AI技术愿景：以学习者繁荣为导向，同时考虑其所处的更广泛复杂系统，并给出初步设计原则与整体设计方法论。

Result: 本文主要产出是概念性/愿景性的设计框架与初步原则，而非实证结果；同时明确指出在该愿景实现之前仍存在许多开放问题。

Conclusion: 挑战了以人为中心设计在教育AI领域的局限性，倡导一种更系统化、以学习者繁荣为核心的解放性设计路径；但该愿景尚不成熟，需在真实教育场景中进一步探索与验证。

Abstract: The hype around generative AI seems to promise unprecedented productivity (and learning) gains. However, these technologies' increasing agentic features seem to push learners towards individualism (or individual isolation), over-reliance, and dependence on them. Human-centered design approaches (e.g., value-sensitive design) assume that, by unearthing human needs, preferences, and values, technology researchers/designers may avoid such dangers, which are driven by wider systemic factors like economic incentives or inherent human limitations (e.g., our tendency to seek, in the moment, the easiest path of action). Yet, so far these efforts seem insufficient to guide our design of educational technology that avoids the aforementioned dependency and isolation dangers, while finding widespread adoption. This paper presents an alternative, more emancipatory vision for future educational AI technology, oriented towards learner flourishing while considering the wider complex systems they inhabit, including tentative design principles and an overall design methodology. Yet, many open questions remain before this vision can be realized.

</details>


### [508] [When Is Content "AI-Generated Enough"? Labelling Synthetic Media under the Digital Services Act and the AI Act](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07727)
*Marie-Therese Sekwenz*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文探讨欧洲平台与AI治理中合成媒体及操纵媒体标签制度（labelling）的有效性，基于DSA和AI法案第50条的框架，识别出四个治理张力：定义模糊性、界面与责任设计、沟通有效性、公平性与可争议性，并将标签概念化为一个社会技术分类实践。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欧盟正越来越多依赖透明度义务（如显著标记、机器可读标记、深度伪造披露）来应对合成与操纵媒体带来的系统性风险，但学界和实务界尚不清楚标签制度在何种条件下是恰当的监管回应，又在何时会过度包容、覆盖不足或无效。作者希望超越"是否应标记"的简单问题，深入考察法律阈值、技术溯源系统、平台界面及报告实践如何共同决定透明度义务的触发条件。

Method: 本文采用规范性法律分析与实证快照相结合的方法：一方面审视AI法案第50条的实施框架，另一方面分析DSA的Statement of Reasons数据库，从中识别跨两个制度框架的治理张力，并提出将标签概念化为一种分配AI提供者、部署者、平台、上传者与接收者之间责任的社会技术分类实践。

Result: 论文识别出四个核心治理张力：1) 定义模糊性——何谓"充分生成、操纵或看似真实"缺乏清晰法律阈值；2) 界面与责任设计——各参与方之间透明度义务的责任分配不清；3) 沟通有效性——标签是否能实际被接收者理解并影响行为存疑；4) 公平性与可争议性——标签实践可能带来的不公平结果及缺乏申诉/争议路径。

Conclusion: 标签制度只有在其法律触发条件、技术基础架构、界面呈现及责任分配机制充分协调时才能成为应对合成媒体的有意义监管工具；否则就存在过度包容、覆盖不足或无效化的风险。作者主张将标签视为一种治理工具层面的社会技术实践，而非单纯的技术或法律机械操作。

Abstract: European platform and AI governance increasingly relies on transparency duties to address synthetic and manipulated media. Under the DSA, very large online platforms and search engines may use prominent markings and recipient-facing indication tools as systemic-risk mitigation measures. Under the AI Act, providers must support machine-readable marking, while deployers must disclose deepfakes and certain AI-generated or manipulated public-interest text, subject to statutory qualifications.
  This extended abstract examines when labelling is a meaningful regulatory response to synthetic media and when it risks becoming over-inclusive, under-inclusive, or ineffective. It argues that the central challenge is not only whether content should be labelled, but how legal thresholds, technical provenance systems, platform interfaces, and reporting practices determine when content is sufficiently generated, manipulated, or authentic-looking to trigger transparency obligations. Drawing on the emerging Article 50 AI Act implementation framework and a snapshot of the DSA Statement of Reasons database, the paper identifies four governance tensions: definitional ambiguity, interface and responsibility design, communicative effectiveness, and fairness and contestability. It conceptualises labelling as a socio-technical classification practice that distributes responsibility among AI providers, deployers, platforms, uploaders, and recipients.

</details>


### [509] [Silent Revision: Measuring Undisclosed Change in the Safety Frameworks of Frontier AI Developers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08789)
*Louis Yiven Zhu*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出了"无声修订率"（silent revision rate）这一指标，用于衡量前沿AI开发者安全框架修订的透明度。作者构建了包含12家开发者所有公开版本及变更记录的版本化、哈希固定语料库，追踪了710个承诺实例并逐项编码，发现67%的重大变更未被公开说明（严格标准下）。研究还发现沉默度与叙述性公告相关，且77%的追踪变更削弱或移除了承诺。作者主张监管应增加"枚举义务"（enumeration duty），使修订可审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 欧盟和加利福尼亚已将对前沿AI安全框架（safety frameworks）的修订视为问责工具并施加修订义务，但现有义务均不要求修订"可读"（legible），即读者无法从开发者自身的叙述中得知发生了什么变化。这种透明度缺口使外部监督失效。

Method: 作者构建了一个包含12家已发布安全框架的开发者所有公开版本、变更日志、红线对比或公告的版本化语料库（带哈希固定）。他们追踪了12个连续版本对中的710个承诺实例，使用冻结的编码手册进行编码，并对244个实例进行了逐项裁定。通过对比开发者的实质性变更与公开叙述，计算无声修订率。

Result: 三个主要发现：(1) 67%的重大变更是无声的（严格标准，95% CI 62-72），宽松标准下为53%，章节粒度下降至49%；(2) 沉默度与叙述形式相关——叙述性公告为74%，条目化变更日志为63%，而篇幅长短几乎无关；(3) 77%的追踪变更削弱或移除了承诺，且在八个版本对中的七对里，削弱比加强更常是无声的。

Conclusion: 现行法定救济针对的是错误的工件：监管要求"说明理由"（justification），而非"列举变化"（enumeration）。作者论证公开义务应附带枚举义务，使修订可审计，并指出已有一家提供者自愿且不完整地做到了这一点。

Abstract: Frontier AI developers publish safety frameworks that commit them to evidencing whether their models are dangerous. The European Union and California now treat these documents as instruments of accountability, and both already impose duties on their revision. Neither requires the revision to be legible, in the sense that a reader could learn from the developer's own account what changed. We introduce the silent revision rate, the share of material changes to a framework's commitments that the developer's published account does not identify, and we release the versioned, hash-pinned corpus needed to compute it. The corpus contains every public version of the safety frameworks of the twelve developers that have published one, together with each provider's changelog, redline or announcement. We trace 710 commitment instances across twelve consecutive version pairs, code them against a frozen codebook, and adjudicate 244 individually. Three findings follow. First, 67% of material changes (95% CI 62 to 72) are silent under a strict standard and 53% under a lenient one, falling to 49% at section granularity. Second, silence appears to track the form of the account, since narrative announcements run at 74% against 63% for itemised changelogs, whereas account length in words barely matters; on the test that respects nesting the difference is suggestive. Third, 77% of traced changes weaken or remove a commitment, and in seven of eight pairs weakenings are more often silent than strengthenings. The statutory remedy therefore exists and specifies the wrong artefact. A justification explains why a framework changed, an enumeration states what changed, and only the latter makes revision auditable. We argue that publication duties should carry an enumeration duty, which one provider already meets, voluntarily and incompletely.

</details>


### [510] [What AI Benchmarks Actually Measure: Adapting Convergent and Discriminant Validity to Interrogate Fifty-Six AI Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08812)
*Meera Desai,Sang T. Truong,Hanna Wallach,Alex Chouldechova,A. Feder Cooper,Jean Garcia-Gathright,Daniel E. Ho,Abigail Z. Jacobs,Sanmi Koyejo,Nicholas Pangakis,Angelina Wang*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文借鉴社会科学中的收敛效度和区分效度概念，提出了一种检验AI基准测试（benchmark）有效性的方法。作者对53个模型在56个能力与安全基准上的表现进行了分析，发现基准测试之间存在概念不一致的问题：同属一个安全概念的基准之间相关性弱、不同能力概念之间的区分度不足，甚至有些基准测的可能是其宣称概念之外的东西。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基准测试在模型开发与治理中至关重要，然而现有基准是否真正衡量其声称衡量的概念（如推理能力、拒答能力）缺乏系统的验证手段，这直接影响基准测试的可靠性和对模型评估的可信度。

Method: 借鉴社会科学中的收敛效度（convergent validity）与区分效度（discriminant validity）概念，将声称概念相似的基准归入同一组，检验组内模型排名相关性是否显著高于组间；同时在条目（item）层面使用项目反应理论（IRT）模型进行类似分析，并对比基准在共享设计元素（如评分格式）下与共享概念下的相关性差异。

Result: 研究发现：1）同一安全概念下的基准间模型排名相关性往往较弱，说明安全概念跨基准界定不一致；2）对于能力概念（如推理、知识），同概念基准间的相关性与不同概念间的相关性相当，说明这些概念缺乏区分度；3）部分情况下共享设计元素的基准间相关性反而强于共享概念的基准；4）某些基准与其他概念基准的相关性高于与自己所属概念基准的相关性，暗示其测的可能并非自称的概念。例如BBQ-accuracy与标记为推理的基准相关性更高，而非与其所属的bias概念基准相关。

Conclusion: 基准测试的有效性存在系统性问题，标称概念与实测内容可能不一致。论文公开了大规模的模型输出与条目级/基准级分数数据集，以支持未来关于基准有效性的实证研究。

Abstract: Benchmarks play a central role in the development and governance of models, yet it is often unclear whether they actually measure the concepts they purport to measure (e.g., reasoning, refusal). We adapt convergent and discriminant validity from the social sciences into an approach for interrogating AI benchmarks, applying it to 56 capability and safety benchmarks across 53 models. We label benchmarks with substantively similar purported concepts to a shared assigned concept, and ask whether model rankings on benchmarks with the same assigned concept correlate more strongly than rankings on benchmarks with different assigned concepts. We ask analogous questions at the item level using item response theory (IRT) models. We find that correlations between model rankings on benchmarks with the same assigned safety concepts are often weak, suggesting these concepts may be conceptualized inconsistently across benchmarks. For assigned capability concepts (e.g., reasoning, knowledge), model rankings are often as strongly correlated among benchmarks with the same assigned concept as between benchmarks with different assigned concepts, suggesting these capability concepts may not discriminate well from one another. In some cases, benchmarks that share design elements (e.g., score format) correlate more strongly than benchmarks with the same assigned concept. Finally, some individual benchmarks correlate more strongly with benchmarks assigned a different concept than with benchmarks sharing their own assigned concept, suggesting they may measure a different concept than they purport to. For example, BBQ-accuracy correlates more strongly with benchmarks labeled reasoning than with benchmarks that share its assigned concept, bias. To support future empirical work on benchmark validity, we release our extensive dataset of model outputs and scores at the item- and benchmark-level.

</details>

### [511] [AhaBench: Do Agents Learn from Prior Experience? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05435)
*Zerui Cheng,Jiawei Xu,Huacan Chai,Jiayang Sun,Pramod Viswanath,Maxm Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AhaBench是一个评估语言智能体长期学习能力的基准测试套件，包含三个组件（Aha-Puzzle、Aha-Euler、Aha-Vending），通过"初始得分-经验后得分-学习提升"三分法衡量模型在获得有用经验后是否能在相关评估条件下表现更好。实验表明，善于利用可见支持的模型、达到高经验后得分的模型和运行中提升最大的模型并非总是同一批。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言智能体评估通常在单次提示后重置，或仅评分单条轨迹的最终状态，无法回答一个更实际的问题：当模型在运行中获得有用经验后，在移除、改变或延迟明显支持的评估条件下，其后续行为是否真的改善？

Method: AhaBench包含三个组件：Aha-Puzzle测试无提示探索（解决隐藏状态谜题后）；Aha-Euler将Project-Euler式数学思想转化为教师/保留任务配精确验证器；Aha-Vending基于Vending-Bench的开源实现，测试智能体在延迟反馈和运营事故下保持盈利的能力。评估采用三部分记分卡：初始得分、经验后得分和两者之差（学习提升）。

Result: 在8个常见模型上，Claude Opus 4.6在经验后总得分（64.3）和学习提升（+25.8）上领先，Gemini 3.1 Pro紧随其后（63.4）。组件结果揭示了模型能力的分化：谜题追踪提升了有支持得分但常无法转化为无提示探索行为；Aha-Euler完整教学达78.6-100.0%而仅答案迁移仅0.0-73.9%；Aha-Vending则区分了盈利性事故处理与破产/无订单失败。

Conclusion: 模型"会用可见支持"、"能达到高经验后得分"和"运行中提升最大"是三个不同的能力维度，不应混为一谈。AhaBench通过这一分解提供了更细粒度的评估视角，并开源所有基准任务、评分标准、验证器、模拟器代码及接口以便评估新智能体。

Abstract: Modern language agents are expected to operate over long horizons: they ask follow-up questions, reuse worked examples, handle tool feedback, and adapt to delayed consequences. Most evaluations still reset the agent after a prompt or score only the final state of one trajectory. AhaBench asks a more operational question: when a fixed model receives useful experience, does its later behavior improve under a related evaluation condition where the obvious support has been removed, changed, or delayed? The suite contains three components. Aha-Puzzle tests no-hint exploration after solved hidden-state puzzles; Aha-Euler turns Project-Euler-style mathematical ideas into generated taught/held-out tasks with exact validators; and Aha-Vending, an open-source implementation inspired by Vending-Bench, tests whether a simulated vending agent remains profitable while handling delayed feedback and operational incidents. AhaBench reports a three-part scorecard: Initial Score measures starting competence, Post-Experience Score measures the later empirical outcome, and Learning Lift is their difference. This decomposition is the main empirical message: models that use visible support well, models that reach high post-experience scores, and models that improve most during a run are not always the same. On the common eight-model panel, Claude Opus 4.6 leads aggregate Post-Experience Score at 64.3 and aggregate Learning Lift at +25.8, with Gemini 3.1 Pro close behind at 63.4. The component results explain the split: puzzle traces raise supported scores but often fail to become no-hint exploration behavior; Aha-Euler full teaching reaches 78.6-100.0% while answer-only transfer ranges from 0.0 to 73.9%; and Aha-Vending separates profitable incident handling from bankruptcy and no-order failure. We release benchmark tasks, rubrics, validators, simulator code, and interfaces for evaluating new agents.

</details>


### [512] [AlphaRJM: Reward-Jump Memory for Stochastic Return-Guided Alpha Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08581)
*Sayan Dhan,Selvaraju Natarajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AlphaRJM方法，通过"奖励跳跃记忆"（事件驱动的隐状态，仅在终端评估时更新）和"动作条件下的SDE回报评论家"（用随机粒子表示未来折扣发现回报），解决了因子发现中延迟反馈导致的池历史缺失与中间动作价值不确定两大难题，在多个股票池、预测周期和随机种子下取得稳定增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公式化alpha发现是一个依赖股票池的符号搜索问题，其关键挑战在于：1）完整的表达式评估后才产生信息反馈（延迟反馈），导致保留的alpha池无法保存全部历史评估反馈；2）中间构建动作的价值不确定，因为其后果取决于最终完成的公式。这两种耦合的困难制约了因子发现的效率。

Method: 提出AlphaRJM框架，包含两个核心组件：1）Reward-Jump Memory（奖励跳跃记忆）：一种事件驱动的隐状态，在token构建期间保持固定，仅在终端评估事件发生时通过实际池奖励和评估结果进行更新；2）动作条件SDE回报评论家：通过随机粒子表示未来折扣发现回报，粒子通过均值和不确定性引导动作选择，采用结合能量距离匹配、均值校准和跳跃正则化的分布贝尔曼目标进行学习。

Result: 在多个股票池（equity universes）、多种预测周期和随机种子下，AlphaRJM均取得强且稳定的性能提升；消融实验证实了持久评估历史、随机回报建模和分布监督三个组件具有互补作用。

Conclusion: AlphaRJM通过引入事件驱动的记忆机制和基于SDE的分布回报评论家，有效解决了延迟反馈下因子发现中的记忆缺失与中间动作价值不确定性问题，并通过消融验证了各组件互补贡献，是该任务上的一种有效方法。

Abstract: Formulaic alpha discovery is a pool-dependent symbolic search problem in which informative feedback is observed primarily when a complete expression is evaluated. This delayed feedback creates two coupled difficulties: the retained alpha pool does not preserve the full history of realized evaluation feedback, and the value of an intermediate construction action is uncertain because its consequence depends on the formula eventually completed. We introduce AlphaRJM, which addresses these difficulties through Reward-Jump Memory, an event-driven latent state that remains fixed during token construction and updates only at terminal evaluation events using the realized pool reward and evaluation outcome, and an action-conditioned SDE return critic that represents future discounted discovery returns with stochastic particles. The particles guide action selection through their mean and uncertainty and are learned using a distributional Bellman objective combining energy-distance matching, mean calibration, and jump regularization. Empirically, AlphaRJM delivers strong and stable gains across multiple equity universes, forecasting horizons, and random seeds, while ablations confirm the complementary roles of persistent evaluation history, stochastic return modeling, and distributional supervision.

</details>


### [513] [When Do Options Help? Policy Necrosis and Redundant Coverage in Option-Critic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05508)
*Bingyun Liu,Yuheng Jing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过理论和实验重新审视Option-critic算法，揭示其性能提升的真正机制与论文头条结论相悖：终止规则学习并无贡献（等价于每步终止），内部策略几乎不探索导致"策略坏死"，额外option的作用仅是降低所有option在同一状态全部失败的概率（从59%降至4%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Option-critic算法的头条结论声称"随着option数量增加性能会提升"，但这篇文章认为这一结论需要被重新解释。作者试图从理论上解释性能提升的真正来源，并通过实验验证。这有助于深入理解分层强化学习中option机制实际起作用的机制。

Method: 方法包括三部分：(1)理论分析终止规则：证明当终止测试与选择option的策略读取相同值时，学习到的终止规则等价于每步终止；当策略探索而测试不探索时（如option-critic），规则可能阻碍探索，存在Ω(T)遗憾的例子，而每步终止可达到O(log T)。(2)通过引入"策略坏死"概念和状态级测试，分析option内部策略几乎不探索的问题。(3)通过实验验证option数量与性能关系的真实机制。

Result: 实验结果：强制每步终止不会改变option数量-性能曲线；典型option中五分之三的状态出现"策略坏死"；恢复探索可修复坏死状态，单个option即可完成任务；额外option并不改善任何单个option，而是将"所有option在同一状态失败"的概率从59%降至4%，性能提升正源于此联合量。

Conclusion: Option-critic性能随option数提升的真实原因并非option子策略的多样性或终止学习的有效，而是降低所有option在某个状态集体失败的概率。终止学习机制实质上无效，且option内部策略存在明显的探索不足问题（策略坏死），提示需要重新审视分层强化学习中的设计假设。

Abstract: Option-critic learns options: sub-policies together with a learned rule for when each one hands control back. Its headline result is that performance improves as options are added. We explain that result, with theory and experiment. First, the termination rule option-critic learns by maximising return contributes nothing. When the termination test and the policy that picks options read the same values, the test fires at every step, so the learned rule is identical to always terminating. When that policy explores and the test does not, as in option-critic itself, the rule can block the exploration; there are instances where it suffers $Ω(T)$ regret while always terminating holds to $O(\log T)$. Forcing termination at every step leaves the option-count curve intact. Second, the policy inside an option barely explores at all, so a state locks onto the first action that looked good and never updates again. We name this policy necrosis, give a state-level test for it, and find three fifths of states necrotic in a typical option. Restoring exploration repairs those states, and one option then solves the task. Third, extra options improve no option; what falls is the chance that all of them fail in the same state, from $59\\%$ to $4\\%$, and performance follows that joint quantity.

</details>


### [514] [Multi-granularity Adaptive Hypergraph Representation Learning via Granular-ball](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05574)
*Sen Zhao,Yifan Guan,Jinyuan Ni,Gaojie Xu,Zhang Xu,Xiaoyu Lian,Yi Liu,Yi Wang,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MGHRL框架，通过自适应粒度超图生成策略和多粒度超图网络，解决超图表示学习中预定义超边无法自适应捕获多粒度高阶关系的问题，并在基准数据集上显著优于基线模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有超图表示学习方法大多依赖预定义规则生成超边，忽视了图拓扑结构的多样性和超边的多粒度特性，导致难以自适应地发现高阶关系并高效处理复杂结构信息。

Method: 提出MGHRL框架，包含两个核心组件：(1)自适应粒度超图生成策略，通过粒度球的自适应分裂在多个粒度层次生成超边，依据图的拓扑结构捕获高阶关系；(2)多粒度超图网络，包含多个子网络以捕获不同粒度超边的特征，并通过分层可逆连接进行特征整合。

Result: 实验结果表明MGHRL在多个基准数据集上显著优于现有基线模型。

Conclusion: 通过自适应多粒度超边生成与分层可逆特征整合，MGHRL能够更有效、更灵活地发现和建模图中的高阶关系，为超图表示学习提供了一种新的自适应范式。

Abstract: Hypergraph representation learning aims to capture high-order information in graphs by constructing hyperedges that simultaneously connect multiple nodes. These hyperedges adapt to the graph's topological features, facilitating the extraction of high-order relationships at multiple granularities. Most prior work relies on predefined definitions to generate hyperedges, overlooking the diversity in graph topological structures and the multi-granularity characteristics of hyperedges. As a result, this limits their ability to effectively and adaptively discover high-order relationships and efficiently process complex structural information. To address this limitation, we propose a novel framework called \underline{M}ulti-\underline{G}ranularity \underline{H}ypergraph \underline{R}epresentation \underline{L}earning (MGHRL). MGHRL introduces an Adaptive Granular Hypergraph Generation strategy, which generates hyperedges at multiple levels of granularity through the adaptive splitting of granular-ball, effectively capturing high-order relationships based on the graph's topological structure. Additionally, we propose a Multi-Granularity Hypergraph Network with multiple sub-networks, capturing features from hyperedges at different granularities and integrating them via hierarchical reversible connections. Experimental results show that MGHRL significantly outperforms baseline models on benchmark datasets.

</details>


### [515] [Capsule Lens: Locating and Tracking Concept Geometry in Model Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05575)
*Yiming Tang,Harshvardhan Saini,Samyak Jha,Huaming Chen,Xufeng Duan,Dianbo Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Capsule Lens框架，用胶囊（简单可追踪的几何形式）来匹配并描述概念在模型内部表示空间中所占据的区域，适用于静态和动态表示分析。静态方面揭示概念几何特征，动态方面通过三个案例研究（CLIP预训练、VQA上的RL后训练、数学推理上的RL后训练）展示不同类型的表示漂移几何动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法主要将表示映射到更可解释的空间，缺乏对概念如何在表示空间中占据区域进行直接刻画；已有假设缺乏严格验证且多聚焦于静态表示。因此需要一种能直接定位、分析并追踪概念几何的框架。

Method: 引入Capsule Lens框架：将概念占据的区域与一个可简单追踪的几何对象——胶囊（capsule）匹配，该胶囊由若干可解释参数定义，以闭式解（closed form）拟合到每个概念的几何结构，并在保留样本上验证其有效性。应用于静态和动态两类表示设置。

Result: 静态表示上成功定位多种模型的概à§念几何，并通过span和norm曲线揭示重要几何特征。动态表示上三个案例研究展示了本质不同的几何动力学：CLIP预训练引起广泛的网络级重构，而RL后训练产生局部的、概念特定的变化。结果既包含与现有文献一致的发现，也有新的观察。

Conclusion: Capsule Lens是定位、分析和追踪静态与动态表示中概念几何的有前景的工具，为机制可解释性提供了一种可追踪、可验证的概念几何表征方案。

Abstract: Understanding how concepts are encoded in the internal representations of machine learning models is a central problem in mechanistic interpretability, essential both for the science of deep learning and for the trustworthy deployment of increasingly capable models. Existing approaches to interpret model representations mainly map representations onto more interpretable spaces and do not directly characterize how concepts occupy representation space; various hypotheses have been proposed, but often lack of rigorous validation and largely focus on static representations. In this work, we introduce Capsule Lens, a framework that matches the region a concept occupies with a simple, trackable geometric form, a capsule, defined by several interpretable parameters, fitted in closed form to each concept's geometry and validated on held-out samples. We apply Capsule Lens in two major settings: static and dynamic representations. On static representations, we demonstrate how to locate concept geometry across various models, and how the span and norm curves uncover important geometric characteristics. On dynamic representations, we present three case studies tracking representation drifts induced by distinct training settings, CLIP pretraining, RL post-training on visual question answering, and RL post-training on mathematical reasoning. These analyses reveal qualitatively different geometric dynamics, ranging from broad network-wide restructuring in CLIP pretraining to localized and concept-specific changes in RL post-training. Our results include findings aligned with existing literature as well as novel observations. We believe Capsule Lens stands as a promising tool for locating, analyzing, and tracking concept geometry in both static and dynamic representations.

</details>


### [516] [Nyström Attention Matches Full Attention for Cross-Sectional Stock Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08106)
*Kunhan Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统剖析了MASTER模型中的跨股票多头注意力模块（占模型参数42.5%、预测价值25%），发现其注意力分布近乎均匀但非均匀性呈低秩结构。通过Nystrom低秩注意力（m=32个landmark）可在O(mN)成本下匹配完整O(N^2)注意力。同时还发现注意力与收益相似度负相关（表明寻求互补性而非相关性挖掘），图结构替代方案均表现更差，且在大规模场景下跨股票模块优势消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解跨股票注意力模块为何有效：该模块参数占比高且贡献显著，但均匀性与有效性的矛盾（去除均匀性丧失判别力）需通过谱分析解释，并探索更高效的替代结构。

Method: 1) 对MASTER的inter-stock多头注意力进行系统分解与混淆测试；2) 谱分析（奇异值分解）揭示低秩结构；3) 采用Nystrom低秩注意力近似并进行TOST等价性检验；4) 分析注意力与收益相似度/行业标签的相关性；5) 对比图神经网络、硬掩码等替代方案；6) 在更大规模（N~3500）下验证跨股票模块的扩展性。

Result: 有效秩~65，前10个模态捕获96.5%能量；Nystrom（m=32）在N=300和N=800下均与全注意力等价；注意力与收益相似度Spearman rho=-0.614（控制行业、beta、波动率后仍为-0.627）；图方法均降级且硬掩码比完全移除更糟；N~3500时无跨股票模块显著超越per-stock LSTM。

Conclusion: 跨股票注意力的价值在于一种可压缩的、动态的、接近全局的再分配机制，它奖励低秩近似但抗拒稀疏化。这为设计高效跨股票建模提供了明确指导：应追求低秩而非稀疏结构。

Abstract: MASTER's inter-stock multi-head attention -- the module responsible for modeling cross-sectional stock relationships -- accounts for 42.5% of model parameters and 25% of predictive value. We systematically decompose this module and uncover a surprising structure: the learned attention is near-uniform (perplexity 278/300), yet forcing exact uniformity eliminates all cross-sectional discrimination. Spectral analysis resolves this paradox: the deviation from uniformity is low-rank (effective rank ~65, top-10 modes capture 96.5% of energy), explaining why sparse approximations consistently fail while Nystrom low-rank attention (m=32 landmarks) matches full O(N^2) attention at O(mN) cost -- certified equivalent via TOST at both N=300 (5 seeds, Rank IC p=0.003) and N=800 (10 seeds, Rank IC p=0.034). Additional findings include: (i) attention anti-correlates with return similarity (Spearman rho = -0.614; on the industry-labeled subset, -0.645 unconditionally and -0.627 after controlling for industry, beta, and volatility), suggesting complementarity-seeking rather than correlation mining; (ii) all graph-based alternatives degrade performance, with hard masking worse than complete module removal; and (iii) at N ~ 3,500 with adapted architectures, no cross-stock module (GCN, Nystrom, or MASTER-style pipeline) significantly outperforms a per-stock LSTM baseline (n=4 seeds), indicating that the benefits observed at smaller scales do not trivially transfer. These results establish that the inter-stock attention's value resides in a compressible, dynamic, near-global redistribution that rewards low-rank approximation but resists sparsification.

</details>


### [517] [HB-PVI: A Hierarchical Bayesian Personalization and Value-of-Information Framework for Complex Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05582)
*Hammed A. Olayinka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HB-PVI框架，一个层次贝叶斯个性化与信息价值框架，用于在可穿戴健康感知应用中决定是否值得为个性化活动识别购买额外的标注标签。在47名参与者的MUSIC-CAR复杂活动队列上，研究发现适配器个性化带来的平均F1增益极小（十标签时仅0.00198），而通过一步期望样本信息价值(EVSI)停止规则，最优策略是不购买任何标签，直接使用群体推断。相比固定十次适配器个性化，该方法将标注减少100%，同时保持F1损失可控（均值0.00217，95%置信区间上界远低于容差），并在216种成本阈值设置中的199种达到效用最优。研究论证了当个性化收益相对于标注、计算和损害成本较小时应采取群体优先的部署策略，价值信息推理而非原始预测精度应驱动个性化决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化可以提高活动识别性能，但参与者特定增益存在异质性，且每个额外的校准标签都有获取成本。现有方法未系统考虑个性化机制的潜在危害、参与者异质性以及标签的经济价值，难以回答"是否值得购买更多标签"这一核心问题。

Method: 提出HB-PVI框架，包含三个核心组件：(1)层次贝叶斯模型联合建模参与者异质性及四种个性化机制的收益与危害；(2)基于序列蒙特卡洛的参与者效应更新器，实现防泄漏的留一参与者评估；(3)Student-t层次增益模型结合一步期望样本信息价值(EVSI)停止规则，用于决策是否继续购买标签。

Result: 适配器个性化在所有标签数量下增益均极小（0.00099到0.00198），适配器加头部及原型残差个性化甚至为负平均增益。在主要实践收益阈值和成本设置下，一步EVSI在每阶段均为零，最优策略是不购买标签。相比固定十次适配器，标注减少100%，后验均值F1损失仅0.00217，后验概率0.9992保持在0.005容差以下。HB-PVI在216种成本阈值设置中的199种达到效用最优。

Conclusion: 当个性化增益相对于标注、计算和损害成本较小时，应优先采用群体推断。价值信息推理而非原始预测精度应驱动健康感知应用中的个性化决策。

Abstract: Personalization can improve activity-recognition performance, but participant-specific gains are heterogeneous, and every additional calibration label has an acquisition cost. This study presents HB-PVI, a hierarchical Bayesian personalization and value-of-information framework jointly modeling participant heterogeneity, the benefit and harm of four personalization mechanisms, and the economic value of an additional label, for the 47-participant MUSIC-CAR complex-activity cohort. A leakage-safe, leave-one-participant-out evaluation combines a sequential-Monte-Carlo participant-effect updater with a Student-$t$ hierarchical gain model and a one-step expected-value-of-sample-information (EVSI) stopping rule. Adapter personalization produced small positive mean F1 gains, growing from 0.00099 at one label to 0.00198 at ten, while adapter-plus-head and prototype-residual personalization were negative on average. Under the primary practical-benefit threshold ($Δ_{\min}=0.01$) and cost setting, one-step EVSI was zero at every decision state, so the policy purchased no labels and retained population inference for all 47 participants, matching always-stop exactly (region-of-practical-equivalence probability $=1$). Relative to fixed ten-shot adapter personalization, this reduced labeling by 100\% while keeping the posterior mean F1 loss at 0.00217 (95\% credible interval, 0.00048 to 0.00389), with posterior probability 0.9992 of remaining below the 0.005 tolerance. HB-PVI was utility-optimal in 199 of 216 cost-threshold settings and in every setting at or above the primary label cost. These results argue for a population-first deployment policy whenever personalization gains are small relative to labeling, computation, and harm costs, and show that value-of-information reasoning, not raw predictive accuracy, should drive personalization decisions in health-sensing applications.

</details>


### [518] [Endogenous Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Intrinsic Curiosity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05650)
*Armando Vieira*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个由内在好奇心驱动的强化学习框架，专为非平稳环境且奖励稀疏或缺失场景设计。基于液态状态机（LSM）实现，在LunarLander和BipedalWalker基准上达到与PPO、ICM相当的竞争性能，并验证"好奇心中间态"假设——探索效能在中度不连贯状态下最优。与Active Inference对比发现该好奇心窗口具有独特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法在面对非平稳环境、稀疏/延迟/缺失奖励时探索效率低；作者假设探索效能与系统的"不连贯程度"呈倒U型关系，既非过于刚性也非过于无序的动态最有利于结构化探索，以此构建认知动机驱动的探索机制。

Method: 设计强化学习框架，将外部奖励与认知动机机制（好奇心/探索奖励）结合以引导动作选择；底层使用液态状态机（LSM）作为神经网络基板处理动态输入；在两个基准（离散动作LunarLander v2和连续控制BipedalWalker v3）上进行评估，并与PPO和ICM等基线对比。

Result: 在两个标准基准任务上，该方法相比PPO和ICM等成熟深度RL算法获得具有竞争力的性能；进一步实验表明Active Inference智能体在相同分析下无法恢复好奇心中间窗口，说明所提出方法捕获了不同于现有方法的独特探索动态。

Conclusion: 中间水平的动力学不连贯性能驱动最优探索，该好奇心窗口为所提框架特有，展现了超越传统RL与Active Inference范式的探索机制潜力。

Abstract: We propose a reinforcement learning framework in which exploration is driven by intrinsic curiosity, designed for scenarios where environments are non-stationary and rewards are sparse, delayed, uninformative, or absent. In our model, action selection is guided by a combination of external rewards and an epistemic motivation mechanism that biases the agent toward structured exploratory directions. The central hypothesis is that effective exploration emerges at intermediate levels of incoherence, while performance degrades under both overly rigid and overly disordered dynamics. To test this idea, we implement the framework on top of a Liquid State Machine (LSM) substrate and evaluate it on two standard benchmarks: the discrete-action LunarLanderv2 and the continuous-control BipedalWalkerv3. The proposed method achieves competitive performance on both tasks relative to established deep RL algorithms, including Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and Intrinsic Curiosity Module (ICM). We further show that the curiosity window is not recovered in Active Inference agents under the same analysis, suggesting that the proposed dynamics capture a distinct exploration regime

</details>


### [519] [Robustness of LLM-Generated SystemVerilog Assertions to Semantics-Preserving RTL Transformations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05658)
*FNU Aditi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对LLM生成SystemVerilog断言(SVA)进行受控变质评估，发现即使输入RTL行为保持不变仅变换语法表示，模型的正确率也会大幅波动（9.7%-27.0%的原本正确行为在变换后出错），表明单一正确率指标不足以反映LLM在断言生成任务中的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在SVA生成任务上的评估仅在单一语法表示上报告正确率，无法揭示同一RTL行为在不同书写方式下模型输出是否稳定，缺乏对模型鲁棒性的刻画。

Method: 基于VERT数据集构建质量过滤的条件控制池和40程序分层评估集（295个赋值行为），评估Qwen2.5-Coder-7B和DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite两个开源代码模型，使用相同的评估提示和贪心解码。研究三种语义保持变换：操作数重排、确定性标识符重命名、冗余括号化。除基线正确率和变换后正确率外，还测量条件鲁棒性、不变性失败率和翻转率，采用10,000样本聚簇bootstrap区间（RTL程序级别）。

Result: 在所有六个模型-变换组合条件下，9.7%-27.0%原本正确的行为在语义保持变换后变得不正确。例如标识符重命名下DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite正确率从53.9%提升到63.7%，但19.5%原本正确的行为失败。人工审查30个正确到错误的转换样本，识别出路径谓词丢失、分支极性错误、布尔结构损坏和输出契约违规四类典型失败模式。

Conclusion: 点准确率不足以刻画LLM在断言生成中的可靠性，需要引入鲁棒性感知的评估方法来衡量AI辅助硬件验证工具的稳定性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for automating SystemVerilog Assertion (SVA) generation, yet most evaluations report correctness on a single syntactic representation of an input. Such point accuracy does not reveal whether a model's correct output is stable when the same RTL behavior is written differently. This paper presents a controlled metamorphic evaluation of LLM-based SVA generation under semantics-preserving RTL transformations. Starting from the VERT dataset, we construct a quality-filtered conditional-control pool and a stratified 40-program evaluation set containing 295 assignment behaviors. We evaluate two open code models, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite, with an identical evaluation prompt and greedy decoding. Three transformations are studied: operand reordering, deterministic identifier renaming, and redundant parenthesization. Beyond baseline and transformed accuracy, we measure conditional robustness, invariance failure, and any-flip rate, with 10,000-sample clustered bootstrap intervals at the RTL-program level. Across all six model-transformation conditions, 9.7%-27.0% of behaviors that were correct on the original RTL become incorrect after a semantics-preserving transformation. Aggregate accuracy can therefore hide substantial instability: under identifier renaming, DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite improves from 53.9% to 63.7% accuracy while 19.5% of its originally correct behaviors fail. Manual review of 30 sampled correct-to-wrong transitions identifies dropped path predicates, branch-polarity errors, Boolean-structure corruption, and output-contract violations. The results show that point accuracy alone is insufficient for characterizing LLM reliability in assertion generation and motivate robustness-aware evaluation for AI-assisted hardware verification.

</details>


### [520] [PAC-Private Autoregressive Generation: Calibrating Noise to Ensemble Disagreement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05676)
*Mina Mirzadehsarcheshmeh,Amir Keyvan Khandani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次将PAC隐私从分类任务扩展到自回归生成任务。通过构造128个重叠世界（每个记录出现在一半世界中），训练多个adapter，利用世界间的投票分歧决定PAC噪声大小。在WikiText-103和GPT-2-small上，以单token预算2^-32保留74%微调增益，10^6 token后成员推理成功率限制在51.08%，远超PMixED方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型在私有文本上微调后通过API服务，隐私泄漏发生在生成输出而非权重暴露。现有的PMixED等方法每次发布都产生隐私成本，且长期依赖公有模型。PAC隐私根据预测在不同可能秘密间的输出变异性来校准噪声，在预测稳定时只需更少噪声，但此前未从分类扩展到自回归生成。

Method: 构造m=128个重叠世界（worlds），每个记录恰好出现在m/2个世界中，在冻结的公有模型上为每个世界训练一个adapter。真实世界即为秘密。在每个token处，公有模型定义候选集，各世界进行投票，其后验加权分歧决定PAC噪声大小；一致同意时无需校准噪声。证明了I(S;Y_{1:T}) ≤ I(S;H_T) ≤ bT的信息论隐私界。扩展包括：将PAC隐私应用于自回归生成、处理自适应自生成上下文、引入耦合解码（coupled decoding），在保持隐私核算的同时避免贪心解码退化。

Result: 在WikiText-103 + GPT-2-small上，以每token 2^-32预算保留74%微调增益；10^6 token后成员推理成功率限制在51.08%；后验熵泄漏估计约为收费预算的17%。推理隐私并非内容保护：即使备忘录canary的成员优势与零不可区分，canary仍以相同速率被生成。与PMixED在相同数据宇宙和测试集下匹配成员推理界进行对比，从10^2到10^6 token保留98%非私有headroom（PMixED最多56%），且无交叉。

Conclusion: PAC隐私成功扩展到自回归生成领域，耦合解码在保证隐私核算的同时避免了贪心退化。该方法在隐私-效用权衡上显著优于PMixED，长期运行下保留更多非私有性能。同时揭示了"推理隐私≠内容保护"的重要性质——隐私预算防止成员推断，但不阻止已记忆内容的生成。

Abstract: Language models adapted on private text are often served through APIs, so privacy leakage occurs through generated outputs rather than exposed weights. Private prediction protects these releases. Methods such as PMixED incur privacy cost at each release and increasingly rely on the public model over long horizons. PAC privacy instead calibrates noise to output variability across possible secrets, adding less noise when predictions are stable. To our knowledge, PAC-private prediction has not previously been extended from classification to autoregressive generation.
  We construct $m=128$ overlapping worlds from the private corpus, with each record appearing in exactly $m/2$ worlds, and train one adapter per world over a frozen public model. The realized world is the secret. At each token, the public model defines a candidate set, the worlds vote, and their posterior-weighted disagreement determines the PAC noise; unanimity requires no calibration noise. We prove $I(S;Y_{1:T}) \leq I(S;H_T) \leq bT$. Our contributions are extending PAC privacy to autoregressive generation, handling adaptive self-generated contexts, and introducing coupled decoding that preserves privacy accounting while avoiding greedy degeneration.
  On WikiText-103 with GPT-2-small, we retain 74% of the fine-tuning gain at a per-token budget of $2^{-32}$, while membership-inference success is bounded by 51.08% after $10^6$ tokens; posterior-entropy estimates of leakage are roughly 17% of the charged budget. Inference privacy is not content protection: even when membership advantage on a memorized canary is indistinguishable from zero, the canary is emitted at the same rate. Against PMixED under matched membership-inference bounds on the same data universe and test set, we retain 98% of non-private headroom from $10^2$ to $10^6$ tokens, versus at most 56%, with no crossover.

</details>


### [521] [Connecting Score Matching, Maximum Likelihood, and Expectation-Maximization in Mixed Linear Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05688)
*Zhankun Luo,Abolfazl Hashemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了混合线性回归(MLR)中响应变量的方差保持扩散，分析了在未知混合权重下，去噪分数匹配目标与统计保证之间的关系，建立了估计量的收敛性和渐近正态性，并推导了与EM算子相关的梯度展开。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合线性回归中，分数匹配（diffusion-based）方法虽然被广泛使用，但其统计保证与优化几何之间的理论联系尚不清晰。作者试图阐明在未知混合权重下，扩散去噪分数匹配目标如何与似然函数相关联，并揭示其与经典EM算法的内在联系，从而为基于扩散的估计方法提供严格的统计理论基础。

Method: 利用KL散度将沿扩散路径积分的去噪分数匹配目标与似然函数及终端差异联系起来；在固定扩散噪声尺度下推导分数匹配损失与交叉熵及EM算子之间的分解关系，得到EM相关的低噪声梯度展开；在高噪声极限下分析各向同性协方差假设下的梯度下降行为，并沿固定高信噪比射线检验梯度项的收敛性。

Result: 在温和正则条件和终端调度下，估计量收敛到MLR的真实参数，其缩放误差收敛到极大似然估计量的高斯极限分布。在固定噪声尺度下，分数匹配损失可分解为交叉熵与EM相关的梯度展开，其中包含潜在方差的修正项。在高噪声极限和固定高信噪比射线条件下，分数匹配不平衡梯度与潜在方差项逐点趋于零。数值实验验证了理论发现。

Conclusion: 论文为扩散分数匹配方法在混合线性回归中的应用提供了严格的统计保证，建立了与似然和EM算子之间的理论桥梁，表明估计量渐近等效于最大似然估计，并揭示了噪声尺度对优化信号的影响机制。

Abstract: We study variance-preserving diffusion of the response in mixed linear regression (MLR) with unknown mixing weights. Our analysis separates the statistical guarantees of score matching from the loss geometry and optimization signal at a fixed diffusion noise level. The KL divergence links the denoising score matching objective integrated over the diffusion path with the likelihood and a terminal discrepancy. Under mild regularity conditions and terminal schedule, the resulting estimator converges up to the ground truth parameters of MLR, and its scaled error converges to the Gaussian limit of the maximum-likelihood estimator. At a fixed scale of the diffusion noise level, we derive a decomposition linking the score matching loss to cross-entropy and Expectation-Maximization (EM) operators. This decomposition yields an EM-related low-noise gradient expansion with additional correction terms of latent variance. In the high-noise limit, we further characterize gradient descent on this limiting loss under isotropic covariance. Along fixed high signal-to-noise ratio rays, the score matching imbalance gradient and the latent-variance term tend to zero pointwise. Numerical experiments illustrate our theoretical findings and statistical guarantees.

</details>


### [522] [GraphNOSE: A Graph Transformer in Olfaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05694)
*Mrityunjay Sharma,Sarabeshwar Balaji,Valentina Parma,Ritesh Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GraphNOSE是一个开源的图Transformer框架，用于从SMILES字符串预测单分子和二元混合物的多标签气味描述符。它通过集成位置和结构编码，以比标准GNN少6倍的参数实现SOTA性能，在OOD化合物上AUROC达84%，超过现有最优方法Open-POM（81%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性模型虽然可以将分子特征与气味描述符关联，但在外推到新的化学骨架、极端分子量或复杂气味混合物时常常失败。现有方法在气味预测的外推和泛化能力上存在明显不足。

Method: GraphNOSE采用基于Transformer的图架构，将位置编码和结构编码集成在图中。输入为SMILES字符串，支持单分子和二元混合物的多标签气味描述符预测。同时应用XAI方法识别驱动气味预测的子结构和分子特征。

Result: GraphNOSE在OOD化合物上AUROC达84%，超过Open-POM（81%，p<0.001）；以少6倍的参数在平均AUROC上超过线性模型、分子语言模型嵌入、分子指纹和基线GNN达4.52%（p<0.01）。XAI结果与化学直觉一致。

Conclusion: GraphNOSE是一种可扩展且可解释的气味预测架构，能够泛化到当前感知数据库中代表性不足的结构独特化合物，为嗅觉预测提供了优于现有方法的新选择。

Abstract: Predicting olfactory qualities from molecular structure is an open problem in chemoinformatics. Although linear models can link molecular features to odor descriptors, they often fail when extrapolating to novel chemical scaffolds, extreme molecular weights, or complex odor mixtures. To address this, we introduce GraphNOSE, an open-source graph transformer framework that predicts multi-label odor descriptors from simplified molecular-input line-entry system (SMILES) strings for single molecules and binary mixtures. By integrating positional and structural encodings within a transformer-based graph architecture, GraphNOSE achieves strong performance with six times fewer parameters than standard graph neural network (GNN) baseline while consistently outperforming linear models, molecular language model embeddings, molecular fingerprints, and baseline GNNs by an average area under the ROC curve (AUROC) margin of 4.52% (p < 0.01). GraphNOSE achieves an AUROC of 84% on out-of-distribution compounds (OODs). This exceeds the current state-of-the-art GNN for OOD in olfaction (Open-POM: 81%, p < 0.001), and identifies conditions under which linear models empirically fail. Finally, we apply XAI (explainable AI) methods to identify which substructures and molecular features drive odor predictions, yielding insights consistent with chemical intuition and grounded in the model's learned representations. Together, these results establish GraphNOSE as a scalable and interpretable architecture for olfactory prediction that generalizes to structurally distinct compounds underrepresented in current perceptual databases.

</details>


### [523] [Analysis of Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia with Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05698)
*Julian Szymanski,Patryk Orkisz,Higinio Mora*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于神经网络的ECG信号分析方法，通过利用呼吸性窦性心律不齐（RSA）现象来估计呼吸频率。方法采用深度学习模型直接从ECG输入数据预测呼吸波形，开发并评估了三种不同的神经网络架构，能够自动提取ECG相关特征而无需手动预处理，为非侵入式呼吸监测提供了稳健且可扩展的解决方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的呼吸频率估计方法通常需要额外的传感器设备或复杂的手动预处理步骤，不够便捷和高效。利用ECG信号中蕴含的RSA现象来实现非侵入式呼吸监测，可以使呼吸监测更加简便、可穿戴化，适用于医疗保健和可穿戴技术等场景。

Method: 采用深度学习模型直接从ECG输入数据预测呼吸波形。具体开发并评估了三种不同的神经网络架构，这些架构能够自动从ECG信号中提取相关特征，无需手动预处理步骤。

Result: 研究评估了三种神经网络架构在从ECG预测呼吸波形方面的性能，验证了该方法的可行性，表明深度学习方法能够有效提取ECG中的RSA特征用于呼吸频率估计。

Conclusion: 提出的方法为非侵入式呼吸监测提供了一种稳健且可扩展的解决方案，基于RSA现象和深度学习技术，无需手动预处理，在医疗保健和可穿戴技术领域具有潜在的应用价值。

Abstract: The paper introduces a neural network-based approach for analyzing ECG signals to estimate respiratory rate by leveraging the phe- nomenon of Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia (RSA). Our method employs a deep learning model trained to predict respiratory waveforms directly from ECG input data. To achieve this, we developed and evaluated three different neural network architectures capable of automatically extract- ing relevant features from ECG signals without the need for manual preprocessing. The proposed approach offers a robust and scalable solu- tion for non-invasive respiratory monitoring, with potential applications in healthcare and wearable technology

</details>


### [524] [Newton Matching for Generative Modeling: A Unified Framework for Fine-Tuning and Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05727)
*Zeyang Li,Yunan Wang,Paolo Giaretta,Navid Azizan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Newton Matching框架,统一了生成建模中的微调与采样问题。通过将Fisher-Rao度量与mixture connection传输到由条件匹配速度构成的流形上,证明反向KL的Hessian等于该度量,从而Newton方向等同于负Fisher-Rao梯度。该框架在理想迭代下具有严格的反向KL下降性、全局收敛性与局部二次收敛性,可恢复多种代表性方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成建模的微调与采样方法往往使用相互孤立的损失函数,缺乏统一的优化视角。作者希望将问题从独立损失转移为在规范模型上的迭代优化,从而建立统一的、可模块化的算法设计框架,并促进强化学习用于生成模型的理论与算法发展。

Method: 核心方法是Newton Matching:(1)定义目标分布π∝μe^{τr},在满足平滑可实现假设下,规范速度构成与密度流形微分同胚的流形;(2)将Fisher-Rao度量与mixture connection传输到该流形,证明反向KL的Hessian等于度量,Newton方向即负Fisher-Rao梯度;(3)每阶段在终端密度ρ处沿正则化奖励r-(1/τ)log(ρ/μ)产生的切向步前进,再执行保持终端密度的规范化(canonicalization);(4)提出协方差与梯度两种形式,分别支持前向或反向回归对构造,得到无重要性采样、无完整轨迹反向传播的样本级切向更新损失。

Result: 论文证明:在0<η≤τ范围内,理想迭代严格降低反向KL(远离目标时);在温和条件下全局收敛;全步长(η=τ)时具有局部二次收敛性。定义了临界点一致性(切向位移为零当且仅当ρ=π)。方法可恢复多种代表性方法作为精确实现、临界点一致近似或目标改变变体。

Conclusion: Newton Matching为推动基于强化学习的生成模型微调与采样提供了统一的数学框架与理论基础,实现了模块化算法设计,并涵盖了多种既有方法,丰富了该领域的理论与实践工具。

Abstract: We develop Newton Matching, a unified framework for fine-tuning and sampling in generative modeling. The target is $π\proptoμe^{τr}$, where $r$ is the reward, $τ>0$ the inverse temperature, and $μ$ denotes the pretrained model's terminal density for fine-tuning or the constant $1$ for sampling. We shift the paradigm from isolated losses to iterative optimization over canonical models: population minimizers of standard conditional matching for terminal densities. Under compatible smooth-realization assumptions, canonical velocities form a manifold diffeomorphic to the density manifold. Transporting the Fisher-Rao metric and mixture connection to this manifold, we show that the reverse-KL Hessian equals the metric, so the Newton direction coincides with the negative Fisher-Rao gradient. At terminal density $ρ$, each stage takes a tangential step generated by the regularized reward $r-\frac1τ\log(ρ/μ)$, followed by terminal-density-preserving canonicalization. This canonical retraction yields an exact finite-stepsize density characterization. For the ideal iteration, we prove strict reverse-KL descent away from the target for $0 < η\le τ$, global convergence under mild conditions, and local quadratic convergence for full steps ($η=τ$). Covariance and gradient forms, each with forward or reverse regression-pair constructions, yield sample-wise tangential-update losses with the same population minimizer, without importance sampling or full-trajectory backpropagation. We develop approximate updates and define critical-point consistency as vanishing tangential displacement if and only if $ρ=π$. We recover representative methods as exact realizations, critical-point-consistent approximations, or objective-altering variants, enabling modular algorithm design. Our work advances the theory and algorithms of reinforcement learning for generative models.

</details>


### [525] [A Multi-Source Ensemble Approach to Candidate Generation for Alternative Vacation Rental Property Recommendations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05748)
*Syed Mohammed Arshad Zaidi,Eric Rincon,Shayan Hassantabar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对度假租赁平台（超过200万活跃房源）的备选房源候选生成方法进行了全面研究，对比了协同过滤、浅层嵌入和图神经网络方法。混合架构结合基于物品的协同过滤与GNN检索，在Recall@300上比最强基线提升14.8%，同时验证了GNN嵌入显著优于浅层Hotel2Vec嵌入，并探讨了候选生成阶段的增益如何传导至下游排序阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 度假租赁市场中的替代房源推荐对用户发现相关选项至关重要，但面临异构库存、地理约束、可用性快速变化和长尾房源分布等独特挑战，缺乏对这些场景下候选生成方法的系统性研究。

Method: 在度假租赁平台上对比三类候选生成方法：协同过滤、浅层嵌入（Hotel2Vec）和图神经网络方法。提出混合架构，将基于物品的协同过滤（擅长早期召回丰富交互历史的房源）与GNN检索（擅长发现非显而易见的多样化备选方案并有效处理冷启动）相结合。

Result: 混合架构在Recall@300上比最强基线提升14.8%；GNN嵌入单独比Hotel2Vec在K个取值上实现48-68%的相对召回提升；候选池质量越高可带来更高的下游排序质量，但存在召回-转化差距。

Conclusion: 候选生成与排序器训练之间存在耦合，使CG阶段增益的归因复杂化，这种召回-转化差距是实践者在两阶段推荐系统中部署新检索方法时需重点考虑的因素。

Abstract: Alternative property recommendations play a critical role in vacation rental marketplaces, helping users discover relevant options when viewing a specific listing. However, generating high-quality candidate alternatives presents unique challenges: heterogeneous inventory, geographic constraints, rapid availability changes, and long-tail property distributions. We present a comprehensive study of candidate generation (CG) approaches for vacation rental alternatives, comparing collaborative filtering, shallow embeddings, and graph neural network (GNN) methods.
  Our experiments on a large-scale vacation rental platform (over 2M active properties) show that a hybrid architecture combining item-based collaborative filtering with GNN-based retrieval improves Recall@300 by 14.8% over the strongest baseline, by leveraging the complementary strengths of the two sources: collaborative filtering excels at early recall for properties with rich interaction history, while GNNs discover diverse, non-obvious alternatives and handle cold-start scenarios more effectively. As a component result, GNN-based embeddings alone substantially outperform shallow Hotel2Vec embeddings (48-68% relative recall improvement across K), motivating their inclusion in the ensemble.
  Crucially, we examine how CG-stage gains carry through to the downstream ranking stage, and find that a stronger candidate pool yields higher downstream ranking quality, though attributing this effect cleanly is complicated by the coupling between candidate generation and ranker training. This recall-conversion gap is an important consideration for practitioners deploying new retrieval methods in two-stage recommendation systems.

</details>


### [526] [Data Scout: Targeted Web Crawling for Domain-Specific Pretraining Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05766)
*Chirag Garg,Eelaaf Zahid,Farhan Ahmed,Jay Pankaj Gala,Eric Butler,Heiko Ludwig*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Data Scout是一种反向构建领域预训练语料库的方法：不再过滤大型网页存档，而是利用LLM将根主题扩展为分类体系和搜索查询，并通过子域级分类器筛选目标爬虫抓取的网页。在数学领域，该方法相比过滤CommonCrawl获得70倍的高质量内容命中率，且63.2%的页面不在CommonCrawl中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统构建领域预训练语料库的主流方法是过滤大型网络存档（如CommonCrawl）。这对热门领域有效，但对专门领域失效——相关内容稀疏且超出热度驱动爬虫的覆盖范围。作者提出反向思路：不过滤存档，而是主动引导定向爬取。

Method: Data Scout流程：（1）LLM将根主题扩展为分类体系和数千条搜索查询；（2）返回的URL（种子）按子域分组；（3）用用户提供的分类器（probe）对每个子域的小样本进行筛查，据此接纳或拒绝整个子域。该方法的关键洞察是相关性在子域层面有清晰边界——数学领域同一子域页面比兄弟子域页面相关概率高21倍。

Result: 以FineMath分类器作为probe时，21.9%的爬取页面为高质量数学内容，是过滤可比网络样本0.31%命中率的70倍。63.2%的这些页面完全不在CommonCrawl中但同样有用。在1.9B Data Scout tokens上继续预训练Llama-3.2-3B，在GSM8k上达到与FineMath语料库相当的表现。

Conclusion: Data Scout不仅提升了爬取效率（减少浪费），还通过挖掘CommonCrawl缺失的内容提供了额外的训练价值。由于probe是唯一的领域特定组件，该方法原则上可适用于任何拥有此类分类器的领域。

Abstract: The dominant approach to building domain-specific pretraining corpora is to filter large web archives such as CommonCrawl. This works well for popular domains but breaks down for specialized ones, where relevant content is sparse and often beyond the reach of popularity-driven crawlers. We present Data Scout, which inverts this: instead of filtering an archive, it directs a targeted crawl. An LLM expands a root topic into a taxonomy and thousands of search queries; the returned URLs (seeds) are grouped by subdomain and screened with a user-supplied classifier (the probe), admitting each subdomain on the basis of a small sample. This works because relevance has a sharp boundary at the subdomain level: in mathematics, a page is 21x more likely to be relevant than one on a sibling subdomain. With the FineMath classifier as the probe, 21.9% of crawled pages are high-quality math content, 70x the 0.31% rate from filtering a comparable web sample, so the crawl wastes far less effort. But the payoff is not just efficiency: 63.2% of these pages are missing from CommonCrawl altogether, yet just as useful for training. Continued pretraining of Llama-3.2-3B on 1.9B Data Scout tokens matches FineMath corpus on GSM8k. Because the probe is the only domain-specific component, Data Scout can in principle apply to any domain with such a classifier.

</details>


### [527] [RAPTOR: Role-Aware Private Training for Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05770)
*Duc Dm,Khai Le-Duc,Nguyen Do,Minh Son Hoang,Florent Draye,Thai Hoang,Hoang Phuong Dam,Jiarui Liu,Chris Ngo,Terry Jingchen Zhang,Anh Le Duc Tran,Nhat Do Minh,Minh Ngoc Le,My T. Thai,Ran Xu,Silvio Savarese,Mona Diab,Bernhard Schölkopf,Zhijing Jin,Huy L. Nguyen,Daeyoung Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RAPTOR是一个针对稀疏MoE模型差分隐私微调的"角色感知"训练框架。它识别出将稀疏MoE当作单一稠密块处理所导致的三个失败模式（全局裁剪抑制专家梯度、批级归一化稀释稀疏专家更新、固定隐私噪声降低低负载专家的信噪比），并通过交替共享/专家优化、专家专属裁剪与噪声、公开期望归属分母及计数无关的更新调度来逐一应对，实现了并行组合的隐私保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的DP微调方法将稀疏MoE模型视为单一稠密块，忽略了共享层与专家层在数据可见性上的本质差异（共享层看所有数据，专家只看到被路由的记录），从而产生了三个未被形式化描述的失败模式，损害了DP微调中MoE模型的性能。

Method: 交替优化共享与专家参数流；使用专家专属裁剪(clipping)与噪声以匹配各自梯度尺度；采用公开"期望归属"(expected-owner)分母估计器避免依赖隐私的真实专家计数；推导出随路由不平衡度可预测增长的偏差-方差分解，据此用公开语料的路由熵确定需要保护的层；证明每层各专家机制并行组合、共享与专家流顺序组合满足(e,δ)-DP。

Result: 在Switch Transformer和OLMoE的GLUE任务微调以及DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny上，相比标准DP基线在各隐私预算(e)下均取得一致提升，且在最紧预算下边际增益最大。

Conclusion: RAPTOR证明了通过识别并利用MoE角色差异、采用并行组合的专家级隐私机制，可以在不增加隐私代价的前提下显著改善DP微调中MoE模型的性能，为大规模稀疏模型的高效隐私训练提供了新范式。

Abstract: Differentially private (DP) fine-tuning methods treat sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models as a single dense block, ignoring that shared layers see all data while experts only see routed records. We identify and formally characterize three resulting failure modes: global clipping suppresses expert gradients, batch-level normalization dilutes sparse expert updates, and fixed privacy noise degrades signal-to-noise ratio on low-load experts. We introduce RAPTOR - a Role-Aware Private Training framework, which alternates shared and expert optimization and targets each failure directly, using expert-specific clipping and noise together with a public expected-owner denominator and a count-independent update schedule that avoids conditioning on private, realized expert counts. We prove the resulting mechanism satisfies $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP: because each record is assigned to exactly one owner expert, per-expert mechanisms within a layer compose in parallel, so updating all $E$ experts costs no more, in privacy terms, than updating one, with shared and expert streams composing sequentially across training. We further derive a bias-variance decomposition of the public-denominator estimator showing its bias grows predictably with routing imbalance, yielding a privacy-free rule for selecting which layer to protect from routing entropy measured on a small public corpus. Experiments on Switch Transformer and OLMoE fine-tuning across GLUE tasks, and on DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny, show consistent gains over standard DP baselines across several privacy levels ($\varepsilon$), with the largest margins typically at the tightest budgets. Code and models are publicly available: https://github.com/leduckhai/RAPTOR

</details>


### [528] [Nonlinear elliptic homogenization with the parametric Deep Ritz method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05778)
*Conor Rowan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出使用参数化Deep Ritz方法求解非线性均匀化中出现的参数化胞元问题。通过神经网络同时离散空间和宏观状态，强加边界条件，可获得连续的、可微的胞元响应表示，相比传统FE²方法显著加速宏观尺度求解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非线性均匀化问题需要求解参数化胞元问题，其响应依赖于宏观状态及其梯度。在牛顿迭代求解宏观状态场时，需要胞元问题解的可微表示，传统方法在这方面存在不足。

Method: 首先利用胞元问题的变分结构，用神经网络同时离散胞元响应对空间和宏观状态的依赖；强加边界条件；采用参数化Deep Ritz方法在宏观状态范围内同时求解胞元问题。

Result: 该方法准确、高效，能提供胞元响应在宏观状态和梯度上的连续可微表示；与传统的FE²方案相比，参数化表示显著加速了宏观尺度求解。

Conclusion: 参数化Deep Ritz方法为非线性均匀化中的胞元问题提供了一种有效且有竞争力的求解途径，兼具精度和计算效率优势。

Abstract: Elliptic homogenization is used to determine coarse-grained properties of materials with features on small scales. When these small scale features have rapid, periodic fluctuations, the solution field corresponding to a homogenized constitutive relation closely resembles the true solution based on the heterogeneous material. This homogenized behavior of the material is computed from a cell problem, where a cell is defined to be one period of the fluctuating material. In the context of linear elliptic partial differential equations, the homogenized constitutive relation is defined simply by a constant coefficient tensor, but for nonlinear problems, the homogenized response depends on the macroscopic state and/or its gradient, thus requiring solutions to parametric cell problems. When computing a numerical solution with the homogenized constitutive relation, it is useful to have a differentiable representation of the solution to the cell problem, as derivatives of the homogenized constitutive relation are required in Newton iterations for the macroscopic state field. In this work, we use the Deep Ritz method to solve the parametric cell problems that arise from nonlinear homogenization. First, we exploit the variational structure of the cell problem, then we discretize the dependence of the cell response on both space and the macroscopic state with a neural network. Enforcing boundary conditions on the cell response strongly, we next use the parametric Deep Ritz method to simultaneously solve the cell problem over a range of macroscopic states. We show that this method is accurate, efficient, and offers a continuous and differentiable representation of the cell response over the macroscopic state and gradient. We then show that our parametric representation of the cell response significantly expedites macroscale solutions when compared to a traditional $\text{FE}^2$ scheme.

</details>


### [529] [Online Learning with LLM Experts from Limited Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05820)
*Wang Wei,Soumyabrata Pal,Koyel Mukherjee,Franck Dernoncourt,Ryan A. Rossi,Branislav Kveton,Hoda Eldardiry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究在有限反馈的在线环境下，如何将提示（prompt）自适应路由到不同的大语言模型（LLM）专家，以最大化响应质量。作者将其建模为带K个动作和d个特征的多臂老虎机问题，提出了在完备信息与bandit设定下分别实现Õ(dT/√m)和Õ(dT√(K/m))遗憾界的算法，实验表明该方法能从有限反馈中高效学习高质量的路由策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在实际应用中，不同的大语言模型对不同类型提示的响应质量各有优劣，因此需要智能地将提示路由到最合适的LLM专家。然而真实反馈（如用户评分）通常有限且昂贵，现有方法缺乏在有限反馈下进行自适应路由的理论保障，因此需要研究在线学习的路由策略。

Method: 将提示到LLM专家的自适应路由问题形式化为一个带上下文特征的多臂老虎机问题（K个专家臂、d维提示特征、T轮时间跨度）。作者分别在两类设定下提出算法：（1）全信息设定（full-information setting），利用所有专家的反馈；（2）bandit设定（bandit setting），仅能观测所选专家的反馈。两种算法都考虑了一个反馈预算m（m≪T），通过策略性地选择和观察奖励来最小化遗憾。

Result: 在全信息设定下达到Õ(dT/√m)的遗憾界；在bandit设定下达到Õ(dT√(K/m))的遗憾界。实验表明算法能在有限反馈预算下高效学习跨多种LLM的高质量路由策略。

Conclusion: 研究验证了在有限反馈条件下，通过精心设计的在线学习算法可以有效学习LLM专家路由策略，为大规模多LLM路由系统中的反馈效率问题提供了理论保障和实用算法。

Abstract: We study adaptive routing of prompts to large language model (LLM) experts to maximize response quality in an online setting with limited feedback. We formulate it as a bandit problem with $K$ actions that represent experts and $d$ features that encode prompts, over a horizon of $T$ rounds. We propose algorithms that strategically select and observe rewards to minimize regret. In the full-information setting, we achieve a regret of $\tilde{O}(d T / \sqrt{m})$, while in the bandit setting we achieve $\tilde{O}(d T \sqrt{K / m})$, where $m \ll T$ is a budget on feedback. Our experiments show that we efficiently learn high-quality routing strategies across diverse LLMs from limited feedback.

</details>


### [530] [Generalizing HVAC Control With Domain Randomized Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05822)
*Pablo Boitel,Kun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NOMAD-RL，一种基于在线元适应的强化学习暖通空调控制器，通过物理信息归一化流的自适应域随机化方案，实现跨异构热区的通用迁移控制，性能优于PID和非随机化RL基线，接近调优良好的MPC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统HVAC控制器在大规模部署时面临挑战：性能往往依赖精确的建筑模型或需要逐站点调参，导致可扩展性差。作者希望设计一种无需逐站点重新调优、能跨异构热区迁移的通用RL控制器。

Method: 1) 提出通用非侵入式恒温器接口，控制器仅基于温度设定点、区域测量和预测信息行动；2) 采用循环策略（recurrent policy）支持部分可观测下的在线适应；3) 核心贡献是基于物理信息归一化流（physics-informed normalizing flows）的自适应域随机化方案，建模热区参数的关联多模态分布，同时保持物理合理性和可控性，生成渐进式自适应训练课程以提升跨建筑迁移能力。

Result: 在单区域和多区域场景中，NOMAD-RL一致优于PID控制器和无域随机化的RL基线，尤其在更具挑战性的多区域场景中接近调优良好的MPC性能。

Conclusion: 自适应、物理信息的域随机化方法在实现稳健且可迁移的HVAC控制方面具有巨大潜力，为大规模部署通用RL控制器提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Deploying advanced HVAC (Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning) controllers at scale remains difficult because performance often depends on accurate building models or per-site retuning. We propose NOMAD-RL (Neural Online Meta-Adaptation for Dynamics), a general-purpose Reinforcement Learning (RL) controller designed to transfer across heterogeneous thermal zones through a universal, non-invasive thermostat interface.
