The controller acts on temperature setpoints from zone measurements and forecasts, while a recurrent policy supports online adaptation under partial observability.
  Our main contribution is an adaptive domain randomization scheme based on physics-informed normalizing flows, which models correlated and multimodal distributions of thermal-zone parameters while maintaining physical plausibility and controllability. This produces a realistic and progressively adaptive training curriculum that improves transfer across buildings. We evaluate NOMAD-RL against a constant-setpoint PID controller, RL without domain randomization, and MPC in single- and multi-zone settings. NOMAD-RL consistently outperforms the PID and non-randomized RL baselines, and approaches the performance of a well-tuned MPC, especially in the more challenging multi-zone case. These results highlight the potential of adaptive, physics-informed domain randomization for robust and transferable HVAC control.

</details>


### [531] [Scaling Optimal Classification Trees via Adaptive Feature and Sample Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05826)
*Jiancheng Tu,Wenqi Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于STreeD的特征与样本空间联合缩减框架，包括Weighted STreeD（投影后合并重复记录为加权代表，加速样本相关计算）和Adaptive STreeD（迭代精炼候选特征集并重建加权表示），在五个数据集上实现最高121.41倍加速，且在相同计算预算下预测性能与最优分类树基线相当或更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态规划求解最优分类树会随着特征数量和训练样本数量的增加而变得计算开销巨大，亟需有效的缩减策略以扩展其可处理的问题规模。

Method: 1) Weighted STreeD：将投影到固定候选特征集后的重复记录合并为加权代表，在不改变固定候选集优化问题的前提下减少样本相关计算；2) Adaptive STreeD：迭代精炼有界候选特征集，保留当前最优树所使用的特征，重建加权表示并求解缩减后的问题。Weighted STreeD的解对当前候选集保证最优性，外层特征搜索在整个特征空间上仍为启发式。

Result: 在五个数据集上，Weighted STreeD相比标准STreeD最高获得121.41倍加速；Adaptive STreeD在深度2至4的匹配比较中降低运行时间，在更深度处仍返回可行树（而全特征方法受时间或内存限制）；在相同计算预算下预测性能与最优分类树基线相当，部分比较中更高。

Conclusion: 特征与样本空间的联合缩减能够有效扩展基于动态规划的最优树学习方法，使其适用于更具挑战性的实例。

Abstract: Dynamic programming for optimal classification trees becomes computationally expensive as the numbers of features and training samples increase. We develop a joint feature- and sample-space reduction framework based on STreeD. Weighted STreeD merges duplicate records created after projection onto a fixed candidate set into weighted representatives. This reduces sample-dependent computation without changing the fixed-candidate optimization problem. Adaptive STreeD repeatedly refines a bounded candidate set, retains features used by the incumbent tree, rebuilds the weighted representation, and solves the resulting reduced problems. Each certified Weighted STreeD solution is optimal for its current candidate set, while the outer feature search remains heuristic over the full feature space. Experiments on five data sets show that Weighted STreeD achieves speedups of up to 121.41 times over standard STreeD. Adaptive STreeD reduces runtime in matched comparisons at depths 2 to 4 and continues to return feasible trees at greater depths where full-feature methods are limited by time or memory. Under the same computational budget, its predictive performance remains comparable to the evaluated optimal classification tree baselines and is higher in some comparisons. These results show how joint feature- and sample-space reduction can scale dynamic-programming-based optimal-tree learning to more demanding instances.

</details>


### [532] [Selective Posterior Margin Regularization for Forward-Corrected Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05859)
*Zexing Zhang,Jichao Li,Tianyang Lei,XiongYi Lu,Yang Kewei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出选择性后验边际正则化（SPMR），在保留前向校正目标的同时，利用反向后验中领先类别与注释不一致的信号，将这种不一致转化为对干净分类器的分级更新，避免误导标签的记忆化，显著提升标签噪声下的分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前向校正方法在有限样本下网络仍可能记忆损坏标签。校正后的似然会诱导一个反向后验，当其中领先类别与注释不一致时，说明模型和转移矩阵对该注释存疑，但领先的替代类别可能几乎不相上下，需要一个分级而非二元的方式来利用此信号。

Method: SPMR选择反向后验中领先的类别，用领先两类的分离程度对解耦的成对边际进行缩放，对分散的冲突赋予较小影响。其差距因子分解为转移调整的成对分离与领先对携带的后验质量；活跃边际遵循局部最小范数logit方向以扩大选定成对边际。

Result: 在五个已知转移基准上，SPMR比完整长度前向校正提高2.5-7.0个百分点，比采用Mixup和早停的前向校正仍高0.7-2.5个百分点。匹配的消融实验证明后验空间系数、转移调整目标和成对动作各自带来不同增益，且设计可迁移到估计转移、人工标注、架构变更及更强的前向矫正方案。

Conclusion: 该方法仅利用前向校正内部已有的隐类别证据，无需将每个后验冲突都提升为修正标签，即能在不破坏前向目标的基础上有效缓解标签噪声记忆化问题，具备良好的通用性与可迁移性。

Abstract: Learning with class-conditional label noise often relies on a transition model from latent clean classes to observed annotations. Forward correction embeds this transition in the likelihood, yet finite-sample networks may still memorize corrupted labels. The corrected likelihood also induces a reverse posterior over the clean classes that could explain each annotation. When its leading class differs from the annotation, the model and transition matrix provide evidence against that annotation, but the leading alternatives can remain nearly tied. We introduce Selective Posterior Margin Regularization (SPMR), which preserves the Forward objective and converts this disagreement into a graded update on the clean classifier. SPMR selects the leading reverse-posterior class, scales a detached pairwise margin by the separation between the two leading posterior classes, and assigns correspondingly little influence to diffuse conflicts. The gap factorizes into transition- adjusted pairwise separation and the posterior mass carried by the leading pair. The active margin follows the locally minimum-norm logit direction that enlarges the selected pairwise margin. Across five known-transition benchmarks, SPMR improves full-length Forward by 2.5-7.0 percentage points and remains 0.7-2.5 percentage points above Forward with Mixup and early stopping. Matched interventions support distinct gains from the posterior-space coefficient, transition-adjusted target, and pairwise action. The same design transfers to estimated transitions, human annotations, architectural changes, and stronger Forward recipes. The formulation uses latent-class evidence already available inside Forward correction without promoting every posterior conflict to a corrected label.

</details>


### [533] [SAFEGuard: Detect Optimization-Based Jailbreak Attacks Through Harmful Semantic Analysis and Fluency Measurement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05850)
*Quoc Viet Vo,Trung Le,Damith C. Ranasinghe,Ehsan Abbasnejad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SAFEGuard，一个统一的对抗性越狱攻击检测框架，结合基于跨层分布距离和困惑度的混合流畅度测量，以及基于梯度匹配的有害语义分析，用于检测优化型越狱攻击。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型即使经过安全对齐，仍然容易受到对抗性越狱攻击。已有的防御方法在检测广泛范围的基于优化的越狱机制时效果有限，因为这些机制可以产生高度流畅优化的提示或有害语义混淆的提示。

Method: SAFEGuard框架结合了两个关键组件：(1) 混合流畅度测量，基于跨层分布距离和困惑度来评估提示的流畅性；(2) 通过梯度匹配分析有害语义。该方法基于一个重要观察：高流畅度提示的恶意意图接近有害提示，而有害语义混淆提示往往注入乱码标记序列。

Result: 评估表明SAFEGuard在各种基于优化的越狱攻击中一致优于最先进的基线方法，并在准确性上取得了显著提升。

Conclusion: SAFEGuard证明了其在对抗不断演化的越狱攻击方面的有效性，为优化型越狱攻击提供了统一的检测方案。

Abstract: Despite the significant efforts devoted to aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values and ensuring safe deployment, recent work has revealed that LLMs remain vulnerable to adversarial jailbreak attacks that can bypass safety guardrails and elicit harmful responses. Many defense methods are proposed to detect jailbreaks but they are limited in their effectiveness to counter wide-range optimization-based jailbreak mechanisms that can yield highly fluency-optimized or harmful semantic obfuscated prompts. To tackle this challenge, we propose a unified detection framework SAFEGuard which incorporates a hybrid fluency measurement based on cross-layer distribution distance and perplexity, and the analysis of harmful semantics through gradient matching. Our method is grounded in a paramount observation: high fluency prompts maintain their malicious intention close to harmful prompts while harmful semantic obfuscated prompts often inject gibberish token sequences. Our evaluation demonstrates that SAFEGuard consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and achieves significant improvement in accuracy across different optimization-based jailbreaks. This underscores the effectiveness of SAFEGuard against evolving jailbreak attacks.

</details>


### [534] [On-the-go Forgetting without Explicit Unlearning via ERASE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05966)
*Kushal Chakrabarti,Mayank Baranwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ERASE框架，通过结构化、类别条件化的输入扰动在推理阶段实现"边用边遗忘"，无需修改模型权重、无需重训练或微调，在保持其他类别预测能力的同时抑制私有数据影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遗忘方法依赖事后权重调整或蒸馏，存在重复内存开销、泛化能力下降和扩展性受限的问题。

Method: ERASE在推理阶段施加结构化的类别条件输入扰动，诱导选择性遗忘；并严格刻画了实现功能遗忘的充分条件，在温和正则性假设下提供理论保障。

Result: 在多种架构和基准数据集上，ERASE在遗忘效果、计算效率与保留保真度之间取得最佳平衡，优于现有基于遗忘的方法。

Conclusion: 将数据移除重新定义为"无需遗忘的遗忘"，为持续学习和隐私保护学习提供了可扩展、合规的路径。

Abstract: Existing unlearning approaches typically rely on post hoc weight adaptation or distillation, leading to duplicated memory costs, degraded generalization, and limited scalability. In this work, we introduce ERASE, Erasure via Reconstructive Adversarial Signal Editing, a framework for on-the-go forgetting that suppresses the observable influence of private data without modifying model weights. ERASE leverages structured, class-conditioned input perturbations to induce selective forgetting during inference, eliminating the need for retraining, fine-tuning, or model copies. We rigorously characterize sufficient conditions when ERASE provably achieves functional forgetting of designated subclasses while preserving predictions across other subclasses within the same superclass. This analysis offers a principled foundation for inference-time forgetting under mild regularity assumptions. Across diverse architectures and benchmark datasets, ERASE maintains the best observed balance between forgetting efficacy, computational efficiency, and retention fidelity over recent unlearning-based methods. By reimagining data removal as forgetting without unlearning, our work establishes a scalable, regulation-aligned pathway for continual, privacy-conscious learning.

</details>


### [535] [Beyond Arbitrary Geometry: Topology Generalization In neural PDE Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05860)
*Peiyao Chen,Zhouyuan Xu,Jianguo Nie,Jiansheng Fan,Chen Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文引入TopoBox-3D基准，通过Hodge热流系统研究神经算子在不同拓扑（Betti数变化）下的泛化能力。研究发现拓扑变化是独立于几何的泛化轴，但主要困难并非来自调和核维度的变化，而是来自谱域（Rayleigh商是最稳定的误差预测器）。显式拓扑先验（incidence和harmonic坐标）并不能提供最佳核身份精度，但TNO在六个任务上取得了最佳非调和精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子常被视为对任意网格（几何）通用，但忽略了PDE算子的不变子空间和衰减子空间会随域拓扑（如隧道和空洞）而变化。本文旨在厘清拓扑变化如何独立于几何影响神经算子的泛化能力，并区分调和核与正谱的影响，填补拓扑作为独立泛化轴的研究空白。

Method: 引入TopoBox-3D基准，使用Hodge热流作为受控观测透镜，其中隧道和空洞变化Betti支持，而Hodge分解将调和核与正谱区分开。对六种架构进行评估，并设计受控探针测试显式incidence和harmonic坐标的效果，系统衡量45个模型-任务-拓扑OOD组合的表现。

Result: 六种架构中，隐式推断拓扑的模型在37/45个模型-任务-拓扑OOD单元中出现过度的匹配退化；但改变调和维度并非更强惩罚因素。初始Rayleigh商是最稳定的误差预测器，谱展宽对edge和face cochains提供额外信息。受控探针显示显式拓扑坐标并未带来最佳核身份精度，但TNO在六项非调和精度任务上均排名第一。

Conclusion: 拓扑是与任意几何兼容性之外的独立泛化轴，其影响横跨整个Hodge谱而非局限于调和核。全局低频结构先验可能有助于组织快速衰减互补分量的预测，为神经算子在跨拓扑和跨几何上的泛化提供新视角。

Abstract: Neural operators that accept arbitrary meshes are often treated as geometry-general, but unseen domain topology changes both the invariant and decaying subspaces of a PDE operator. We use Hodge heat flow as a controlled lens on this distinction and introduce TopoBox-3D, where tunnels and cavities vary Betti support while the exact Hodge decomposition separates the harmonic kernel from the positive spectrum. Across six architectures, models that infer topology implicitly suffer excess matched degradation in 37 of 45 model--task topology-OOD cells, yet cases that change harmonic dimension are not more strongly penalized on average. The dominant difficulty is instead spectral: the initial Rayleigh quotient is the most stable predictor of error, and spectral broadening adds information for edge and face cochains. Most strikingly, controlled probes show that explicit incidence and harmonic coordinates do not yield the best kernel-identity accuracy; nevertheless, TNO ranks first in mixed-input nonharmonic accuracy on all six tasks with nontrivial harmonic support. Together, these results establish topology as a distinct generalization axis beyond arbitrary-geometry compatibility and show that its influence extends across the Hodge spectrum rather than remaining confined to the harmonic kernel. More broadly, they suggest that global, low-frequency structural priors may help organize predictions in the faster-decaying complementary component, offering a new perspective on how neural operators may generalize across topology as well as geometry.

</details>


### [536] [Stability and Generalization of Straight-Through Estimators for Training Two-Layer Quantized Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06430)
*Yiming Ying*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文从统计学习理论角度分析了二值激活网络中使用直通估计器(STE)训练的泛化性质，证明了在饱和输出区域中STE训练等价于对凸潜在损失的随机次梯度下降，并通过算法稳定性分析获得了显式的泛化界限和风险保证，包括O(n^{-1/2})的速率以及在间隔可分性条件下的最优阶误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解不连续的STE训练规则所产生的估计器的统计泛化性质是一个关键理论挑战。作者希望回答算法稳定性能否解释STE训练输出的统计泛化性能，从而弥补对这一广泛使用的训练方法缺乏理论理解的空白。

Method: 作者将零初始化的样本级STE递归在饱和输出区域中精确地表示为凸潜在损失(-yu^⊤x)_+上的随机次梯度下降。利用这一表示，推导了两个耦合更新的精确距离恒等式，证明公共样本映射的近似非扩张性（仅在两个潜在间隔跨越零时有二次缺陷），从而获得ℓ2平均模型稳定性和泛化界限，并将稳定性等距地从潜在向量转移到完整的第一层矩阵。结合稳定性与标准优化界得到显式的超额诱导风险保证。在间隔可分性条件下，通过互补论证推导出随机单遍STE迭代的期望超额误分类误差的O(R²/(γ²n))最优阶界及相应的多数投票界。

Result: 获得了显式的ℓ2平均模型稳定性与泛化界限；当T=n²时得到O(n^{-1/2})的超额诱导风险率；在间隔可分性条件下，得到期望超额误分类误差的最优阶O(R²/(γ²n))界以及多数投票界。

Conclusion: 算法稳定性确实能够解释STE训练规则的统计泛化行为，作者通过精确的问题表示和细致的稳定性分析，为这种不连续的训练方法提供了严格的SLT保证，并在间隔可分条件下达到了最优收敛阶。

Abstract: We study the identity straight-through estimator (STE) for training a two-layer binary-activation network with hinge loss from the perspective of Statistical Learning Theory (SLT). Our central question is whether algorithmic stability can explain the statistical generalization of the estimator produced by the discontinuous STE training rule. In the saturated-output regime, the zero-initialized samplewise STE recursion is exactly the stochastic subgradient descent on the convex latent loss $(-yu^\top x)_+$. This representation makes a stability analysis possible. We derive an exact distance identity for two coupled updates and prove approximate non-expansiveness of the common-example map, with a quadratic defect only when the two latent margins straddle zero. We then obtain explicit $\ell_2$ on-average model-stability and generalization bounds, transferring stability isometrically from the latent vector to the full first-layer matrix. Combining stability with a standard optimization bound yields an explicit excess induced-risk guarantee and the rate $O(n^{-1/2})$ when $T=n^2$. Under margin separability, a complementary argument gives the optimal-order $O(R^2/(γ^2n))$ expected excess misclassification error for a randomized one-pass STE iterate and a corresponding majority-vote bound.

</details>


### [537] [Budgeted Task-Aware Acquisition of Dynamic Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05862)
*Zihe Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Scout框架，用于在动态图上进行预算受限的任务感知信息获取。该框架通过学习查询每个节点的任务价值来决定刷新哪些过时的图信息，在21个基准预算设置中的19个达到了最高的平均下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态图学习面临挑战：网络变化只能被部分观测，获取当前图信息需要高昂的观测和计算成本，在有限资源下无法进行完整更新。现有方法未考虑下游任务需求来决定图信息的获取。

Method: 提出Scout，一个轻量级框架，从维护的图和观测历史中学习查询每个节点的任务价值，从而决定在预算约束下优先刷新哪些过时的节点信息。

Result: 评估涵盖1个合成和4个真实世界动态网络、2个下游任务、9种获取基线和多种查询预算。Scout在21个基准预算设置中的19个获得最高平均下游性能；任务效用监督在16个真实世界设置的13个中优于结构变化监督。

Conclusion: 有用的图观测依赖于具体下游任务，通过在预算约束下学习下游效用，可以更有效地分配有限的观测预算。任务匹配的获取在链接预测上提升AUC 0.012-0.016，在节点分类上提升准确率0.064-0.09。

Abstract: Learning on dynamic graphs is difficult when changes in the underlying network are only partially observed. Acquiring current graph information incurs observation and computational costs, making complete updates impractical under limited resources. This paper focuses on budgeted task-aware acquisition on dynamic networks, where a model needs to decide which stale graph information to refresh for a downstream task. We propose Scout, a lightweight framework that learns the task value of querying each node from the maintained graph and observation history. Our evaluation covers one synthetic and four real-world dynamic networks, two downstream tasks, nine acquisition baselines, and several query budgets. Scout achieves the highest mean downstream performance in 19 of the 21 benchmark-budget settings. Task-utility supervision also outperforms structural-change supervision in 13 of the 16 real-world settings. On the same dynamic network, task-matched acquisition improves link-prediction AUC by 0.012-0.016 and node-classification accuracy by 0.064-0.09 over task-mismatched acquisition. These results show that useful graph observations depend on the downstream task and that limited observation budgets can be allocated more effectively by learning directly from downstream utility.

</details>


### [538] [Deep Barycentric Regression for Optimal Transport Map Estimation and its Statistical Optimality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06598)
*Kunwoong Kim,Insung Kong,Yongdai Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BROT方法，一种简单两步法用于最优传输映射估计：先计算无正则化OT计划，再通过最小二乘回归将深度神经网络拟合到诱导的重心目标上。理论上证明在标准正则条件下，当真实OT映射为Lipschitz时，该方法达到极小极大收敛速率；实验中在合成数据、图像数据及两个下游任务（单细胞扰动预测和无监督域适应）中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OT映射估计器存在理论与实践的鸿沟：理论估计器虽能达到极小极大最优收敛速率，但通常是非参数化的，实现设计和推理成本高；实际估计器虽参数化且可扩展，但统计保证研究不足，且其min-max对抗式训练目标对优化算法敏感。

Method: 提出BROT两阶段方法：(1) 计算无正则化的OT计划；(2) 通过最小二乘回归将深度神经网络（DNN）拟合到由OT计划诱导的重心目标上。这是一种简单的参数化回归方法，规避了对抗式训练目标的敏感性。

Result: 理论证明在标准正则条件且真实OT映射为Lipschitz时，BROT的DNN估计器达到极小极大收敛速率。数值实验（合成数据集和图像数据集）表明其提供精确的映射估计、强目标分布匹配和竞争性传输成本；在单细胞扰动预测和无监督域适应两个下游任务中展示了更强的任务性能。

Conclusion: BROT弥合了理论最优性与实践可扩展性之间的差距，表明一个简单的最小二乘回归框架既能获得严格的理论保证，又具有实用的训练稳定性和下游任务有效性。

Abstract: The optimal transport (OT) map provides a geometric transformation for aligning probability distributions and has become a useful tool in machine learning. However, existing estimators of the OT map still exhibit a gap between sharp statistical guarantees and practical parametric estimation based on stable training objectives. Theoretical estimators achieve minimax optimal convergence rates, but they are typically nonparametric and can incur demanding implementation design or inference costs. Practical estimators are parametric and scalable, but their statistical guarantees remain underexplored, and their min-max, adversarial-like training objectives can be sensitive to optimization algorithms. We propose BROT (Barycentric Regression for OT), a simple two-step method that first computes the unregularized OT plan and then fits a deep neural network (DNN) to the induced barycentric targets by least-squares regression. Under standard regularity conditions, we prove that the DNN estimator of BROT attains the minimax convergence rate, when the ground-truth OT map is Lipschitz. Numerical studies on synthetic datasets and an image dataset show that BROT provides accurate map estimates, strong target distribution matching, and competitive transport costs, compared to existing estimation methods. Experiments on two downstream tasks, single-cell perturbation prediction and unsupervised domain adaptation, further suggest that the accurate estimation of BROT can translate into stronger task performance.

</details>


### [539] [A budget-dependent crossover between coverage- and response-based training-set selection for machine-learned interatomic potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05877)
*Jia Bi,Alin-Marin Elena*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过预算解析比较，揭示训练集大小是决定原子级训练集选择策略（结构覆盖 vs. 响应引导选择）的关键变量。在5%预算下覆盖策略优于随机抽样；在20%预算下，基于模型分歧的"响应见证"选择器反超覆盖策略，在所有八个配对训练种子间隔上均降低直接留出集力误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 选择紧凑训练集时，需要在保留结构多样性与针对模型分歧的构型之间做权衡，而最优选择可能依赖于保留多少数据。仅在单一训练集大小下进行比较不足以揭示这种依赖关系，因此需要一种预算解析的比较框架。

Method: 在GAP-20 Carbon和池化修订版MD17数据集上，对MACE模型进行预算解析比较。结构覆盖选择器与响应引导选择器（针对覆盖训练模型与全数据参考模型之间的分歧）相对比。同时在多个预算级别（1%、5%、20%）以及多个力端点评估。

Result: 在5%预算下，覆盖策略比随机抽样在四个力端点上产生更小的与全数据误差的绝对偏差。见证选择器在1%和5%下有更大偏差，但在20%时排序反转——见证选择的模型将直接留出集力误差降低0.46-5.89%，八个配对训练种子间隔全部偏向见证选择，且六个误差低于全数据参考。学习到的相似性保持覆盖排序，而冻结模型误差选择反而更差。

Conclusion: 保留数据预算被确立为原子级训练集选择中的决定性变量。研究提供了响应引导压缩何时能超越结构覆盖的直接检验，表明模型分歧在高预算下更有价值，而结构多样性在低预算下更稳健。

Abstract: Selecting compact training sets for machine-learned interatomic potentials requires deciding whether to preserve structural diversity or target configurations on which models disagree. The better choice can depend on how much data is retained, making a comparison at one training-set size insufficient. Here we link selection criteria to prediction accuracy through a budget-resolved comparison of retrained MACE models on GAP-20 Carbon and pooled revised MD17. Structural coverage is compared with a response-guided selector that targets disagreement between a coverage-trained model and a full-data reference. This retrospective response witness tests the value of model disagreement for compressing an already labelled pool. At 5\%, coverage gives smaller absolute deviations from the full-data error than random sampling across four force endpoints in both datasets. The witness has larger deviations than coverage at 1\% and 5\%, but the ordering reverses at 20\%. At 20\%, witness-selected models also lower direct held-out force errors by 0.46--5.89\% relative to coverage, with all eight paired training-seed intervals favouring the witness. Six errors fall below the full-data reference. Mean force-error reductions are 0.164--0.167~meV~$\textÅ^{-1}$, with larger gains for tail and masked endpoints. Complementary analyses show that learned similarity preserves the coverage ranking, while selecting by frozen-model error gives higher error than embedding coverage. These findings establish retained-data budget as a deciding variable in atomistic training-set selection and provide a direct test of when response-guided compression improves on structural coverage.

</details>


### [540] [Efficient Learning and Symmetry Discovery under Exact Invariances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07031)
*Ashkan Soleymani,Behrooz Tahmasebi,Patrick Jaillet,Stefanie Jegelka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次提出了统一适用于有限群和无限群的精确群不变性学习多项式时间算法，并解决了未知对称性发现场景下的学习问题。算法运行时间与群无关，仅取决于数据维度和样本量，同时提供了强的泛化保证。在对称性发现场景中，针对有限群的子群格，算法能够在多项式时间内从数据中恢复底层对称性，并达到已知对称性设置下的极小极大最优样本复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 群不变性学习在科学和几何学习问题中至关重要，但其计算基础尚未被充分理解。先前工作仅证明了对有限且已知的群可以在多项式时间内强制精确不变性，但对无限群和未知对称性的情况仍是开放问题。本文旨在同时解决这两个挑战，为不变性和等变性方法在几何机器学习中的经验成功提供计算解释。

Method: 本文采用两方面的技术手段：(1) 对于精确群不变性学习，提出首个统一适用于有限和无限群的通用多项式时间算法，运行时间与群无关；(2) 对于未知对称性发现，将问题建模为有限群的子群格上的学习，利用随机Cayley图和扩张图理论（expander theory）的工具来识别精确对称性并从数据中利用这些对称性进行学习。

Result: 算法在有限维特征空间上的回归问题中，能够以多项式时间（随数据维度和样本量）恢复底层对称性，匹配已知对称性设置下的极小极大最优样本复杂度，并提供强的泛化保证。所得分析工具（随机Cayley图与扩张图理论）可能具有独立的学术价值。

Conclusion: 本文完整解决了精确群不变性学习中无限群和未知对称性两个开放挑战，为不变方法的经验成功提供了理论计算基础，部分回答了文献中的开放问题，并引入了可能具有广泛适用性的图论分析工具。

Abstract: Learning with group invariances is central to many scientific and geometric learning problems, yet its computational foundations remain poorly understood. Even for classical supervised regression settings, it has been unclear whether one can efficiently compute a regression function that is exactly invariant to a given group action. Recent work showed that exact invariance can be enforced in polynomial time when the underlying group is finite and known, but left open the cases of infinite groups and unknown symmetries. In this paper, we resolve both challenges. First, we present the first polynomial-time algorithm for learning with exact group invariances that applies uniformly to finite and infinite groups. The runtime is polynomial in the data dimension and sample size, and independent of the group, while achieving strong generalization guarantees. This provides a computational explanation for the empirical success of invariant and equivariant methods in geometric machine learning and partially answers a recent open question in the literature. Second, we study learning in the symmetry discovery setting, where the invariance group is unknown. Focusing on the subgroup lattice of a finite group, we show that exact symmetries can be identified from data and exploited for learning in polynomial time. For regression over finite-dimensional feature spaces, our algorithm provably recovers the underlying symmetry, matches the minimax-optimal sample complexity of the known-symmetry setting, and runs in time polynomial in the data dimension and sample size. Our analysis relies on tools from random Cayley graphs and expander theory, which may be of independent interest.

</details>


### [541] [Grounded and Faithful P&ID Reasoning: Constraining Vision-Language Models with Recovered Evidence Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05880)
*Prathamesh Gadekar,Sagar Srinivas Sakhinana,Venkataramana Runkana*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于显式图的接地方法（Graph-Grounded Harness）用于P&ID图纸的拓扑问答。该方法先从图纸中恢复出显式的图形结构（符号、工艺连接和标签），然后强制视觉-语言模型仅通过七个只读操作符查询该图来回答问题，从而保证拓扑声明有据可依。在TopoPID-VQA基准上，将精确匹配准确率从36.7–41.3%提升到74.3–76.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型能流畅描述P&ID图纸，但常常臆造或遗漏工艺连接。在隔离、维护和HAZOP等决策中，一个被臆造或遗漏的连接可能反转隔离或可达性判断，因此不能信任未经与图纸线条核对的流畅回答。

Method: 首先从图纸中恢复显式的图形结构（符号、工艺连接和标签），然后要求模型只能通过七个只读操作符查询该图来回答问题。拓扑声明只有在引用支持其的查询结果时才会被返回，从而保证回答有据可循。

Result: 在TopoPID-VQA（3000个拓扑问题的基准）上，将精确匹配准确率从图像直答的36.7–41.3%（Qwen3-VL-4B, Qwen3-VL-8B, Gemma-4-E4B）提升到74.3–76.0%。在Digitize-PID数据集上恢复图在精确工艺连接上F1为0.742，合并符号和标签后为0.801。残余误差与恢复图的质量差距相符。

Conclusion: 接地方法在恢复图正确之处显著生效，但感知误差仍会在恢复图错误的地方破坏拓扑问题的回答。这揭示了当前方法的局限性：回答质量受限于底层图形恢复的准确性。

Abstract: Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) are the authoritative maps of process plants: isolation, maintenance, and HAZOP decisions depend on what connects to what. Vision-language models describe these sheets fluently, yet they often invent or miss process connections---and an invented or missed link can reverse an isolation or reachability call, so a plant decision cannot trust a fluent answer that was never checked against the linework. We instead recover an explicit graph of the drawing---its symbols, the process connections between them, and the tags that name them---and then require the model to answer only by querying that graph through seven read-only operators, so a topology claim is returned only when it cites the query results that support it. On TopoPID-VQA, a new suite of 3000 topology questions over these sheets, Graph-Grounded Harness (Ours) raises exact match accuracy from 36.7--41.3% under image-only prompting to 74.3--76.0% for Qwen3-VL-4B, Qwen3-VL-8B, and Gemma-4-E4B. It does so on an imperfect substrate: on Digitize-PID dataset the recovered graph scores F1 0.742 on exact process connections, and 0.801 once symbols and tags are pooled in. The residual errors track that gap---grounding pays off where the recovered graph is right, and perception error still breaks topology questions where it is not.

</details>


### [542] [Dense Structural Compression of Transformers via Gauge-Correct Channel Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07264)
*Jed A. Duersch,Naïm Es-Sebbani,Nathanaël Haas,Zied Bouraoui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GaugeLasso方法，通过通道惩罚驱动整个张量切片归零，在保持稠密张量和高GPU吞吐的同时减少推理FMA计算。该方法解决了由规范自由度引起的优化不稳定问题，能在训练过程中自适应压缩模型结构。在多项式长除、字符级语言建模和掩码自编码等任务上实现了148-255倍的计算压缩，且压缩后的模型性能优于手工设计的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer推理的每token能量直接决定成本和碳足迹，主要由稠密矩阵乘法的FMA操作和内存流量主导。现有方法要么引入稀疏性（损害GPU吞吐），要么依赖人工剪枝（无法达到最优结构）。作者希望从第一性原理出发，在训练过程中自适应调整结构复杂度，最大化每单位计算的推理效用，同时保持稠密张量以维持高GPU吞吐。

Method: 核心方法是GaugeLasso——加性对称群套索惩罚。关键在于作者发现"直接惩罚每个通道上算子分量范数"的朴素方法会被规范自由度致命地不稳定化。GaugeLasso通过引入对称组套索惩罚，在网络收敛到规范平衡时恢复乘积范数的单调函数。平衡分析实现逐通道校准，正确抑制推理效用/单位计算较低的切片。持续的自适应压力驱动网络重组为深度依赖的结构轮廓。

Result: - 多项式长除(𝔽₃₁)：计算压缩148-255倍且精度完美
- 字符级语言建模：压缩模型在相同FMA下超越手工设计基线
- 掩码自编码：压缩试验暴露各轴过度配置与饱和情况，指导更好的二次设计
- 训练单调加速
- 同排名的后验剪枝无法达到这些结构，表明持续压力对发现高效模型至关重要
- 重训练发现的结构在统计任务恢复基线质量，但在精确算法任务上失败

Conclusion: 持续的结构自适应压力是发现高效模型架构的核心机制，远优于事后剪枝。GaugeLasso提供了一种理论上严谨的方法，在保持稠密计算（利于GPU）的同时实现大规模结构压缩。然而，发现的架构在精确算法任务上的泛化/可重训练性存在问题，暗示压缩过程可能依赖训练中特定的计算路径而非纯粹的结构知识。

Abstract: Inference energy per token drives the cost and carbon footprint of deployed transformers. It is dominated by dense matrix products that incur fused multiply-accumulate (FMA) operations and memory traffic. To reduce these computations while retaining dense tensors for high GPU throughput, we develop a methodology from first principles to adapt structural complexity during training to maximize inference utility per unit compute. Channel penalties drive entire tensor slices to zero to enable physical removal while preserving density and the network function.
  The natural approach, penalizing the norm of operator components acting through each channel, is provably destabilized by gauge freedom. We resolve this pathology with GaugeLasso: additive symmetric group-lasso penalties that recover a monotone function of product-norms when the network converges to gauge balance. Our equilibrium analysis enables per-channel calibration to correctly suppress slices that under-perform in inference utility per unit compute.
  Under adaptive pressure, the network reorganizes into depth-dependent structural profiles that can be far smaller than the architecture required to learn the task. On polynomial long division over $\mathbb{F}_{31}$, compute compresses from 148 to 255 times with perfect accuracy. On character-level language modeling, compressed models outperform the hand-designed baseline at equal FMA. On masked autoencoding, a compression trial exposes which axes were over-provisioned and which saturated, guiding a better second design. Compaction also accelerates training monotonically as the model progresses. Post-hoc pruning with the same utility ranking cannot reach these structures, showing that sustained pressure is central to discovery of efficient models. Retraining a discovered architecture recovers baseline quality on our statistical tasks, but fails on our exact algorithmic task.

</details>


### [543] [CALM: Class-wise Agreement and Label-gated Disagreement Modulation for Decentralized Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05884)
*Yifan Ying,Qing Tian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CALM方法，通过三级平滑信任门控机制解决联邦蒸馏在非IID数据下的硬决策问题，无需通信开销或辅助数据即可提升异构联邦学习性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统联邦学习依赖参数平均，要求客户端同构且数据IID。联邦蒸馏虽能解决架构异构问题，但在严重非IID数据下，现有方法对教师信任度采用硬性全有或全无的决策（阈值剔除离群教师并完全信任幸存者），忽视了信任本身是程度问题。

Method: 提出CALM，在三个层面用平滑信任门控替代硬决策：1) 类别级：按教师与同行共识的一致性加权；2) 样本级：按教师与目标的散度缩放蒸馏；3) 标签级：按目标对样本真实标签的支持强度缩放。无需额外通信或辅助数据。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、SVHN、OrganAMNIST和Google Speech Commands上，配合Dirichlet标签偏移及异构客户端架构，CALM持续优于均匀和硬过滤蒸馏方法，并达到或超越现有异构FL方法。

Conclusion: 通过将硬决策替换为三级平滑信任门控，CALM在不增加通信或数据成本的前提下，有效提升了非IID异构联邦蒸馏的鲁棒性和性能。

Abstract: Conventional federated learning relies on parameter averaging, which forces clients to be doubly homogeneous: all must run an identical architecture, and accuracy degrades when local data are non-IID. Decentralized federated distillation sidesteps both: each client runs its peers' model snapshots as teachers on its own local data and distills from their soft predictions, with no server, no public data, and no shared architecture. Under severe non-IID skew, however, the trustworthiness of the aggregated teacher target is a matter of degree, yet existing pipelines make hard, all-or-nothing decisions: outlier teachers are discarded by threshold, and whatever target survives is trusted in full. We propose CALM, which replaces every hard decision with a smooth trust gate at three levels: per class, teachers are weighted by agreement with the peer consensus; per sample, distillation is scaled by the teachers' divergence from that target; and a label gate scales it by how strongly the target supports the sample's true label. None of this adds communication or auxiliary data. On CIFAR-10, SVHN, OrganAMNIST, and Google Speech Commands with heterogeneous client architectures under Dirichlet label skew, CALM consistently outperforms uniform and hard-filtered distillation and matches or exceeds competing heterogeneous-FL methods.

</details>


### [544] [Statistical versus machine learning-based spatial interpolation of post-processed ensemble weather forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07512)
*Mária Lakatos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究比较了统计与机器学习方法对ECMWF 2米温度和10米风速预报的统计后处理效果，覆盖德国观测站与未观测站。提出了一种海拔感知线性池（ALP）方法，在未观测位置相对于标准线性池有显著改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统计后处理能改善集合天气预报的校准性，但在无观测站点的位置生成校准预报仍具挑战性，需要探索适用于未观测位置的后处理方法。

Method: 比较EMOS方法、分布回归网络、Transformer、图神经网络等多种方法；对温度数据提出海拔感知线性池（ALP），并在有限与扩展预测变量设置下评估。

Result: 后处理在多数情况下优于原始集合预报，但没有任何单一方法在所有变量、站点组和评估指标上表现最佳；ALP在未观测位置相对标准线性池有小幅但显著的改进。

Conclusion: 不同后处理方法各有优势，需根据具体变量和场景选择；提出的ALP方法为未观测位置的温度预报提供了有效的改进方案。

Abstract: Statistical post-processing improves ensemble weather forecasts, but generating calibrated predictions at locations without observations remains challenging. This study compares statistical and machine-learning-based methods for post-processing ECMWF 2-m temperature and 10-m wind speed forecasts at observed and unobserved stations in Germany. We consider EMOS-based approaches, distributional regression networks, Transformers, and graph neural networks under both limited and extended predictor settings. For temperature, we also investigate linear forecast combinations and propose an altitude-aware linear pool (ALP). The results show that post-processing improves upon the raw ensemble in most settings, but no single method performs best across all variables, station groups, and evaluation metrics. The proposed ALP provides a small but significant improvement over the standard linear pool at unobserved locations.

</details>


### [545] [One Rate Is Not Enough: Adaptive Anisotropic Learning Rates for LoRA Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05885)
*Huiyi Wang,Daijiao Liu,Lina Yao,Dong Gong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了自适应各向异性学习率模型（AnLR-LoRA），为LoRA适配器的每个秩一组件分配独立的学习率，解决统一学习率忽视模块内异质性的问题，在多个基准上超越标准LoRA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准LoRA及其变体采用统一的全局学习率应用于所有适配器的每个秩一组件，但这种惯例忽视了模块内部显著的异质性——秩一组件以不均匀的速度更新，低速度模块收敛到集中的奇异谱，未充分利用标称秩预算。

Method: 提出自适应各向异性学习率模型，为每个秩一组件赋予其自身的有效学习率，该学习率基于训练时信号在线计算，并按模块均值归一化以保持全局学习率预算。具体利用AdamW优化中可用的函数空间速度和Adam SNR两种信号，是一种无额外可训练参数的轻量级方案。

Result: 在常识推理、自然语言生成和视觉指令调优基准上，AnLR-LoRA一致优于标准LoRA，同时促进更充分地利用秩容量；增益在广泛的全局学习率范围内保持稳健，并可迁移到其他LoRA变体。

Conclusion: 自适应各向异性学习率能够更有效地利用秩预算，提升LoRA微调性能，且具有轻量、无需额外参数、鲁棒性与迁移性良好的优点。

Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become the standard for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models. Most LoRA variants follow a uniform-LR convention, applying a single global learning rate across every rank-one component of every adapter. We show that this convention overlooks substantial within-module heterogeneity, where the rank-one components of a LoRA adapter update at highly uneven rates and low-velocity modules converge to concentrated singular spectra that underutilize the nominal rank budget. To address this, we propose an adaptive anisotropic learning-rate model that assigns each rank-one component its own effective learning rate, computed online from training-time signals and mean-normalized per module to preserve the global LR budget. AnLR-LoRA instantiates this model with two signals available during AdamW optimization, namely function-space velocity and Adam SNR, as a lightweight scheme with no extra trainable parameters. Across commonsense reasoning, natural language generation and visual instruction-tuning benchmarks, AnLR-LoRA consistently improves over LoRA while encouraging broader use of rank capacity, with gains that remain robust across a wide range of global learning rates and transfer cleanly to other LoRA variants.

</details>


### [546] [InfluenceField: A Differentiable Field with Interventionally Identifiable Causal Structure for Multimodal World Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07874)
*Zihao Yang,Zijia Wang,Zhiqiu Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: InfluenceField是一种插入在多模态大语言模型视觉编码器与语言解码器之间的干预感知潜在场，通过连续空间表征传播有向影响并预测局部视觉干预效果，在CausalVQA上较骨干模型提升13.1个百分点准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型虽能捕捉视觉-语言相关性，但难以预测局部视觉干预如何传播并影响下游答案，缺乏因果推理能力。

Method: 在视觉编码器与语言解码器之间引入干预感知潜在场(InfluenceField)，将patch特征提升为连续空间表征，通过共享转移算子进行多步有向影响传播，并预测局部干预效果。联合优化语言建模、跨环境不变性、反事实推演监督和结构正则化四项目标。

Result: 在CausalVQA上，InfluenceField较其骨干模型整体准确率提升13.1个百分点，在规划和假设类别的提升最大。容量匹配的基线与结构对照证明增益来自因果目标而非容量增加。理论上给出非线性有限基总体模型的精确可识别性、线性特化的部分覆盖特征与有限损失稳定性界。

Conclusion: 目标对齐的干预监督配合一步分离条件可将允许表征限制为位置内重参数化，从而精确恢复完整转移的有向依赖图；增益主要归因于因果目标设计而非模型容量。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models often capture visual-linguistic correlations but struggle to predict how local visual interventions propagate and affect downstream answers. We introduce InfluenceField, an intervention-aware latent field inserted between the visual encoder and language decoder. It lifts patch features into a continuous spatial representation, propagates directed influence over multiple steps, and predicts local intervention effects through a shared transition operator. Training jointly optimizes language modeling, cross-environment invariance, counterfactual rollout supervision, and structural regularization. For a nonlinear finite-basis population model, we show that target-aligned interventional supervision, together with a one-step separation condition on the transition, restricts admissible representations to within-location reparameterizations, so that the directed dependency graph of the full transition is recovered exactly. A linear specialization gives an exact partial-coverage characterization and a finite-loss stability bound, and the field analysis derives the spatial profile of coefficient interventions together with a shared-channel calibration result. On CausalVQA, InfluenceField improves overall accuracy over its backbone by 13.1 percentage points, with the largest gains on the planning and hypothetical categories. Capacity-matched baselines and structural controls attribute the gains in robustness and factual-counterfactual consistency to the causal objectives rather than to added capacity.

</details>


### [547] [A First-Order Learning Algorithm for Online Resource Allocation with Constant Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05895)
*Menglong Li,Jiawei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究有限时域在线资源分配问题，提出了一种原始一阶学习策略，每期仅对当前请求类型对应的动作坐标执行一次梯度上升更新。该策略相对于事后最优达到O(1)的期望加性遗憾，且遗憾界与时间T无关，无需求解线性规划，也无需流体线性规划的非退化假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线资源分配问题中，现有方法通常需要求解线性规划或依赖非退化假设来保证遗憾界，这限制了算法的实用性和理论适用范围。作者希望设计一种简单高效、无需求解LP且不依赖非退化条件的策略，同时能达到与T无关的遗憾界。

Method: 提出一种原始一阶学习策略（primal first-order learning policy）。在每个时期，根据当前观测到的请求类型，仅对其对应的动作坐标执行一次梯度上升更新。该策略不求解任何线性规划，采用直接的一阶优化方法在原始空间中进行迭代学习。

Result: 该策略实现了O(1)的期望加性遗憾，遗憾界与时间T无关（即不随horizon增长）。此外，遗憾上界不依赖于流体线性规划的非退化假设，放宽了现有方法的理论条件。

Conclusion: 研究表明，通过简单的原始一阶梯度上升方法即可在在线资源分配问题中获得常数遗憾，且无需求解LP或依赖非退化假设，为大规模在线资源分配提供了理论保证且计算高效的解决方案。

Abstract: We study a finite-horizon online resource allocation problem with initial resource capacities proportional to the horizon. In each period, a request type is observed and one action is chosen from a finite menu. Each action earns a reward and consumes a vector of resources. The arrival types are independent and identically distributed, but their probabilities are unknown. We present a primal first-order learning policy that, in each period, performs one gradient ascent update of the action coordinates associated with the current request type. The policy achieves $O(1)$ expected additive regret relative to the hindsight optimum, with a bound independent of the horizon $T$. It does not solve any linear program, and the regret bound does not require a nondegeneracy assumption on the fluid linear program.

</details>


### [548] [GPU-Enabled Large-Scale Optimization Using Randomized Linear Algebra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08136)
*Pratik Rathore,Zachary Frangella,Parth Nobel,Xuning Hu,Madeleine Udell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍rlaopt，一个基于PyTorch的开源包，用于使用随机数值线性代数（RandNLA）进行大规模优化和科学计算。该包提供GPU加速的求解器（NystromPCG、NysADMM、SAPPHIRE），支持正定线性系统和带约束的凸经验风险最小化问题，并包含自然数学语法的建模语言，支持迭代可微性用于超参数调优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管RandNLA算法取得了显著进展，但很少有实现能将GPU加速与简单的问题指定接口相结合，这限制了此类算法在大规模优化问题中的实际应用。

Method: rlaopt提供三种基于RandNLA的GPU求解器：加速共轭梯度（NystromPCG）、算子分裂（NysADMM）和随机梯度方法（SAPPHIRE）；包含允许用户以自然数学语法指定问题的建模语言，自动检查与所选求解器的兼容性并执行问题分解；求解器支持迭代微分以实现超参数调优。

Result: 在岭回归、有界多项逻辑回归和有界弹性网络上的实验识别了随机预条件改善性能的条件，并展示了GPU执行带来的显著加速。包已开源（Apache许可），源码位于GitHub，版本0.1.0可在PyPI获取。

Conclusion: rlaopt填补了RandNLA算法从理论到实际可用工具之间的空白，结合GPU加速和简单接口，为大规模优化问题提供了实用且可扩展的求解方案。

Abstract: This paper introduces rlaopt, a PyTorch-based package for large-scale optimization and scientific computing using randomized numerical linear algebra (RandNLA). Despite substantial progress in RandNLA-based algorithms, few implementations combine GPU acceleration with a simple interface for specifying optimization problems. rlaopt addresses this gap by providing GPU-enabled solvers for positive-definite linear systems and convex empirical risk minimization with constraints and regularizers. These solvers use RandNLA to accelerate conjugate gradient (NystromPCG), operator splitting (NysADMM), and stochastic gradient methods (SAPPHIRE). Moreover, rlaopt includes a modeling language that lets users specify problems using natural mathematical syntax. rlaopt automatically checks compatibility with the selected solver and performs the required problem decomposition. The solvers also support differentiation through their iterations, enabling applications such as hyperparameter tuning. Experiments on ridge regression, bounded multinomial logistic regression, and bounded elastic net identify when randomized preconditioning improves performance and demonstrate substantial speedups from GPU execution. The package is open-source under an Apache license, with source code at https://github.com/udellgroup/rlaopt and version 0.1.0 available on PyPI.

</details>


### [549] [A dictionary learning framework for graphs via filters and optimal transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05919)
*Jinchuan Liao,Dai Hai Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种图字典学习（GDL）框架，将每个图表示为基于其滤波拉普拉斯算子的零均值高斯分布，通过滤波图距离（fGOT）下的重心来近似观测图，并使用可处理的代理距离（sfGOT）端到端优化重建误差，实验验证了其在图聚类和分类任务上的优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的图字典学习方法在比较图时往往依赖节点对应关系或仅关注局部结构，难以捕捉图的全局结构特性，且缺乏可微、可端到端优化的框架。本文旨在提出一个能刻画全局结构、不依赖节点对应的图字典学习方法。

Method: 1) 每个图被建模为零均值高斯分布，来源于其滤波拉普拉斯；2) 用学习到的原子图的fGOT重心近似观测图；3) 使用sfGOT距离衡量重建误差，该距离在无节点对应情况下可计算；4) 通过反向传播端到端最小化损失；5) 从希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（HSIC）角度解释sfGOT，揭示其等价于最大化节点谱嵌入间的统计依赖性。

Result: 在多种基准数据集上的图聚类和图分类实验中，该方法优于现有的图字典学习方法，展现出竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: GDL框架借助高斯分布建模和最优传输工具，有效实现无对应关系下的图字典学习；sfGOT与HSIC的连接提供了理论洞见，说明结构比较可被理解为谱嵌入间的依赖性最大化；整体框架在结构感知的图学习任务上表现优异。

Abstract: We propose a graph dictionary learning (GDL) framework where each graph is represented as a zero-mean Gaussian distribution derived from its filtered Laplacian. Each observed graph is approximated by a barycenter over learned atom graphs, computed under the filter graph distance (fGOT), a graph comparison metric sensitive to global structural properties. The reconstruction error between the observed graph and its barycenter is measured by the surrogate fGOT (sfGOT) distance, a tractable approximation of fGOT that handles graphs without known node correspondence, and is minimized end-to-end via backpropagation. We further provide a novel interpretation of sfGOT through the lens of the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion, showing that minimizing the sfGOT distance between two graphs is equivalent to maximizing statistical dependence between the spectral embedding of their nodes. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate competitive performance over existing GDL methods on graph clustering and classification tasks.

</details>


### [550] [Rethinking the Evaluation of Efficiency Methods for Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05933)
*Jiamu Zhang,Lingxi Zhang,Pengjun Lu,Qiyue Zhang,Yu-Neng Chuang,Zhengchen Li,Shuai Xu,Vipin Chaudhary,Hanjie Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文质疑了现有LLM多智能体系统(MAS)效率提升方法的评估可靠性，指出现有报告的性能提升可能源于方法特定的提示词、起始拓扑结构等混淆因素，而非结构性改进本身。作者构建了一个受控且需要MAS的诊断基准，发现许多声称的效率提升是设置依赖的，可能来自结构坍缩、禁用工具通路或随机剪枝已能保持精度的情况。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着更大模型和更多智能体带来高昂执行成本，MAS效率优化日益重要。现有剪枝智能体、移除通信边、搜索紧凑结构等方法声称能降低开销，但其评估方式可能高估了真实效果：报告收益常在方法特定提示词和起始拓扑下测得，难以归因于提出的结构变化；且许多成功案例出现在单智能体或随机剪枝已能保持强性能的非MAS强需求场景中。

Method: 作者引入一个受控且MAS强需求的诊断基准，在共享骨干模型、智能体注册表和运行时下，系统评估代表性MAS效率方法，并控制拓扑、规模、深度和工具使用等变量的变化。

Result: 分析显示许多报告的高收益与具体设置高度相关，可能来源于结构坍缩（结构退化导致功能丧失而看似高效）、策略性禁用工具通路带来的虚假增益，或起始系统本身随机剪枝即可保持精度——这些均非对MAS效率的稳健改善。

Conclusion: 现有MAS效率方法评估存在系统性偏差，需要更受控、更能体现MAS价值的基准来公平验证结构性改进的真实贡献，避免混淆因素主导结论。

Abstract: Efficiency is increasingly important for Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS), as larger models and more agents introduce substantial execution costs. Recent methods aim to make MAS cheaper by pruning agents, removing communication edges, or searching for compact structures. However, we argue that existing evaluations may overestimate their true ability to improve MAS efficiency. Reported gains are often measured under method-specific prompts and starting topologies, making them difficult to attribute to the proposed structural changes. Moreover, many reported successes appear in non-MAS-demanding settings, where a single agent or a randomly pruned system can already preserve strong performance. To study these issues, we introduce a controlled and MAS-demanding diagnostic benchmark for representative MAS efficiency methods. We evaluate methods under a shared backbone model, agent registry, and runtime, across controlled variations in topology, scale, depth, and tool use. Our analysis shows that many reported gains are setup-dependent and may arise from structural collapse, disabled tool pathways, or starting systems where random pruning already preserves accuracy, rather than robust improvements in MAS efficiency.

</details>


### [551] [Interpretable and Fair Generalized Additive Neural Networks via Multi-objective Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05946)
*Ziming Wang,Changwu Huang,Ke Tang,Yew-Soon Ong,Xin Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对基于神经网络的广义加性模型（NN-GAMs），首次提出量化可解释性指标，并构建了多目标神经基础模型（MONBM）框架，通过多目标进化学习同时优化准确性、可解释性和公平性，揭示三者之间的复杂关系与权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究大多聚焦于提升NN-based GAMs的准确性，其可解释性评估与优化仍未被充分探索；同时，可解释性与公平性的联合显式优化及其权衡关系也缺乏深入研究。

Method: 提出了量化NN-GAMs可解释性的显式指标；设计MONBM框架，基于多目标进化学习同时优化准确率、可解释性和公平性；开发部分重训练策略以适配深度模型架构的进化多目标优化。

Result: 通过MONBM揭示了三者之间的复杂关系及其成因，获得一组具有不同权衡的模型集合，并与最先进方法对比验证了竞争力的有效性。

Conclusion: 多目标优化与自解释模型的结合能有效揭示可信AI目标间的关系，为在准确率、可解释性与公平性之间进行显式权衡提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Interpretability and fairness are two of the most emphasized dimensions in trustworthy artificial intelligence (AI). Various explainable AI methods have been introduced to improve interpretability. This paper focuses on neural network (NN)-based generalized additive models (GAMs), a class of self-interpretable models. While most existing research has prioritized improving the accuracy of NN-based GAMs, their interpretability remains largely underexplored. To address this gap, this paper introduces explicit quantitative metrics for evaluating the interpretability of NN-based GAMs, empirically examines their effectiveness, and explores strategies for improving interpretability within these models. In addition, the simultaneous and explicit optimization of both interpretability and fairness, along with their trade-offs and the underlying reasons, remains underexplored. To address this, we propose a multi-objective neural basis model (MONBM) framework based on multi-objective evolutionary learning to consider accuracy, interpretability, and fairness simultaneously. A partial retraining strategy is further developed to facilitate the practical application of evolutionary multi-objective optimization to deep model architectures. Based on MONBM, this paper reveals the complex relationships between these dimensions and the reasons behind these intricate relationships. This analysis demonstrates how multi-objective optimization can be combined with self-interpretable models to reveal relationships among trustworthiness objectives. In addition, MONBM obtains a set of models with different trade-offs between dimensions, and the competitiveness of the approach is validated by comparing it with state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [552] [QGB-W$k$NN: Quantum Granular-Ball Learning for Robust Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05952)
*Suzhen Yuan,Dehang Chen,Lifeng Shen,Shuyin Xia,Jeremiah D. Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于量子粒球的高效可靠加权K近邻分类框架（QGB-WkNN），通过量子核粒球表示与纯度感知的加权决策机制，联合解决传统最近邻分类在计算效率低和噪声环境下鲁棒性不足两方面的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最近邻分类方法在噪声环境中往往面临计算效率低下和鲁棒性有限的双重挑战，需要一种能同时兼顾效率与可靠性的分类框架。

Method: 1) 构建量子核粒球表示，减少检索冗余并增强非线性特征表达；2) 提出粒球纯度引导的HNSW优化策略，利用结构可靠性指导层次图构建，缓解随机分层导致的局部最优问题；3) 引入融合粒球相似性与纯度的加权投票机制，在噪声环境下产生更可靠的分类决策。

Result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，QGB-WkNN在取得具有竞争力的分类精度的同时，展现了良好的分类性能与计算成本之间的帕累托权衡，并在多种噪声条件下持续提升鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 可靠性感知的量子粒球学习为高效鲁棒的最近邻分类提供了一种有前景的新范式。

Abstract: Nearest-neighbor classification is widely used in machine learning, yet existing methods often suffer from low computational efficiency and limited robustness in noisy environments. To jointly address these challenges, this paper proposes an efficient and reliable weighted $K$-nearest neighbor classification framework based on quantum granular balls, termed QGB-W$k$NN. The proposed framework improves computational efficiency by integrating quantum-enhanced granular-ball representation with hierarchical nearest-neighbor search, while enhancing classification reliability through a purity-aware weighted decision mechanism. Specifically, quantum-kernel granular balls are constructed to reduce retrieval redundancy and strengthen nonlinear feature representation under limited quantum resources. A granular-ball purity-guided HNSW optimization strategy is developed to exploit structural reliability for hierarchical graph construction during neighbor retrieval, alleviating the local optimality issue caused by conventional random layering. Finally, a weighted voting mechanism jointly incorporating granular-ball similarity and purity is introduced to produce more reliable classification decisions in noisy environments. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that QGB-W$k$NN achieves competitive classification accuracy while exhibiting favorable Pareto trade-offs between classification performance and computational cost. Moreover, the proposed framework consistently improves robustness under various noisy conditions, suggesting that reliability-aware quantum granular-ball learning provides a promising paradigm for efficient and robust nearest-neighbor classification.

</details>


### [553] [Transformers as In-Context Samplers: From Closed-Form Diffusion to Estimation-Free Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08981)
*Arman Adibi,Alireza Jafari,Mohammad Ghavamzadeh,Hadi Daneshmand*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明冻结的Transformer不仅能进行上下文学习（in-context learning）完成监督学习任务，还能模拟迭代式生成采样器进行数据生成。作者展示了Transformer可以实现闭式和解闭式平滑的扩散采样器，其中softmax注意力计算责任权重和加权经验均值，前馈层实现欧拉更新。在实证方面，通过语义主题采样任务（如动物、食物、城市），发现隐藏状态呈现两阶段几何结构——中间层趋向均匀球面参考，输出层回归主题相关结构，并验证了跨层U型能量模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的理论工作表明大语言模型能够在上下文中进行线性回归等监督学习任务的推断，但尚未证明这种能力能否扩展到数据生成领域。作者希望弥合这一理论空白，证明Transformer可以在无需参数更新的情况下，仅凭上下文中的样本模拟数据生成过程。

Method: 理论层面，作者证明Transformer可构造闭式和解闭式平滑的扩散采样器以及基于能量的采样器，其中softmax注意力负责计算责任权重和加权统计量，前馈层实现数值积分更新。实证层面，通过语义主题采样任务分析预训练语言模型隐藏状态的几何结构，并测量粒子间相互作用能量。

Result: 预训练Transformer的隐藏状态在层间呈现U型模式：中间层趋向均匀球面参考分布，输出层恢复主题相关的结构化表示；交互粒子能量的测量也呈现相同的U型曲线，这与理论构造的能量采样器行为一致。

Conclusion: 上下文学习能力不仅限于监督学习，还延伸到数据生成。冻结的Transformer能够从上下文样本中模拟生成式采样过程，且预训练模型的内部几何结构与理论构造的能量采样器形成对应，为理解LLM的生成机制提供了新视角。

Abstract: A growing body of work establishes that large language models are not mere statistical memorizers, but are capable of in-context learning: performing inference at test time using only examples provided in the prompt, without any parameter updates. Prior theoretical work has shown that this capability extends to supervised learning tasks such as linear regression. We prove that in-context learning extends further to \emph{data generation}: frozen transformers can simulate iterative generative samplers from in-context samples. We first show that transformers can realize closed-form and smoothed closed-form diffusion samplers. The construction identifies a concrete generative role for softmax attention: it computes responsibility weights and weighted empirical averages, while feedforward layers implement Euler updates.
  To empirically relate these constructions to pretrained language models, we study \emph{semantic-topic sampling}: prompts consisting of words drawn from a common semantic category, such as animals, foods, or cities. Across transformer layers, the normalized hidden states exhibit a two-stage geometry: they move toward a uniform spherical reference in intermediate layers and then return to structured, topic-dependent representations near the output. We further measure an interacting-particle energy on these hidden-state clouds and observe the same U-shape pattern. We then prove that transformers can approximate an energy-based sampler, constructing the same U-shape energy across the layers.

</details>


### [554] [LoGIC: Budgeted Context Construction for Node-Level Graph In-Context Learning with Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05955)
*Mingqi Yang,Zidong Guo,Jihui Yang,Wenming Zuo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LoGIC，一种为节点级图内上下文学习（ICL）构建高效上下文的方案。它通过结构、特征和覆盖三个通道检索标记节点，并为每个查询共享聚类局部上下文，同时引入未标记halo用于适配器消息传递，在保持全上下文性能的同时大幅降低峰值内存，使冻结的图ICL可在百万节点图上运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前的表格基础模型（如G2T-FM、GraphPFN）将节点编码为特征行并通过ICL进行预测，但现有协议使用完整训练表作为上下文，导致注意力与标记池呈平方级增长，并引入预处理和内存瓶颈。

Method: 将上下文分配形式化为两个资源预算：标记上下文预算（提供预测证据）和未标记halo预算（适配器消息传递）。LoGIC通过结构、特征和覆盖三个通道检索标记节点，在图像局部簇中为查询共享上下文，使用适配器骨干网并纳入未标记halo，且在无测试标签的情况下选择通道和上下文预算。

Result: 在GraphLand上跨三个骨干配置（来自两个模型家族），预算化上下文保持本地可运行的全上下文性能，与已发表的大规模数据集结果保持竞争力，并显著降低峰值内存要求。还支持在百万节点图上进行冻结图ICL推理而无需重训练。

Conclusion: 分析识别了各检索通道的最佳适用场景，并将其行为与图属性关联起来，为节点级图ICL的上下文构建提供了系统化的指导。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models have become powerful graph learners. Systems such as G2T-FM and GraphPFN encode each node as a feature row and make predictions through in-context learning (ICL), with labeled rows serving as the prompt. Current protocols employ the complete training table as context, causing attention to scale quadratically with the labeled pool and introducing preprocessing and memory bottlenecks. We investigate context construction for node-level graph ICL: which labeled nodes and auxiliary unlabeled nodes should constitute the prompt for specified queries. We formulate this allocation in terms of two resources: a labeled-context budget for predictive evidence and an unlabeled-halo budget for adapter message passing without using label capacity. We present LoGIC, which retrieves labeled nodes via structural, feature-based, and coverage channels, shares each context across the queries in a graph-local cluster, incorporates an unlabeled halo for adapter backbones, and chooses the channel and context budget without test labels. Across three backbone configurations drawn from two model families on GraphLand, budgeted contexts maintain locally runnable full-context performance, stay competitive with published large-dataset results, and markedly lower peak memory requirements compared with full-context and whole-graph inference. They further permit frozen graph ICL on million-node graphs without retraining. Our analysis identifies when retrieval channels work best and connects their behavior with graph properties.

</details>


### [555] [Nearly Tight Rademacher Bounds for Sparsely Activated Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09130)
*Xiaoyu Li,Zhizhou Sha,Jiaojiao Jiang,Junbin Gao,Andi Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究单隐层ReLU网络中"输入依赖稀疏性"的统计复杂度。核心发现是：每个输入最多激活k个单元（宽度为s）时，该类别在固定半径输入域上的Rademacher复杂度上界为CWR·min{k, √(sk/m)·log^{3/2}(2m)} + kB/√m，消除了之前显式的维度因子（至多对数因子）。下界匹配至对数因子，显示跨输入变化激活单元会保留宽度依赖。输入域的性质至关重要：在全球上稀疏的零偏置网络至多只有2k个非零单元且复杂度为O(kWR/√m)，而偏置与WR可比时恢复最坏情况率。还给出agnostic minimax excess-risk界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解输入依赖稀疏性（不同输入激活不同单元子集）对神经网络泛化能力统计复杂度的影响，特别是去除对隐藏层宽度s的显式依赖，以及阐明输入域（球vs采样支撑）在此类问题中的关键作用。

Method: 采用支持保持（support-preserving）覆盖方法和统一的归一化chaining论证来消除显式维度因子。此外构造球形帽（spherical-cap）结构证明偏置可比情形下的最坏情况率，并利用适当的i.i.d.边际分布建立匹配的下界。

Result: 得到Rademacher复杂度上界CWR·min{k, √(sk/m)log^{3/2}(2m)} + kB/√m；下界在i.i.d.边际上匹配至对数因子。零偏置球上稀疏网络复杂度为O(kWR/√m)（至多2k非零单元）；偏置与WR可比时在log维上达到最坏情况率。agnostic minimax excess-risk界为min{1, √(s/(km))}（至多对数因子）。

Conclusion: 输入依赖稀疏性以min{k, √(sk/m)}的形式决定统计复杂度，宽度依赖并未完全消失；偏置和输入域的选择对复杂度有本质影响——零偏置在球上强制单元数上界，而可比偏置恢复最坏情况率。该分析将复杂度从显式维度因子（modulo对数）中解放出来。

Abstract: An input may activate few hidden units even when different inputs collectively use an entire network. We study the statistical complexity of this input-dependent sparsity in the one-hidden-layer ReLU model of Awasthi et al. (COLT 2024). For width $s$, at most $k$ active units per input, and effective weight and bias bounds $W,B$, every size-$m$ sample in the class's fixed radius-$R$ input domain satisfies $\mathcal{R}(S)\le CWR\min\{k,\sqrt{sk/m}\log^{3/2}(2m)\}+kB/\sqrt m$. A support-preserving cover and a single normalized chaining argument remove the previous explicit dimension factor, up to logarithms. Lower bounds on appropriate i.i.d. marginals match up to those logarithms, showing how changing active units across inputs retains a width dependence. The input domain matters: zero-bias networks sparse on the entire ball have at most $2k$ nonzero units and complexity $O(kWR/\sqrt m)$, whereas bias bounds comparable to $WR$ restore the worst-case rate on that same domain in only logarithmic dimension. A spherical-cap construction proves the latter claim without assuming sparsity merely on the sampling support. For a specified normalized bounded loss and biases comparable to $WR$, we also obtain agnostic minimax excess-risk bounds of order $\min\{1,\sqrt{s/(km)}\}$ up to logarithms.

</details>


### [556] [Machine Learning for Pre-Culture ESBL Risk Stratification to Guide Empiric Antibiotic Selection: A 12-Hospital Study of Enterobacteriaceae Cultures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05970)
*Aravind V. Kuruvikkattil,Lalitha Pranathi Pulavarthy,Rashmita Kudamala,Saptarshi Purkayastha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 开发了一个成本敏感的XGBoost模型，利用45个培养前EHR特征预测ESBL表型，在12家医院132,955份培养样本（14.41%为ESBL表型）上达到90%敏感性时NPV为95.8%，可将ESBL后验概率降至4.2%，在非ICU场景下可能支持安全的碳青霉烯保留策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经验性抗生素治疗需在培养结果出来前48-72小时选择，临床医生面临两难：治疗不足会漏治耐药感染，而过度使用碳青霉烯又会加剧耐药性。需要一个在培养下单时即可预测ESBL表型的工具来辅助决策。

Method: 使用成本敏感的XGBoost模型，采用45个培养前EHR特征，在患者层面划分数据（132,955份培养，72,217名患者，12家医院），在90%敏感性阈值下评估NPV和碳青霉烯保留效果，并通过SHAP分析识别关键预测因子，进行多种敏感性分析（严格IDSA定义、标本类型、无类别不平衡校正、不同菌株分层）。

Result: 90%敏感性下NPV达95.8%（后验ESBL概率降至4.2%），每1,000份培养可避免307次不必要广谱疗程，代价是每1,000份漏诊14例ESBL。AUROC在不同条件下稳定（0.762-0.766），不同菌株分层下为0.71-0.78。SHAP显示先前ESBL定植为最主要预测因子；移除邻里剥夺特征仅致AUROC下降0.020。

Conclusion: 该模型在培养下单时即可准确预测ESBL表型，且性能在多场景验证下稳健。去除剥夺特征后性能损失极小，支持公平的床旁部署，有望在非ICU环境中安全支持碳青霉烯保留，平衡治疗充分性与抗生素管理。

Abstract: Empiric antibiotic therapy for suspected ESBL-producing Enterobacteriaceae must be selected 48-72 hours before culture results, forcing clinicians to choose between undertreating resistant infections and overusing carbapenems that drive further resistance. We developed a cost-sensitive XGBoost model predicting an ESBL phenotype (resistance to ceftriaxone, ceftazidime, cefepime or piperacillin-tazobactam) at culture ordering using 45 pre-culture EHR features across 132,955 cultures from 72,217 patients at 12 hospitals (14.41% with the ESBL phenotype). Cultures were partitioned at the patient level. At 90% sensitivity, the model achieved 95.8% NPV, reducing post-test ESBL probability to 4.2%, a threshold that may support safe carbapenem-sparing in non-ICU settings, while sparing 307 of every 1,000 cultures an unnecessary broad-spectrum course at the cost of 14 missed ESBL cases per 1,000. SHAP analysis identified prior ESBL colonization as the dominant predictor, ahead of prior organism burden and neighborhood deprivation; removing deprivation features caused minimal performance loss ($Δ\text{AUROC} = -0.020$), enabling equitable bedside deployment. Discrimination was unchanged under a strict IDSA ESBL-E definition (AUROC 0.766), with specimen type added as a predictor (0.764) and without any class-imbalance correction (0.762), and ranged from 0.71 to 0.78 across organism strata.

</details>


### [557] [DART: Distributional Adversarial Recurrent Training for Algorithm Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05988)
*Hieu Tran Bao,Phung Thanh Dang,Pham Quang Nhat Minh,Hoang Thanh Tung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出分布对抗递归训练（DART），用局部目标分布替代单点监督，并通过对抗目标使模型输出与该分布对齐，从而提升递归推理模型（RRMs）在困难任务上的解质量、稳定性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归推理模型依赖实例级单点监督进行训练，但随着任务难度增加，有效解在解空间中的占比极小，无效解却迅速增多，导致监督信号不足，训练愈发困难。

Method: DART框架用围绕真实解（ground-truth solution）的局部目标分布替代单点监督，并通过对抗目标（adversarial objective）让模型输出与该目标分布对齐，从而提供更丰富的学习信号并促进更稳定的迭代轨迹。

Result: 在Maze、Chess和masked Sudoku任务上，配合多种RRMs（包括Deep Thinking Systems和Tiny Recursive Models），DART提升了解质量、稳定性和在评估分布偏移下的鲁棒性。与标签平滑、高斯软化目标和渐进训练对比，DART的收益不能仅由目标软化解释，且与稳定长时递归的训练方案互补。

Conclusion: DART是提升递归推理模型鲁棒性的有前景的训练框架，为克服实例级监督在困难任务中的局限性提供了新思路。

Abstract: Recurrent reasoning models (RRMs) can solve structured problems, achieving easy-to-hard generalization through iterative computation in hidden space. These models are typically trained with instance-level supervision, which becomes increasingly problematic as task difficulty grows: valid solutions occupy a tiny region of the solution space, while invalid solutions proliferate rapidly. We propose Distributional Adversarial Recurrent Training (DART), a training framework that replaces single-point supervision with a local target distribution around the ground-truth solution and aligns model outputs with this distribution through an adversarial objective. DART provides a richer learning signal and encourages more stable iterative trajectories toward valid solutions. When evaluated on Maze, Chess, and masked Sudoku with multiple RRMs, including Deep Thinking Systems and Tiny Recursive Models, DART improves solution quality, stability, and robustness under the evaluated distribution shifts. Comparisons with label smoothing, Gaussian softened targets, and progressive training show that DART is not explained by target softening alone and is complementary to training schemes that stabilize long-horizon recurrence. These results identify DART as a promising approach for improving robustness across the evaluated recurrent reasoning models.

</details>


### [558] [Memory in Deep Time-Series Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06006)
*Minh Hoang Nguyen,Huu Hiep Nguyen,Manh Nguyen,Van Dai Do,Dung Nguyen,Hung Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将时序建模中的信息保留与访问问题统一视为"记忆"问题，构建了一个独立于骨干网络架构的记忆机制分类体系，将现有方法沿内部记忆到外部记忆的光谱进行组织，并综述了三类外部记忆机制，最后指出开放问题与未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序深度学习经历了一系列架构范式的演进（循环网络、Transformer、状态空间模型、检索增强预测器、基础模型、工具使用智能体），但这些进展通常按架构或时代孤立地研究。作者认为它们可以通过一个共同的核心问题统一起来：时序模型如何在其直接输入之外保留和访问信息？传统的固定尺寸状态压缩可能丢失后续有用的信息，而输入窗口有限又无法覆盖远处的相关信息，这一根本局限被形式化为"记忆"问题。

Method: 作者提出将现有时序方法组织在一条从内部记忆（参数和固定尺寸状态中编码）到外部记忆（可寻址、可检索、日益由智能体维护）的光谱上。在此基础上，开发了一套统一的记忆机制分类体系，并在共同框架（保留什么、如何写入和访问、如何持久化）下综述了三类外部记忆：显式模块、检索增强和智能体存储。最后进行跨领域分析，将记忆机制映射到时序任务并识别方法及评估中的空白。

Result: 文章产出了一个"记忆作为时序建模第一类维度"的分析框架，独立于底层骨干网络。通过统一分类学综述了外部记忆的三类机制（显式模块、检索增强、智能体存储），并进行了将记忆机制与时序任务映射的跨领域分析，识别出现有方法与评估体系中的差距。

Conclusion: 作者指出构建记忆系统面临的开放问题：如何在时间环境演化中实现选择性地保留、检索、修订和遗忘信息。该框架为未来研究提供了独立于架构的记忆中心视角，为时序建模中的记忆系统设计奠定基础。

Abstract: Deep learning for time series has progressed through successive architectural paradigms, from recurrent networks and transformers to structured state-space models, retrieval-augmented predictors, foundation models, and tool-using agents. These developments are typically studied in isolation, organized by architecture or modeling era. We argue that they can instead be viewed through a common question of \emph{how does a time-series model retain and access information beyond its immediate input?} This question is motivated by a fundamental limitation of conventional time-series modeling: information relevant to a prediction may lie far beyond a feasible input window, while compressing history into a fixed-size state can discard information that may become useful later. We formulate this challenge as a \emph{memory} problem and organize existing time-series methods along a spectrum from internal memory, encoded in parameters and fixed-size states, to external memory that is addressable, retrievable, and increasingly maintained by agents. We then develop a unified taxonomy of memory mechanisms and review three classes of external memory, including explicit modules, retrieval augmentation, and agentic stores, under a common framework for what is retained, how it is written and accessed, and how it persists. A cross-cutting analysis maps these mechanisms to time-series tasks and identifies gaps in both methods and evaluation. We conclude by outlining open problems in building memory systems that can selectively retain, retrieve, revise, and forget information as temporal environments evolve. The result is a framework for studying memory as a first-class dimension of time series modeling, independent of the underlying backbone.

</details>


### [559] [Granular-Ball Quantum Clustering for Resource-Efficient and Robust Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06016)
*Suzhen Yuan,Qilin Xie,Lifeng Shen,Shuyin Xia,Jermiah D. Deng,Guoying Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出粒度球量子聚类（GBQC）框架，通过PCA引导的粒度球抽象压缩数据、结合量子相干性过滤噪声，在减少80%量子核评估的同时提升聚类精度和鲁棒性，解决了量子聚类中样本复杂度高与结构保持之间的两难困境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子聚类虽能利用量子特征表示发现超越欧几里得几何的复杂数据结构，但逐样本核构建需要O(n²)次量子电路执行，在近期量子资源约束下成为严重瓶颈。现有方法无法解决效率-精度两难：经典粒度球聚类依赖欧几里得度量无法捕捉量子相关性，而现有量子压缩方案牺牲结构保持导致非凸或噪声数据上性能退化。

Method: GBQC框架将粒度球结构抽象与量子特征学习紧密耦合。首先通过PCA引导的切分策略将原始数据压缩为紧凑且有代表性的粒度球，将核评估减少80%；随后设计量子相干性机制在希尔伯特空间中过滤噪声颗粒以增强聚类鲁棒性。

Result: 在合成、噪声、重叠及真实数据集上的大量实验表明，GBQC相比代表性经典和量子聚类方法持续获得更优的聚类精度和鲁棒性。同时，粒度球压缩显著降低了量子核评估和计算开销，使量子聚类实验能在参数化量子学习框架中应用于更大规模数据集。

Conclusion: 粒度球表示不仅作为降低量子计算成本的压缩机制，还作为有效的结构抽象机制，通过消除冗余和结构模糊的学习单元来提升聚类质量。

Abstract: Quantum clustering aims to exploit quantum feature representations to uncover complex data structures beyond conventional Euclidean geometry. Yet this sample-level kernel construction requires O(n^2) quantum circuit executions for n data points, creating a major bottleneck under near-term quantum resource constraints. Prior solutions fail to resolve this efficiency-accuracy dilemma: classical granular-ball clustering reduces sample complexity but relies on Euclidean metrics that cannot capture quantum correlations, while existing quantum compression schemes prioritize efficiency over structural preservation, degrading performance on non-convex or noisy data. Here we propose Granular-Ball Quantum Clustering (GBQC), a framework that tightly couples granular-ball structural abstraction with quantum feature learning. GBQC first compresses raw data into compact, representative granular balls via a PCA-guided splitting strategy, reducing kernel evaluations by 80% compared to full-sample methods. A quantum cohesion mechanism then filters noisy granules in Hilbert space to improve clustering robustness. Extensive experiments on synthetic, noisy, overlapping, and real-world datasets demonstrate that GBQC consistently achieves superior clustering accuracy and robustness compared with representative classical and quantum clustering methods. Meanwhile, the proposed granular-ball compression significantly reduces quantum kernel evaluations and computational overhead, enabling quantum clustering experiments on larger datasets within parameterized quantum learning frameworks. These results suggest that granular-ball representations serve not only as a compression mechanism to reduce quantum computational costs but also as an effective structural abstraction mechanism that improves clustering quality by eliminating redundant and structurally ambiguous learning units.

</details>


### [560] [IXPLORE: Bounded Ideal Point Estimation with Grid-Based Uncertainty Quantification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06018)
*Fynn Bachmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: IXPLORE是一种有界理想点估计算法，结合预测拟合目标与稀疏感知似然函数，在五个基准数据集上超越了基于模型和机器学习的方法，尤其在稀疏响应用户的重建与插补误差方面表现优异，并提供网格贝叶斯后验推断以实现不确定性量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理想点估计在政治数据分析中广泛使用，但现有方法存在权衡：基于模型的方法（如IRT）依赖效用函数而非优化预测精度；大多数机器学习替代方法在嵌入稀疏测试响应时难以泛化到训练数据之外。

Method: 提出IXPLORE算法，核心有三：(1) 结合预测拟合目标与稀疏感知似然函数；(2) 引入非线性特征变换进一步降低重建误差并保持视觉可解释性；(3) 在二维有界潜在空间上应用基于网格的后验推断来量化不确定性。

Result: 在涵盖调查、唱名投票和审议的五个基准数据集上，IXPLORE在重建误差和插补误差方面均优于模型基与机器学习基算法，尤其对稀疏响应用户优势明显；非线性特征变换可进一步降低重建误差。

Conclusion: IXPLORE提供了一个灵活框架，用于构建有界、可解释的政治图谱，具有快速推断和强大的插补性能，并已作为Python包发布在PyPI上。

Abstract: Ideal point estimation is widely used to analyze and visualize political data. However, selecting the corresponding spatial model involves various trade-offs: while model-based approaches such as Item Response Theory (IRT) are based on utility functions rather than optimized for predictive accuracy, most Machine Learning (ML) alternatives struggle to generalize beyond training data when embedding sparse test responses. We introduce IXPLORE, a bounded ideal point estimation algorithm that combines a predictive fit objective with a sparsity-aware likelihood function. On five benchmark datasets spanning surveys, roll calls, and deliberation, this approach surpasses model-based and ML-based algorithms on reconstruction and imputation error - especially for users with sparse responses. Furthermore, we show that non-linear feature transforms can further reduce the reconstruction error while remaining visually interpretable. To quantify uncertainty, IXPLORE applies grid-based posterior inference on a bounded 2D latent space. Available as a Python package on PyPI, IXPLORE offers a flexible framework for constructing bounded, interpretable political maps with fast inference and strong imputation performance.

</details>


### [561] [Minimizing the Effect of Sleep Deprivation in the Forward-Forward Algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06042)
*Joy Datta,Puja Saha,Rawhatur Rabbi,Nafiz Imtiaz Rafin,Swakkhar Shatabda,Md. Golam Rabiul Alam,Chad Mourning*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了Forward-Forward算法在"睡眠剥夺"情境下的学习性能退化问题，通过改进激活函数、优化损失函数、阈值调整以及引入周期性休息（减少正样本传递轮次）和咖啡因刺激等策略，在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上将严重睡眠剥夺（16个清醒期、1个睡眠期）条件下的准确率提升了2%-62%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Forward-Forward算法中两个pass分离及数据处理不平衡被视作对人类睡眠剥夺认知过程的模拟，但先前研究表明睡眠剥夺对学习效果有灾难性影响，亟需缓解该问题。

Method: 采用多种缓解策略：替代激活函数、优化损失函数、阈值调整；通过交替epoch中减少正pass数量模拟周期性休息（短休息阶段）；额外引入咖啡因刺激来提升睡眠剥夺条件下的性能。

Result: 在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上验证了这些修改在睡眠剥夺情境下能显著提升准确率，例如在严重睡眠剥夺设置（16个清醒期与1个睡眠期）下获得2%-62%的准确率提升。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法不仅增强了算法在睡眠剥夺条件下的鲁棒性，还使其更贴合人类认知的适应性机制。

Abstract: This paper addresses the challenge posed by sleep deprivation in the Forward-Forward algorithm, where separating the two passes in this algorithm and imbalancing the data processing in the passes is considered an imitation of the cognitive processes observed in humans suffering from sleep deprivation. Previous research has demonstrated that sleep deprivation in the Forward-Forward algorithm has a catastrophic effect on learning efficacy. To mitigate this issue, we explore several approaches; these include alternative activation, optimized loss function, and threshold tuning. To simulate periodic rest, we reduce the number of positive passes in alternating epochs, creating short break phases. We additionally investigate the potential of caffeine-induced stimulation to enhance performance during sleep-deprived conditions. Experimental evaluations conducted on the MNIST and Fashion-MNIST datasets demonstrate that these modifications improve accuracy under the context of sleep deprivation. For example, a 2%-62% accuracy gain is observed in a severe sleep deprivation setting (16 positive or awake periods and 1 negative or sleep period). The approaches also enhance the resilience of the algorithm and its alignment with the adaptive mechanisms of human cognition.

</details>


### [562] [Data Quality Rule Generation with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06053)
*Anna-Christina Glock,Thomas Hütter,Johannes Fürnkranz,Wolfram Wöß,Christine Dominka-Kiss,Lisa Ehrlinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LeDQeR，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动化数据质量（DQ）规则生成方法，通过生成-过滤框架自动生成可执行、正确、可泛化且不冗余的数据验证规则，以解决传统人工维护规则集成本高、易遗漏的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据验证（如客户和员工数据）在许多组织中至关重要，数据错误可能带来严重后果（如病历中药物单位错误可危及生命）。企业常使用基于规则的数据质量工具，但人工维护全面的规则集具有挑战性，领域专家在复杂领域和大数据量下常遗漏关键规则，因此自动化DQ规则生成是实践中亟待解决的开放问题。

Method: 作者形式化了一个可泛化的生成-过滤框架，并引入LeDQeR方法。首先，利用LLM从观察到的脏数据元组中，针对给定规则型DQ工具语法生成候选规则；其次，应用四种过滤技术确保生成规则满足：(i)可执行性、(ii)正确性、(iii)可泛化性，并避免(iv)冗余性。

Result: 大量实验评估表明，LeDQeR能够在多种数据集和错误类型下生成有效且紧凑的规则集。

Conclusion: LeDQeR成功结合LLM的语义理解能力与自动化过滤机制，为自动化数据质量规则生成提供了一个有效且实用的解决方案，解决了人工维护规则集易遗漏的实践难题。

Abstract: The validation of data, such as customer and employee data, is an important task in many organizations. Errors in data can have severe consequences. For example, a wrong drug unit in a patient record can lead to life-threatening medication errors, and a missing street number in an address to failed deliveries. Companies often employ rule-based enterprise data quality (DQ) tools, which allow domain experts to specify rules to validate the data over time. While rule-based DQ tools are computationally efficient and provide explainable reports, maintaining a comprehensive rule set manually is challenging, as domain experts often overlook essential rules, especially in complex domains and large data volumes. Hence, closing these gaps remains an open problem in practice. In this paper, we address the challenge of automated DQ rule generation. For this, we formalize a generalizable generate-filter framework and introduce LeDQeR, an LLM-based DQ rule generation approach. First, a large language model (LLM) generates candidates rules from an observed dirty data tuple for a given rule-based DQ tool syntax. Second, we apply four filter techniques that ensure the (i) executability, (ii) correctness, and (iii) generalizability, and avoid (iv) redundancy of the generated rules. An extensive experimental evaluation suggests that LeDQeR is able to produce effective and compact rule sets for various datasets and error types.

</details>


### [563] [Calendar-SPCA: Interpretable Representation Learning for Multi-Periodic Electricity Consumption Profiles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06060)
*Carlos Quesada-Granja,Tony Castillo-Calzadilla,Carlos Rizo-Maestre*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Calendar-SPCA方法，一种结合日历多周期结构的稀疏主成分分析方法，用于长期电力消费曲线的低维表示学习。该方法在日历图上施加L1稀疏惩罚和图全变差正则化，在两个智能电表数据集上验证，在保持大部分PCA解释方差的同时产生高稀疏度且时间上局部连贯的载荷模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期电力消费数据具有每日、每周和年度等多重周期性结构，但传统低维表示学习方法（如PCA、稀疏PCA）未利用这一已知的多周期几何先验信息，导致学习到的特征难以在原始时间坐标中直接解释。

Method: 将特征域表示为循环日历轴的笛卡尔积，形成日历图结构；在日历图上进行低秩分解，目标函数包含L1稀疏加载惩罚和基于日历图的图全变差正则化；通过因子实验系统分析稀疏性和日历一致性的互补效应及鲁棒性。

Result: 在秩为15时，Calendar-SPCA在GoiEner和Low Carbon London数据集上分别保留了rank匹配PCA的96.92%和82.90%解释方差，平均载荷稀疏度达61.95%和81.50%；与经典稀疏PCA和SPCA-TV相比，Calendar-SPCA在保留显著低秩信息的同时，实现了潜在因子在原始日历坐标中的系统组织化。

Conclusion: Calendar-SPCA能够生成连贯且互补的每日、每周、季节性和联合局部化的日历模式，并展现出数据集特定的几何特征，为带有多周期结构的时序数据低维分析提供了一种可解释性强且信息保留度高的有效方法。

Abstract: Long-term electricity-consumption profiles exhibit several simultaneous periodic structures, including daily, weekly, and annual cycles. This work introduces Calendar-SPCA, a calendar-structured sparse principal component method that incorporates this known multi-periodic geometry directly into low-dimensional representation learning. The feature domain is represented as the Cartesian product of cyclic calendar axes, and a low-rank factorization is estimated using an L1 loading penalty together with graph total variation over the resulting calendar graph. The method therefore produces sparse and locally coherent loading patterns that remain directly readable in their original temporal coordinates. Calendar-SPCA is evaluated on two independent smart-meter datasets with different sample sizes and temporal resolutions: GoiEner and Low Carbon London. A factorial experiment characterizes the complementary effects of sparsity and calendar coherence and examines robustness across sample size, latent dimensionality, and repeated fits. At rank 15, Calendar-SPCA retains 96.92% and 82.90% of the explained variance of rank-matched PCA in GoiEner and Low Carbon London, respectively, while producing mean loading sparsities of 61.95% and 81.50%. Comparisons with classical sparse PCA and SPCA-TV further show that Calendar-SPCA adds a systematic organization of the latent factors in the original calendar coordinates while preserving substantial low-rank information. The resulting components form coherent and complementary daily, weekly, seasonal, and jointly localized calendar patterns, with dataset-specific geometries across the two datasets.

</details>


### [564] [ACE: Adapter Consolidation across Experts for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of MoE LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06072)
*Ahin Lee,Sehyun Yun,Joonha Park,Taesik Gong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ACE（Adapter Consolidation across Experts）提出将MoE模型中专家专属的LoRA适配器进行分组合并，用组共享的高秩LoRA模块替代冗余的专家专属适配器，同时引入分组执行将碎片化计算合并为更大规模的GEMM操作，在保持参数预算不变的前提下提升精度和训练速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PEFT方法对MoE模型采用每个专家独立附加低秩适配器的设计，但这种专家级碎片化方案存在三重问题：容量被分割到狭窄的低秩更新中、稀疏路由导致梯度监督稀疏不均衡、执行被分解为大量小型GEMM。作者发现大量专家专属适配器在微调过程中变得功能相似，存在冗余，因此不必要保留完全独立的专家适配器。

Method: 首先识别在微调过程中功能趋于相似的冗余专家组，然后将组内专家的专属LoRA适配器合并为组共享的高秩LoRA模块（在相同PEFT参数预算下）。同时引入分组适配器执行机制，将碎片化的专家级适配器计算整合为更少的组级大规模GEMM运算。

Result: 在12个数据集和4个MoE主干网络上进行评估，ACE在三个具有完整基线覆盖的主干网络上取得了参数匹配PEFT方法中最高的平均准确率，相比专家级LoRA提供1.31倍至1.48倍的墙钟训练加速，且不增加峰值内存。

Conclusion: 专家级适配器在MoE微调中存在系统性冗余，通过合理分组与合并可以在不增加参数预算和内存的前提下同时提升模型精度与计算效率，为MoE模型的PEFT提供了一种新的高效范式。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of mixture-of-experts (MoE) models commonly attaches a separate low-rank adapter to each expert. This expert-wise design fragments adaptation in three ways: capacity is split across narrow low-rank updates, gradient supervision becomes sparse and imbalanced under sparse routing, and execution is decomposed into many small GEMMs. We find that such expert-wise separation is often unnecessary, as subsets of LoRA adapters become functionally similar during fine-tuning, revealing redundancy among expert-specific adapters. Based on this redundancy, we propose ACE (Adapter Consolidation across Experts), which groups redundant experts and replaces their expert-specific adapters with group-shared higher-rank LoRA modules under the same PEFT budget. ACE further introduces grouped adapter execution, which consolidates fragmented expert-wise adapter computations into fewer, larger group-level GEMMs. Across evaluations covering 12 datasets and four MoE backbones, ACE achieves the highest observed mean accuracy among the parameter-matched PEFT methods on the three backbones with complete baseline coverage, while providing $1.31\times$ to $1.48\times$ wall-clock training speedup over expert-wise LoRA without increasing peak memory. Our code is available at https://github.com/UbiquitousAILab/ACE.

</details>


### [565] [FedSubMuon: Communication-Efficient Federated LLM Fine-Tuning via Structured Subspace Muon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.06073)
*Shaolong Chen,Youming Tao,Shuzhen Chen,Falko Dressler,Qingqing Ye,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedSubMuon和FedSubMuon-GT，一种通信高效的联邦Muon微调方法。该方法在共享结构化子空间内优化紧凑系数矩阵，保留Muon对单个矩阵值可训练对象的矩阵感知更新几何，同时将客户端上传量压缩为紧凑系数矩阵。实验表明在指令微调和数学推理任务上，FedSubMuon-GT在五组数据集-模型组合中的四组取得最佳精度，FedSubMuon在所有匹配通信预算下表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦微调将大语言模型适应分散的客户端数据，但其跨设备训练的可扩展性常受高通信成本限制。现有联邦Muon方法虽然证明了矩阵感知优化在联邦学习中的优势，但仍需传输完整层规模的更新和优化器状态。直接对LoRA因子应用Muon会改变优化对象并削弱Muon的矩阵感知更新几何，因此需要一种既能保持Muon优势又能降低通信成本的方法。
