Conclusion: 所提出的分类风险导向的标签采集准则在渐近意义上最优地分配标注预算，其价值在于关注扰动主动贝叶斯决策边界的参数方向，而非单纯基于不确定性。在有限预算下优于完整分类信息比较器，但在预算充足时各策略差异趋于收敛。

Abstract: We study how a limited labeling budget should be allocated to minimize multiclass zero-one classification risk. We consider parametric classification problems in which features are observed for all sampling units while class labels can be acquired selectively. By combining the Fisher information supplied by an acquired label with the local geometry of multiclass excess risk, we derive an acquisition criterion that minimizes the leading asymptotic coefficient of expected multiclass excess risk. The resulting rule values a label according to how strongly its information is aligned with parameter directions that perturb the active Bayes decision boundary, rather than according to posterior uncertainty or global parameter information alone. We characterize the oracle acquisition design, establish its threshold structure, and derive face-specific and cost-sensitive extensions. An analytic example shows that posterior uncertainty and classification value can produce different, and even reversed, acquisition rankings. We further develop a two-stage adaptive procedure that attains the oracle leading-risk criterion under regularity conditions and provide explicit results for Gaussian discriminant analysis. Three-class QDA experiments illustrate the resulting acquisition geometry, while an application to the six-class Statlog Landsat Satellite data shows that classification-risk acquisition can differ materially from both uncertainty-based acquisition and the complete-classification-information comparator. The adaptive classification-risk design attains lower mean error than this Fisher comparator across the labeling budgets considered, although it does not uniformly outperform entropy or margin sampling and differences among the targeted strategies become small as the labeling budget increases.

</details>


### [773] [Distributed Lag Neural Additive Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07381)
*Calle Helmersson,Shivang Pandey,Leonardo Olivetti,Elena Raffetti*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出分布式滞后神经加性模型（DLNAMs），用神经组件替代DLNMs中预设的样条交叉基来学习暴露-滞后响应曲面，在保持加性可解释性和分布式滞后摘要的同时，避免基函数族、维度和节点位置的选择。通过指数中心输入层、平滑激活和学习子网络混合实现平滑且局部自适应的表示，不确定性采用条件最后一层拉普拉斯近似与成员间集成分散的结合。模拟实验表明DLNAMs在恢复已知响应函数方面总体优于DLNM比较模型（含惩罚和树变体），偏差更低、边界恢复更强、累积区间校准更好，且在样本量、结果族、滞后范围及多暴露联合拟合下表现稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统DLNMs依赖预设样条交叉基，需要用户选择基函数族、维度和节点位置，这种先验选择可能限制模型灵活性和拟合质量，亟需更自适应且保持可解释性的替代方案。

Method: DLNAMs采用神经网络架构：指数中心化输入层编码滞后结构，平滑激活函数保证输出平滑性，学习子网络混合机制赋予局部自适应能力；不确定性估计结合条件最后一层拉普拉斯近似与集成成员间变异的点态置信区间。

Result: 模拟实验中DLNAMs在恢复已知响应函数上通常优于DLNM比较模型（包括惩罚和树变体），具备更低的偏差、更强的边界恢复能力和更优的累积区间校准；在更具挑战性的函数上优势最显著。方法在多种样本量、结果族、滞后范围及联合多暴露设定下保持一致性能。

Conclusion: DLNAMs作为DLNMs的神经加性替代方案，在消除预规范选择负担的同时提供更优的恢复性能和自适应表达能力，能复现既有的实证模式，具备广泛适用性。

Abstract: We introduce Distributed Lag Neural Additive Models (DLNAMs), neural-additive analogues of Distributed Lag Non-linear Models (DLNMs) for learning nonlinear effects distributed over lags. DLNAMs replace a prespecified spline cross-basis with neural components that learn exposure--lag response surfaces, avoiding choices of basis family, dimension, and knot placement while preserving additive interpretability and familiar distributed-lag summaries. Exp-centered input layers, smooth activations, and learned subnetwork mixtures produce smooth, locally adaptive representations; pointwise uncertainty combines a conditional last-layer Laplace approximation with between-member ensemble variation. In simulations, DLNAMs generally outperformed DLNM comparators, including penalized and treed variants, in recovering known response functions, with lower bias, stronger boundary recovery, and better-calibrated cumulative intervals; gains were largest for more demanding functions. The architecture performed consistently across sample sizes, outcome families, lag horizons, and jointly fitted multi-exposure settings, retaining recovery performance as exposures were added; fit-specific changes were largely confined to optimization, and applications recovered established empirical patterns.

</details>


### [774] [SGD in Multiclass Logistic Regression: Sequential Learning and Scaling Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07868)
*Konstantinos Christopher Tsiolis,Denny Wu,Christos Thrampoulidis,Murat A. Erdogdu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究了高维高斯混合模型上多分类逻辑回归的训练动力学，建立了交叉熵风险在梯度优化下的精确缩放定律，并拓展到计算最优缩放定律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有理论缩放定律主要针对线性回归，缺乏对多分类任务在梯度优化下训练动力学的严格理论刻画，而实际大规模神经网络中观察到的经验缩放定律需要更基础的理论支撑。

Method: 在高斯混合模型设定下分析多分类逻辑回归的训练动力学，推导风险随类别频率顺序学习的精确缩放律；通过向主成分投影限制有效维度，将风险分解为容量项和优化项，并对二者的权衡进行优化。

Result: 揭示了类别按频率从高到低顺序学习的现象；当先验服从幂律分布时，风险动力学呈现三个阶段（初始平台期、幂律衰减期、最终收敛期）；推导出逻辑回归的计算最优缩放定律，给出了模型大小和训练时间的显式表达式。

Conclusion: 将缩放定律理论从线性回归扩展到多分类场景，建立了与大规模神经网络中经验缩放定律的理论联系，为理解计算预算约束下模型容量与优化的权衡提供了严谨框架。

Abstract: We study the training dynamics of multiclass logistic regression on high-dimensional Gaussian mixture models with a large number of classes and establish precise scaling laws governing the cross-entropy risk under gradient-based optimization. We show that learning proceeds sequentially across classes, from most to least frequent. When the class priors follow a power law distribution, the risk dynamics decompose into three phases: an initial plateau until the first class is learned, a power-law decay regime during which sequential learning occurs, and a final convergence regime.
  We then analyze how model capacity interacts with optimization under a fixed compute budget. When the effective dimension is restricted via projection onto leading principal components, the risk decomposes into a capacity term (a power law in the retained dimension) and an optimization term (a power law in training time). Optimizing this tradeoff yields a compute-optimal scaling law for logistic regression, with explicit prescriptions for model size and training time as functions of compute. These results extend theoretical scaling laws from linear regression to multiclass classification, while connecting to empirical scaling laws observed in large-scale neural networks.

</details>


### [775] [The Role of Uncertainty in Assessing the Fairness of Machine Learning Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07959)
*Francesca Panero,Ernst C. Wit,Marco Scutari*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文超越传统的点估计方法，探讨公平机器学习中的不确定性量化问题，分别从频率学派和贝叶斯学派两个角度出发，并结合模拟和真实数据的实际案例来阐述其在公平性风险评估中的意义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型广泛应用于临床、社交媒体、执法和关键基础设施等场景，确保其输出不对弱势群体产生偏见至关重要。然而现有文献大多只关注寻找一个在预测准确性和公平性之间取得平衡的单一模型（点估计），而忽略了与模型选择和估计相关的不确定性，这使得对公平性违规的严格风险评估变得困难。

Method: 本文采用频率学派和贝叶斯学派两种统计框架对公平机器学习中的不确定性进行量化，并通过模拟数据和真实数据的实际案例展示两种方法的具体应用与含义。

Result: 通过实际案例展示了频率学派和贝叶斯方法在公平机器学习不确定性量化中的可行性和实践价值，说明了超越点估计可以更全面地评估公平性风险。

Conclusion: 公平机器学习的不确定性量化是进行严格公平性风险评估的必要环节，频率学派和贝叶斯方法提供了互补的工具体系，有助于更可靠地指导模型在敏感领域的部署。

Abstract: Machine learning models are widely used in clinical applications, social media, law enforcement and critical infrastructure. Verifying whether their outputs are biased against disadvantaged groups or individuals is crucial to ensuring they are fair and allowing their use in such settings. A rigorous risk assessment of possible fairness violations requires quantifying the uncertainty associated with selecting and estimating such models. Yet, this is rarely done in the literature, which focuses on identifying a single model with a suitable trade-off between predictive accuracy and fairness. In this paper, we move beyond point estimation and discuss frequentist and Bayesian approaches to uncertainty quantification for fair machine learning, with practical examples and implications for simulated and real data.

</details>


### [776] [Distribution-free inference on the number of changepoints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08234)
*Rohan Hore,Aaditya Ramdas*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究在数据分布发生未知次数K次变化的情况下，如何对K进行无分布假设的统计推断。作者首先证明了对K构造任何分布无关的上置信界是不可能的（必然平凡无信息），然后利用保形p值，在数据段内可交换且段间相互独立的假设下，构造了一个有限样本有效的K下置信界，称为CLOCC（Conformal LOwer bound on Changepoint Count）。作者证明了CLOCC在所述假设下是为K提供下界的唯一可行方法（即普适性），并提供了选择评分函数的实用指南。合成数据与真实数据实验表明CLOCC能提供信息量丰富的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 变点检测问题中，通常的推断关注于变点位置或数量，但现有方法多依赖参数假设（如分布族已知）。在完全无分布假设下对未知变点数K进行统计推断尚未被系统研究，特别是：对K做上界推断是否可行？对K做下界推断是否可行且如何实现？本文旨在填补这一空白，探索在极弱假设下关于K的可行性边界。

Method: （1）证明不可能性结果：在无分布假设下，任何K的上置信界必然是平凡（trivial）且无信息量的。（2）提出CLOCC方法：利用保形p值（conformal p-values）构造K的有限样本有效下置信界。其核心假设为变点分割出的数据段内部可交换、段间相互独立。（3）证明CLOCC的普适性（universality）：在所述假设下，它是提供K下界的唯一可行方式。（4）提供评分函数选择指南以提升下界的紧致性与效率。

Result: 理论上建立了变点数K在分布无关推断下的可行性边界：上界不可行（平凡性），下界可行且CLOCC是最优/唯一方案。实验上，在合成数据和真实数据中，CLOCC均产生了具有实际信息量的K下界，验证了方法的实用性。

Conclusion: 本文系统性地刻画了在无分布假设下对变点数K进行推断的理论边界（上界不可行、下界可行），并提出了理论上最优、实践上有效的CLOCC方法，为变点计数问题提供了一种全新的分布无关推断范式。

Abstract: Suppose we are given an ordered sequence of independent data whose distribution changes $K$ times at unknown locations, for some unknown $K \geq 0$. In this paper, we study the problem of performing distribution-free inference on $K$. First, we show an impossibility result: any distribution-free upper confidence bound on $K$ must be trivial and uninformative. Then, using conformal $p$-values, and under only the assumption that the data segments induced by the changepoints are exchangeable (within themselves) and mutually independent, we construct a finite-sample valid lower confidence bound on $K$, which we call the Conformal LOwer bound on Changepoint Count (CLOCC). We show that CLOCC is the only feasible way to provide a lower bound on $K$ under the stated assumptions, a property we refer to as its universality. We provide practical guidelines for choosing score functions that yield efficient and tight lower bounds. We evaluate CLOCC in several synthetic and real-data experiments, where it provides informative lower bounds on $K$, demonstrating its practical applicability.

</details>


### [777] [Non-Adaptive 1-Bit Mean Estimation: Minimax Rates and the Sample-Interval Tradeoff](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08564)
*Ivan Lau,Jonathan Scarlett*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究一维均值估计在1比特通信约束下的分布式问题。作者发现，对于任意k>1，非自适应协议可以达到与自适应协议相同的1比特极小极大速率（这与Lau和Scarlett提出的问题形成对比）。此外，作者进一步刻画了当每个one-set被限制为最多s个区间的并集时，非自适应1比特估计器的极小极大样本复杂度，并给出了样本复杂度与区间复杂度之间的完整权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Lau和Scarlett提出的最优两阶段协议使用第一轮的响应来选择第二轮的查询，这引出了一个核心问题：这一轮交互是否是必要的？理解自适应与非自适应协议的能力差距对于设计通信高效的分布式估计算法至关重要。

Method: 作者通过构造非自适应协议证明了其能达到自适应的1比特极小极大速率，从而否定地回答了交互必要性的问题。同时，对于one-set被限制为最多s个区间的并集的非自适应估计器，作者给出了其极小极大样本复杂度的完整刻画。

Result: 主要结果包括：(1) 对于每个k>1，非自适应协议能达到与自适应协议相同的1比特极小极大速率；(2) 在区间复杂度限制s下，非自适应1比特估计的样本复杂度相比无限制情况增加了一个(λσ/(sε²))log(1/δ)阶的项；(3) 作为推论，确定了维持无限制1比特极小极大样本速率所需的最小区间预算。

Conclusion: 本研究表明单轮交互（即自适应查询）并不是实现最优1比特均值估计所必需的，同时提供了样本复杂度与查询区间复杂性之间的完整权衡（精确到与k相关的常数因子）。

Abstract: We study distributed one-dimensional mean estimation under a 1-bit communication constraint. Each agent observes one sample, drawn independently from an unknown distribution, and returns a single bit in response to a query $Q: \mathbb{R}\to\{0,1\}$ chosen by a central learner. The distribution has mean in $[-λ,λ]$ and $k$-th central moment at most $σ^k$, for a fixed $k>1$. The order-optimal two-stage protocol of Lau and Scarlett uses responses from the first batch to choose the second-batch queries, motivating the question of whether this single round of interaction is necessary. We answer this negatively: for every $k>1$, a non-adaptive protocol attains the adaptive 1-bit minimax rate (and concurrent works reached the same conclusion via different strategies). We further determine the minimax sample complexity among non-adaptive 1-bit estimators when every one-set $Q^{-1}(1)$ is restricted to a union of at most $s$ intervals. Relative to unrestricted non-adaptive 1-bit querying, this constraint adds a term of order $(λσ/(s\varepsilon^2))\log(1/δ)$, giving the full tradeoff between sample complexity and interval complexity to within $k$-dependent constant factors. As a corollary, we identify, order-wise, the minimum interval budget needed to retain the unrestricted 1-bit minimax sample rate.

</details>


### [778] [Optimal estimation for Functional Linear Regression with Noisy Discretized Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.08671)
*Sixtine Sphabmixay*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文针对规则网格采样且含加性噪声的函数型协变量的标量-函数线性回归问题，提出了基于傅里叶投影重建曲线与三角空间惩罚最小二乘估计斜率函数的两步法，并证明了预测误差的oracle型不等式和极小极大最优收敛速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际的函数型数据往往只能在规则网格上被离散观测并受到加性噪声污染，而不是完整地观察到潜在的真实曲线。因此需要一种能够处理这种现实采样方案下的标量-函数线性回归建模与估计方法。

Method: 该方法分为两步：(1) 利用基于傅里叶的投影方法从离散含噪观测中重建潜在曲线；(2) 在有限维三角函数空间中，通过带数据驱动选择模型维数的惩罚最小二乘准则来估计斜率函数。分析中分别针对重建曲线和真实潜在曲线建立了预测误差的oracle型不等式。

Result: 在斜率函数满足正则性假设且协变量特征值呈多项式衰减的条件下，推导出了预测误差的收敛速率，证明当网格点数足够大时，所提估计量达到极小极大最优速率。并通过模拟数据和真实气象数据集进行了方法验证。

Conclusion: 所提出的两步估计方法在离散含噪函数型数据回归中具有良好的理论性质，能够实现极小极大最优的预测误差收敛速率，并在实际数据中展示了有效性。

Abstract: In this paper, we consider the scalar-on-function linear regression model under a realistic sampling scheme in which the functional covariates are observed on a regular grid and contaminated by additive noise. We propose a two-step estimation procedure: first, the underlying curves are reconstructed from the discrete noisy observations using a Fourier-based projection method; second, the slope function is estimated by a penalized least-squares criterion over finite-dimensional trigonometric spaces, with data-driven selection of the model dimension. We establish oracle-type inequalities for the prediction error, both with respect to the reconstructed curves and to the true latent curves. Under regularity assumptions on the slope function and polynomial decay of the eigenvalues of the covariate, we derive convergence rates for the prediction error and show that our estimator attains the minimax rate when the number of grid points is sufficiently large. Finally, the proposed method is illustrated on simulated data and on a real meteorological dataset.

</details>
